> {二|èr}、{请|qǐng}{在|zài}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{内|nèi}{填写|tián xiě}《{实习|shí xí}{人员|rén yuán}{表|biǎo}》，{并|bìng}{将|jiāng}{表格|biǎo gé}{交|jiāo}{到|dào}{三|sān}{楼|lóu}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}。{表格|biǎo gé}{内容|nèi róng}{要|yào}{详细|xiáng xì}、{正确|zhèng què}。
>
> {三|sān}、{上班|shàng bān}{时间|shí jiān}{为|wéi}{上午|shàng wǔ}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}{下午|xià wǔ}{五|wǔ}{点|diǎn}。{新闻|xīn wén}{多|duō}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{需要|xū yào}{加班|jiā bān}，{部门|bù mén}{会|huì}{提前|tí qián}{通知|tōng zhī}。
>
> {四|sì}、{办公室|bàn gōng shì}{现有|xiàn yǒu}{的|de}{电脑|diàn nǎo}{暂时|zàn shí}{不够|bú gòu}，{新|xīn}{同事|tóng shì}{可以|kě yǐ}{先|xiān}{使用|shǐ yòng}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{电脑|diàn nǎo}。{连接|lián jiē}{网络|wǎng luò}{时|shí}，{请|qǐng}{按照|àn zhào}{说明书|shuō míng shū}{上|shàng}{的|de}{要求|yāo qiú}{做|zuò}。
>
> {五|wǔ}、{每|měi}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{五|wǔ}{下午|xià wǔ}，{各|gè}{部门|bù mén}{将|jiāng}{进行|jìn xíng}{一|yí}{次|cì}{讨论|tǎo lùn}，{请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{提出|tí chū}{工作|gōng zuò}{中|zhōng}{遇到|yù dào}{的|de}{问题|wèn tí}。
>
> {六|liù}、{实习|shí xí}{期间|qī jiān}，{请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{按时|àn shí}{上下班|shàng xià bān}。{有|yǒu}{事|shì}{不|bù}{能|néng}{来|lái}{的|de}，{请|qǐng}{提前|tí qián}{跟|gēn}{部门|bù mén}{的|de}{编辑|biān jí}{联系|lián xì}。
>
> {有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{请|qǐng}{联系|lián xì}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}，{电话|diàn huà}：0000 1234。
>
> {网站|wǎng zhàn}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}
>
> {六|liù}{月|yuè}{二十八|èr shí bā}{日|rì}

Glosses: {关于|guān yú} (about, HSK 3), {不够|bú gòu} (not enough, lesson 15), {现|xiàn}{将|jiāng}{有关|yǒu guān}{事项|shì xiàng}{通知|tōng zhī}{如下|rú xià} (we hereby give notice of the following), {为|wéi} (is:
lesson 12), {至|zhì} (to), {期间|qī jiān} (the period of), {并|bìng} (and, written: lesson 14), {提前|tí qián} (in advance, lesson 17), {连接|lián jiē} (to connect), {网络|wǎng luò}
(the network), {讨论|tǎo lùn} (a discussion, lesson 14), {遇到|yù dào} (to meet, run into).

1. Who arranges the interns' work?
2. What must the interns do in their first three days?
3. Why can new colleagues bring their own computers?
4. What does the notice suggest the website wants from the Friday meetings?

<details>
<summary>Answers and translation</summary>

1. The editors of each department ({由|yóu}{各|gè}{部门|bù mén}{的|de}{编辑|biān jí}{负责|fù zé}{安排|ān pái}{和|hé}{管理|guǎn lǐ}).
2. Fill in the intern form, in detail and correctly, and hand it in at the third-floor office ({请|qǐng}{在|zài}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{内|nèi}
   {填写|tián xiě}《{实习|shí xí}{人员|rén yuán}{表|biǎo}》，{并|bìng}{将|jiāng}{表格|biǎo gé}{交|jiāo}{到|dào}{三|sān}{楼|lóu}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}).
3. There aren't enough computers in the office for now ({办公室|bàn gōng shì}{现有|xiàn yǒu}{的|de}{电脑|diàn nǎo}{暂时|zàn shí}{不够|bú gòu}).
4. It wants the interns to speak up about problems they meet at work, not just listen
   ({请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{提出|tí chū}{工作|gōng zuò}{中|zhōng}{遇到|yù dào}{的|de}{问题|wèn tí}): the website expects new staff to take part.

"**Notice for new interns.** Dear new colleagues, welcome to your internship at our website! To
make it easy for you to get to know the work, we give notice of the following. 1. The internship
runs from 1 July to 31 August. During it, your work will be arranged and managed by the editors of
each department. 2. Please fill in the 'Intern form' within three days and hand it in at the
third-floor office. The form should be detailed and correct. 3. Working hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.
When there's a lot of news, overtime will be needed; your department will tell you in advance. 4.
There aren't enough computers in the office at present, so for now new colleagues may use their
own. To connect to the network, please follow the instructions in the manual. 5. Every Friday
afternoon each department will hold a discussion: please bring up any problems you've met in your
work. 6. During the internship, please arrive and leave on time. If you can't come, please let
your department's editor know in advance. If you have questions, please contact the office: 0000 1234. Website office, 28 June."
</details>

## Write it

**A sentence about a picture.** The picture: in an office, a young woman sits at a desk writing on
a form; a colleague stands beside her, pointing at one line. Write one sentence with {填写|tián xiě}.

**A short notice.** Rewrite this spoken message as a written notice (two or three sentences),
using {将|jiāng}, {由|yóu} and {内|nèi}: {大家|dà jiā}{把|bǎ}{表|biǎo}{填|tián}{好|hǎo}，{三|sān}{天|tiān}{以内|yǐ nèi}{交|jiāo}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}。{表|biǎo}{上|shàng}{的|de}{问题|wèn tí}{小孟|Xiǎo Mèng}{负责|fù zé}{回答|huí dá}。

<details>
<summary>Model answers</summary>

- {同事|tóng shì}{在|zài}{告诉|gào su}{她|tā}{这|zhè}{张|zhāng}{表格|biǎo gé}{应该|yīng gāi}{怎么|zěn me}{填写|tián xiě}。 — Her colleague is showing her how to fill in the form. (Or:
  {她|tā}{正在|zhèng zài}{填写|tián xiě}{表格|biǎo gé}，{同事|tóng shì}{指出|zhǐ chū}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{错误|cuò wù}。 — She's filling in the form, and her colleague has pointed out a
  mistake.)
- {请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{将|jiāng}{表格|biǎo gé}{填写|tián xiě}{好|hǎo}，{三|sān}{天|tiān}{内|nèi}{交|jiāo}{到|dào}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}。{表格|biǎo gé}{上|shàng}{的|de}{问题|wèn tí}{由|yóu}{孟洁|Mèng Jié}{负责|fù zé}{回答|huí dá}。 — Please fill in the form and hand it in
  at the office within three days. Meng Jie will answer any questions about the form.
</details>

## Speaking: retell a passage

In the speaking test, as reported, you hear a short passage twice and retell it in your own words.
Play the passage below with **Play all**, or read it once, then cover it and retell it in about
forty seconds. Keep the order: who, where, what happened, how it ended.

```speak
# Wang Fang's first week
{王芳|Wáng Fāng}{大学|dà xué}{毕业|bì yè}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{在|zài}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{新闻|xīn wén}{网站|wǎng zhàn}{实习|shí xí}。
= After graduating, Wang Fang became an intern at a news website.
{第|dì}{一|yī}{天|tiān}，{负责|fù zé}{实习生|shí xí shēng}{的|de}{郑|Zhèng}{老师|lǎo shī}{带|dài}{她|tā}{看|kàn}{了|le}{部门|bù mén}，{给|gěi}{她|tā}{安排|ān pái}{了|le}{任务|rèn wu}。
= On the first day, Ms Zheng, who's in charge of the interns, showed her the department and gave her her tasks.
{按照|àn zhào}{规定|guī dìng}，{新人|xīn rén}{写|xiě}{的|de}{文章|wén zhāng}{都|dōu}{要|yào}{由|yóu}{郑|Zhèng}{老师|lǎo shī}{先|xiān}{查看|chá kàn}。
= Under the rules, everything newcomers write is looked over by Ms Zheng first.
{第|dì}{一|yī}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}，{王芳|Wáng Fāng}{写|xiě}{了|le}{三|sān}{篇|piān}{短|duǎn}{新闻|xīn wén}，{郑|Zhèng}{老师|lǎo shī}{指出|zhǐ chū}{了|le}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{小|xiǎo}{错误|cuò wù}，{也|yě}{表扬|biǎo yáng}{她|tā}{写|xiě}{得|de}{很|hěn}{认真|rèn zhēn}。
= In the first week Wang Fang wrote three short news items. Ms Zheng pointed out a few small mistakes, and also praised her for writing carefully.
{星期|xīng qī}{五|wǔ}{开会|kāi huì}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{王芳|Wáng Fāng}{提出|tí chū}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{新|xīn}{的|de}{想法|xiǎng fǎ}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{觉得|jué de}{不错|bú cuò}。
= At Friday's meeting, Wang Fang put forward a new idea, and everyone thought it was good.
```

<details>
<summary>A model retelling</summary>

{王芳|Wáng Fāng}{毕业|bì yè}{以后|yǐ hòu}{去|qù}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{新闻|xīn wén}{网站|wǎng zhàn}{实习|shí xí}。{郑|Zhèng}{老师|lǎo shī}{负责|fù zé}{管理|guǎn lǐ}{实习生|shí xí shēng}，{给|gěi}{她|tā}{安排|ān pái}{了|le}{工作|gōng zuò}。{新人|xīn rén}{的|de}{文章|wén zhāng}{要|yào}{先|xiān}{给|gěi}{郑|Zhèng}{老师|lǎo shī}{看|kàn}。{第|dì}{一|yī}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{她|tā}{写|xiě}{了|le}{三|sān}{篇|piān}{新闻|xīn wén}，{有|yǒu}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{小|xiǎo}{错误|cuò wù}，{但是|dàn shì}{郑|Zhèng}{老师|lǎo shī}{说|shuō}{她|tā}{很|hěn}{认真|rèn zhēn}。{星期|xīng qī}{五|wǔ}{开会|kāi huì}，{她|tā}{提|tí}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{想法|xiǎng fǎ}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{说|shuō}{好|hǎo}。

— After graduating, Wang Fang went to intern at a news website. Ms Zheng manages the interns and
gave her her work. Newcomers' articles go to Ms Zheng first. In the first week she wrote three news
items with a few small mistakes, but Ms Zheng said she was careful. At the Friday meeting she
suggested an idea and everyone said it was good. (A retelling can be simpler than the passage:
{提|tí} for {提出|tí chū}, {看|kàn} for {查看|chá kàn}.)
</details>

## Say it

```speak
# Office phrases
{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{由|yóu}{我|wǒ}{负责|fù zé}。
= I'm responsible for this.
{请|qǐng}{按照|àn zhào}{说明书|shuō míng shū}{使用|shǐ yòng}。
= Please use it according to the instructions.
{请|qǐng}{将|jiāng}{表格|biǎo gé}{交|jiāo}{到|dào}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}。
= Please hand the form in at the office.
{有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{请|qǐng}{跟|gēn}{我|wǒ}{联系|lián xì}。
= If you have any questions, please contact me.
{我|wǒ}{下|xià}{星期|xīng qī}{要|yào}{去|qù}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{出差|chū chāi}。
= I'm going to Shanghai on a business trip next week.
{新闻|xīn wén}{多|duō}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{要|yào}{加班|jiā bān}。
= When there's a lot of news, we have to work overtime.
```

## Pronunciation

- {由|yóu} yóu, {油|yóu} yóu, {邮|yóu} yóu: the same syllable, rising tone.
- {出差|chū chāi} chū chāi: 差 is **chāi** here (a work errand), not chà ({差点儿|chà diǎnr}) or chā. Two first tones.
- {规定|guī dìng} guī dìng and {管理|guǎn lǐ} guǎn lǐ: in guǎn lǐ, two third tones in a row are said 2+3 (guán lǐ): taught,
  not written.
- {详细|xiáng xì} xiáng xì: both x, both with the tongue flat behind the lower teeth.
- {暂时|zàn shí} zàn shí: z is unaspirated (like *ds*), zh in {指出|zhǐ chū} zhǐ chū is curled back.
- {任务|rèn wu} rèn wu: the second syllable is light.

## Common mistakes

- ~~{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{被|bèi}{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}{负责|fù zé}~~: whose job it is takes {由|yóu}: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{由|yóu}{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}{负责|fù zé}. {被|bèi} is for something done to the
  subject.
- ~~{请|qǐng}{将|jiāng}{表格|biǎo gé}~~ with nothing after the verb: like {把|bǎ}, {将|jiāng} needs a complete verb phrase: {请|qǐng}{将|jiāng}{表格|biǎo gé}{交|jiāo}{到|dào}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}, {请|qǐng}{将|jiāng}
  {表格|biǎo gé}{填写|tián xiě}{好|hǎo}.
- {进行|jìn xíng} + a one-syllable verb sounds wrong: ~~{进行|jìn xíng}{谈|tán}~~ → {进行|jìn xíng}{讨论|tǎo lùn}, or just {谈一谈|tán yi tán}.
- {按照|àn zhào} vs {根据|gēn jù}: {按照|àn zhào}{规定|guī dìng} (following the rules), {根据|gēn jù}{天气|tiān qì}{预报|yù bào} (based on the forecast). {根据|gēn jù}{说明书|shuō míng shū}{使用|shǐ yòng} is heard
  but less natural than {按照|àn zhào}{说明书|shuō míng shū}{使用|shǐ yòng}.
- Don't mix registers in a casual chat: {我|wǒ}{将|jiāng}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{书|shū}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}{了|le} is correct but sounds like a notice. Say
  {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{书|shū}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}{了|le}.
- {出差|chū chāi} is a business trip, not any trip: a holiday is {旅游|lǚ yóu} or {旅行|lǚ xíng} (lesson 18).

## Key points

- {由|yóu} + doer + verb: whose job it is (formal): {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{由|yóu}{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}{负责|fù zé}. {由|yóu} also "from": {由此|yóu cǐ}{进入|jìn rù}.
- {按照|àn zhào} / {按|àn} + rule, plan, instructions: according to. {按|àn} also "to press". {根据|gēn jù}: on the basis of facts.
- {将|jiāng} = written {把|bǎ}: {请|qǐng}{将|jiāng}{表格|biǎo gé}{交|jiāo}{到|dào}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}. In speech, {把|bǎ}.
- Written ↔ spoken: {使用|shǐ yòng} / {用|yòng}, {查看|chá kàn} / {看看|kàn kan}, {填写|tián xiě} / {填|tián}, {内|nèi} / {以内|yǐ nèi}, {现有|xiàn yǒu} / {现在|xiàn zài}{有|yǒu}{的|de}, {至|zhì} / {到|dào}, {进行|jìn xíng} + two-syllable verb.
- Office words: {部门|bù mén}, {单位|dān wèi}, {人员|rén yuán}, {任务|rèn wu}, {安排|ān pái}, {管理|guǎn lǐ} / {管|guǎn}, {办公|bàn gōng}, {办理|bàn lǐ}, {办事|bàn shì}, {加班|jiā bān}, {出差|chū chāi}, {联系|lián xì}, {定|dìng}, {同时|tóng shí}, {提出|tí chū},
  {指出|zhǐ chū}; forms: {通知|tōng zhī}, {规定|guī dìng}, {说明|shuō míng} / {说明书|shuō míng shū}, {表格|biǎo gé} / {表|biǎo}, {材料|cái liào}, {文件|wén jiàn}, {详细|xiáng xì}, {正式|zhèng shì}, {暂时|zàn shí}, {便于|biàn yú}.
- New characters: {部|bù} {材|cái} {管|guǎn} {规|guī} {联|lián} {使|shǐ} {填|tián} {详|xiáng} {指|zhǐ} {暂|zàn} {式|shì} {由|yóu}; ✎ {部|bù} {管|guǎn} {联|lián} {使|shǐ} {指|zhǐ} {式|shì} {由|yóu}.

The words from this lesson are listed below; they join your vocabulary reviews when you complete
the lesson.

lessons.title: Working with others: 尽管, 然而, 却 and 并不
lessons.body:
## What this lesson is for

Work means other people: meetings where colleagues don't agree, suggestions to make and turn down,
misunderstandings to clear up, apologies and thanks. This lesson gives you the words to disagree
politely and the grammar of **[[concession]]** and contrast: saying "although…", "however", "but" and
"not at all" in the ways Chinese does.

You'll learn:

- {尽管|jǐn guǎn}…{但是|dàn shì} / {可是|kě shì} / {还是|hái shi} / {却|què}, "although, even though", and {尽管|jǐn guǎn} "feel free to";
- {然而|rán ér} (however: written), {不过|bú guò} (but: mild, spoken) and {却|què} (but, yet: after the subject);
- {并|bìng} + {不|bù} / {没|méi}, "(not) at all, not really", correcting what someone expects;
- agreeing and disagreeing: {支持|zhī chí} and {反对|fǎn duì}, {建议|jiàn yì}, {意见|yì jiàn}, {商量|shāng liang}, {讨论|tǎo lùn}, {交流|jiāo liú}, {谈|tán}, {提|tí}, {答应|dā ying} and {拒绝|jù jué}, {接受|jiē shòu}, {理解|lǐ jiě},
  {解释|jiě shì}, {误会|wù huì}, {互相|hù xiāng} and {相互|xiāng hù}, {共同|gòng tóng}, {对方|duì fāng}, {另|lìng};
- apologising and thanking: {道歉|dào qiàn}, {抱歉|bào qiàn}, {原谅|yuán liàng}, {感谢|gǎn xiè}, {打扰|dǎ rǎo}, {麻烦|má fan}, {打招呼|dǎ zhāo hu}, {点头|diǎn tóu}; and {批评|pī píng}, {不满|bù mǎn}, {不必|bú bì}, {实在|shí zài},
  {再说|zài shuō}, {指|zhǐ}, {表示|biǎo shì}.

## {尽管|jǐn guǎn}: although, even though

{尽管|jǐn guǎn} starts a clause that admits a fact; the second clause says what is true **all the same**. The
second clause takes {但是|dàn shì}, {可是|kě shì}, {还是|hái shi} or {却|què}, as {虽然|suī rán} (HSK 2) does:

{尽管|jǐn guǎn}{工作|gōng zuò}{很|hěn}{辛苦|xīn kǔ}，{但是|dàn shì}{她|tā}{从来|cóng lái}{不|bù}{说|shuō}{累|lèi}。 — Although the work is hard, she never says she's tired.

{尽管|jǐn guǎn}{下|xià}{着|zhe}{雨|yǔ}，{他|tā}{还是|hái shi}{来|lái}{了|le}。 — Even though it was raining, he still came.

{尽管|jǐn guǎn}{我们|wǒ men}{意见|yì jiàn}{不同|bù tóng}，{可是|kě shì}{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{尊重|zūn zhòng}{对方|duì fāng}。 — Although we disagree, we respect each other. ({尊重|zūn zhòng}: to
respect, lesson 22; {对方|duì fāng}: the other side.)

Sentences like these are sentences of **[[concession]]**: you concede one point, then say the other
still holds. {尽管|jǐn guǎn} and {虽然|suī rán} are close. {尽管|jǐn guǎn} is a little more emphatic ("even though") and a little more
written; in everyday speech {虽然|suī rán} is more common. Both need the second half.

As an adverb, {尽管|jǐn guǎn} has another, friendly meaning: **feel free to, don't hesitate to**:

{有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{你|nǐ}{尽管|jǐn guǎn}{问|wèn}。 — If you have questions, just ask.

{你|nǐ}{尽管|jǐn guǎn}{放心|fàng xīn}，{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{交|jiāo}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{吧|ba}。 — Don't worry at all: leave it to me.

Note the reading: jǐn guǎn, third tones (said jín guǎn). With the traditional script on, {尽管|jǐn guǎn} is
written {+{尽管|jǐn guǎn}+}, with a different character from the {尽|jìn} of other words ({尽力|jìn lì}, to do one's best).

## {然而|rán ér}, {不过|bú guò} and {却|què}: three kinds of "but"

**{然而|rán ér}** (however) is written and formal. It starts a clause, after a full stop or a comma, and
contrasts it with all that came before:

{这个|zhè ge}{计划|jì huà}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。{然而|rán ér}，{我们|wǒ men}{现在|xiàn zài}{的|de}{人|rén}{太|tài}{少|shǎo}{了|le}。 — This is a good plan. However, there are too few of us at
the moment.

**{不过|bú guò}** (but) is softer than {但是|dàn shì} and very common in speech. It often adds a small reservation:

{这个|zhè ge}{办法|bàn fǎ}{不错|bú cuò}，{不过|bú guò}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{麻烦|má fan}。 — This method's not bad, but it's a bit of a nuisance.

{我|wǒ}{同意|tóng yì}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{意见|yì jiàn}，{不过|bú guò}{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{再|zài}{补充|bǔ chōng}{一|yì}{点|diǎn}。 — I agree with you, but I'd like to add one point. ({补充|bǔ chōng}: to add.)

{不过|bú guò} also means "only, no more than": {他|tā}{不过|bú guò}{是|shì}{个|gè}{孩子|hái zi} (he's only a child).

**{却|què}** (but, yet) is an **[[adverb]]**: it goes **after the subject**, before the verb, and marks
something unexpected:

{他|tā}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}，{却|què}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{休息|xiū xi}。 — He's very tired, yet he doesn't want to rest.

{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{同意|tóng yì}{了|le}，{他|tā}{却|què}{反对|fǎn duì}。 — Everyone agreed, but he was against it.

So ~~{却|què}{他|tā}{反对|fǎn duì}~~ is wrong: {却|què} never comes before a subject. It can join {但是|dàn shì} or {可是|kě shì} in the same
clause for emphasis: {他|tā}{学|xué}{了|le}{很|hěn}{久|jiǔ}，{但是|dàn shì}{却|què}{说|shuō}{得|de}{不|bú}{太|tài}{好|hǎo} (he studied for a long time, and yet he doesn't speak
it very well). {尽管|jǐn guǎn} often pairs with {却|què}: {尽管|jǐn guǎn}{他|tā}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}，{却|què}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{休息|xiū xi}.

| Word | Register | Position | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| {但是|dàn shì} / {可是|kě shì} | neutral | start of the clause | {他|tā}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}，{但是|dàn shì}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{休息|xiū xi}。 |
| {不过|bú guò} | spoken, mild | start of the clause | {不错|bú cuò}，{不过|bú guò}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{贵|guì}。 |
| {然而|rán ér} | written | start of the clause | {然而|rán ér}，{我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{人|rén}{太|tài}{少|shǎo}{了|le}。 |
| {却|què} | neutral, emphatic | after the subject | {他|tā}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}，{却|què}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{休息|xiū xi}。 |

## {并|bìng} + {不|bù} / {没|méi}: not at all

{并|bìng} before {不|bù} or {没|méi} corrects something that someone expects or assumes: "actually not, not at all":

{他|tā}{并|bìng}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}。 — He doesn't actually know about this (as you might think).

{我|wǒ}{并|bìng}{没有|méi yǒu}{生气|shēng qì}，{你|nǐ}{别|bié}{担心|dān xīn}。 — I'm not angry at all, don't worry.

{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{并|bìng}{不|bù}{难|nán}。 — This question isn't really that hard.

{并|bìng} adds weight: compare plain {他|tā}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào} (he doesn't know) with {他|tā}{并|bìng}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào} (he doesn't know, whatever you
thought). It's common with {却|què} and {其实|qí shí} (actually): {大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{以为|yǐ wéi}{他|tā}{很|hěn}{高兴|gāo xìng}，{其实|qí shí}{他|tā}{并|bìng}{不|bù}{高兴|gāo xìng} (everyone thought he
was happy; in fact he wasn't at all).

In writing, {并|bìng} alone is also "and", joining two verbs: {请|qǐng}{填写|tián xiě}{表格|biǎo gé}，{并|bìng}{交|jiāo}{到|dào}{办公室|bàn gōng shì} (please fill in the form and
hand it in at the office: lesson 13's notice). {并且|bìng qiě} (lesson 04) does the same.

Some notes:

- {意见|yì jiàn} is your view, but often a **critical** one: {我|wǒ}{对|duì}{这个|zhè ge}{计划|jì huà}{有|yǒu}{意见|yì jiàn} is "I have objections to this plan".
  {你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{意见|yì jiàn}？ asks for views, and may sound like "any complaints?": in a meeting, {大家|dà jiā}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{看法|kàn fǎ}？
  (lesson 25) is gentler.
- {商量|shāng liang} is talking something over to decide together, often in pairs or families: {跟|gēn}…{商量|shāng liang}. {讨论|tǎo lùn} is a
  discussion, often in a group, about a question: {讨论|tǎo lùn}{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}. {交流|jiāo liú} is an exchange of ideas or
  experience: {交流|jiāo liú}{经验|jīng yàn} (to share experience).
- {理解|lǐ jiě} is understanding someone's point of view or feelings: {我|wǒ}{理解|lǐ jiě}{你|nǐ} (I understand how you feel). {了解|liǎo jiě}
  (HSK 3) is knowing about something well; {明白|míng bai} is getting it.
- {解释|jiě shì} is explaining (why something happened, what a word means). {说明|shuō míng} (lesson 13) is setting something
  out, as instructions do.
- {提|tí} is to mention or raise: {提|tí}{意见|yì jiàn} (to make a criticism, a suggestion), {提|tí}{问题|wèn tí}. It's also "to carry in
  the hand": {提|tí}{着|zhe}{一|yí}{个|gè}{包|bāo} (carrying a bag).
- {指|zhǐ} is "to point at", and "to mean, to refer to": {他|tā}{说|shuō}{的|de}"{老师|lǎo shī}"{是|shì}{指|zhǐ}{郑华|Zhèng Huá} (by "teacher" he means Zheng Hua).
- {互相|hù xiāng} and {相互|xiāng hù} both mean "each other". {互相|hù xiāng} goes before the verb ({互相|hù xiāng}{帮助|bāng zhù}, {互相|hù xiāng}{理解|lǐ jiě}); {相互|xiāng hù} is more
  written and can also go before a noun ({相互|xiāng hù}{的|de}{理解|lǐ jiě}, mutual understanding).
- {共同|gòng tóng} is shared, joint, together: {共同|gòng tóng}{的|de}{目标|mù biāo} (a common goal), {共同|gòng tóng}{努力|nǔ lì} (to work together).
- {对方|duì fāng} is "the other side": the other person in a conversation, the other team, the other company.
- {另|lìng} is "another, other": {另|lìng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}, {另|lìng}{一|yí}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}. {另外|lìng wài} (lesson 04) also starts a clause, "besides".
- {再说|zài shuō} is "besides, what's more", giving a second reason: {今天|jīn tiān}{太|tài}{晚|wǎn}{了|le}，{再说|zài shuō}{外面|wài miàn}{还|hái}{下|xià}{着|zhe}{雨|yǔ} (it's too late
  today, and besides it's still raining). It's also "let's talk about it later": {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{以后|yǐ hòu}{再说|zài shuō}{吧|ba}.

## Apologising, thanking and being polite

| Word | Meaning | Example |
|---|---|---|
| {道歉|dào qiàn} | to apologise | {我|wǒ}{向|xiàng}{你|nǐ}{道歉|dào qiàn}。 I apologise to you. |
| {抱歉|bào qiàn} | sorry, apologetic (an adjective) | {很|hěn}{抱歉|bào qiàn}，{我|wǒ}{来|lái}{晚|wǎn}{了|le}。 Sorry I'm late. |
| {原谅|yuán liàng} | to forgive | {请|qǐng}{原谅|yuán liàng}{我|wǒ}。 Please forgive me. |
| {感谢|gǎn xiè} | to thank (formal) | {感谢|gǎn xiè}{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{支持|zhī chí}！ Thank you all for your support! |
| {打扰|dǎ rǎo} | to disturb | {对不起|duì bu qǐ}，{打扰|dǎ rǎo}{一下|yí xià}。 Sorry to bother you. |
| {麻烦|má fan} | troublesome; to trouble | {麻烦|má fan}{你|nǐ}{帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{一下|yí xià}。 Could you have a look for me? |
| {打招呼|dǎ zhāo hu} | to greet, say hello | {他|tā}{跟|gēn}{我|wǒ}{打|dǎ}{了|le}{个|gè}{招呼|zhāo hu}。 He said hello to me. |
| {点头|diǎn tóu} | to nod | {她|tā}{点|diǎn}{了|le}{点|diǎn}{头|tóu}。 She nodded. |

- {道歉|dào qiàn} is a verb with no object: you {向|xiàng} (or {跟|gēn}) someone {道歉|dào qiàn}: {我|wǒ}{向|xiàng}{他|tā}{道歉|dào qiàn}{了|le}. Not ~~{我|wǒ}{道歉|dào qiàn}{他|tā}~~.
- {抱歉|bào qiàn} is an adjective: {很|hěn}{抱歉|bào qiàn}, {非常|fēi cháng}{抱歉|bào qiàn} (I'm very sorry). It's more formal than {对不起|duì bu qǐ}.
- {麻烦|má fan}{你|nǐ}… is the polite way to ask a favour: "could I trouble you to…". As an adjective, {很|hěn}{麻烦|má fan} is "a
  hassle". {给|gěi}{你|nǐ}{添|tiān}{麻烦|má fan}{了|le} (sorry to have caused you trouble) is a polite thank-you after help.
- {打扰|dǎ rǎo} is to disturb: {打扰|dǎ rǎo}{一下|yí xià} (excuse me, sorry to bother you), and on leaving someone's home or office,
  {打扰|dǎ rǎo}{了|le} (sorry to have taken up your time).
- {打招呼|dǎ zhāo hu} is greeting someone, by a word, a wave or a nod; it's also "to tell someone beforehand": {走|zǒu}{以前|yǐ qián}
  {跟|gēn}{我|wǒ}{打|dǎ}{个|gè}{招呼|zhāo hu} (let me know before you go).
- {不必|bú bì} is "need not, there's no need": {你|nǐ}{不必|bú bì}{道歉|dào qiàn} (you needn't apologise). It's the polite opposite of
  {必须|bì xū} (HSK 3).
- {实在|shí zài} is "really, truly", with a feeling: {实在|shí zài}{抱歉|bào qiàn} (I'm truly sorry), {我|wǒ}{实在|shí zài}{太|tài}{累|lèi}{了|le}. As an adjective it's
  "honest, down to earth": {他|tā}{这个|zhè ge}{人|rén}{很|hěn}{实在|shí zài}.
- {批评|pī píng} is to criticise; {表扬|biǎo yáng} (lesson 04) is its opposite. {不满|bù mǎn} is dissatisfied, discontent: {对|duì}…{很|hěn}{不满|bù mǎn}, {表示|biǎo shì}
  {不满|bù mǎn} (to express dissatisfaction).
- {表示|biǎo shì} is to express, show: {表示|biǎo shì}{感谢|gǎn xiè} (to express thanks), {点头|diǎn tóu}{表示|biǎo shì}{同意|tóng yì} (to nod in agreement).

### Sound parts

- **包 → 抱 饱 跑.** 抱 bào is 扌 (hand) + 包 bāo: holding in your arms. You know 包 in 饱
  bǎo (full) and 跑 pǎo (to run).
- **仑 → 论 轮.** 论 lùn is 讠 + 仑; the same part gives 轮 lún (a wheel, later).
- **平 → 评 苹.** 评 píng is 讠 + 平 píng; 苹 píng ({苹果|píng guǒ}) has it too.
- **比 → 批.** 批 pī is 扌 + 比 bǐ: the sound is close.
- **巨 → 拒 距.** 拒 jù is 扌 + 巨 jù; 距 ({距离|jù lí}, lesson 16) has the same sound part.
- **乎 → 呼.** 呼 hū is 口 + 乎 hū ({几乎|jī hū}, HSK 3): an exact match.

### Families and look-alikes

- **讠 (speech)**: 谈, 讨, 论, 评 join 说, 话, 语, 请 and 译 ({翻译|fān yì}, lesson 03). In
  traditional the part is 訁 on the left: 談, 討, 論, 評.
- **欠** is on the right of 歉, as in 歌 (song), 欢 (happy) and 次.
- **反 and 友.** 反 (against) has a left-falling stroke on top and 又 inside; 友 (friend) is
  𠂇 + 又. 反 is also the sound part of 饭 fàn and 板 bǎn ({黑板|hēi bǎn}).
- **却 and 脚.** 却 què is 去 + 卩; 脚 jiǎo (foot) is 月 + 却. Traditional 卻 has 谷
  instead of 去.
- **尽**: 尺 with two dots below. Simplified 尽 stands for two traditional characters, 儘 and
  盡; the switch writes 儘管 for {尽管|jǐn guǎn}.

### Stroke order

- **建**: 聿 first (the bent stroke, four horizontals, the long vertical), then 廴 last, just
  as 辶 comes last in 这: radicals that wrap round the bottom left are written after what they
  hold.
- **互**: the top horizontal, then a bent stroke (left-falling-turn), then a horizontal-left-
  falling stroke, and the bottom horizontal last: four strokes.
- **反**: the left-falling stroke on top, then the long left-falling stroke, then 又.
- **麻**: 广 first, then the two 木 (each a horizontal, a vertical and a left-falling stroke;
  the first ends with a dot, the second with a right-falling stroke).

## Dialogue: two ideas for the summer feature

At the Friday meeting, {郑华|Zhèng Huá} (Zheng Hua) asks the interns for ideas for a summer feature ({专题|zhuān tí}).
{许东|Xǔ Dōng} (Xu Dong), a young reporter, and {孟洁|Mèng Jié} (Meng Jie) don't agree.

```dialogue
# A difference of opinion
郑华: {今天|jīn tiān}{我们|wǒ men}{讨论|tǎo lùn}{一下|yí xià}{暑假|shǔ jià}{专题|zhuān tí}。{大家|dà jiā}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{建议|jiàn yì}，{尽管|jǐn guǎn}{提|tí}。

= I suggest writing about students with summer jobs. More and more students work in the holidays; people should be interested.
孟洁: {这个|zhè ge}{想法|xiǎng fǎ}{不错|bú cuò}，{不过|bú guò}{我|wǒ}{有|yǒu}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{不同|bù tóng}{的|de}{意见|yì jiàn}。{打工|dǎ gōng}{的|de}{事|shì}，{去年|qù nián}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{网站|wǎng zhàn}{都|dōu}{写|xiě}{过|guo}{了|le}。

= I'm not against your idea at all. I just think this year's graduates looking for jobs are more worth writing about.

= Graduates matter, of course. But do they have much to do with our readers?
孟洁: {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{读者|dú zhě}{里|lǐ}，{大学生|dà xué shēng}{和|hé}{毕业生|bì yè shēng}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{啊|a}。
= Our readers include plenty of students and graduates, though.
郑华: {你们|nǐ men}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}{的|de}{意见|yì jiàn}{都|dōu}{有道理|yǒu dào li}。{王芳|Wáng Fāng}，{你|nǐ}{怎么|zěn me}{看|kàn}？

= Good, that's settled then. Wang Fang and Meng Jie will do the graduates, Xiao Xu the students with summer jobs.
```

- {尽管|jǐn guǎn}{提|tí}: {尽管|jǐn guǎn} as an adverb, "don't hesitate to".
- {我|wǒ}{有|yǒu}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{不同|bù tóng}{的|de}{意见|yì jiàn}: a soft way to disagree, with {不过|bú guò} before it.
- {我|wǒ}{并|bìng}{不|bú}{是|shì}{反对|fǎn duì}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{想法|xiǎng fǎ}: {并|bìng}{不|bú}{是|shì} corrects what he might assume. {只是|zhǐ shì} (just, only, HSK 3) softens the point.
- {然而|rán ér} is a little formal in speech; {许东|Xǔ Dōng} uses it to sound reasonable. Most people would say {但是|dàn shì}.
- {想法|xiǎng fǎ} (an idea: lesson 25), {值得|zhí de} (worth: lesson 18), {道理|dào li} (reason, sense: {有道理|yǒu dào li}, to have a point), {直接|zhí jiē} (direct, blunt: lesson 17),
  {嗯|èn} (hmm: lesson 23), {嘛|ma} (a particle: "after all, you see").
- {你|nǐ}{别|bié}{误会|wù huì}: don't misunderstand me, a common way to soften what you've just said.

## Reading: a misunderstanding in the office

A post by {王芳|Wáng Fāng} (Wang Fang) on her blog about her second week at work.

> **{一|yí}{个|gè}{小|xiǎo}{误会|wù huì}**
>
> {上|shàng}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}，{我们|wǒ men}{部门|bù mén}{发生|fā shēng}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小|xiǎo}{误会|wù huì}。
>
> {许东|Xǔ Dōng}{刚|gāng}{来|lái}{部门|bù mén}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{每|měi}{天|tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{都|dōu}{跟|gēn}{大家|dà jiā}{打招呼|dǎ zhāo hu}。{可是|kě shì}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{天|tiān}，{孟洁|Mèng Jié}{从|cóng}{他|tā}{旁边|páng biān}{走|zǒu}{过|guò}，{却|què}{没有|méi yǒu}{跟|gēn}{他|tā}{说话|shuō huà}，{也|yě}{没有|méi yǒu}{点头|diǎn tóu}。{第|dì}{二|èr}{天|tiān}{又|yòu}{是|shì}{这样|zhè yàng}。{许东|Xǔ Dōng}{觉得|jué de}{很|hěn}{奇怪|qí guài}，{心里|xīn li}{也|yě}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{不满|bù mǎn}，{以为|yǐ wéi}{孟洁|Mèng Jié}{对|duì}{他|tā}{有|yǒu}{意见|yì jiàn}。
>
> {尽管|jǐn guǎn}{他|tā}{很|hěn}{不|bù}{高兴|gāo xìng}，{但是|dàn shì}{他|tā}{没有|méi yǒu}{说|shuō}{什么|shén me}。{直到|zhí dào}{星期|xīng qī}{五|wǔ}{开会|kāi huì}，{他|tā}{才|cái}{把|bǎ}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{告诉|gào su}{了|le}{我|wǒ}。{我|wǒ}{觉得|jué de}{孟洁|Mèng Jié}{并|bìng}{不|bú}{是|shì}{这样|zhè yàng}{的|de}{人|rén}，{就|jiù}{去|qù}{问|wèn}{她|tā}。
>
> {原来|yuán lái}，{孟洁|Mèng Jié}{那|nà}{几|jǐ}{天|tiān}{眼镜|yǎn jìng}{坏|huài}{了|le}，{看|kàn}{东西|dōng xi}{很|hěn}{不|bù}{清楚|qīng chu}，{她|tā}{并|bìng}{没有|méi yǒu}{看见|kàn jiàn}{许东|Xǔ Dōng}！{她|tā}{听|tīng}{了|le}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{马上|mǎ shàng}{去|qù}{向|xiàng}{许东|Xǔ Dōng}{道歉|dào qiàn}："{实在|shí zài}{抱歉|bào qiàn}，{我|wǒ}{真|zhēn}{的|de}{没|méi}{看见|kàn jiàn}{你|nǐ}，{请|qǐng}{你|nǐ}{原谅|yuán liàng}。"{许东|Xǔ Dōng}{也|yě}{笑|xiào}{了|le}，{说|shuō}："{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{误会|wù huì}{你|nǐ}{了|le}，{不必|bú bì}{道歉|dào qiàn}。"
>
> {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{明白|míng bai}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{道理|dào li}：{同事|tóng shì}{之间|zhī jiān}{有|yǒu}{了|le}{问题|wèn tí}，{最好|zuì hǎo}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{说|shuō}{出来|chū lái}，{互相|hù xiāng}{交流|jiāo liú}，{互相|hù xiāng}{理解|lǐ jiě}。{要不然|yào bù rán}，{小|xiǎo}{误会|wù huì}{也|yě}{可能|kě néng}{变成|biàn chéng}{大|dà}{问题|wèn tí}。

Glosses: {发生|fā shēng} (to happen), {奇怪|qí guài} (strange), {以为|yǐ wéi} (to think wrongly, HSK 3), {直到|zhí dào} (until), {原来|yuán lái} (it turned out:
lesson 20), {眼镜|yǎn jìng} (glasses: lesson 06), {坏|huài} (broken), {之间|zhī jiān} (between: lesson 21), {要不然|yào bù rán} (otherwise, spoken).

1. Why did Xu Dong think Meng Jie had something against him?
2. Why hadn't Meng Jie greeted him?
3. How did Meng Jie put things right?
4. What does the writer think colleagues should do, and why?

<details>
<summary>Answers and translation</summary>

1. Two days running she walked past him without speaking or nodding ({从|cóng}{他|tā}{旁边|páng biān}{走|zǒu}{过|guò}，{却|què}{没有|méi yǒu}{跟|gēn}{他|tā}{说话|shuō huà}，{也|yě}{没有|méi yǒu}
   {点头|diǎn tóu}).
2. Her glasses were broken and she couldn't see clearly: she hadn't seen him at all ({她|tā}{并|bìng}{没有|méi yǒu}{看见|kàn jiàn}{许东|Xǔ Dōng}).
3. She went straight to him and apologised ({马上|mǎ shàng}{去|qù}{向|xiàng}{许东|Xǔ Dōng}{道歉|dào qiàn}: {实在|shí zài}{抱歉|bào qiàn}…{请|qǐng}{你|nǐ}{原谅|yuán liàng}).
4. Bring problems up early and talk them through, so as to understand each other ({早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{说|shuō}{出来|chū lái}，{互相|hù xiāng}{交流|jiāo liú}，
   {互相|hù xiāng}{理解|lǐ jiě}); otherwise a small misunderstanding can turn into a big problem. The writer is drawing a
   lesson from a story that could easily have gone the other way.

"**A small misunderstanding.** Last week there was a small misunderstanding in our department.
When Xu Dong first joined the department, he said hello to everyone every morning. But one day Meng
Jie walked right past him without a word or a nod. The next day it happened again. Xu Dong thought
it very strange, and was a bit annoyed: he assumed she had something against him. Although he was
upset, he didn't say anything. It wasn't until Friday's meeting that he told me about it. I didn't
think Meng Jie was like that, so I went and asked her. It turned out that her glasses had been
broken those few days and she couldn't see clearly: she hadn't seen Xu Dong at all! When she heard,
she went straight to Xu Dong and apologised: 'I'm truly sorry, I really didn't see you. Please
forgive me.' Xu Dong laughed too and said: 'It was my misunderstanding. There's no need to
apologise.' This taught me something: when colleagues have a problem, it's best to bring it up
early, talk to each other and understand each other. Otherwise, even a small misunderstanding can
turn into a big problem."
</details>

## Write it

**A sentence about a picture.** The picture: in a meeting room, a woman is showing a chart on the
screen; one man at the table is shaking his head, another is nodding. Write one sentence with {反对|fǎn duì}
or {支持|zhī chí}.

**A short apology.** You promised a colleague you'd finish part of a report yesterday, but you
didn't. Write a short message (two or three sentences) with {抱歉|bào qiàn} or {道歉|dào qiàn} and {尽管|jǐn guǎn} or {不过|bú guò}.

<details>
<summary>Model answers</summary>

- {一|yí}{个|gè}{同事|tóng shì}{支持|zhī chí}{她|tā}{的|de}{建议|jiàn yì}，{另|lìng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{同事|tóng shì}{却|què}{反对|fǎn duì}。 — One colleague supports her suggestion, but the other is
  against it. (Or: {她|tā}{在|zài}{说明|shuō míng}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{想法|xiǎng fǎ}，{有|yǒu}{人|rén}{点头|diǎn tóu}，{有|yǒu}{人|rén}{摇头|yáo tóu}。 {摇头|yáo tóu}: to shake one's head.)
- {小李|Xiǎo Lǐ}，{实在|shí zài}{抱歉|bào qiàn}！{我|wǒ}{答应|dā ying}{昨天|zuó tiān}{做|zuò}{完|wán}，{可是|kě shì}{没|méi}{做|zuò}{完|wán}。{尽管|jǐn guǎn}{今天|jīn tiān}{很|hěn}{忙|máng}，{但是|dàn shì}{我|wǒ}{下班|xià bān}{以前|yǐ qián}{一定|yí dìng}{发|fā}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ}，{请|qǐng}{你|nǐ}{原谅|yuán liàng}。
  — Xiao Li, I'm truly sorry! I promised to finish it yesterday, but I didn't. Although today is
  busy, I'll definitely send it to you before I leave work. Please forgive me.
</details>

## Say it

```speak
# Disagreeing politely
{这个|zhè ge}{想法|xiǎng fǎ}{不错|bú cuò}，{不过|bú guò}{我|wǒ}{有|yǒu}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{不同|bù tóng}{的|de}{意见|yì jiàn}。
= That's a good idea, but I see it a bit differently.
{我|wǒ}{并|bìng}{不|bú}{是|shì}{反对|fǎn duì}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{想法|xiǎng fǎ}。
= I'm not against your idea at all.
{你们|nǐ men}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}{的|de}{意见|yì jiàn}{都|dōu}{有道理|yǒu dào li}。
= You both have a point.
{有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{你|nǐ}{尽管|jǐn guǎn}{问|wèn}。
= If you have questions, just ask.
{实在|shí zài}{抱歉|bào qiàn}，{请|qǐng}{你|nǐ}{原谅|yuán liàng}。
= I'm truly sorry; please forgive me.
{对不起|duì bu qǐ}，{打扰|dǎ rǎo}{一下|yí xià}。
= Sorry to bother you.
{感谢|gǎn xiè}{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{支持|zhī chí}！
= Thank you all for your support!
```

## Pronunciation

- {尽管|jǐn guǎn} jǐn guǎn: two third tones, said jín guǎn. {并|bìng} bìng: falling, with *-ing*.
- {却|què} què, {缺|quē} quē (lesson 12): q + üe, written ue; only the tone differs.
- {答应|dā ying} dā ying: first tone, then light; the {答|dá} of {回答|huí dá} is dá, rising.
- {商量|shāng liang} shāng liang and {麻烦|má fan} má fan: light second syllables.
- {然而|rán ér} rán ér: two separate syllables (written rán'ér in running pinyin), not *ránér* run together.
- {误会|wù huì} wù huì and {意见|yì jiàn} yì jiàn: two falling tones each.
- {打招呼|dǎ zhāo hu} dǎ zhāo hu: light hu at the end.

## Common mistakes

- ~~{却|què}{他|tā}{反对|fǎn duì}~~: {却|què} is an adverb and goes after the subject: {他|tā}{却|què}{反对|fǎn duì}.
- ~~{我|wǒ}{道歉|dào qiàn}{他|tā}~~: {道歉|dào qiàn} has no object: {我|wǒ}{向|xiàng}{他|tā}{道歉|dào qiàn} (or {跟|gēn}{他|tā}{道歉|dào qiàn}).
- ~~{尽管|jǐn guǎn}{下雨|xià yǔ}~~ on its own: {尽管|jǐn guǎn} "although" needs a second clause: {尽管|jǐn guǎn}{下|xià}{着|zhe}{雨|yǔ}，{他|tā}{还是|hái shi}{来|lái}{了|le}.
- {他|tā}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào} and {他|tā}{并|bìng}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào} are both correct; {并|bìng} adds "contrary to what you'd think". Don't use {并|bìng} without a
  reason to correct someone.
- {我|wǒ}{对|duì}{你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{意见|yì jiàn} is strong: it means "I have a complaint about you". To ask for views gently, say {你|nǐ}{觉得|jué de}
  {怎么样|zěn me yàng}？ or {你|nǐ}{怎么|zěn me}{看|kàn}？
- {理解|lǐ jiě} and {了解|liǎo jiě}: {我|wǒ}{理解|lǐ jiě}{你|nǐ} (I understand how you feel), {我|wǒ}{了解|liǎo jiě}{他|tā} (I know him well).
- Don't use {然而|rán ér} in a casual chat with friends: it sounds like a newspaper. {不过|bú guò} or {但是|dàn shì} is what people
  say.

## Key points

- {尽管|jǐn guǎn} A，{但是|dàn shì} / {可是|kě shì} / {还是|hái shi} / {却|què} B: although A, B all the same (concession). Adverb {尽管|jǐn guǎn} + verb: feel free to.
- {然而|rán ér} (written), {不过|bú guò} (mild, spoken), {但是|dàn shì} / {可是|kě shì}: start of the clause. {却|què}: after the subject.
- {并|bìng} + {不|bù} / {没|méi}: not at all, contrary to expectation. Written {并|bìng} is also "and".
- Opinions: {支持|zhī chí} / {反对|fǎn duì}, {建议|jiàn yì}, {意见|yì jiàn} (often critical), {讨论|tǎo lùn}, {商量|shāng liang}, {交流|jiāo liú}, {谈|tán}, {提|tí}, {答应|dā ying} / {拒绝|jù jué}, {接受|jiē shòu}, {理解|lǐ jiě}, {解释|jiě shì},
  {误会|wù huì}, {互相|hù xiāng} / {相互|xiāng hù}, {共同|gòng tóng}, {对方|duì fāng}, {另|lìng}, {再说|zài shuō}, {指|zhǐ}.
- Politeness: {道歉|dào qiàn} ({向|xiàng}…{道歉|dào qiàn}), {抱歉|bào qiàn} (adjective), {原谅|yuán liàng}, {感谢|gǎn xiè}, {打扰|dǎ rǎo} ({一下|yí xià} / {了|le}), {麻烦|má fan}{你|nǐ}…, {打招呼|dǎ zhāo hu}, {点头|diǎn tóu}, {不必|bú bì}, {实在|shí zài}.
- New characters: {示|shì} {抱|bào} {歉|qiàn} {扰|rǎo} {反|fǎn} {呼|hū} {建|jiàn} {释|shì} {拒|jù} {绝|jué} {麻|má} {烦|fán} {互|hù} {尽|jǐn} {批|pī} {评|píng} {却|què} {谈|tán} {讨|tǎo} {论|lùn}; ✎ {示|shì} {抱|bào} {反|fǎn} {建|jiàn} {麻|má} {烦|fán} {谈|tán} {讨|tǎo} {论|lùn}.

lessons.body:
## What this lesson is for

Work brings money: wages, savings, fees and budgets. {李明|Lǐ Míng} (Li Ming) has been working for a few months
and is adding up what a year's master's in Britain would cost. This lesson gives you the words for
earning, saving and spending, and the numbers that go with them: **[[approximate numbers]]** ("ten or
so", "around eight o'clock"), decimals, fractions, percentages and multiples.

You'll learn:

- approximate numbers with {来|lái} ({十|shí}{来|lái}{个|gè}{人|rén}), {左右|zuǒ yòu} ({三十|sān shí}{岁|suì}{左右|zuǒ yòu}), {前后|qián hòu} ({春节|Chūn jié}{前后|qián hòu}) and {大约|dà yuē};
- decimals ({三|sān}{点|diǎn}{五|wǔ}), fractions ({三|sān}{分之|fēn zhī}{一|yī}), percentages ({百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{三十|sān shí}) and multiples with {倍|bèi};
- {仅|jǐn} and {仅仅|jǐn jǐn}, "only" (written), and the words for "all": {全|quán}, {全部|quán bù}, {全都|quán dōu}, {所有|suǒ yǒu}, {整个|zhěng gè};
- money words: {收入|shōu rù}, {赚|zhuàn}, {存|cún} and {取|qǔ}, {费|fèi} and {费用|fèi yòng}, {学费|xué fèi}, {零钱|líng qián} and {零花钱|líng huā qián}, {值|zhí}, {密码|mì mǎ}, {降低|jiàng dī} and {下降|xià jiàng}, {不够|bú gòu}, {剩|shèng}, {留|liú};
- and {数|shù}, {数字|shù zì}, {数量|shù liàng}, {算|suàn}, {减|jiǎn}, {共|gòng}, {克|kè}, {许多|xǔ duō}, {目前|mù qián}, {年底|nián dǐ}, {月份|yuè fèn}, {以内|yǐ nèi}, {空|kòng}.

The reference sheet **Numbers at HSK 4** has everything in one table.

## Approximate numbers: {来|lái}, {左右|zuǒ yòu}, {前后|qián hòu}, {大约|dà yuē}

Chinese has several ways to say "about". Each has its place in the sentence.

**{来|lái}** goes after a round number (10, 20, 100, 1,000…) and before the measure word: "ten-odd,
twenty-something":

{我们|wǒ men}{部门|bù mén}{有|yǒu}{十|shí}{来|lái}{个|gè}{人|rén}。 — There are ten or so people in our department.

{她|tā}{看起来|kàn qǐ lai}{二十|èr shí}{来|lái}{岁|suì}。 — She looks twenty-something. ({看起来|kàn qǐ lai}: to look, seem.)

{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衣服|yī fu}{一百|yì bǎi}{来|lái}{块|kuài}{钱|qián}。 — This piece of clothing is a hundred-odd yuan.

**{左右|zuǒ yòu}** goes **after** the number and measure word (or the time): "or so, give or take":

{他|tā}{三十|sān shí}{岁|suì}{左右|zuǒ yòu}。 — He's about thirty.

{我|wǒ}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{左右|zuǒ yòu}{到|dào}。 — I'll get there around eight.

{一|yí}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{的|de}{生活费|shēng huó fèi}{三千|sān qiān}{块|kuài}{左右|zuǒ yòu}。 — A month's living costs are three thousand or so. ({生活费|shēng huó fèi}: living costs.)

**{前后|qián hòu}** goes after a **point in time** only: a date, a festival, an event:

{春节|Chūn jié}{前后|qián hòu}，{火车|huǒ chē}{票|piào}{很|hěn}{难|nán}{买|mǎi}。 — Around the Spring Festival, train tickets are hard to get.

{她|tā}{是|shì}{七|qī}{月|yuè}{前后|qián hòu}{毕业|bì yè}{的|de}。 — She graduated around July.

Not with amounts: ~~{五十|wǔ shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{前后|qián hòu}~~ is wrong; say {五十|wǔ shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{左右|zuǒ yòu}.

**{大约|dà yuē}** goes **before** the number: "approximately":

{从|cóng}{这儿|zhèr}{到|dào}{公司|gōng sī}{大约|dà yuē}{要|yào}{四十|sì shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}。 — It takes about forty minutes from here to the office.

{大约|dà yuē}{有|yǒu}{一半|yí bàn}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}{打|dǎ}{过|guo}{工|gōng}。 — About half the students have had a part-time job.

You'll often hear {大约|dà yuē} and {左右|zuǒ yòu} together ({大约|dà yuē}{五十|wǔ shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{左右|zuǒ yòu}): it's common in speech, though careful
writers avoid the doubling. And you already know the HSK 1–3 ways: {十|shí}{几|jǐ}{个|gè} (a dozen or so, between 11
and 19), {二十|èr shí}{多|duō}{岁|suì} (over twenty), {差不多|chà bu duō} (almost).

| Word | Goes | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| {来|lái} | after a round number, before the measure word | {十|shí}{来|lái}{个|gè}{人|rén} | ten or so people |
| {左右|zuǒ yòu} | after the number + measure word or the time | {三十|sān shí}{岁|suì}{左右|zuǒ yòu} | about thirty |
| {前后|qián hòu} | after a point in time | {春节|Chūn jié}{前后|qián hòu} | around the Spring Festival |
| {大约|dà yuē} | before the number | {大约|dà yuē}{四十|sì shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng} | about forty minutes |
| {几|jǐ} / {多|duō} | inside the number (HSK 1–3) | {十|shí}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}, {二十|èr shí}{多|duō}{岁|suì} | a dozen or so; over twenty |

## Decimals, fractions and percentages

**Decimals** use {点|diǎn} (point): 3.5 is {三|sān}{点|diǎn}{五|wǔ}, 0.8 is {零|líng}{点|diǎn}{八|bā}, 12.25 is {十二|shí èr}{点|diǎn}{二五|èr wǔ} (after {点|diǎn}, the digits one
by one).

**Fractions** say the whole first, then {分之|fēn zhī}, then the part: {三|sān}{分之|fēn zhī}{一|yī} is "one of three parts", ⅓.
{四|sì}{分之|fēn zhī}{三|sān} is ¾. {一半|yí bàn} (half) is the everyday word for ½.

{这个|zhè ge}{月|yuè}{的|de}{工资|gōng zī}，{我|wǒ}{存|cún}{了|le}{三|sān}{分之|fēn zhī}{一|yī}。 — I saved a third of this month's pay.

**Percentages** are fractions of a hundred: {百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{三十|sān shí} (30 %), {百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{百|bǎi} (100 %), {百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{五|wǔ}{点|diǎn}{五|wǔ} (5.5 %).

{公司|gōng sī}{百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{六十|liù shí}{的|de}{人员|rén yuán}{是|shì}{女性|nǚ xìng}。 — Sixty per cent of the company's staff are women.

The order is the reverse of English in both: the whole ({三|sān}, {百|bǎi}) comes before {分之|fēn zhī}, and the part after
it. So "30 %" is {百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{三十|sān shí}, never ~~{三十|sān shí}{百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}~~.

## {倍|bèi}: times, -fold

{倍|bèi} is a measure word for multiples: {两|liǎng}{倍|bèi} (twice, two times), {三|sān}{倍|bèi} (three times).

{他|tā}{的|de}{工资|gōng zī}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi}。 — His pay is twice mine.

{这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{房租|fáng zū}{比|bǐ}{我们|wǒ men}{那儿|nàr}{贵|guì}{一|yí}{倍|bèi}。 — Rents in this city are twice as high as where we live.
(literally: more expensive by one time)

{去年|qù nián}{的|de}{收入|shōu rù}{增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{一|yí}{倍|bèi}。 — Last year's income doubled. ({增加|zēng jiā}: to increase, lesson 28.)

Watch two patterns:

- **A {是|shì} B {的|de} N {倍|bèi}**: A is N times B. {二十|èr shí}{是|shì}{十|shí}{的|de}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi} (twenty is twice ten).
- **A {比|bǐ} B {多|duō} / {贵|guì} / {高|gāo} N {倍|bèi}**, **{增加|zēng jiā}{了|le} N {倍|bèi}**: A is more by N times, so the total is N + 1 times. {增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{一|yí}{倍|bèi}
  is "doubled" (+100 %), and strictly {增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi} is "tripled". In everyday speech people aren't always this
  careful, so check the figures when it matters.

Discounts work the other way round (lesson 09): {打|dǎ}{八|bā}{折|zhé} is "80 % of the price", i.e. 20 % off.

## {仅|jǐn} and {仅仅|jǐn jǐn}: only (written)

{仅|jǐn} (written) and {仅仅|jǐn jǐn} mean "only, merely", like {={只|zhǐ}=} (HSK 3):

{能|néng}{拿|ná}{到|dào}{奖学金|jiǎng xué jīn}{的|de}{人|rén}{仅|jǐn}{占|zhàn}{百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{十|shí}。 — Only ten per cent of people get a scholarship. ({占|zhàn}: to make up.)

{我们|wǒ men}{仅仅|jǐn jǐn}{用|yòng}{了|le}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{就|jiù}{做|zuò}{完|wán}{了|le}。 — We finished it in only three days.

{仅|jǐn} is typical of notices and news ({仅|jǐn}{限|xiàn}{本人|běn rén}{使用|shǐ yòng}: for the holder's use only; {限|xiàn}, to limit), and before
numbers: {仅|jǐn}{五十|wǔ shí}{元|yuán} (only fifty yuan). {仅仅|jǐn jǐn} is a little more emphatic and also common in speech. In
conversation, {={只|zhǐ}=} is the everyday word: {我|wǒ}{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{五十|wǔ shí}{块|kuài}.

## {全|quán}, {全部|quán bù}, {全都|quán dōu}, {所有|suǒ yǒu}, {整个|zhěng gè}: all, whole

| Word | Kind | Use | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| {全|quán} | adjective, adverb | whole (before a noun); all, entirely (before a verb) | {全|quán}{家|jiā} (the whole family), {全|quán}{班|bān}; {我|wǒ}{全|quán}{忘|wàng}{了|le} (I forgot it all) |
| {全部|quán bù} | noun | all of it, the whole | {全部|quán bù}{的|de}{钱|qián}, {钱|qián}{全部|quán bù}{花|huā}{完|wán}{了|le} |
| {全都|quán dōu} | adverb | all, without exception (before the verb) | {我们|wǒ men}{全都|quán dōu}{同意|tóng yì}。 |
| {所有|suǒ yǒu} | adjective | all (every one of a group), before a noun | {所有|suǒ yǒu}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué}{都|dōu}{来|lái}{了|le}。 |
| {整个|zhěng gè} | adjective | the whole, entire (one thing, start to finish) | {整个|zhěng gè}{下午|xià wǔ}, {整个|zhěng gè}{城市|chéng shì} |

- {所有|suǒ yǒu} usually has {的|de} and {都|dōu}: {所有|suǒ yǒu}{的|de}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{知道|zhī dào}. It counts members of a group.
- {整个|zhěng gè} is one whole thing: {整个|zhěng gè}{晚上|wǎn shang} (the whole evening), {整个|zhěng gè}{公司|gōng sī}. You can't say ~~{整个|zhěng gè}{学生|xué sheng}~~ for "all the
  students": that's {所有|suǒ yǒu}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng} or {全部|quán bù}{学生|xué sheng}.
- {全|quán} before a noun makes compounds: {全|quán}{家|jiā}, {全|quán}{国|guó} (the whole country), {全身|quán shēn} (lesson 07). Before a verb it's
  "all, completely": {他|tā}{全|quán}{说|shuō}{对|duì}{了|le} (he got it all right).
- {整|zhěng} alone is "whole; exactly": {整|zhěng}{天|tiān} (all day), {八|bā}{点|diǎn}{整|zhěng} (eight o'clock sharp), and as a verb it's "to put
  in order" ({整理|zhěng lǐ}, lesson 10).

## Numbers and time words

- {数|shù} shù is a number, a figure; {数字|shù zì} a digit, figure; {数量|shù liàng} a quantity: {人数|rén shù} (the number of people), {数字|shù zì}
  {很|hěn}{大|dà}, {数量|shù liàng}{不|bù}{多|duō}. (The verb "to count" is read shǔ: you'll meet it later.)
- {算|suàn} is to calculate, work out: {算一算|suàn yi suàn} (work it out), {算|suàn}{错|cuò}{了|le}. It also means "to count as": {这|zhè}{不|bú}{算|suàn}{贵|guì} (that's
  not expensive, as prices go).
- {减|jiǎn} is to subtract, take away: {十|shí}{减|jiǎn}{三|sān}{等于|děng yú}{七|qī} (ten minus three is seven; {等于|děng yú}: to equal). {加|jiā} is "plus".
- {共|gòng} is "altogether", short and written: {共|gòng}{三十|sān shí}{元|yuán} (thirty yuan in all). In speech, {一共|yí gòng} (HSK 3).
- {克|kè} is a gram: {五百|wǔ bǎi}{克|kè} (500 g). {千克|qiān kè} (a kilogram, lesson 08) is 1,000 {克|kè}.
- {许多|xǔ duō} is many, a lot of: {许多|xǔ duō}{人|rén}, {许多|xǔ duō}{年|nián}. A little more written than {很|hěn}{多|duō}.
- {目前|mù qián} is "at present, so far": {目前|mù qián}{还|hái}{没有|méi yǒu}{人|rén}{报名|bào míng} (no one has signed up so far).
- {年底|nián dǐ} is the end of the year; {月份|yuè fèn} is "month" in counting and statistics: {七|qī}{月份|yuè fèn} (July), {哪个|nǎ ge}{月份|yuè fèn}.
- {以内|yǐ nèi} is "within": {三|sān}{天|tiān}{以内|yǐ nèi}, {一百|yì bǎi}{块|kuài}{以内|yǐ nèi} (up to a hundred yuan). Its written form is {内|nèi} (lesson 13).
- {空|kòng} is free time: {你|nǐ}{明天|míng tiān}{有|yǒu}{空|kòng}{吗|ma}？ (are you free tomorrow?), {有|yǒu}{空儿|kòngr}{来|lái}{玩儿|wánr} (come round when you're free). Fourth tone here; the {空|kōng}
  kōng of lesson 10 is "empty". It also means "left empty, unused": {这个|zhè ge}{房间|fáng jiān}{一直|yì zhí}{空|kòng}{着|zhe} (this room has stood empty all along).

### Sound parts and families

- **京 → 凉 谅 景.** 谅 liàng is 讠 + 京 jīng: the sound has drifted, but 京 gives -iang
  in 凉 liáng (cool, lesson 08) and -ing in 景 jǐng ({风景|fēng jǐng}, lesson 18) and 影 yǐng ({电影|diàn yǐng}).
- **直 → 值 植.** 值 zhí is 亻 + 直 zhí: an exact match. 植 zhí ({植物|zhí wù}, lesson 27) has it too.
- **咅 → 倍 部.** 倍 bèi and lesson 13's 部 bù share 咅.
- **勺 → 约.** 约 yuē is 纟 + 勺 (a spoon: {勺子|sháo zi}). The sound part no longer matches.
- **贝 again**: 赚 (to earn) is 贝 (money) + 兼. Lesson 11 had the family: 负, 责, 贵, 费, 货.
- **乘 + 刂 = 剩.** The left part is 乘 chéng ({乘坐|chéng zuò}, lesson 16), with 刂 on the right.

### Look-alikes and traps

- **存 and 在.** Both start with a horizontal, a left-falling stroke and a short vertical. 在 has
  土 inside; 存 has 子. A memory aid: you deposit ({存|cún}) money for your child ({子|zǐ}).
- **密**: 宀 on top, 必 in the middle, 山 at the bottom. 蜜 (honey, later) has 虫 instead of
  山.
- **原**: 厂 on the outside, 白 and 小 inside. Don't drop the dot at the top of 白.
- **约** and lesson 14's 绝 both have 纟. Write 纟 as three strokes: two bent strokes and a rising
  stroke. In traditional it is 糹, with six: 約, 絕.

### Stroke order

- **存**: the horizontal, the long left-falling stroke, the short vertical, then 子 (the
  horizontal-bent stroke, the vertical hook, the horizontal last).
- **剩**: 乘 first (ten strokes), then 刂.

## Pronunciation

- {空|kòng} (free time: {有|yǒu}{空|kòng}) and {空|kōng} (empty: lesson 10): the same character, two tones.
- {数|shù} shù (a number) is fourth tone; the verb {数|shǔ} shǔ (to count) is third, a later word.
- {赚|zhuàn} zhuàn, {存|cún} cún, {剩|shèng} shèng: zhu-, c-, sh-. Keep c (like *ts* in "cats") apart from ch.
- {倍|bèi} bèi rhymes with {被|bèi} bèi (HSK 3): same syllable, same tone.
- {零花钱|líng huā qián} líng huā qián: three syllables, rising, level, rising.
- {百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{三十|sān shí} bǎi fēn zhī sān shí: zhī is the {之|zhī} of written Chinese (lesson 21).
- {仅仅|jǐn jǐn} jǐn jǐn: two third tones, said jín jǐn.

## Common mistakes

- ~~{五十|wǔ shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{前后|qián hòu}~~: {前后|qián hòu} is only for times: {春节|Chūn jié}{前后|qián hòu}, {八|bā}{点|diǎn}{前后|qián hòu}. For amounts, {左右|zuǒ yòu}: {五十|wǔ shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{左右|zuǒ yòu}.
- ~~{十|shí}{个|gè}{来|lái}{人|rén}~~: {来|lái} goes before the measure word: {十|shí}{来|lái}{个|gè}{人|rén}.
- ~~{三十|sān shí}{百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}~~: the whole comes first: {百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{三十|sān shí}. And ⅓ is {三|sān}{分之|fēn zhī}{一|yī}, not ~~{一|yì}{分之|fēn zhī}{三|sān}~~.
- ~~{整个|zhěng gè}{学生|xué sheng}{都|dōu}{来|lái}{了|le}~~: for all the members of a group, {所有|suǒ yǒu}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}{都|dōu}{来|lái}{了|le} or {学生|xué sheng}{全都|quán dōu}{来|lái}{了|le}. {整个|zhěng gè} is one whole thing:
  {整个|zhěng gè}{班|bān} (the whole class).
- {价格|jià gé}{降低|jiàng dī}{了|le} is heard too, but {下降|xià jiàng} is the usual word when something falls by itself: {价格|jià gé}{下降|xià jiàng}{了|le}. {降低|jiàng dī} takes
  an object: {降低|jiàng dī}{价格|jià gé}.
- Don't mix up {存|cún} (to put money in) and {取|qǔ} (to take it out): {去|qù}{银行|yín háng}{存|cún}{钱|qián} / {取|qǔ}{钱|qián}.

## Key points

- Approximate numbers: {十|shí}{来|lái}{个|gè} ({来|lái} after a round number), {三十|sān shí}{岁|suì}{左右|zuǒ yòu} ({左右|zuǒ yòu} after the amount), {春节|Chūn jié}{前后|qián hòu} ({前后|qián hòu} after a
  time), {大约|dà yuē}{四十|sì shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng} ({大约|dà yuē} before the number).
- Decimals with {点|diǎn} ({三|sān}{点|diǎn}{五|wǔ}); fractions whole first ({三|sān}{分之|fēn zhī}{一|yī}); percentages {百分之|bǎi fēn zhī} + number.
- {倍|bèi}: A {是|shì} B {的|de}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi} (twice B); {比|bǐ}…{贵|guì}{一|yí}{倍|bèi} (twice as expensive); {增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{一|yí}{倍|bèi} (doubled).
- {仅|jǐn} / {仅仅|jǐn jǐn}: only (written; {={只|zhǐ}=} in speech). All: {全|quán} (compounds; before verbs), {全部|quán bù}, {全都|quán dōu} (before the verb), {所有|suǒ yǒu}
  (members of a group, with {的|de}…{都|dōu}), {整个|zhěng gè} (one whole thing).
- Money: {收入|shōu rù}, {赚|zhuàn}, {存|cún} / {取|qǔ}, {费|fèi} / {费用|fèi yòng} / {学费|xué fèi}, {零钱|líng qián}, {零花钱|líng huā qián}, {值|zhí}, {密码|mì mǎ}, {降低|jiàng dī} (+ object) / {下降|xià jiàng}, {不够|bú gòu}, {剩|shèng}, {留|liú}.
