questions.stem: Read: "{上|shàng}{个|gè}{学期|xué qī}{期末|qī mò}{考试|kǎo shì}，{我|wǒ}{的|de}{口语|kǒu yǔ}{只|zhǐ}{得|dé}{了|le}{五十八|wǔ shí bā}{分|fēn}，{没有|méi yǒu}{合格|hé gé}。{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{难过|nán guò}，{因为|yīn wèi}{我|wǒ}{从来|cóng lái}{没有|méi yǒu}{考|kǎo}{得|de}{这么|zhè me}{差|chà}{过|guo}。{老师|lǎo shī}{告诉|gào su}{我|wǒ}，{学院|xué yuàn}{允许|yǔn xǔ}{不|bù}{合格|hé gé}{的|de}{考生|kǎo shēng}{在|zài}{下|xià}{个|gè}{学期|xué qī}{开学|kāi xué}{以前|yǐ qián}{重新|chóng xīn}{考|kǎo}{一|yí}{次|cì}。{寒假|hán jià}{里|lǐ}，{我|wǒ}{没有|méi yǒu}{回|huí}{家|jiā}。{我|wǒ}{给|gěi}{自己|zì jǐ}{做|zuò}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{时间表|shí jiān biǎo}：{上午|shàng wǔ}{读|dú}{课文|kè wén}，{下午|xià wǔ}{练|liàn}{听力|tīng lì}，{晚上|wǎn shang}{练|liàn}{口语|kǒu yǔ}。{我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{课本|kè běn}{上|shàng}{的|de}{课文|kè wén}{都|dōu}{读|dú}{了|le}{三|sān}{遍|biàn}，{还|hái}{把|bǎ}{老师|lǎo shī}{上课|shàng kè}{讲|jiǎng}{的|de}{重点|zhòng diǎn}{仔细|zǐ xì}{地|de}{复习|fù xí}{了|le}{一|yí}{遍|biàn}。{我|wǒ}{发现|fā xiàn}，{以前|yǐ qián}{上课|shàng kè}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}{说话|shuō huà}，{因为|yīn wèi}{我|wǒ}{怕|pà}{说|shuō}{错|cuò}。{所以|suǒ yǐ}{我|wǒ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{都|dōu}{找|zhǎo}{中国|Zhōng guó}{同学|tóng xué}{聊天儿|liáo tiānr}，{请|qǐng}{他们|tā men}{把|bǎ}{我|wǒ}{说|shuō}{错|cuò}{的|de}{地方|dì fang}{改|gǎi}{一下|yí xià}。{开始|kāi shǐ}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{我|wǒ}{说|shuō}{一|yí}{句|jù}{话|huà}，{他们|tā men}{要|yào}{改|gǎi}{三四|sān sì}{个|gè}{错误|cuò wù}，{后来|hòu lái}{要|yào}{改|gǎi}{的|de}{地方|dì fang}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{少|shǎo}{了|le}。{重新|chóng xīn}{考试|kǎo shì}{那|nà}{天|tiān}，{老师|lǎo shī}{问|wèn}{了|le}{我|wǒ}{三|sān}{个|gè}{问题|wèn tí}，{我|wǒ}{都|dōu}{回答|huí dá}{出来|chū lái}{了|le}，{最后|zuì hòu}{我|wǒ}{得|dé}{了|le}{八十二|bā shí'èr}{分|fēn}，{比|bǐ}{上|shàng}{次|cì}{高|gāo}{了|le}{二十|èr shí}{多|duō}{分|fēn}。{老师|lǎo shī}{说|shuō}，{我|wǒ}{的|de}{口语|kǒu yǔ}{比|bǐ}{以前|yǐ qián}{好|hǎo}{多|duō}{了|le}。{现在|xiàn zài}{我|wǒ}{明白|míng bai}{了|le}，{学习|xué xí}{语言|yǔ yán}{没有|méi yǒu}{别的|bié de}{办法|bàn fǎ}，{就|jiù}{是|shì}{要|yào}{多|duō}{说|shuō}、{多|duō}{练|liàn}，{不要|bú yào}{怕|pà}{说|shuō}{错|cuò}。" What has the writer learned from the retake?
choices: The best way is to read the textbook many times.
A timetable matters more than practice.
There is no shortcut: speak and practise a lot, and don't fear mistakes.
Teachers give higher marks the second time.
questions.explanation: {学习|xué xí}{语言|yǔ yán}{没有|méi yǒu}{别的|bié de}{办法|bàn fǎ}，{就|jiù}{是|shì}{要|yào}{多|duō}{说|shuō}、{多|duō}{练|liàn}，{不要|bú yào}{怕|pà}{说|shuō}{错|cuò}: there is no other way to learn a language than to speak and practise a lot without fearing mistakes. Reading the texts three times helped, but the writer's conclusion is about speaking.

questions.stem: How do you say "He was so busy he even forgot to eat."?
questions.explanation: {连|lián} + the thing picked out + {都|dōu} + verb: {连|lián}{饭|fàn}{都|dōu}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{吃|chī}. The object {饭|fàn} moves before {都|dōu} and the verb; {连|lián} comes straight before it.

questions.stem: What does "{他|tā}{连|lián}{一|yí}{个|gè}{字|zì}{都|dōu}{没|méi}{写|xiě}。" mean?
choices: He didn't write a single character.
He wrote every character but one.
He wrote one character after another.
questions.explanation: {连|lián} + {一|yī} + measure word + noun + {都|dōu} + a negative is "not even one": {连|lián}{一|yí}{个|gè}{字|zì}{都|dōu}{没|méi}{写|xiě}, not a single character.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
choices: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{连|lián}{小孩儿|xiǎo háir}{知道|zhī dào}。
{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{小孩儿|xiǎo háir}{连|lián}{知道|zhī dào}。
{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{连|lián}{小孩儿|xiǎo háir}{都|dōu}{知道|zhī dào}。
{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{都|dōu}{小孩儿|xiǎo háir}{连|lián}{知道|zhī dào}。
questions.explanation: {连|lián} needs {都|dōu} (or {也|yě}) before the verb: {连|lián}{小孩儿|xiǎo háir}{都|dōu}{知道|zhī dào} (even a child knows). In speech {连|lián} can be dropped ({小孩儿|xiǎo háir}{都|dōu}{知道|zhī dào}), but {都|dōu} / {也|yě} never.

questions.stem: "{这儿|zhèr}{冬天|dōng tiān}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}，{四|sì}{月|yuè}{甚至|shèn zhì}{还|hái}{会|huì}{下|xià}{雪|xuě}。" What does {甚至|shèn zhì} add?
choices: that April is the coldest month
that it never snows in April
that snow in April is a surprising extreme
that it snows only in April
questions.explanation: {甚至|shèn zhì} (even) adds a further, surprising step: the winters are cold, and it can even snow as late as April.

questions.stem: Choose the words: {这个|zhè ge}{字|zì}{连|lián}{老师|lǎo shī}{都|dōu}{不|bú}{认识|rèn shi}，{我们|wǒ men} ___ {不|bú}{认识|rèn shi}{了|le}。 (Even the teacher doesn't know this character, so we certainly don't.)
questions.explanation: {连|lián} A {都|dōu}…，B {就|jiù}{更|gèng}…{了|le}: if even A, then B all the more. {我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{更|gèng}{不|bú}{认识|rèn shi}{了|le}. {也|yě}{不|bù} would give "we don't either", which loses the "all the more"; and a second {不|bù} would make "{也|yě}{不|bù}{不|bú}{认识|rèn shi}".

questions.stem: Choose the measure word: {这|zhè} ___ {歌|gē}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}，{你|nǐ}{会|huì}{唱|chàng}{吗|ma}？
questions.explanation: {首|shǒu} counts songs and poems: {一|yì}{首|shǒu}{歌|gē}, {一|yì}{首|shǒu}{诗|shī}. {篇|piān} is for a piece of writing ({一|yì}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng}), {本|běn} for a book, {张|zhāng} for flat things such as a ticket or a photo.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{小说|xiǎo shuō}{的|de} ___ {是|shì}{一|yí}{位|wèi}{很|hěn}{年轻|nián qīng}{的|de}{女|nǚ}{作家|zuò jiā}。
questions.explanation: The author of a particular book is its {作者|zuò zhě}: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{小说|xiǎo shuō}{的|de}{作者|zuò zhě}. A {读者|dú zhě} is a reader, a {作品|zuò pǐn} a work, and {内容|nèi róng} its content; none of them can be "a young woman writer".

questions.stem: "{我们|wǒ men}{学院|xué yuàn}{有|yǒu}{三百|sān bǎi}{名|míng}{学生|xué sheng}，{其中|qí zhōng}{一百|yì bǎi}{名|míng}{是|shì}{留学生|liú xué shēng}。" How many of the students are from abroad?
questions.explanation: {其中|qí zhōng} (among them, of whom) points back to the three hundred students: of them, one hundred are international students.

questions.stem: How do you say "Please translate this article into English."?
choices: {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{这|zhè}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng}{翻译|fān yì}{成|chéng}{英文|Yīng wén}。
{请|qǐng}{翻译|fān yì}{成|chéng}{英文|Yīng wén}{把|bǎ}{这|zhè}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng}。
{请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{英文|Yīng wén}{翻译|fān yì}{成|chéng}{这|zhè}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng}。
{请|qǐng}{这|zhè}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng}{把|bǎ}{翻译|fān yì}{成|chéng}{英文|Yīng wén}。
questions.explanation: {把|bǎ} + what you translate + {翻译|fān yì}{成|chéng} + the language: {把|bǎ}{这|zhè}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng}{翻译|fān yì}{成|chéng}{英文|Yīng wén}. {成|chéng} marks what something becomes. {把|bǎ}{英文|Yīng wén}{翻译|fān yì}{成|chéng}{这|zhè}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng} would turn the English into the article.

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: "{为了|wèi le}{写|xiě}{好|hǎo}{毕业|bì yè}{论文|lùn wén}，{她|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}{查找|chá zhǎo} ___ 。" ({毕业|bì yè}{论文|lùn wén}: graduation thesis)
questions.explanation: {查找|chá zhǎo}{资料|zī liào}: to look up material for study or research. You don't look up readers ({读者|dú zhě}), writers ({作家|zuò jiā}) or an order ({顺序|shùn xù}).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {文章|wén zhāng} wén zhāng (article): a rising tone, then a high level one, 2+1.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {翻译|fān yì} fān yì (to translate): a high level tone, then a falling one, 1+4.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {他|tā}{的|de}{普|pǔ} ___ {话|huà}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。 (He speaks good Mandarin.)
questions.explanation: {普通话|pǔ tōng huà} pǔ tōng huà. {={通|tōng}=} is {甬|yǒng} inside 辶, and 辶 is written last.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {文|wén} ___ (article, essay)
questions.explanation: {文章|wén zhāng} wén zhāng. {={章|zhāng}=} is {立|lì} over {早|zǎo}, with the vertical of {早|zǎo} running down to the bottom. {早|zǎo} zǎo, {音|yīn} yīn ({音乐|yīn yuè}) and {意|yì} yì ({意思|yì si}) share parts of it but are other characters.

questions.stem: Listen to two friends. What does the first one think?

audio.text:
你还在图书馆？现在都六点了，你连午饭都没吃吧？
真的忘了。

choices: The friend hasn't even had lunch.
The friend has had lunch already.
The friend wants to have dinner early.
questions.explanation: {连|lián}{午饭|wǔ fàn}{都|dōu}{没|méi}{吃|chī}{吧|ba}？: "I bet you haven't even had lunch?" The answer is {真|zhēn}{的|de}{忘|wàng}{了|le}: I really forgot.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker's main point?

audio.text: 我什么书都看，小说、杂志、历史书，甚至字典我也喜欢翻一翻。

choices: They read history books for their studies.
They read every kind of book, even dictionaries.
questions.explanation: {什么|shén me}{书|shū}{都|dōu}{看|kàn}: they read any kind of book, and {甚至|shèn zhì}{字典|zì diǎn}{我|wǒ}{也|yě}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{翻|fān}{一|yì}{翻|fān} adds the surprising extreme: they even like leafing through dictionaries ({翻|fān}: to leaf through).

questions.stem: Listen. Why hasn't the speaker read the novel?

audio.text: 我不是不想看这本小说，是这个学期太忙了，连一本书都没看完。

choices: The novel is too hard for them.
They have been too busy this term.
questions.explanation: {不|bú}{是|shì}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{看|kàn}…{是|shì}…{太|tài}{忙|máng}{了|le}: it isn't that they don't want to, they've been too busy; they haven't finished a single book this term ({连|lián}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}{都|dōu}{没|méi}{看|kàn}{完|wán}).

questions.stem: Listen. How many of the writer's novels are in English?

audio.text: 这位作家写了十几本小说，其中有三本已经翻译成了英文。

questions.explanation: {十|shí}{几|jǐ}{本|běn}{小说|xiǎo shuō}，{其中|qí zhōng}{有|yǒu}{三|sān}{本|běn}{已经|yǐ jīng}{翻译|fān yì}{成|chéng}{了|le}{英文|Yīng wén}: of more than ten novels, three have been translated into English.

questions.stem: Read: "{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{连|lián}{一|yì}{本|běn}{故事书|gù shi shū}{都|dōu}{没有|méi yǒu}。{十|shí}{岁|suì}{那|nà}{年|nián}，{邻居|lín jū}{家|jiā}{的|de}{奶奶|nǎi nai}{送|sòng}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{一|yì}{本|běn}{小说|xiǎo shuō}。{我|wǒ}{本来|běn lái}{只|zhǐ}{想|xiǎng}{看|kàn}{几|jǐ}{页|yè}，{没想到|méi xiǎng dào}{一|yí}{看|kàn}{就|jiù}{停|tíng}{不|bu}{下来|xià lái}{了|le}，{甚至|shèn zhì}{在|zài}{被子|bèi zi}{里|lǐ}{看|kàn}{到|dào}{了|le}{半夜|bàn yè}。" ({故事书|gù shi shū}: storybook; {停|tíng}{不|bu}{下来|xià lái}: couldn't stop; {被子|bèi zi}: quilt; {半夜|bàn yè}: midnight) What is true?
choices: The writer's family had a lot of storybooks.
The writer had planned to read the whole novel that night.
The novel was a present from a neighbour.
The writer stopped reading after a few pages.
questions.explanation: {邻居|lín jū}{家|jiā}{的|de}{奶奶|nǎi nai}{送|sòng}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{一|yì}{本|běn}{小说|xiǎo shuō}: the old lady next door gave the writer the novel. There wasn't a single storybook at home; the writer meant to read only a few pages ({本来|běn lái}{只|zhǐ}{想|xiǎng}{看|kàn}{几|jǐ}{页|yè}) but couldn't stop.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: I haven't written a single page all afternoon.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{一|yí}{下午|xià wǔ}{连|lián}{一|yí}{页|yè}{都|dōu}{没|méi}{写|xiě}。{连|lián} + {一|yī} + measure word + noun + {都|dōu} + {没|méi}: not a single page. The time {一|yí}{下午|xià wǔ} (the whole afternoon) can come before or after the subject. {没|méi}{写|xiě} takes no {了|le}.

questions.stem: Read the letter to a magazine and its reply: "“{我|wǒ}{是|shì}{一|yì}{名|míng}{大学生|dà xué shēng}，{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{读|dú}{小说|xiǎo shuō}，{可是|kě shì}{每|měi}{次|cì}{读|dú}{完|wán}{一|yì}{本|běn}，{过|guò}{几|jǐ}{天|tiān}{就|jiù}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{里面|lǐ miàn}{的|de}{内容|nèi róng}。{我|wǒ}{应该|yīng gāi}{怎么办|zěn me bàn}？——{一|yí}{位|wèi}{读者|dú zhě}”　“{这|zhè}{位|wèi}{读者|dú zhě}：{你好|nǐ hǎo}！{你|nǐ}{的|de}{问题|wèn tí}，{很|hěn}{多|duō}{读者|dú zhě}{都|dōu}{提到|tí dào}{过|guo}。{我|wǒ}{认识|rèn shi}{一|yí}{位|wèi}{作家|zuò jiā}，{他|tā}{从小|cóng xiǎo}{就|jiù}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{习惯|xí guàn}：{每|měi}{读|dú}{完|wán}{一|yì}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng}{或者|huò zhě}{一|yì}{本|běn}{小说|xiǎo shuō}，{就|jiù}{在|zài}{日记|rì jì}{里|lǐ}{写|xiě}{几|jǐ}{句|jù}{话|huà}，{例如|lì rú}{书|shū}{里|lǐ}{最|zuì}{有意思|yǒu yì si}{的|de}{人|rén}{是|shì}{谁|shéi}，{自己|zì jǐ}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{哪|nǎ}{一|yí}{段|duàn}。{连|lián}{读|dú}{过|guo}{的|de}{一|yì}{首|shǒu}{很|hěn}{短|duǎn}{的|de}{诗|shī}，{他|tā}{都|dōu}{会|huì}{写|xiě}{下来|xià lái}。{开始|kāi shǐ}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{他|tā}{觉得|jué de}{这样|zhè yàng}{做|zuò}{很|hěn}{花|huā}{时间|shí jiān}，{后来|hòu lái}{发现|fā xiàn}，{这样|zhè yàng}{读|dú}{过|guo}{的|de}{书|shū}，{过|guò}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{年|nián}{也|yě}{不|bú}{会|huì}{忘|wàng}。{甚至|shèn zhì}{他|tā}{后来|hòu lái}{写|xiě}{的|de}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{作品|zuò pǐn}，{都|dōu}{是|shì}{从|cóng}{这些|zhè xiē}{日记|rì jì}{里|lǐ}{来|lái}{的|de}。{所以|suǒ yǐ}{我|wǒ}{觉得|jué de}{你|nǐ}{也|yě}{可以|kě yǐ}{试一试|shì yi shì}：{读|dú}{完|wán}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}，{用|yòng}{自己|zì jǐ}{的话|de huà}{把|bǎ}{主要|zhǔ yào}{内容|nèi róng}{写|xiě}{下来|xià lái}。{不用|bú yòng}{写|xiě}{得|de}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}，{几|jǐ}{句|jù}{话|huà}{就|jiù}{可以|kě yǐ}{了|le}。{这样|zhè yàng}{做|zuò}{能|néng}{让|ràng}{你|nǐ}{更加|gèng jiā}{清楚|qīng chu}{地|de}{记|jì}{住|zhù}{书|shū}{的|de}{内容|nèi róng}，{也|yě}{能|néng}{让|ràng}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{知识|zhī shi}{更加|gèng jiā}{丰富|fēng fù}。{希望|xī wàng}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{回答|huí dá}{对|duì}{你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{帮助|bāng zhù}。”" ({诗|shī}: a poem) What is the reader's problem?
choices: They have no time to read novels.
They can't understand the novels they read.
They can't find good books to read.
They forget what a book was about a few days after reading it.
questions.explanation: {每|měi}{次|cì}{读|dú}{完|wán}{一|yì}{本|běn}，{过|guò}{几|jǐ}{天|tiān}{就|jiù}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{里面|lǐ miàn}{的|de}{内容|nèi róng}: every time they finish a book, they have forgotten its content a few days later.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct? (He can not only sing but also dance.)
choices: {不仅|bù jǐn}{他|tā}{会|huì}{唱歌|chàng gē}，{还|hái}{会|huì}{跳舞|tiào wǔ}。
{他|tā}{不仅|bù jǐn}{会|huì}{唱歌|chàng gē}，{他|tā}{还|hái}{不仅|bù jǐn}{会|huì}{跳舞|tiào wǔ}。
{他|tā}{会|huì}{唱歌|chàng gē}{不仅|bù jǐn}，{还|hái}{会|huì}{跳舞|tiào wǔ}。
{他|tā}{不仅|bù jǐn}{会|huì}{唱歌|chàng gē}，{还|hái}{会|huì}{跳舞|tiào wǔ}。
questions.explanation: With one subject for both clauses, the subject comes first and {不仅|bù jǐn} follows it: {他|tā}{不仅|bù jǐn}{会|huì}{唱歌|chàng gē}，{还|hái}{会|huì}{跳舞|tiào wǔ}. {不仅|bù jǐn} goes before the subject only when the two clauses have different subjects.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Not only do the students like this activity, the teachers like it too."?

{学生|xué sheng}{不仅|bù jǐn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{这个|zhè ge}{活动|huó dòng}，{老师|lǎo shī}{还|hái}{喜欢|xǐ huan}。
{不仅|bù jǐn}{学生|xué sheng}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{这个|zhè ge}{活动|huó dòng}，{也|yě}{老师|lǎo shī}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}。
{学生|xué sheng}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{这个|zhè ge}{活动|huó dòng}，{不仅|bù jǐn}{老师|lǎo shī}{也|yě}{喜欢|xǐ huan}。
questions.explanation: Two different subjects: {不仅|bù jǐn} comes before the first one ({不仅|bù jǐn}{学生|xué sheng}…), and the second clause takes {也|yě} after its own subject ({老师|lǎo shī}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}). {也|yě} never goes before the subject.

questions.stem: Which sentence uses {并且|bìng qiě} correctly?
choices: {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{老师|lǎo shī}{并且|bìng qiě}{同学|tóng xué}。
questions.explanation: {并且|bìng qiě} joins two verbs or clauses, at the start of the second: {他|tā}{报|bào}{了|le}{名|míng}，{并且|bìng qiě}{交|jiāo}{了|le}{钱|qián} (he signed up and also paid). It doesn't join two nouns ({老师|lǎo shī}{和|hé}{同学|tóng xué}) and doesn't start the first clause.

questions.stem: "{那|nà}{天|tiān}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}，{加上|jiā shàng}{下|xià}{大|dà}{雨|yǔ}，{来|lái}{的|de}{人|rén}{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}。" Why did few people come?
choices: because of the cold, and the heavy rain as well
questions.explanation: {加上|jiā shàng} (on top of that) adds a second reason to the first: it was cold, and heavy rain as well, so few people came.

questions.stem: Choose the verb: {上|shàng}{个|gè}{月|yuè}，{外语学院|wài yǔ xué yuàn} ___ {了|le}{一|yì}{场|chǎng}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{演讲|yǎn jiǎng}{大赛|dà sài}。 ({演讲|yǎn jiǎng}: speech)
questions.explanation: The college is the organiser, so {举办|jǔ bàn} (to hold, to organise): {外语学院|wài yǔ xué yuàn}{举办|jǔ bàn}{了|le}{一|yì}{场|chǎng}{大赛|dà sài}. {举|jǔ} alone is "to raise" ({举手|jǔ shǒu}); {报名|bào míng} is to sign up and {参赛|cān sài} to take part, which a college doesn't do.

questions.stem: Choose the verb: {她|tā}{的|de}{演讲|yǎn jiǎng} ___ {了|le}{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{掌声|zhǎng shēng}。 (Her speech won everyone's applause.) ({掌声|zhǎng shēng}: applause)
questions.explanation: {赢得|yíng dé} takes something earned, such as applause, praise or support: {赢得|yíng dé}{了|le}{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{掌声|zhǎng shēng}. {赢|yíng} alone takes a game or an opponent ({赢|yíng}{了|le}{比赛|bǐ sài}), {输|shū} is to lose, and {打败|dǎ bài} is to defeat someone.

questions.stem: Choose the verb: {糟糕|zāo gāo}，{我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{手机|shǒu jī} ___ {了|le}！ (Oh no, I've lost my phone!) ({糟糕|zāo gāo}: oh no)
questions.explanation: Losing a thing is {丢|diū} (HSK 3). {输|shū} is "to lose" only a game, a match or a bet: {我们|wǒ men}{输|shū}{了|le}{比赛|bǐ sài}. {败|bài} is "defeated", and {赢|yíng} "to win".

questions.stem: Choose the measure word: {昨天|zuó tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{的|de}{那|nà} ___ {足球|zú qiú}{比赛|bǐ sài}{你|nǐ}{看|kàn}{了|le}{吗|ma}？
questions.explanation: {场|chǎng} counts matches, shows and other events that take place: {一|yì}{场|chǎng}{比赛|bǐ sài}, {一|yì}{场|chǎng}{电影|diàn yǐng}. {张|zhāng} is for flat things, {首|shǒu} for songs and poems, and {本|běn} for books.

questions.stem: How do you say "Teacher Wang encouraged Anna to sign up."?
choices: {王|Wáng}{老师|lǎo shī}{鼓励|gǔ lì}{报名|bào míng}{安娜|Ān nà}。
{安娜|Ān nà}{鼓励|gǔ lì}{王|Wáng}{老师|lǎo shī}{报名|bào míng}。
{王|Wáng}{老师|lǎo shī}{报名|bào míng}{鼓励|gǔ lì}{安娜|Ān nà}。
{王|Wáng}{老师|lǎo shī}{鼓励|gǔ lì}{安娜|Ān nà}{报名|bào míng}。
questions.explanation: {鼓励|gǔ lì} + person + what they're encouraged to do: {王|Wáng}{老师|lǎo shī}{鼓励|gǔ lì}{安娜|Ān nà}{报名|bào míng}. {邀请|yāo qǐng} (to invite) works the same way.

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: "{安娜|Ān nà}{不仅|bù jǐn}{报名|bào míng}{参加|cān jiā}{了|le}{演讲|yǎn jiǎng}{比赛|bǐ sài}， ___ {每|měi}{天|tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{练习|liàn xí}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。"
questions.explanation: The second clause adds a further point to the first: {不仅|bù jǐn}…{并且|bìng qiě}… (not only… but also). {但是|dàn shì} would set up a contrast, {所以|suǒ yǐ} a result, and {如果|rú guǒ} a condition.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {鼓励|gǔ lì} gǔ lì (to encourage): a dipping tone, then a falling one, 3+4.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {庆祝|qìng zhù} qìng zhù (to celebrate): two falling tones, 4+4.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {这|zhè}{门|mén}{课|kè}{有|yǒu}{笔试|bǐ shì}， ___ {外|wài}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{口语|kǒu yǔ}{考试|kǎo shì}。 (The course has a written exam, and an oral exam as well.)
questions.explanation: {另外|lìng wài} lìng wài (in addition). {={另|lìng}=} is {口|kǒu} over {力|lì}; add 刂 and you get {别|bié} bié.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? ___ {队|duì} (to queue)
questions.explanation: {排队|pái duì} pái duì. {={排|pái}=} is 扌 + {非|fēi}. {非|fēi} alone is fēi (as in {非常|fēi cháng}); {推|tuī} (to push, lesson 10) has 扌 + {隹|zhuī}, and {拜|bài} bài ({拜年|bài nián}) is another character altogether.

questions.stem: Listen. How did the speaker's team do?

audio.text: 我们队打败了三班，可是最后输给了五班，获得了第二名。

questions.stem: Listen to an announcement. What should students who want to take part do?

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker's attitude to the contest?

The contest is a waste of time.

questions.stem: What does "{我|wǒ}{不|bú}{是|shì}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}，{而是|ér shì}{没有|méi yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}。" mean?
choices: I don't want to go, and I have no time.
I want to go, so I'll make time.
It isn't that I don't want to go: I don't have time.
Either I go, or I have no time.
questions.explanation: {不|bú}{是|shì} A ，{而是|ér shì} B corrects A with B: the reason isn't unwillingness ({不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}) but lack of time ({没有|méi yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}). "Either… or" would be {不|bú}{是|shì}…{就是|jiù shì}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {周末|zhōu mò}{他|tā}{不|bú}{是|shì}{在|zài}{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}{看|kàn}{书|shū}， ___ {在|zài}{家|jiā}{上网|shàng wǎng}。 (At weekends he's either reading in the library or online at home.) ({上网|shàng wǎng}: to go online)
questions.explanation: "Either A or B", the only two possibilities, is {不|bú}{是|shì} A ，{就是|jiù shì} B. {不|bú}{是|shì}…{而是|ér shì} would correct (not in the library but at home), which isn't what the English says. {还是|hái shi} asks "or?" in a question, and {可是|kě shì} is "but".

questions.stem: Which sentence would you expect in a university notice?
choices: {毕业|bì yè}{典礼|diǎn lǐ}{快要|kuài yào}{举行|jǔ xíng}{了|le}{吧|ba}？

{我们|wǒ men}{六|liù}{月|yuè}{二十|èr shí}{号|hào}{要|yào}{去|qù}{毕业|bì yè}{典礼|diǎn lǐ}{呢|ne}。
{毕业|bì yè}{典礼|diǎn lǐ}{是|shì}{哪|nǎ}{天|tiān}{来着|lái zhe}？
questions.explanation: {将|jiāng} + verb is the written future, the style of notices: {毕业|bì yè}{典礼|diǎn lǐ}{将|jiāng}{在|zài}{六|liù}{月|yuè}{二十|èr shí}{日|rì}{举行|jǔ xíng} (the graduation ceremony will be held on 20 June; {典礼|diǎn lǐ}: ceremony). The others are chatty: a question with {吧|ba}, a plan with {呢|ne}, and {来着|lái zhe} (what was it again?).

{你们|nǐ men}{快要|kuài yào}{离开|lí kāi}{学校|xué xiào}{了|le}。
{你们|nǐ men}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{离开|lí kāi}{学校|xué xiào}{了|le}。
{你们|nǐ men}{刚|gāng}{离开|lí kāi}{学校|xué xiào}。
questions.explanation: {将要|jiāng yào} is the written "be about to": in speech, {快要|kuài yào}…{了|le}. {已经|yǐ jīng}{离开|lí kāi} and {刚|gāng}{离开|lí kāi} say it has already happened, and {不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{离开|lí kāi} is "don't want to leave".

questions.stem: Choose the word: {哥哥|gē ge}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{热闹|rè nao}， ___ {弟弟|dì di}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{安静|ān jìng}。 (My older brother likes a lively time, whereas my younger brother likes quiet.) ({热闹|rè nao}: lively)
questions.explanation: {而|ér} joins two clauses that contrast, "while, whereas", in written style. {并且|bìng qiě} would add a second point about the same subject, and {所以|suǒ yǐ} and {因为|yīn wèi} would make one a cause of the other.

questions.stem: Choose the word for a farewell card: {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ} ___ {顺利|shùn lì}！ (All the best!) ({顺利|shùn lì}: smooth, going well)
questions.explanation: {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{一切|yí qiè}{顺利|shùn lì} (may everything go well) is the set wish; {一切|yí qiè} stands on its own as "everything". {任何|rèn hé} (any) and {各种|gè zhǒng} (all kinds of) need a noun after them, and so does {所有|suǒ yǒu} (all): {所有|suǒ yǒu}{的|de}{事|shì}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: ___ {你|nǐ}{生日|shēng rì}{快乐|kuài lè}！ (Happy birthday!)
questions.explanation: A wish for the future is {祝|zhù} + person + wish: {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{生日|shēng rì}{快乐|kuài lè}. {祝贺|zhù hè} congratulates on something achieved ({祝贺|zhù hè}{你|nǐ}{毕业|bì yè}{了|le}), {庆祝|qìng zhù} is to celebrate, and {邀请|yāo qǐng} to invite.

questions.stem: How do you say "He graduated from university last year."?
choices: {他|tā}{去年|qù nián}{大学|dà xué}{毕业|bì yè}{了|le}。
{他|tā}{去年|qù nián}{毕业|bì yè}{大学|dà xué}{了|le}。
{他|tā}{毕业|bì yè}{了|le}{大学|dà xué}{去年|qù nián}。

questions.stem: Choose the word: {我|wǒ}{今年|jīn nián}{的|de} ___ {是|shì}{通过|tōng guò} HSK {四级|sì jí}。 (My goal this year is to pass HSK 4.)
questions.explanation: {目标|mù biāo} is a goal you aim to reach. {人生|rén shēng} is life as a whole and {一生|yì shēng} one's whole lifetime; {梦|mèng} is a dream in your sleep. ({目的|mù dì}, a purpose, answers "why?")

questions.stem: How is 为 read in 成为 (to become)?
questions.explanation: {成为|chéng wéi} chéng wéi: here {为|wéi} is wéi, the written "to be, to act as", as in {作为|zuò wéi} and {分为|fēn wéi} (lessons 12 and 27). It's wèi in {为了|wèi le}, {为什么|wèi shén me} and {因为|yīn wèi}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {申请|shēn qǐng} shēn qǐng (to apply): a high level tone, then a dipping one, 1+3.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {博士|bó shì} bó shì (doctorate, PhD): a rising tone, then a falling one, 2+4.

questions.stem: Write the missing word, two characters (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {毕业|bì yè}{以后|yǐ hòu}{你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me} ___ ？ (What are your plans after graduation?)
questions.explanation: {计划|jì huà} jì huà (a plan). {={计|jì} is 讠 + {十|shí} and {划|huà} is {戈|gē} + 刂=}: both handwriting characters. In traditional script the word is {+{计划|jì huà}+}.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {目|mù} ___ (goal, target)
questions.explanation: {目标|mù biāo} mù biāo. {={标|biāo} is {木|mù} + {示|shì}. {示|shì} alone is shì ({表示|biǎo shì}, lesson 14), {际|jì} jì ({国际|guó jì}, lesson 24) has 阝 + {示|shì}, and {林|lín} lín is two {木|mù}.=}

questions.stem: Listen to two friends. Why isn't the second one going on to postgraduate study now?

audio.text:
你不考虑读研究生吗？
我不是不想读，而是想先工作几年。

choices: They want to work for a few years first.
They don't want to study any more.

questions.stem: Listen to the announcement. When is the ceremony?

audio.text: 各位同学请注意，今年的毕业典礼将在六月二十日上午九点举行。

questions.stem: Listen. What will the speaker do first?

audio.text: 我打算先工作几个月，然后再申请去英国读硕士。

choices: apply for a master's in Britain

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker's advice?

audio.text: 失败了不要放弃，成功了也不要骄傲，继续往前走。

choices: Keep going, whether you fail or succeed.
Avoid anything you might fail at.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: It isn't that I don't want to go: I don't have time.

She worked for a company at weekends.
questions.explanation: {她|tā}{一边|yì biān}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{附近|fù jìn}{的|de}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小学|xiǎo xué}{教|jiāo}{英语|Yīng yǔ}，{一边|yì biān}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{考试|kǎo shì}: she taught English at a primary school near home while preparing for the exam, studying until midnight after work. {一边|yì biān}…{一边|yì biān} joins two things done in the same period.

questions.stem: Read: "{我|wǒ}{的|de}{好|hǎo}{朋友|péng you}{大学|dà xué}{毕业|bì yè}{那|nà}{年|nián}{报考|bào kǎo}{了|le}{研究生|yán jiū shēng}，{可是|kě shì}{没有|méi yǒu}{通过|tōng guò}。{那|nà}{段|duàn}{时间|shí jiān}{她|tā}{很|hěn}{难过|nán guò}，{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{人|rén}{也|yě}{让|ràng}{她|tā}{放弃|fàng qì}，{先|xiān}{找|zhǎo}{个|gè}{工作|gōng zuò}。{她|tā}{考虑|kǎo lǜ}{了|le}{很|hěn}{久|jiǔ}，{最后|zuì hòu}{还是|hái shi}{决定|jué dìng}{继续|jì xù}{考|kǎo}。{她|tā}{说|shuō}：“{我|wǒ}{的|de}{目标|mù biāo}{不|bú}{是|shì}{找|zhǎo}{一|yí}{个|gè}{工作|gōng zuò}，{而是|ér shì}{成为|chéng wéi}{一|yì}{名|míng}{老师|lǎo shī}。”{第|dì}{二|èr}{年|nián}，{她|tā}{一边|yì biān}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{附近|fù jìn}{的|de}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小学|xiǎo xué}{教|jiāo}{英语|Yīng yǔ}，{一边|yì biān}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{考试|kǎo shì}。{每|měi}{天|tiān}{下班|xià bān}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{她|tā}{都|dōu}{要|yào}{学习|xué xí}{到|dào}{晚上|wǎn shang}{十二|shí'èr}{点|diǎn}，{周末|zhōu mò}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}{休息|xiū xi}。{她|tā}{给|gěi}{自己|zì jǐ}{做|zuò}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{学习|xué xí}{计划|jì huà}，{每|měi}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{都|dōu}{检查|jiǎn chá}{一|yí}{次|cì}{自己|zì jǐ}{做|zuò}{到|dào}{了|le}{没有|méi yǒu}。{今年|jīn nián}{春天|chūn tiān}，{她|tā}{终于|zhōng yú}{通过|tōng guò}{了|le}{考试|kǎo shì}，{还|hái}{申请|shēn qǐng}{到|dào}{了|le}{奖学金|jiǎng xué jīn}。{九|jiǔ}{月|yuè}，{她|tā}{将|jiāng}{开始|kāi shǐ}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{研究生|yán jiū shēng}{生活|shēng huó}。{她|tā}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}{说|shuō}：“{这|zhè}{一|yì}{年|nián}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}，{可是|kě shì}{我|wǒ}{觉得|jué de}{一切|yí qiè}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{有用|yǒu yòng}{的|de}。{如果|rú guǒ}{那|nà}{时候|shí hou}{我|wǒ}{放弃|fàng qì}{了|le}，{可能|kě néng}{就|jiù}{不|bú}{会|huì}{有|yǒu}{今天|jīn tiān}{了|le}。”{放|fàng}{下|xià}{电话|diàn huà}，{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{了|le}{很|hěn}{久|jiǔ}。{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}，{成功|chéng gōng}{的|de}{人|rén}{不|bú}{是|shì}{比|bǐ}{别人|bié ren}{聪明|cōng ming}，{而是|ér shì}{比|bǐ}{别人|bié ren}{更|gèng}{不|bú}{怕|pà}{失败|shī bài}。{祝贺|zhù hè}{你|nǐ}，{我|wǒ}{的|de}{朋友|péng you}！{祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{将来|jiāng lái}{成为|chéng wéi}{一|yì}{名|míng}{好|hǎo}{老师|lǎo shī}！" What does the writer think makes people succeed?
choices: being less afraid of failure than others
questions.explanation: {成功|chéng gōng}{的|de}{人|rén}{不|bú}{是|shì}{比|bǐ}{别人|bié ren}{聪明|cōng ming}，{而是|ér shì}{比|bǐ}{别人|bié ren}{更|gèng}{不|bú}{怕|pà}{失败|shī bài}: successful people aren't cleverer than others, they're less afraid of failing. The friend failed once and tried again: that is the writer's point.

questions.stem: In 《{绝句|jué jù}》 by Du Fu ({杜甫|Dù Fǔ}), the first two lines are "{两个黄鹂鸣翠柳|liǎng gè huáng lí míng cuì liǔ}，{一行白鹭上青天|yì háng bái lù shàng qīng tiān}。" What do they describe?
choices: two boats on a green river, and white snow on the mountains
two yellow flowers on a willow, and white clouds in the sky
two orioles singing in green willows, and a line of egrets rising into the sky
two birds flying home, and a line of people walking up a hill
questions.explanation: {黄鹂|huáng lí} are orioles, {鸣|míng} is "to sing", {翠|cuì}{柳|liǔ} green willows; {一|yì}{行|háng}{白鹭|bái lù} is a line of egrets, and {上|shàng}{青|qīng}{天|tiān} "rise into the blue sky".

questions.stem: How is 行 read in "一行白鹭上青天" (a line of egrets climbs the blue sky)?
questions.explanation: {行|háng} is háng, "a line, a row", as in {银行|yín háng} (a bank). It's xíng in {行|xíng} (OK), {旅行|lǚ xíng} and {自行车|zì xíng chē}.

questions.stem: In 《{绝句|jué jù}》 by Du Fu, "{窗含西岭千秋雪|chuāng hán xī lǐng qiān qiū xuě}" pictures snow of "a thousand autumns" ({千|qiān}{秋|qiū}). What does that mean?
choices: snow that never melts on the mountains
snow that fell a thousand years ago
questions.explanation: {千|qiān}{秋|qiū}{雪|xuě} is snow that has lain through a thousand autumns: the permanent snow of the western mountains, which the window "holds" ({含|hán}) like a picture.

questions.stem: In 《{绝句|jué jù}》 by Du Fu, "{门泊东吴万里船|mén bó Dōng Wú wàn lǐ chuán}" uses {泊|bó}. What does {泊|bó} mean here?
questions.explanation: {泊|bó} is to moor, to lie at anchor: at the door are moored boats bound for {东|dōng}{吴|Wú} (Eastern Wu), ten thousand li away. In modern Chinese you'd say {门|mén}{外|wài}{停|tíng}{着|zhe}{船|chuán}.

questions.stem: Du Fu's 《{春夜喜雨|Chūn yè xǐ yǔ}》 begins "{好雨知时节|hǎo yǔ zhī shí jié}，{当春乃发生|dāng chūn nǎi fā shēng}。" What does {发生|fā shēng} mean in this line?
choices: to come forth and bring things to life
to give birth to a child
questions.explanation: In classical Chinese {发生|fā shēng} is "to come forth, to make things grow": the good rain comes just when spring arrives and brings life. Today {发生|fā shēng} means "to happen" ({发生|fā shēng}{了|le}{什么|shén me}{事|shì}？), a later meaning.

questions.stem: In 《{春夜喜雨|Chūn yè xǐ yǔ}》 by Du Fu, the rain comes "{随风潜入夜|suí fēng qián rù yè}，{润物细无声|rùn wù xì wú shēng}". How does it come?
choices: loudly, with thunder, in the afternoon
quietly, with the wind, in the night
suddenly, in the morning, as a storm
questions.explanation: {随|suí}{风|fēng} (with the wind), {潜|qián}{入|rù}{夜|yè} (slips secretly into the night), {细|xì}{无|wú}{声|shēng} (fine and without a sound): a soft rain that arrives unheard.

questions.stem: The last line of Du Fu's 《{春夜喜雨|Chūn yè xǐ yǔ}》 is "{花重锦官城|huā zhòng Jǐn guān chéng}". What is {锦官城|Jǐn guān chéng}?
choices: the name of Du Fu's cottage
questions.explanation: {锦官城|Jǐn guān chéng}, the City of the Brocade Official, is Chengdu ({成都|Chéng dū}), where Du Fu lived when he wrote the poem; in the Han dynasty an official there oversaw the city's brocade.

questions.stem: How is 重 read in "花重锦官城" (the flowers hang heavy over the Brocade City)?
questions.explanation: The flowers are heavy (with rain), so {重|zhòng} is zhòng, as in {重要|zhòng yào}. Chóng (again) is the reading in {重新|chóng xīn} and {重写|chóng xiě} (lesson 02).

questions.stem: Which two names go together in the way Chinese readers remember the two great Tang poets?
choices: {杜甫|Dù Fǔ}, {诗人|shī rén}; {李白|Lǐ Bái}, {作家|zuò jiā}
{李白|Lǐ Bái}, {诗圣|shī shèng}; {杜甫|Dù Fǔ}, {诗仙|shī xiān}
{李白|Lǐ Bái} and {杜甫|Dù Fǔ} are both called {诗圣|shī shèng}
{李白|Lǐ Bái}, {诗仙|shī xiān} (the immortal of poetry); {杜甫|Dù Fǔ}, {诗圣|shī shèng} (the sage of poetry)
questions.explanation: {李白|Lǐ Bái} (about 701–762), with his free poems of wine and the moon, is {诗仙|shī xiān}; {杜甫|Dù Fǔ} (712–770), with his poems of ordinary people's lives, is {诗圣|shī shèng}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {杜甫|Dù Fǔ} Dù Fǔ: a falling tone, then a dipping one, 4+3.

questions.stem: Read: "759{年|nián}{年底|nián dǐ}，{杜甫|Dù Fǔ}{来|lái}{到|dào}{了|le}{成都|Chéng dū}。{他|tā}{在|zài}{成都|Chéng dū}{住|zhù}{进|jìn}{了|le}{一|yí}{座|zuò}{简单|jiǎn dān}{的|de}{草堂|cǎo táng}。{在|zài}{成都|Chéng dū}{的|de}{这|zhè}{几|jǐ}{年|nián}，{是|shì}{他|tā}{一生|yì shēng}{中|zhōng}{比较|bǐ jiào}{安静|ān jìng}、{快乐|kuài lè}{的|de}{日子|rì zi}。" ({年底|nián dǐ}: end of the year; {草堂|cǎo táng}: thatched cottage; {日子|rì zi}: days) What does the text say about Du Fu's years in Chengdu?
choices: They were the hardest years of his life.
They were among the calmest and happiest years of his life.
He lived in a big house in the city centre.
He left Chengdu after a few weeks.
questions.explanation: {在|zài}{成都|Chéng dū}{的|de}{这|zhè}{几|jǐ}{年|nián}，{是|shì}{他|tā}{一生|yì shēng}{中|zhōng}{比较|bǐ jiào}{安静|ān jìng}、{快乐|kuài lè}{的|de}{日子|rì zi}: his years in Chengdu were among the calmest and happiest of his life. He lived in a simple thatched cottage ({简单|jiǎn dān}{的|de}{草堂|cǎo táng}).

questions.stem: Read: "{杜甫|Dù Fǔ}{的|de}{一生|yì shēng}{很|hěn}{不|bù}{容易|róng yì}。{他|tā}{年轻|nián qīng}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{想|xiǎng}{当官|dāng guān}，{可是|kě shì}{考试|kǎo shì}{没有|méi yǒu}{成功|chéng gōng}。{后来|hòu lái}{国家|guó jiā}{发生|fā shēng}{了|le}{战争|zhàn zhēng}，{他|tā}{带|dài}{着|zhe}{家人|jiā rén}{到处|dào chù}{走|zǒu}。" ({当官|dāng guān}: to become an official; {战争|zhàn zhēng}: war) Why did Du Fu travel from place to place?
choices: He liked travelling and writing about new places.
He had become an official and was sent to many towns.
War came, and he moved about with his family.
He was looking for a school to teach in.
questions.explanation: {后来|hòu lái}{国家|guó jiā}{发生|fā shēng}{了|le}{战争|zhàn zhēng}，{他|tā}{带|dài}{着|zhe}{家人|jiā rén}{到处|dào chù}{走|zǒu}: war broke out and he went from place to place with his family. He had failed the exams ({考试|kǎo shì}{没有|méi yǒu}{成功|chéng gōng}), so he wasn't an official.

questions.stem: What is {甲骨文|jiǎ gǔ wén} (oracle bone script)?
choices: writing cast into bronze bells of the Han dynasty
the earliest large body of Chinese writing, carved on shells and bones in the late Shang
a style of brush writing invented in the Tang dynasty
questions.explanation: {甲骨文|jiǎ gǔ wén}, "shell-and-bone writing", was carved on tortoise shells and ox bones for divination in the late Shang dynasty (roughly 1250–1050 BCE). Bronze inscriptions are {金文|jīn wén}.

questions.stem: What were the oracle bones used for?
choices: divination, asking questions such as "will it rain?"
questions.explanation: The Shang kings' diviners carved questions on the bones, heated them until they cracked, and read the answers in the cracks: will it rain, will the harvest be good, should the king go hunting.

questions.stem: Which script became the standard across China after the Qin unification of 221 BCE?
questions.explanation: The Qin state's seal script, which had grown more regular over the centuries, became the national standard: {小篆|xiǎo zhuàn}. Regular script came much later (Han to Tang), and oracle bone script long before.

questions.stem: Read: "{小篆|xiǎo zhuàn}{很|hěn}{好看|hǎo kàn}，{可是|kě shì}{写|xiě}{起来|qǐ lái}{比较|bǐ jiào}{慢|màn}。{汉朝|Hàn cháo}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{人|rén}{们|men}{已经|yǐ jīng}{用|yòng}{毛笔|máo bǐ}{写字|xiě zì}{了|le}。{用|yòng}{毛笔|máo bǐ}{写|xiě}{小篆|xiǎo zhuàn}{很|hěn}{慢|màn}，{写|xiě}{隶书|lì shū}{就|jiù}{快|kuài}{多|duō}{了|le}。" ({毛笔|máo bǐ}: brush; {隶书|lì shū}: clerical script) Why did clerical script spread?
choices: It was much quicker to write with a brush.
It was more beautiful than seal script.
The emperor ordered it for all books.
questions.explanation: {用|yòng}{毛笔|máo bǐ}{写|xiě}{小篆|xiǎo zhuàn}{很|hěn}{慢|màn}，{写|xiě}{隶书|lì shū}{就|jiù}{快|kuài}{多|duō}{了|le}: seal script was slow with a brush, and clerical script much quicker. Seal script is the one called beautiful ({小篆|xiǎo zhuàn}{很|hěn}{好看|hǎo kàn}).

questions.stem: The characters you are learning in this course, simplified and traditional, are written in which style?
questions.explanation: {楷书|kǎi shū}, regular script, grew out of clerical script between the Han and Three Kingdoms periods and matured in the Tang dynasty. It is the script of print and careful handwriting today, in both forms.

questions.stem: In which year was the Chinese Character Simplification Scheme ({汉字简化方案|Hàn zì jiǎn huà fāng àn}) published?
questions.explanation: The scheme was published in January 1956. The General List of Simplified Characters followed in 1964, and the 2013 Table of General Standard Chinese Characters ({通用规范汉字表|Tōng yòng Guī fàn Hàn zì biǎo}) set out 8,105 standard characters.

questions.stem: Simplified {={发|fā}=} stands for two traditional characters. Which word has which?
choices: {出发|chū fā} has {髮|fà} and {头发|tóu fa} has {發|fā}.
{出发|chū fā} has {發|fā} and {头发|tóu fa} has {髮|fà}.
questions.explanation: {發|fā} (to send out, to start) is in {+{出发|chū fā}+}; {髮|fà} (hair) is in {+{头发|tóu fa}+}. One simplified character for several is one of the ways the simplified forms were made, and it's why the traditional switch has to know the word.

questions.stem: Simplified {={飞|fēi}=} (to fly) and {={习|xí}=} (to practise) come from their traditional forms {+{飞|fēi}+} and {+{习|xí}+}. How were they simplified?
choices: by replacing the whole character with a sound
by keeping only part of the character
by merging two characters into one
questions.explanation: Both keep part of the traditional character and leave the rest out. Other methods were cursive shapes made regular ({={书|shū}=} from {+{书|shū}+}), simpler components ({={门|mén}=} from {+{门|mén}+}) and one character for several ({={发|fā}=}).

questions.stem: Where are traditional characters used today?
choices: in Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau and in many overseas communities
in mainland China, Singapore and Malaysia
questions.explanation: Traditional characters are used in Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau and in many overseas Chinese communities. Simplified characters are the standard in mainland China, and are also used in Singapore and Malaysia.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {文字|wén zì} wén zì (writing, a script): a rising tone, then a falling one, 2+4.

questions.stem: Read: "{不管|bù guǎn}{是|shì}{简体字|jiǎn tǐ zì}{还是|hái shi}{繁体字|fán tǐ zì}，{都|dōu}{是|shì}{同一|tóng yī}{种|zhǒng}{文字|wén zì}。{学|xué}{好|hǎo}{了|le}{一|yì}{种|zhǒng}，{再|zài}{学|xué}{另|lìng}{一|yì}{种|zhǒng}{就|jiù}{不|bú}{太|tài}{难|nán}{了|le}。" ({不管|bù guǎn}…{都|dōu}: whether… or…; {简体字|jiǎn tǐ zì} / {繁体字|fán tǐ zì}: simplified / traditional characters) What does the writer think?
choices: Simplified and traditional are two different languages.
Traditional characters are much harder than simplified.
Everyone should learn only traditional characters.
Learning the second form is not too hard once you know one well.
questions.explanation: {同一|tóng yī}{种|zhǒng}{文字|wén zì}: they are the same writing system, and {学|xué}{好|hǎo}{了|le}{一|yì}{种|zhǒng}，{再|zài}{学|xué}{另|lìng}{一|yì}{种|zhǒng}{就|jiù}{不|bú}{太|tài}{难|nán}{了|le}: once you know one well, the other isn't too hard. The writer doesn't rank the two forms.

questions.stem: Read: "{那|nà}{时候|shí hou}，{人|rén}{们|men}{把|bǎ}{想|xiǎng}{问|wèn}{的|de}{问题|wèn tí}{刻|kè}{在|zài}{乌龟|wū guī}{的|de}{壳|ké}{和|hé}{牛|niú}{的|de}{骨头|gǔ tou}{上|shàng}。{有的|yǒu de}{甲骨文|jiǎ gǔ wén}{像|xiàng}{画儿|huàr}{一样|yí yàng}，{例如|lì rú}“{日|rì}”{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{圆|yuán}，{中间|zhōng jiān}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{点|diǎn}。" ({刻|kè}: to carve; {乌龟|wū guī}{的|de}{壳|ké}: a tortoise shell; {骨头|gǔ tou}: bone; {圆|yuán}: circle) How was {日|rì} written in oracle bone script?
choices: as a square with two lines
as a circle with a dot in the middle
questions.explanation: “{日|rì}”{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{圆|yuán}，{中间|zhōng jiān}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{点|diǎn}: a circle with a dot in the middle, a picture of the sun. A crescent was {月|yuè} (the moon), and three peaks {山|shān}.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "My head is killing me."?
questions.explanation: Adjective + {死|sǐ}{了|le} says "terribly": {我|wǒ}{头|tóu}{疼|téng}{死|sǐ}{了|le}。 It takes no {很|hěn} ({死|sǐ}{了|le} already says how much) and no {得|de}: {疼|téng}{得|de}{死|sǐ}{了|le} mixes up the two complements. {死|sǐ}{了|le} always comes after the adjective.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "He has a bad cough."?
questions.explanation: {厉害|lì hai} as a degree complement follows the verb with {得|de}: {咳嗽|ké sou}{得|de}({很|hěn}){厉害|lì hai}。 It doesn't go before the verb ({很|hěn}{厉害|lì hai}{咳嗽|ké sou}), and the order is verb + {得|de} + {厉害|lì hai}, not {厉害|lì hai}{得|de} + verb.

questions.stem: Your friend has cooked eight dishes for a party, all on their own. You say: “{你|nǐ}{真|zhēn}{厉害|lì hai}！” What are you telling them?
questions.explanation: On its own, {厉害|lì hai} is "formidable": very good at something, or (of a teacher, say) strict. After a feat like this, {你|nǐ}{真|zhēn}{厉害|lì hai}！ is praise. "Seriously ill" would be {病|bìng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{厉害|lì hai}, and nothing here is about anger.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I'm scared of injections."?
questions.explanation: "To be afraid of something" is {怕|pà}: {我|wǒ}{怕|pà}{打针|dǎ zhēn}。 {恐怕|kǒng pà} means "I'm afraid that… (probably)" and is followed by what's likely to happen: {恐怕|kǒng pà}{要|yào}{打针|dǎ zhēn} (I'm afraid you'll need an injection). It never takes a feared thing as its object.

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: “{这个|zhè ge}{药|yào}{一|yì}{天|tiān}{吃|chī}{三|sān}{次|cì}，{你|nǐ} ___ {别|bié}{忘|wàng}{了|le}！”
questions.explanation: {千万|qiān wàn} + {别|bié} is an urgent warning: "whatever you do, don't forget!" {恐怕|kǒng pà} introduces a likely outcome ({恐怕|kǒng pà}{别|bié}{忘|wàng}{了|le} makes no sense), and {正常|zhèng cháng} (normal) and {严重|yán zhòng} (serious) are adjectives that can't stand before {别|bié}.

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: “{身体|shēn tǐ}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{问题|wèn tí}，{要|yào} ___ {去|qù}{医院|yī yuàn}，{别|bié}{等|děng}{病|bìng}{严重|yán zhòng}{了|le}{才|cái}{去|qù}。”
questions.explanation: {及时|jí shí} (promptly, before it's too late) goes straight before the verb: {及时|jí shí}{去|qù}{医院|yī yuàn}。 The second half (don't wait until it's serious) tells you the gap is about timing. {正常|zhèng cháng} and {难受|nán shòu} are adjectives, {情况|qíng kuàng} a noun.

questions.stem: How do you say 大夫 when it means "doctor"?
questions.explanation: {大夫|dài fu}, the spoken word for a doctor, is dàifu: dài with an i, and a light second syllable. Read dàfū it is an old title for officials. {医生|yī shēng} yīshēng is the neutral word.

questions.stem: How is 量 read in “{护士|hù shi}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}量{体温|tǐ wēn}。”?
questions.explanation: As the verb "to measure" ({量|liáng}{体温|tǐ wēn}, take a temperature), {量|liáng} is liáng, second tone. As the noun "amount" it's liàng ({少量|shǎo liàng}, {数量|shù liàng}). liǎng is {两|liǎng}.

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: “{王|Wáng}{老师|lǎo shī}{今天|jīn tiān}{没|méi}{来|lái}{上课|shàng kè}。{听说|tīng shuō}{她|tā}{昨天|zuó tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{发烧|fā shāo}{了|le}，{今天|jīn tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{体温|tǐ wēn}{还是|hái shi}{不|bú} ___ ，{所以|suǒ yǐ}{去|qù}{医院|yī yuàn}{了|le}。”
questions.explanation: {体温|tǐ wēn}{不|bú}{正常|zhèng cháng}: her temperature still wasn't normal, so she went to hospital. {严重|yán zhòng} is for an illness or a problem, not a temperature ({体温|tǐ wēn}{不|bù}{严重|yán zhòng} isn't said), {及时|jí shí} is about timing, and {情况|qíng kuàng} is a noun.

questions.stem: Read: “{上|shàng}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{的|de}{一|yí}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}，{我|wǒ}{和|hé}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{同学|tóng xué}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{打|dǎ}{篮球|lán qiú}。{那|nà}{天|tiān}{天气|tiān qì}{很|hěn}{热|rè}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{想|xiǎng}{快点儿|kuài diǎnr}{开始|kāi shǐ}，{没有|méi yǒu}{先|xiān}{做|zuò}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{活动|huó dòng}。{打|dǎ}{了|le}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{多|duō}{小时|xiǎo shí}，{我|wǒ}{跳|tiào}{起来|qǐ lái}{接|jiē}{球|qiú}，{下来|xià lái}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{没|méi}{站|zhàn}{好|hǎo}，{右|yòu}{胳膊|gē bo}{先|xiān}{着地|zháo dì}{了|le}。” ({着地|zháo dì}: to land on, touch the ground; {准备|zhǔn bèi}{活动|huó dòng}: a warm-up) Why did the writer get hurt?
choices: He hadn't warmed up, and he landed badly after a jump.
He was ill and tired that day.
questions.explanation: {没有|méi yǒu}{先|xiān}{做|zuò}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{活动|huó dòng} (they didn't warm up first) and {下来|xià lái}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{没|méi}{站|zhàn}{好|hǎo} (he landed badly when he came down): the cause and the moment of the injury. Nobody ran into him, and the text mentions heat, not rain or illness.

questions.stem: Read the start and end of a story about a sports injury: “{那|nà}{天|tiān}{天气|tiān qì}{很|hěn}{热|rè}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{想|xiǎng}{快点儿|kuài diǎnr}{开始|kāi shǐ}，{没有|méi yǒu}{先|xiān}{做|zuò}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{活动|huó dòng}。……{现在|xiàn zài}，{我|wǒ}{每|měi}{次|cì}{打|dǎ}{球|qiú}{以前|yǐ qián}{都|dōu}{先|xiān}{做|zuò}{十|shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{活动|huó dòng}。{妈妈|mā ma}{说|shuō}：‘{你|nǐ}{早|zǎo}{就|jiù}{该|gāi}{这样|zhè yàng}{了|le}！’” ({准备|zhǔn bèi}{活动|huó dòng}: a warm-up) What does the mother's remark suggest?
choices: She doesn't want him to play any more.
She is surprised that he warms up.
She thinks he should have been warming up all along.
She thinks ten minutes is too long.
questions.explanation: {早|zǎo}{就|jiù}{该|gāi}{这样|zhè yàng}{了|le} is "should have been like this long ago": she approves of the warm-up but adds a gentle "I told you so". She doesn't stop him playing, isn't surprised, and says nothing about the length.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker's problem?

audio.text: 大夫，我从昨天晚上开始咳嗽，咳得很厉害。

choices: a bad cough since last night
questions.explanation: {大夫|dài fu}，{我|wǒ}{从|cóng}{昨天|zuó tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{开始|kāi shǐ}{咳嗽|ké sou}，{咳|ké}{得|de}{很|hěn}{厉害|lì hai}。 "Doctor, I started coughing last night, and it's a bad cough." {从|cóng}…{开始|kāi shǐ} gives the start, and {咳|ké}{得|de}{很|hěn}{厉害|lì hai} how bad it is. No fever, arm or headache is mentioned.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker say?

audio.text: 体温三十七度，很正常，不用担心。

choices: The temperature is normal: no need to worry.
The temperature is high: see a doctor.
The temperature hasn't been taken yet.
The temperature is a little low.
questions.explanation: {体温|tǐ wēn}{三十七|sān shí qī}{度|dù}，{很|hěn}{正常|zhèng cháng}，{不用|bú yòng}{担心|dān xīn}。 "37 degrees: perfectly normal, nothing to worry about." {正常|zhèng cháng} is normal; {不用|bú yòng}{担心|dān xīn}, no need to worry.

questions.stem: Listen. How does the speaker feel?

audio.text: 你又不吃早饭？千万别再这样了，身体最重要！

questions.explanation: {又|yòu} (again) shows annoyance, {千万|qiān wàn}{别|bié}{再|zài}{这样|zhè yàng}{了|le} (whatever you do, don't do that again) is an urgent warning, and {身体|shēn tǐ}{最|zuì}{重要|zhòng yào} (your health comes first) shows concern: the speaker is worried and insistent.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker telling you?

audio.text: 我恐怕明天不能去上班了，大夫让我休息两天。

choices: They'll be late for work tomorrow.
They have to see a doctor tomorrow.
They're afraid of going to work.
They probably can't go to work tomorrow: the doctor told them to rest.
questions.explanation: {恐怕|kǒng pà}{明天|míng tiān}{不|bù}{能|néng}{去|qù}{上班|shàng bān}{了|le} is "I'm afraid I won't be able to go to work tomorrow", and the reason is {大夫|dài fu}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{休息|xiū xi}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān} (the doctor told me to rest for two days). {恐怕|kǒng pà} gives the likely outcome; it isn't "afraid of".

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {体温|tǐ wēn}, body temperature: third tone + first tone. {体|tǐ} dips low, {温|wēn} stays high and level.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {恐怕|kǒng pà}, I'm afraid that: third tone + fourth tone. Before the falling {怕|pà}, {恐|kǒng} is a low half-third.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word {情|qíng}___ (situation, how things are)?
questions.explanation: {情况|qíng kuàng}. {={况|kuàng} is {兄|xiōng} with the two-stroke ice radical 冫 on the left; {兄|xiōng} alone is "older brother"=} (traditional {+{况|kuàng}+} has the water radical, 氵 + {兄|xiōng}). {祝|zhù} is in {祝贺|zhù hè}; {={凉|liáng} ({凉快|liáng kuai}, cool) has the ice radical too, but with {京|jīng} on the right=}.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (it's one to know by hand): {护士|hù shi}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ} ___ {体温|tǐ wēn}。 (The nurse took my temperature.)
questions.explanation: {护士|hù shi}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{量|liáng}{体温|tǐ wēn}。 {量|liáng} liáng, to measure. {={量|liáng} is {日|rì}, a long horizontal, then {里|lǐ}: twelve strokes=}.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Whatever you do, don't forget to take your medicine after meals.
questions.explanation: {你|nǐ}{千万|qiān wàn}{别|bié}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{饭|fàn}{后|hòu}{吃|chī}{药|yào}！ {千万|qiān wàn} comes after the subject and before {别|bié}; {饭|fàn}{后|hòu} (after meals) goes before {吃|chī}{药|yào}, or before {千万|qiān wàn} as a time setting ({你|nǐ}{饭|fàn}{后|hòu}{千万|qiān wàn}{别|bié}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{吃|chī}{药|yào}). The subject {你|nǐ} can be left out of advice. {恐怕|kǒng pà} doesn't make a warning.

questions.explanation: {最近|zuì jìn}{感冒|gǎn mào}、{咳嗽|ké sou}{或者|huò zhě}{发烧|fā shāo}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué}，{请|qǐng}{先|xiān}{告诉|gào su}{护士|hù shi}，{大夫|dài fu}{会|huì}{根据|gēn jù}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{情况|qíng kuàng}{决定|jué dìng}{当天|dàng tiān}{能|néng}{不|bu}{能|néng}{体检|tǐ jiǎn}: tell the nurse first; the doctor decides from your condition whether you can be examined that day. Changing the time by phone is for students with an exam or something else on.

questions.stem: Read the notice: "{学生|xué sheng}{体检|tǐ jiǎn}　{各位|gè wèi}{同学|tóng xué}：{本|běn}{学期|xué qī}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}{体检|tǐ jiǎn}{时间|shí jiān}{是|shì}{下|xià}{周|zhōu}{三|sān}{和|hé}{周|zhōu}{四|sì}{上午|shàng wǔ}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}{十一|shí yī}{点|diǎn}，{地点|dì diǎn}{是|shì}{学校|xué xiào}{医院|yī yuàn}{二|èr}{楼|lóu}。{外语|wài yǔ}{学院|xué yuàn}{和|hé}{新闻|xīn wén}{学院|xué yuàn}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué}{周|zhōu}{三|sān}{来|lái}，{其他|qí tā}{学院|xué yuàn}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué}{周|zhōu}{四|sì}{来|lái}。{体检|tǐ jiǎn}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{护士|hù shi}{会|huì}{给|gěi}{大家|dà jiā}{量|liáng}{体温|tǐ wēn}，{大夫|dài fu}{会|huì}{检查|jiǎn chá}{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{眼睛|yǎn jing}、{鼻子|bí zi}{和|hé}{皮肤|pí fū}。{请|qǐng}{注意|zhù yì}{下面|xià miàn}{几|jǐ}{点|diǎn}：{一|yī}、{请|qǐng}{在|zài}{自己|zì jǐ}{学院|xué yuàn}{的|de}{时间|shí jiān}{来|lái}，{不要|bú yào}{早|zǎo}{到|dào}，{也|yě}{不要|bú yào}{迟到|chí dào}。{二|èr}、{体检|tǐ jiǎn}{那|nà}{天|tiān}{请|qǐng}{穿|chuān}{方便|fāng biàn}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}，{不要|bú yào}{带|dài}{太|tài}{多|duō}{东西|dōng xi}。{三|sān}、{最近|zuì jìn}{感冒|gǎn mào}、{咳嗽|ké sou}{或者|huò zhě}{发烧|fā shāo}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué}，{请|qǐng}{先|xiān}{告诉|gào su}{护士|hù shi}，{大夫|dài fu}{会|huì}{根据|gēn jù}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{情况|qíng kuàng}{决定|jué dìng}{当天|dàng tiān}{能|néng}{不|bu}{能|néng}{体检|tǐ jiǎn}。{四|sì}、{如果|rú guǒ}{你|nǐ}{以前|yǐ qián}{受|shòu}{过|guo}{伤|shāng}，{或者|huò zhě}{得|dé}{过|guo}{什么|shén me}{病|bìng}，{请|qǐng}{在|zài}{体检|tǐ jiǎn}{以前|yǐ qián}{告诉|gào su}{大夫|dài fu}。{五|wǔ}、{体检|tǐ jiǎn}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{如果|rú guǒ}{发现|fā xiàn}{问题|wèn tí}，{学校|xué xiào}{医院|yī yuàn}{会|huì}{及时|jí shí}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}，{请|qǐng}{保持|bǎo chí}{手机|shǒu jī}{畅通|chàng tōng}。{体检|tǐ jiǎn}{是|shì}{每|měi}{个|gè}{学生|xué sheng}{都|dōu}{必须|bì xū}{参加|cān jiā}{的|de}。{如果|rú guǒ}{你|nǐ}{那|nà}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}{有|yǒu}{考试|kǎo shì}{或者|huò zhě}{别的|bié de}{事|shì}，{请|qǐng}{先|xiān}{给|gěi}{学校|xué xiào}{医院|yī yuàn}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}，{换|huàn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{时间|shí jiān}。{千万|qiān wàn}{不要|bú yào}{因为|yīn wèi}{忙|máng}{就|jiù}{不|bù}{来|lái}{体检|tǐ jiǎn}！　{学校|xué xiào}{医院|yī yuàn}　{三|sān}{月|yuè}{二|èr}{日|rì}" ({根据|gēn jù}: according to; {当天|dàng tiān}: on that day; {保持|bǎo chí}: to keep; {畅通|chàng tōng}: open, unblocked (of a phone line or road)) What does the last sentence, {千万|qiān wàn}{不要|bú yào}{因为|yīn wèi}{忙|máng}{就|jiù}{不|bù}{来|lái}{体检|tǐ jiǎn}, show?
choices: The check-up is only for students who are ill.
The hospital is too busy to see everyone.
Busy students may skip the check-up.
The check-up is compulsory, and being busy is no excuse.
questions.explanation: {千万|qiān wàn}{不要|bú yào} is a strong "be sure not to": being busy is no reason to miss it. The sentence before says the same: {体检|tǐ jiǎn}{是|shì}{每|měi}{个|gè}{学生|xué sheng}{都|dōu}{必须|bì xū}{参加|cān jiā}{的|de} (every student must take part), and students who can't come change the time instead.

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: “{以后|yǐ hòu}{请|qǐng} ___ {来|lái}{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{玩儿|wánr}！”
questions.explanation: An invitation about the future takes {常常|cháng cháng}: {以后|yǐ hòu}{请|qǐng}{常常|cháng cháng}{来|lái}{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{玩儿|wánr}！ {往往|wǎng wǎng} only sums up a pattern you've already seen ({周末|zhōu mò}{他|tā}{往往|wǎng wǎng}{去|qù}{爬|pá}{山|shān}), so it can't go in a request. {尤其|yóu qí} (especially) and {至少|zhì shǎo} (at least) don't fit the sense.

questions.stem: What does “{刚|gāng}{开始|kāi shǐ}{健身|jiàn shēn}{的|de}{人|rén}{往往|wǎng wǎng}{练|liàn}{得|de}{太|tài}{多|duō}。” mean?
choices: People who've just started working out tend to overdo it.
People who've just started working out should train more.
People who've just started working out never train enough.
People who've just started working out train once in a while.
questions.explanation: {往往|wǎng wǎng} states a tendency, a pattern seen in a situation: beginners, as a rule, train too much ({练|liàn}{得|de}{太|tài}{多|duō}). It isn't advice (should), and {偶尔|ǒu ěr} would be "once in a while".

questions.stem: Your flatmate says: “{你|nǐ}{怎么|zěn me}{老是|lǎo shi}{把|bǎ}{衣服|yī fu}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{沙发|shā fā}{上|shàng}？” How do they feel?
questions.explanation: {老是|lǎo shi} (always) with {怎么|zěn me} (how come) is a complaint: "Why do you always leave your clothes on the sofa?" With {总是|zǒng shì} the sentence would sound more neutral. ({沙发|shā fā}: sofa.)

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: “{我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{运动|yùn dòng}， ___ {是|shì}{游泳|yóu yǒng}{和|hé}{跑步|pǎo bù}。”
questions.explanation: {尤其|yóu qí}{是|shì} picks out the best example from a group: "I love sport, especially swimming and running." {偶尔|ǒu ěr} (occasionally), {往往|wǎng wǎng} (tends to) and {至少|zhì shǎo} (at least) don't go before {是|shì} + an example like this.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I didn't get to sleep at all last night."?
choices: {昨天|zuó tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{一直|yì zhí}{不|bú}{睡|shuì}{着|zháo}。
{昨天|zuó tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{一直|yì zhí}{没|méi}{睡|shuì}{着|zháo}{了|le}。
{昨天|zuó tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{一直|yì zhí}{睡|shuì}{没|méi}{着|zháo}。
{昨天|zuó tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{一直|yì zhí}{没|méi}{睡|shuì}{着|zháo}。
questions.explanation: {睡|shuì}{着|zháo} (zháo: to fall asleep) is a verb + result, and a result that didn't happen is negated with {没|méi}, without {了|le}: {没|méi}{睡|shuì}{着|zháo}. {不|bù} before it doesn't work for a past event, and {没|méi} goes before the verb, not between.

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: “{大夫|dài fu}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ} ___ {吃|chī}{药|yào}，{早上|zǎo shang}{一|yí}{次|cì}，{晚上|wǎn shang}{一|yí}{次|cì}。”
questions.explanation: {按时|àn shí} is "at the set times": morning and evening, as the doctor said. {偶尔|ǒu ěr} (occasionally) is the opposite of what a doctor wants, {老是|lǎo shi} is a complaint, and {尤其|yóu qí} (especially) needs a group to pick from.

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: “{我|wǒ}{已经|yǐ jīng} ___ {了|le}{早|zǎo}{睡|shuì}{早|zǎo}{起|qǐ}{的|de}{习惯|xí guàn}。”
questions.explanation: {养成|yǎng chéng} + {习惯|xí guàn} is "to form a habit": {养成|yǎng chéng}{了|le}{早|zǎo}{睡|shuì}{早|zǎo}{起|qǐ}{的|de}{习惯|xí guàn}. {完成|wán chéng} is to finish a task, {成为|chéng wéi} to become ({成为|chéng wéi}{一|yí}{个|gè}{好|hǎo}{习惯|xí guàn} would need a different subject), and {变化|biàn huà} is a change.

questions.stem: What does {困|kùn} mean in “{我|wǒ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{没|méi}{睡|shuì}{好|hǎo}，{现在|xiàn zài}{很|hěn}{困|kùn}。”?
questions.explanation: After a bad night, {很|hěn}{困|kùn} is "very sleepy". Tired from effort is {累|lèi}, and {困难|kùn nan} (difficulty) uses another meaning of the character (in traditional characters "sleepy" is written {={睏|kùn}=}).

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: “{跑|pǎo}{完|wán}{步|bù}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{别|bié}{马上|mǎ shàng}{坐|zuò}{下|xià}，{要|yào}{让|ràng}{身体|shēn tǐ} ___ {一下|yí xià}，{比如|bǐ rú}{慢|màn}{慢|màn}{地|de}{走|zǒu}{一|yi}{走|zǒu}。”
questions.explanation: {让|ràng}{身体|shēn tǐ}{放松|fàng sōng}{一下|yí xià}: let your body relax. {放松|fàng sōng} is the verb, and it takes {一下|yí xià}. {加油|jiā yóu} is cheering, {力气|lì qi} a noun (strength), and {轻|qīng} (light) can't take {一下|yí xià} here.

questions.stem: Read: “{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{开始|kāi shǐ}{健身|jiàn shēn}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{认真|rèn zhēn}：{买|mǎi}{了|le}{新|xīn}{衣服|yī fu}，{去|qù}{了|le}{健身房|jiàn shēn fáng}，{还|hái}{请|qǐng}{了|le}{教练|jiào liàn}。{可是|kě shì}{过|guò}{了|le}{一两|yì liǎng}{个|gè}{月|yuè}，{他们|tā men}{往往|wǎng wǎng}{就|jiù}{不|bú}{去|qù}{了|le}。{健身房|jiàn shēn fáng}{的|de}{教练|jiào liàn}{说|shuō}，{最|zuì}{大|dà}{的|de}{原因|yuán yīn}{是|shì}{大家|dà jiā}{太|tài}{想|xiǎng}{马上|mǎ shàng}{看|kàn}{到|dào}{效果|xiào guǒ}{了|le}。” ({原因|yuán yīn}: reason) Why, according to the trainer, do people stop going?
choices: They want to see results too fast.
questions.explanation: {最|zuì}{大|dà}{的|de}{原因|yuán yīn}{是|shì}{大家|dà jiā}{太|tài}{想|xiǎng}{马上|mǎ shàng}{看|kàn}{到|dào}{效果|xiào guǒ}{了|le}: the main reason is that people are too eager to see results. Nothing is said about cost, strict trainers or injuries.

questions.stem: Read: “{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{开始|kāi shǐ}{健身|jiàn shēn}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{认真|rèn zhēn}，{可是|kě shì}{过|guò}{了|le}{一两|yì liǎng}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{往往|wǎng wǎng}{就|jiù}{不|bú}{去|qù}{了|le}。{教练|jiào liàn}{说|shuō}：‘{健身|jiàn shēn}{跟|gēn}{学|xué}{外语|wài yǔ}{一样|yí yàng}，{最|zuì}{重要|zhòng yào}{的|de}{不|bú}{是|shì}{一|yì}{开始|kāi shǐ}{有|yǒu}{多|duō}{努力|nǔ lì}，{而|ér}{是|shì}{能|néng}{不|bu}{能|néng}{养成|yǎng chéng}{习惯|xí guàn}。’” What is the trainer's main point?
choices: Learning a language is harder than keeping fit.
You should work as hard as possible at the start.
Keeping it up as a habit matters more than early effort.
People should learn languages at the gym.
questions.explanation: {不|bú}{是|shì}…{而|ér}{是|shì} sets the wrong idea against the right one: not how hard you try at first, but whether it becomes a habit ({养成|yǎng chéng}{习惯|xí guàn}). The comparison with learning a language makes the same point; it doesn't rank the two.

questions.stem: Listen. How often does the speaker exercise?

audio.text: 我平常很少运动，偶尔周末去打打乒乓球。

choices: only now and then, at weekends
questions.explanation: {很|hěn}{少|shǎo}{运动|yùn dòng} (hardly ever exercises) and {偶尔|ǒu ěr}{周末|zhōu mò}{去|qù}{打打|dǎ da}{乒乓球|pīng pāng qiú} (now and then plays a bit of table tennis at the weekend). {偶尔|ǒu ěr} is "occasionally": not never, not often.

questions.stem: Listen. What is happening?

audio.text: 加油！加油！还有最后一百米！

choices: Someone is filling up a car.
A coach is explaining a movement.
People are cheering a runner near the finish.
questions.explanation: {加油|jiā yóu}！ is the cheer "come on!", and {还|hái}{有|yǒu}{最后|zuì hòu}{一百|yì bǎi}{米|mǐ} (just the last hundred metres to go) puts you near the finish of a race. {加油|jiā yóu} can mean filling up with fuel, but not with {还|hái}{有|yǒu}{最后|zuì hòu}{一百|yì bǎi}{米|mǐ}.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker's attitude?

audio.text: 你又躺在床上看手机？这样怎么能睡好呢？

questions.explanation: {又|yòu} (again) and the question {这样|zhè yàng}{怎么|zěn me}{能|néng}{睡|shuì}{好|hǎo}{呢|ne}？ (how can you sleep well like that?) are a reproach: the speaker disapproves of looking at the phone in bed.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker's main point?

audio.text: 健身的效果不是一两天就能看到的，至少要坚持三个月。

choices: Results take time: keep going for at least three months.
You should work out for three hours a day.
Working out is only useful in the first three months.
questions.explanation: {效果|xiào guǒ}{不|bú}{是|shì}{一两|yì liǎng}{天|tiān}{就|jiù}{能|néng}{看|kàn}{到|dào}{的|de} (you won't see results in a day or two) and {至少|zhì shǎo}{要|yào}{坚持|jiān chí}{三|sān}{个|gè}{月|yuè} (keep at it for at least three months). {坚持|jiān chí} is HSK 3's "to keep at it".

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {健身|jiàn shēn}, to work out: fourth tone + first tone, as in {健康|jiàn kāng} (health).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {排球|pái qiú}, volleyball: two rising tones, second + second. {篮球|lán qiú} (basketball) is the same pattern: lán qiú.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word {早|zǎo} ___ (early morning)?
questions.explanation: {早晨|zǎo chén} zǎochén. {={晨|chén} is the sun {日|rì} over {辰|chén}, which gives the sound chén=}. {层|céng} (floor, storey) and {晴|qíng} (sunny) look a little alike, and {星|xīng} is in {星期|xīng qī}.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (it's one to know by hand): {最近|zuì jìn}{工作|gōng zuò}{很|hěn}{忙|máng}， ___ {力|lì}{很|hěn}{大|dà}。 (I've been busy at work lately, and I'm under a lot of pressure.)
questions.explanation: {压力|yā lì} yālì, pressure, stress. {={压|yā} is {厂|chǎng}, then {土|tǔ} inside, and the dot last: six strokes=} (traditional {+{压|yā}+}: 17 strokes).

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: I've got into the habit of walking for half an hour every day.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{养成|yǎng chéng}{了|le}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{散步|sàn bù}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{的|de}{习惯|xí guàn}。 {养成|yǎng chéng}{了|le} + the habit, which is described in front of {习惯|xí guàn} with {的|de}: {每|měi}{天|tiān}{散步|sàn bù}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{的|de}{习惯|xí guàn}. {往往|wǎng wǎng} sums up a pattern; it doesn't go into a habit you've just formed.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "This dish is really spicy!"?

questions.stem: Which phrase means "a big bowl of noodles"?
questions.explanation: {大|dà} (or {小|xiǎo}) goes between the number and the measure word: {一|yí}{大|dà}{碗|wǎn}{面|miàn}{条|tiáo}. {一|yì}{碗|wǎn}{大|dà}{面|miàn}{条|tiáo} would make the noodles big, not the bowl, and {大|dà} can't come before the number. ({面|miàn}{条|tiáo}: noodles.)

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: “{这个|zhè ge}{药|yào}{真|zhēn} ___ ，{孩子|hái zi}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{吃|chī}。”

questions.stem: Which sentence means "That smells wonderful!"?

choices: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{毛衣|máo yī}{比|bǐ}{那|nà}{件|jiàn}{便宜|pián yi}。
{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{毛衣|máo yī}{比|bǐ}{那|nà}{件|jiàn}{很|hěn}{便宜|pián yi}。
{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{毛衣|máo yī}{便宜|pián yi}{比|bǐ}{那|nà}{件|jiàn}。
{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{毛衣|máo yī}{比|bǐ}{那|nà}{件|jiàn}{不|bù}{便宜|pián yi}。

({不如|bù rú} would need a good quality: {那|nà}{件|jiàn}{不如|bù rú}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{便宜|pián yi}, "that one isn't as cheap as this one".)

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: “ ___ {去年|qù nián}{相比|xiāng bǐ}，{今年|jīn nián}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}{贵|guì}{多|duō}{了|le}。”
questions.explanation: {跟|gēn}…{相比|xiāng bǐ} (compared with…) opens the sentence: {跟|gēn}{去年|qù nián}{相比|xiāng bǐ}. {比|bǐ} can't be followed by {相比|xiāng bǐ}, and {对|duì} and {从|cóng} don't pair with it. {和|hé} and, in writing, {与|yǔ} work like {跟|gēn} here.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "It's getting colder by the day."?
questions.explanation: {一|yī} + measure word + {比|bǐ} + {一|yī} + measure word, then the adjective: {一|yì}{天|tiān}{比|bǐ}{一|yì}{天|tiān}{冷|lěng}. As in any {比|bǐ} sentence, no {很|hěn}.

questions.stem: A coat costs 500 yuan. The sign says {打|dǎ}{八|bā}{折|zhé}. How much do you pay?
questions.explanation: {打|dǎ}{八|bā}{折|zhé} means you pay eight tenths (80 %): 500 × 0.8 = 400 yuan, a 20 % discount. It isn't 80 % off.

questions.explanation: {贵|guì}{了|le}{一|yí}{倍|bèi} is "up by one times": the rent has doubled, from 2,000 to 4,000 yuan. A {是|shì} B {的|de}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi} says the same: {今年|jīn nián}{的|de}{房租|fáng zū}{是|shì} {去年|qù nián}{的|de}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi}.

questions.stem: A supermarket notice announces a monthly member day with discounts and ends: “{此外|cǐ wài}，{会员|huì yuán}{日|rì}{顾客|gù kè}{比较|bǐ jiào}{多|duō}，{请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{耐心|nài xīn}{排队|pái duì}，{谢谢|xiè xie}！” ({耐心|nài xīn}: patiently) What does the supermarket expect?
choices: Queues, because the day will be busy.

questions.stem: What does “{我们|wǒ men}{班|bān}{没有|méi yǒu}{人|rén}{不|bù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{她|tā}。” mean?
choices: No one in our class likes her.
Some people in our class don't like her.
Everyone in our class likes her.
She doesn't like anyone in our class.
questions.explanation: {没有|méi yǒu} + {人|rén} + {不|bù} + verb is a double negation: "there's no one who doesn't like her", so everyone does. The two negatives cancel out and make a strong positive.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I had no choice but to take a taxi."?
choices: {我|wǒ}{不得不|bù dé bù}{打车|dǎ chē}。
{我|wǒ}{不得不|bù dé bú}{不|bù}{打车|dǎ chē}。
questions.explanation: {不得不|bù dé bù} + verb: have no choice but to. One {不得不|bù dé bù} is enough; {不得不|bù dé bú}{不|bù}{打车|dǎ chē} would say "had no choice but not to take a taxi", and {得|děi}{不|bù} and {不得|bù dé} at the end aren't patterns.

questions.stem: Complete the sentence: “{最后|zuì hòu}{一|yì}{班|bān}{地铁|dì tiě}{走|zǒu}{了|le}， ___ 。”
choices: {只好|zhǐ hǎo}{我们|wǒ men}{打车|dǎ chē}{回|huí}{家|jiā}
{我们|wǒ men}{打车|dǎ chē}{只好|zhǐ hǎo}{回|huí}{家|jiā}
{我们|wǒ men}{打车|dǎ chē}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{只好|zhǐ hǎo}
{我们|wǒ men}{只好|zhǐ hǎo}{打车|dǎ chē}{回|huí}{家|jiā}
questions.explanation: {只好|zhǐ hǎo} is an adverb: after the subject and before the verb phrase: {我们|wǒ men}{只好|zhǐ hǎo}{打车|dǎ chē}{回|huí}{家|jiā} (so we had to take a taxi home). The first half gives the reason, as usual with {只好|zhǐ hǎo}.

questions.stem: Someone says: “{我|wǒ}{今天|jīn tiān}{差点儿|chà diǎnr}{迟到|chí dào}。” Were they late?
questions.explanation: {差点儿|chà diǎnr} is "almost": it nearly happened, but didn't. They arrived in time, just.

questions.stem: Someone says: “{我|wǒ}{今天|jīn tiān}{差点儿|chà diǎnr}{没|méi}{迟到|chí dào}。” What happened?
choices: They were nearly late, but weren't.
They were nearly on time, but were late.
questions.explanation: For something nobody wants, like being late, {差点儿|chà diǎnr}{迟到|chí dào} and {差点儿|chà diǎnr}{没|méi}{迟到|chí dào} mean the same: nearly late, but not. The {没|méi} just underlines that it didn't happen.

questions.stem: What does “{那|nà}{本|běn}{书|shū}{我|wǒ}{差点儿|chà diǎnr}{没|méi}{买|mǎi}{到|dào}。” mean?
choices: I nearly bought the book, but didn't.
I bought the book, but only just.
I bought two copies of the book.
questions.explanation: Buying the book is something you want, so {差点儿|chà diǎnr}{没|méi}{买|mǎi}{到|dào} is "nearly didn't get it", and you did. {差点儿|chà diǎnr}{买|mǎi}{到|dào}{了|le} would be "nearly got it, but didn't".

questions.stem: What does “{这个|zhè ge}{窗户|chuāng hu}{非|fēi}{修|xiū}{不|bù}{可|kě}{了|le}。” mean?
choices: The window simply has to be repaired.
questions.explanation: {非|fēi}…{不|bù}{可|kě} is "simply must": "if not repaired, it won't do". It's emphatic and spoken, and sounds stronger than {得|děi}{修|xiū}.

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: “{洗衣机|xǐ yī jī} ___ {了|le}，{不|bù}{能|néng}{用|yòng}{了|le}。”
questions.explanation: A machine that has stopped working is {坏|huài}{了|le}. {破|pò} is broken with a crack or a hole (glass, clothes), {乱|luàn} is messy, and {空|kōng} kōng empty.

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: “{我|wǒ}{的|de}{房间|fáng jiān}{太|tài} ___ {了|le}，{衣服|yī fu}{和|hé}{书|shū}{都|dōu}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{床|chuáng}{上|shàng}{和|hé}{地|dì}{上|shàng}，{周末|zhōu mò}{得|děi}{好好|hǎo hǎo}{收拾|shōu shi}{一下|yí xià}。”

questions.stem: A flat-to-let ad ends: “{要求|yāo qiú}：{爱|ài}{干净|gān jìng}；{不|bù}{能|néng}{养|yǎng}{猫|māo}、{狗|gǒu}；{晚上|wǎn shang}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{以后|yǐ hòu}{请|qǐng}{不要|bú yào}{大|dà}{声|shēng}{放|fàng}{音乐|yīn yuè}。{有|yǒu}{兴趣|xìng qù}{的|de}{朋友|péng you}，{请|qǐng}{给|gěi}{房东|fáng dōng}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}（{晚上|wǎn shang}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{以后|yǐ hòu}{不|bù}{接|jiē}{电话|diàn huà}）。” ({大|dà}{声|shēng}: loudly) Who would the flat suit best?

questions.explanation: The landlord wants someone clean ({爱|ài}{干净|gān jìng}), with no cats or dogs, and no loud music after ten. His own rule (no calls after nine) suggests he values quiet evenings too.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: There's no one who doesn't like our landlady.

The writer slept at a neighbour's.
The writer had the lock changed.
The barber downstairs let the writer in.
