questions.stem: According to UNESCO, where and when did {太极拳|tài jí quán} (tai chi) begin?
choices: in the Shaolin Temple, in the 5th century
in Wenxian County, Henan, in the mid-17th century
in Nanyang, under the Eastern Han
questions.explanation: UNESCO's entry says tai chi originated in the mid-seventeenth century in {温县|Wēn Xiàn} (Wenxian County), Henan. China's heritage website names the village, {陈家沟|Chén jiā gōu}. The Shaolin Temple, also in Henan, is much older (495) and has its own kung fu.

questions.stem: In which year did UNESCO add Taijiquan to its Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity?
questions.explanation: 2020, at the committee's fifteenth session. 1990 is the year the International Wushu Federation was founded in Beijing.

questions.stem: The styles of tai chi, such as {陈|Chén}{式|shì}, {杨|Yáng}{式|shì} and {孙|Sūn}{式|shì}, are named after…
choices: the families or masters who passed them on
the provinces where they are practised
questions.explanation: Each {流派|liú pài} (style, school) carries the surname of a family or master: {陈|Chén}, {杨|Yáng}, {武|Wǔ}, {吴|Wú}, {孙|Sūn}, {和|Hé}. {式|shì} is "style, form".

questions.stem: Two tai chi styles are both written "Wu" in English: 武式 and 吴式. How do they differ in pinyin?
choices: Wǔ shì and Wú shì: only the tone of the first syllable
They are pronounced exactly the same.
questions.explanation: {武|wǔ} wǔ (third tone, "martial") and {吴|Wú} wú (second tone, a surname): the syllable is the same, the tone isn't.

questions.stem: Where is the Shaolin Temple ({少林寺|Shào lín sì})?
choices: on Mount Song ({嵩山|Sōng shān}), near Dengfeng in Henan
questions.explanation: {少林寺|Shào lín sì} is on {嵩山|Sōng shān} (Mount Song), near {登封|Dēng fēng} (Dengfeng) in Henan, the same province as tai chi's {陈家沟|Chén jiā gōu}. {寺|sì} is a Buddhist temple.

questions.stem: According to China's intangible-heritage website, when was the Shaolin Temple founded?
questions.explanation: The site says the temple was founded in 495 ({北魏|Běi Wèi}{太和|Tài hé}{十九|shí jiǔ}{年|nián}), and that Shaolin kung fu grew up there over more than 1,500 years.

questions.stem: In a wushu competition, what is {散打|sǎn dǎ}?
questions.explanation: {散打|sǎn dǎ} sǎndǎ is sparring, in weight classes. Routines (forms), with or without weapons, are {套路|tào lù} tàolù; tai chi is one of the {套路|tào lù} events.

questions.stem: When and where was the International Wushu Federation founded?
choices: in Beijing in 1990, during the Asian Games
questions.explanation: The IWUF was set up in Beijing in October 1990, during the 11th Asian Games, where wushu was on the programme for the first time.

questions.stem: Read: “{第|dì}{一|yī}{次|cì}{上课|shàng kè}，{我|wǒ}{以为|yǐ wéi}{太极拳|tài jí quán}{很|hěn}{容易|róng yì}，{因为|yīn wèi}{动作|dòng zuò}{那么|nà me}{慢|màn}。{可是|kě shì}{只|zhǐ}{打|dǎ}{了|le}{十|shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{出|chū}{了|le}{一|yì}{身|shēn}{汗|hàn}。” What surprised the writer?
choices: Slow movements were hard work: she was sweating after ten minutes.
questions.explanation: {以为|yǐ wéi} (thought, wrongly) + {可是|kě shì}: she expected slow to mean easy, but {只|zhǐ}{打|dǎ}{了|le}{十|shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{出|chū}{了|le}{一|yì}{身|shēn}{汗|hàn} (after only ten minutes I was sweating all over).

questions.stem: A tai chi teacher says: “{慢|màn}{不|bù}{等于|děng yú}{容易|róng yì}。{动作|dòng zuò}{越|yuè}{慢|màn}，{越|yuè}{要|yào}{用心|yòng xīn}。” ({等于|děng yú}: to equal; {用心|yòng xīn}: to concentrate) What does he mean?
choices: Slow movements are easy, so don't worry.
Being slow isn't the same as being easy: slower movements need more concentration.
Only slow people can do tai chi.
questions.explanation: {慢|màn}{不|bù}{等于|děng yú}{容易|róng yì}: slow doesn't equal easy. {越|yuè}{慢|màn}，{越|yuè}{要|yào}{用心|yòng xīn} ({越|yuè}…{越|yuè}): the slower you go, the more you must concentrate.

questions.stem: At the end of a piece about learning tai chi, the writer reports: “{齐|Qí}{大爷|dà ye}{说|shuō}，{学|xué}{太极拳|tài jí quán}{跟|gēn}{学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{一样|yí yàng}，{不|bù}{能|néng}{着急|zháo jí}，{要|yào}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{练习|liàn xí}。” ({齐|Qí}{大爷|dà ye}: Grandpa Qi, her teacher) What do the two have in common, in his view?
choices: Both are only for young people.
Both need patience and daily practice.
questions.explanation: {不|bù}{能|néng}{着急|zháo jí} (you can't rush) and {要|yào}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{练习|liàn xí} (you have to practise every day): patience and regular practice.

questions.stem: Choose the verb: “{我|wǒ}{爷爷|yé ye}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{在|zài}{公园|gōng yuán}{里|lǐ} ___ {太极拳|tài jí quán}。”
questions.explanation: {打|dǎ}{太极拳|tài jí quán}, as {打|dǎ} is used for ball games and many hand activities. {踢|tī} is for football (kicked); {玩儿|wánr} would make it a game.

questions.stem: When did {张衡|Zhāng Héng} (Zhang Heng) live?
choices: under the Eastern Han, from 78 to 139
questions.explanation: {张衡|Zhāng Héng} lived from 78 to 139, under the Eastern Han ({东汉|Dōng Hàn}, 25–220). He came from {南阳|Nán yáng} (Nanyang), in today's Henan.

questions.stem: The 《{后汉书|Hòu Hàn shū}》 says: “{阳嘉|Yáng jiā}{元年|yuán nián}，{复|fù}{造|zào}{候风地动仪|hòu fēng dì dòng yí}。” Which year is {阳嘉|Yáng jiā}{元年|yuán nián}?
questions.explanation: {阳嘉|Yáng jiā} is a reign period, and its first year ({元年|yuán nián}) is 132: the year of Zhang Heng's {候风地动仪|hòu fēng dì dòng yí}. 78 and 139 are his birth and death, and 445 is the year {范晔|Fàn Yè}, the author of the 《{后汉书|Hòu Hàn shū}》, died.

questions.stem: According to the 《{后汉书|Hòu Hàn shū}》, how did Zhang Heng's instrument (the {地动仪|dì dòng yí}) show where an earthquake was?
choices: A bell rang in the capital.
Water flowed out on one side.
A ball dropped from one of eight dragons into the mouth of a toad below.
questions.explanation: Eight dragons faced eight directions, each holding a bronze ball; a toad with an open mouth sat below each. When the earth moved, one dragon dropped its ball, and its direction showed where the earthquake was.

questions.stem: In the famous story of Zhang Heng's earthquake detector, a ball dropped although nobody in the capital, {洛阳|Luò yáng}, felt anything. What happened next?
choices: A few days later a messenger brought news of an earthquake in {陇西|Lǒng xī}, far to the west.
The emperor had the instrument destroyed.
An earthquake hit the capital the next day.
Zhang Heng admitted the instrument was broken.
questions.explanation: The scholars doubted it, but a few days later news came: {果|guǒ}{地震|dì zhèn}{陇西|Lǒng xī}, there had indeed been an earthquake in {陇西|Lǒng xī} (in today's Gansu). After that, people believed in the instrument.

questions.stem: What does “{果|guǒ}{地震|dì zhèn}{陇西|Lǒng xī}” mean in the 《{后汉书|Hòu Hàn shū}》's story of Zhang Heng's instrument? ({地震|dì zhèn}: earthquake)
choices: Longxi was too far away to feel it.
There had indeed been an earthquake in Longxi.
Longxi asked for an instrument too.
questions.explanation: {果|guǒ} here is classical "indeed, as expected" (as in modern {果然|guǒ rán}), not "fruit": the instrument had been right. {地震|dì zhèn}{陇西|Lǒng xī} is "an earthquake (in) {陇西|Lǒng xī}".

questions.stem: What survives of Zhang Heng's original earthquake detector?
choices: nothing: it is lost, and today's models are reconstructions
the whole instrument, in a Beijing museum
questions.explanation: The instrument is long lost, and the 《{后汉书|Hòu Hàn shū}》 says little about its inside. Every model you see is a modern reconstruction from the written account.

questions.stem: What is the main criticism of the 1951 model of Zhang Heng's earthquake detector by {王振铎|Wáng Zhèn duó}, long shown in Chinese textbooks?
choices: Its upright pole would fall over at the smallest vibration.
It was too large to move.
questions.explanation: The model has an upright pole that falls towards one dragon. Critics note that such a pole would be knocked over by ordinary vibrations, so it couldn't work as a detector of distant earthquakes.

questions.stem: What is inside the model of Zhang Heng's earthquake detector built in the 2000s by a team led by {冯锐|Féng Ruì}?
questions.explanation: A hanging pendulum, which responds to the side-to-side shaking of earthquake waves. It passed laboratory tests, but no real earthquake has been detected with it.

questions.stem: What turned Zhang Heng's armillary sphere ({浑天仪|hún tiān yí}), the bronze globe that showed the stars rising and setting?
choices: gears driven by water from a water clock
questions.explanation: The steady flow of a water clock drove gears that turned the globe evenly, so it is also called the {漏水转浑天仪|lòu shuǐ zhuàn hún tiān yí} (the water-turned armillary sphere).

questions.stem: The {浑天说|hún tiān shuō} (enveloping-sky theory), which Zhang Heng developed, pictured the sky and the earth as…
choices: a bowl over a square table
an eggshell with the earth inside like the yolk
a flat plate floating on water
questions.explanation: The sky is like an eggshell, and the earth sits inside it like the yolk ({蛋黄|dàn huáng}).

questions.stem: What is {张衡一号|Zhāng Héng yī hào}, named after Zhang Heng?
choices: a satellite launched in 2018 to study the earth's electromagnetic field
questions.explanation: {张衡一号|Zhāng Héng yī hào} (Zhang Heng No. 1) is an electromagnetic monitoring satellite launched on 2 February 2018, used in part for earthquake research.

questions.stem: A text about Zhang Heng's earthquake detector ends: “{今天|jīn tiān}{博物馆|bó wù guǎn}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{地动仪|dì dòng yí}，{都|dōu}{是|shì}{现代|xiàn dài}{科学家|kē xué jiā}{根据|gēn jù}{这些|zhè xiē}{记录|jì lù}{做|zuò}{的|de}{模型|mó xíng}。{它们|tā men}{跟|gēn}{原来|yuán lái}{的|de}{一样|yí yàng}{不|bu}{一样|yí yàng}，{谁|shéi}{也|yě}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}。” ({博物馆|bó wù guǎn}: museum; {现代|xiàn dài}: modern; {记录|jì lù}: records; {模型|mó xíng}: models) What is the writer telling you?
choices: The museum models are exact copies of the original.
The original is in a museum.
Scientists have proved how it worked.
Nobody can be sure the models are like the original.
questions.explanation: {跟|gēn}{原来|yuán lái}{的|de}{一样|yí yàng}{不|bu}{一样|yí yàng}，{谁|shéi}{也|yě}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}: whether they're the same as the original, nobody knows. The models are built from the written records ({根据|gēn jù}{这些|zhè xiē}{记录|jì lù}), not copied from the instrument.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "If you're free tomorrow, let's go and see a film."?
choices: {要是|yào shi}{你|nǐ}{明天|míng tiān}{有|yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}，{就|jiù}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{电影|diàn yǐng}{吧|ba}。
{你|nǐ}{明天|míng tiān}{有|yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}{要是|yào shi}，{我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{电影|diàn yǐng}{吧|ba}。
{要是|yào shi}{你|nǐ}{明天|míng tiān}{有|yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}，{我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{电影|diàn yǐng}{吧|ba}。
{要是|yào shi}{你|nǐ}{明天|míng tiān}{有|yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}，{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{电影|diàn yǐng}{就|jiù}{吧|ba}。
questions.explanation: {要是|yào shi} (if, spoken) works like {如果|rú guǒ}: it opens the condition, at the start or after the subject ({你|nǐ}{要是|yào shi}…), and {就|jiù} goes after the subject of the second clause, before its verb: {我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{去|qù}. {就|jiù} can't come before the subject (×{就|jiù}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}) or after the verb.

questions.stem: What does "{你|nǐ}{得|děi}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{走|zǒu}，{否则|fǒu zé}{会|huì}{迟到|chí dào}。" mean?
choices: You'd better leave early, otherwise you'll be late.
Even if you leave early, you'll be late.
You left early, so you weren't late.
If you leave early, you'll be late.
questions.explanation: {否则|fǒu zé} (otherwise) introduces what happens if the first clause doesn't: leave early, or you'll be late. It says the same as {如果|rú guǒ}{你|nǐ}{不|bù}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{走|zǒu}，{你|nǐ}{就|jiù}{会|huì}{迟到|chí dào}. {得|děi} is "must, had better".

questions.stem: A job advertisement ends: "{请|qǐng}{写|xiě}{清楚|qīng chu}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{电话|diàn huà}{号码|hào mǎ}，___ {我们|wǒ men}{无法|wú fǎ}{通知|tōng zhī}{你|nǐ}{面试|miàn shì}{的|de}{时间|shí jiān}。" Which word fits? ({通知|tōng zhī}: to notify; {面试|miàn shì}: an interview)
questions.explanation: The second clause is what happens if you don't write your number: {否则|fǒu zé} (otherwise). {所以|suǒ yǐ} (so) would make the missing number a result of writing it clearly, {要是|yào shi} (if) would need a condition after it, and {虽然|suī rán} (although) needs {但是|dàn shì} later.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Let's go early so we can get tickets."?
choices: {我们|wǒ men}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{去|qù}，{买|mǎi}{到|dào}{票|piào}{好|hǎo}。
{我们|wǒ men}{好|hǎo}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{去|qù}，{买|mǎi}{到|dào}{票|piào}。
{好|hǎo}{我们|wǒ men}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{去|qù}，{买|mǎi}{到|dào}{票|piào}。
{我们|wǒ men}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{去|qù}，{好|hǎo}{买|mǎi}{到|dào}{票|piào}。
questions.explanation: {好|hǎo} before a verb, in the second clause, means "so that (we) can": {好|hǎo}{买|mǎi}{到|dào}{票|piào}. It goes straight before the verb (after a subject, if the clause has one: {我|wǒ}{好|hǎo}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}), never at the end of the clause.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {暑假|shǔ jià}{他|tā}{在|zài}{咖啡馆|kā fēi guǎn}___，{每|měi}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{去|qù}{三|sān}{天|tiān}。 (In the summer holidays he works part-time in a café, three days a week.)
questions.explanation: {打工|dǎ gōng} is to work a temporary or part-time job for someone else, often while studying. {生意|shēng yi} is business ({做|zuò}{生意|shēng yi}), {职业|zhí yè} an occupation (a noun), and {工人|gōng rén} a worker (a noun): none of them can be the verb here.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct? (I meet your requirements.)
choices: {我|wǒ}{合适|hé shì}{你们|nǐ men}{的|de}{条件|tiáo jiàn}。
{我|wǒ}{负责|fù zé}{你们|nǐ men}{的|de}{条件|tiáo jiàn}。
{我|wǒ}{符合|fú hé}{你们|nǐ men}{的|de}{条件|tiáo jiàn}。
questions.explanation: {符合|fú hé} (to meet, to match) takes a condition, requirement or rule: {符合|fú hé}{条件|tiáo jiàn}, {符合|fú hé}{要求|yāo qiú}. It doesn't take a person (×{我|wǒ}{符合|fú hé}{你们|nǐ men}). {合适|hé shì} (suitable) is an adjective with no object, and {负责|fù zé} is "to be in charge of".

questions.stem: A colleague has worked late to finish a report for the team. What do you mean if you say "{你|nǐ}{辛苦|xīn kǔ}{了|le}！"?
choices: Thank you for all your hard work.
Your work was too hard for you.
questions.explanation: {辛苦|xīn kǔ} is "hard, tiring", and {你|nǐ}{辛苦|xīn kǔ}{了|le}！ is the usual way to thank someone for their effort: to a colleague after a long day, to a driver, to someone who has helped you. It isn't a complaint.

questions.stem: Which of these people would you normally address as "{师傅|shī fu}"?
choices: a child you meet in the park
questions.explanation: {师傅|shī fu} is a respectful way to address someone with a trade: a driver, a cook, a repairer, a factory worker. A professor is addressed as {老师|lǎo shī} or {教授|jiào shòu} (lesson 01).

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{我|wǒ}___ {法|fǎ}{回答|huí dá}。 (I'm unable to answer this question.)
questions.explanation: {无法|wú fǎ} wú fǎ (unable to, written style): {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{我|wǒ}{无法|wú fǎ}{回答|huí dá}. {=Simplified {无|wú} has four strokes: two horizontals, a left-falling stroke and a vertical-bend-hook=} (traditional {+{无|wú}+}: 12 strokes). In speech you'd say {没|méi}{办法|bàn fǎ}{回答|huí dá} or {回答|huí dá}{不了|bu liǎo}.

questions.stem: A news report says: "{这个|zhè ge}{职业|zhí yè}{的|de}___ {越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{多|duō}。" (There are more and more women in this profession.) Which word fits a written news report best?
questions.explanation: {女性|nǚ xìng} (female, women) and {男性|nán xìng} are the formal words, used in news, forms and statistics. {女|nǚ}{的|de} means the same but is spoken: it sounds casual in a report. {女儿|nǚ ér} is a daughter and {女朋友|nǚ péng you} a girlfriend.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {工资|gōng zī} (wages, pay): two high level tones, 1+1.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {职业|zhí yè} (occupation): a rising tone, then a falling one, 2+4.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {经|jīng}___ (economy)
questions.explanation: {经济|jīng jì}: 济 jì has 氵 (water) on the left. 齐 is the right half alone, 挤 (to squeeze, a later word) has 扌 (the hand), and 际 ({国际|guó jì}, international, lesson 24) has 阝.

questions.stem: Which character is guǎng, as in guǎnggào (an advertisement)?
questions.explanation: {广告|guǎng gào} guǎng gào. {=Simplified {广|guǎng} is three strokes, a dot, a horizontal and a long left-falling stroke; {厂|chǎng} chǎng (factory) has no dot; {庆|qìng} ({庆祝|qìng zhù}, lesson 04) and {床|chuáng} (bed) are built on {广|guǎng} with something inside.=} In traditional, {广告|guǎng gào} is {+{广告|guǎng gào}+}, and the character has 15 strokes.

questions.stem: Listen. What will they do if it rains tomorrow?

audio.text: 要是明天下雨，我们就不去公园了，在家看电影吧。

choices: stay at home and watch a film
go to the park the day after
questions.explanation: {要是|yào shi}{明天|míng tiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{不|bú}{去|qù}{公园|gōng yuán}{了|le}，{在|zài}{家|jiā}{看|kàn}{电影|diàn yǐng}{吧|ba}: if it rains tomorrow, we won't go to the park; let's watch a film at home. {要是|yào shi}…{就|jiù} is the spoken "if… then".

questions.stem: Listen to the advice. Why should you take some articles you've written?

audio.text: 面试的时候，你最好带上两篇自己写的文章，否则他们不知道你的水平。

choices: because the interview is about writing a new article
because the articles will be published
otherwise they won't know how good you are
because the interviewers asked for exactly three
questions.explanation: {否则|fǒu zé}{他们|tā men}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{水平|shuǐ píng}: otherwise they won't know your standard. Take two articles you wrote yourself ({两|liǎng}{篇|piān}{自己|zì jǐ}{写|xiě}{的|de}{文章|wén zhāng}) to the interview ({面试|miàn shì}, lesson 12).

questions.stem: Listen. How does the speaker feel about the job?

audio.text: 这个工作虽然挺辛苦的，有时候晚上也要干活儿，但是能学到很多书上没有的东西，我很喜欢。

choices: It's too tiring, and they want to leave.
It's hard work, but they like it.
It's badly paid, so they're looking for another.

questions.stem: Listen. What is this?

audio.text: 我们饭馆招聘周末打工的学生两名，每天工作六个小时，工资一天一百五十元。有兴趣的同学请给我们打电话。

choices: a student asking for a job
a notice about a price rise
questions.explanation: {饭馆|fàn guǎn}{招聘|zhāo pìn}{周末|zhōu mò}{打工|dǎ gōng}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}{两|liǎng}{名|míng}: the restaurant is recruiting two students for weekend work, six hours a day at 150 yuan a day. {招聘|zhāo pìn} is what an employer does; the person who answers {应聘|yìng pìn}. ({兴趣|xìng qù}: interest.)

questions.stem: Read the advertisement: "{招聘|zhāo pìn}：{书店|shū diàn}{打工|dǎ gōng}。{条件|tiáo jiàn}：{大学|dà xué}{学生|xué sheng}，{年龄|nián líng}{十八|shí bā}{到|dào}{二十二|èr shí èr}{岁|suì}，{每|měi}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}、{星期日|xīng qī rì}{都|dōu}{能|néng}{来|lái}{上班|shàng bān}。{工资|gōng zī}：{每|měi}{小时|xiǎo shí}{二十五|èr shí wǔ}{元|yuán}。{要是|yào shi}{你|nǐ}{符合|fú hé}{条件|tiáo jiàn}，{请|qǐng}{给|gěi}{书店|shū diàn}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}：0000 1234。" Your friend is a 24-year-old student who is free every weekend. Can your friend apply?
choices: Yes: the weekend is when the shop needs people.
No: the shop wants people who can work on weekdays.
No: your friend is older than the age the shop asks for.
questions.explanation: {年龄|nián líng}{十八|shí bā}{到|dào}{二十二|èr shí èr}{岁|suì}: the age required is 18 to 22, and your friend is 24, so they don't {符合|fú hé}{条件|tiáo jiàn} (meet the requirements), even though they're a student and free at weekends ({每|měi}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}、{星期日|xīng qī rì}{都|dōu}{能|néng}{来|lái}{上班|shàng bān}).

questions.prompt: If you meet the requirements, give us a call.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I like her because she's conscientious."?
choices: {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{做|zuò}{事|shì}{认真|rèn zhēn}{她|tā}。
{我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{她|tā}{做|zuò}{事|shì}{认真|rèn zhēn}。
{她|tā}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{我|wǒ}{做|zuò}{事|shì}{认真|rèn zhēn}。
{我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{认真|rèn zhēn}{她|tā}{做|zuò}{事|shì}。
questions.explanation: A pivotal sentence of liking: {喜欢|xǐ huan} + the person + what they're like or do. {她|tā} is the object of {喜欢|xǐ huan} and the subject of {做|zuò}{事|shì}{认真|rèn zhēn}, so it comes straight after {喜欢|xǐ huan}. {她|tā}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{我|wǒ}{做|zuò}{事|shì}{认真|rèn zhēn} is "she likes me for being conscientious".

questions.stem: What does "{大家|dà jiā}{选|xuǎn}{他|tā}{当|dāng}{班长|bān zhǎng}。" mean? ({班长|bān zhǎng}: class monitor)

He wants everyone to choose a monitor.
He chose everyone to be class monitors.
Everyone was chosen by the class monitor.
questions.explanation: {选|xuǎn} + person + {当|dāng} + role: a pivotal sentence of appointing. {他|tā} is chosen (the object of {选|xuǎn}) and becomes the monitor (the subject of {当|dāng}). {大家|dà jiā} (everyone) did the choosing.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}___ {大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{高兴|gāo xìng}。 (This made everyone very happy.)

questions.explanation: {适合|shì hé} is a verb and takes an object: {适合|shì hé}{你|nǐ}. {合适|hé shì} (HSK 3) is an adjective with no object: {这个|zhè ge}{工作|gōng zuò}{对|duì}{你|nǐ}{很|hěn}{合适|hé shì}. {很|hěn} goes before the verb, never after the object.

Students should study hard for us.

questions.stem: In 成为 (to become), how is 为 read?

questions.explanation: {经验|jīng yàn}: 验 has 马 (horse) on the left. All four share the same right half: 脸 (face) has 月, 检 ({检查|jiǎn chá}) has 木, and 险 ({危险|wēi xiǎn}, dangerous, lesson 28) has 阝.

questions.stem: Which character is jiǎn, "to reduce", as in jiǎnqīng (to lighten)?
questions.explanation: {减轻|jiǎn qīng}. {=Simplified {减|jiǎn} is 冫 (two dots: ice) + {咸|xián}; {咸|xián} alone is xián (salty, lesson 08), {喊|hǎn} (to shout, lesson 04) has {口|kǒu}, and {感|gǎn} ({感谢|gǎn xiè}) has {心|xīn} underneath.=} Traditional {+{减|jiǎn}+} has the water radical, three dots, on the left.

questions.stem: Listen. Why is Xiao Zhang in charge of the event?

Nobody else wanted to do it.
Everyone likes how conscientious she is.
She organised the last event too.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Xiao Wang is responsible for this matter." in the style of a notice?
choices: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{由|yóu}{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}{负责|fù zé}。
{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{被|bèi}{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}{负责|fù zé}。
{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}{由|yóu}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{负责|fù zé}。
{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{由|yóu}{负责|fù zé}{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}。
questions.explanation: {由|yóu} + doer + verb says whose job something is, in formal writing: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{由|yóu}{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}{负责|fù zé}. {被|bèi} marks something done to the subject (often unwelcome), so ×{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{被|bèi}{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}{负责|fù zé} is wrong. The doer comes straight after {由|yóu}, before the verb.

questions.stem: A notice says "{请|qǐng}{将|jiāng}{表格|biǎo gé}{交|jiāo}{到|dào}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}。" Which spoken sentence means the same?
choices: {表格|biǎo gé}{将|jiāng}{交|jiāo}{到|dào}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}。
{请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{表格|biǎo gé}{交|jiāo}{到|dào}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}。
{请|qǐng}{让|ràng}{表格|biǎo gé}{交|jiāo}{到|dào}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}。
{请|qǐng}{被|bèi}{表格|biǎo gé}{交|jiāo}{到|dào}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}。
questions.explanation: In notices {将|jiāng} is the written {把|bǎ}, with the same word order: {请|qǐng}{将|jiāng}{表格|biǎo gé}{交|jiāo}{到|dào}{办公室|bàn gōng shì} = {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{表格|biǎo gé}{交|jiāo}{到|dào}{办公室|bàn gōng shì} (please hand the form in at the office). {表格|biǎo gé}{将|jiāng}{交|jiāo}{到|dào}{办公室|bàn gōng shì} uses {将|jiāng} as "will": "the form will be handed in", a statement, not a request.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {请|qǐng}___ {说明书|shuō míng shū}{使用|shǐ yòng}。 (Please use it according to the instructions.)
questions.explanation: {按照|àn zhào} + rules, plans or instructions: according to, following. {由|yóu} marks the doer ({由|yóu}{我|wǒ}{负责|fù zé}), {关于|guān yú} is "about" ({关于|guān yú}{工作|gōng zuò}{的|de}{问题|wèn tí}) and {被|bèi} marks the passive.

questions.stem: Which word fits this written notice best? "{实习|shí xí}{人员|rén yuán}{请|qǐng}{在|zài}{三|sān}{天|tiān}___ {填写|tián xiě}{表格|biǎo gé}。" (Interns, please fill in the form within three days.)
questions.explanation: {内|nèi} is the written "within": {三|sān}{天|tiān}{内|nèi} (in speech, {三|sān}{天|tiān}{以内|yǐ nèi}). {旁边|páng biān} (beside), {中间|zhōng jiān} (in the middle) and {后面|hòu miàn} (behind) are places, not a time limit.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct? (Each department will hold a discussion.)
choices: {各|gè}{部门|bù mén}{将|jiāng}{讨论|tǎo lùn}{进行|jìn xíng}。
{各|gè}{部门|bù mén}{进行|jìn xíng}{将|jiāng}{讨论|tǎo lùn}。
{各|gè}{部门|bù mén}{将|jiāng}{进行|jìn xíng}{讨论|tǎo lùn}。
questions.explanation: {进行|jìn xíng} (to carry out) takes a two-syllable verb as its object: {进行|jìn xíng}{讨论|tǎo lùn} ({讨论|tǎo lùn}: to discuss, lesson 14). A one-syllable verb after it sounds wrong (×{进行|jìn xíng}{谈|tán}), and {将|jiāng} (will) goes before {进行|jìn xíng}.

questions.stem: What does "{大卫|Dà wèi}{下|xià}{星期|xīng qī}{要|yào}{去|qù}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{出差|chū chāi}。" mean?
choices: David is going on holiday to Shanghai next week.
David is going to Shanghai on business next week.
David is moving to Shanghai next week.
David came back from Shanghai last week.
questions.explanation: {出差|chū chāi} chū chāi is to go on a business trip: travel for work. A holiday trip is {旅游|lǚ yóu} or {旅行|lǚ xíng} (lesson 18).

questions.stem: Someone you've just met asks "{你|nǐ}{在|zài}{哪个|nǎ ge}{单位|dān wèi}{工作|gōng zuò}？" What are they asking?
choices: how many people are in your team
questions.explanation: {单位|dān wèi} is one's workplace or employer, whatever kind: a company, a school, a hospital. {你|nǐ}{在|zài}{哪个|nǎ ge}{单位|dān wèi}{工作|gōng zuò}？ asks where you work.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {这个|zhè ge}{部门|bù mén}{由|yóu}{谁|shéi}___？ (Who's in charge of this department?)
questions.explanation: {管|guǎn} is to look after, be in charge of: {由|yóu}{谁|shéi}{管|guǎn} (who is in charge of it). {填|tián} is to fill in (a form), {按|àn} to press or "according to", and {指|zhǐ} to point.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {正|zhèng}___ (formal, official)
questions.explanation: {正式|zhèng shì} zhèng shì (formal, official): {正式|zhèng shì}{员工|yuán gōng} (a permanent member of staff). {式|shì} is also the right half of {试|shì} ({考试|kǎo shì}).

questions.stem: What does "{电脑|diàn nǎo}{暂时|zàn shí}{不够|bú gòu}，{大家|dà jiā}{先|xiān}{用|yòng}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}。" mean? ({不够|bú gòu}: not enough)
choices: For now there aren't enough computers, so use your own first.
The computers are too old, so everyone has bought their own.
There will never be enough computers.
Everyone must bring their own computer every day.
questions.explanation: {暂时|zàn shí} is "for the time being": the shortage is temporary. {大家|dà jiā}{先|xiān}{用|yòng}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de} (everyone use your own for now): {先|xiān} (first, for now) and {自己|zì jǐ}{的|de} with {电脑|diàn nǎo} left out.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {规定|guī dìng} (a rule; to stipulate): a high level tone, then a falling one, 1+4.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {详细|xiáng xì} (detailed): a rising tone, then a falling one, 2+4.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? ___ {门|mén} (department)
questions.explanation: {部门|bù mén}: 部 has 阝 on the right (a town, a region), like 都. 陪 ({陪|péi}, to keep someone company, lesson 21) has 阝 on the left, and 倍 ({倍|bèi}, times, lesson 15) shares 部's left part but has 亻.

questions.stem: Which character is yóu, "by; from" (written)?
questions.explanation: 由 is 田 with the vertical sticking out at the top. 甲 (first) sticks out at the bottom, 申 ({申请|shēn qǐng}, lesson 05) at both ends, and 田 (a field) not at all.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker say about the event?

audio.text: 这次活动由我们部门负责，时间定在下个月十五号。

choices: Their department is in charge, and the date is fixed for the 15th of next month.
The date hasn't been fixed yet.
It took place on the 15th of last month.
questions.explanation: {由|yóu}{我们|wǒ men}{部门|bù mén}{负责|fù zé} (our department is in charge of it), {时间|shí jiān}{定|dìng}{在|zài}{下|xià}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{十五|shí wǔ}{号|hào} (the date is fixed for the 15th of next month). {定|dìng} is to fix, settle.

questions.stem: Listen. What should people do if they have a problem with the machine?

audio.text: 请大家按照说明书上的要求使用这台机器，有问题跟办公室联系。

questions.explanation: {有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{跟|gēn}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}{联系|lián xì}: if there's a problem, contact the office. The first part says to use the machine according to the manual ({按照|àn zhào}{说明书|shuō míng shū}{上|shàng}{的|de}{要求|yāo qiú}{使用|shǐ yòng}).

questions.stem: Listen to the message for David. What will David do next Wednesday?

audio.text: 大卫，下星期三你跟我一起去上海出差，在那儿住两天。火车票我已经让小李买好了。

choices: go to Shanghai on business for two days
buy train tickets for the team

stay in the office for two days

choices: happy because overtime is well paid

{请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{将|jiāng}{不用|bú yòng}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{门口|mén kǒu}。
{有|yǒu}{任何|rèn hé}{问题|wèn tí}，{请|qǐng}{及时|jí shí}{跟|gēn}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}{联系|lián xì}。
{表格|biǎo gé}{在|zài}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}{门口|mén kǒu}。
questions.explanation: {请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{将|jiāng}{不用|bú yòng}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{门口|mén kǒu} is {请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{把|bǎ}{不用|bú yòng}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{门口|mén kǒu} in written style: {将|jiāng} + object + verb, as in {请|qǐng}{将|jiāng}{表格|biǎo gé}{交|jiāo}{给|gěi}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}. In {三|sān}{楼|lóu}{的|de}{各|gè}{部门|bù mén}{将|jiāng}{搬|bān}{到|dào}{四|sì}{楼|lóu}, by contrast, {将|jiāng} is the written future ("will move").

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct? (Everyone agreed, but he was against it.)
choices: {大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{同意|tóng yì}{了|le}，{他|tā}{却|què}{反对|fǎn duì}。
{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{同意|tóng yì}{了|le}，{却|què}{他|tā}{反对|fǎn duì}。
{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{同意|tóng yì}{了|le}，{他|tā}{反对|fǎn duì}{却|què}。
{却|què}{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{同意|tóng yì}{了|le}，{他|tā}{反对|fǎn duì}。
questions.explanation: {却|què} (but, yet) is an adverb: it goes after the subject of its clause and before the verb, {他|tā}{却|què}{反对|fǎn duì}. It can't stand before a subject the way {但是|dàn shì} can ({但是|dàn shì}{他|tā}{反对|fǎn duì}).

questions.stem: Choose the pair: ___ {工作|gōng zuò}{很|hěn}{辛苦|xīn kǔ}，___ {她|tā}{从来|cóng lái}{不|bù}{说|shuō}{累|lèi}。 (Although the work is hard, she never says she's tired.)
questions.explanation: The first clause admits a fact and the second says what holds all the same: concession, {尽管|jǐn guǎn}…{但是|dàn shì} (like {虽然|suī rán}…{但是|dàn shì}). {因为|yīn wèi}…{所以|suǒ yǐ} would make the hard work the reason she never complains.

questions.stem: What does "{他|tā}{并|bìng}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}。" add to "{他|tā}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}。"?
choices: that he doesn't actually know, whatever you may think
that he knew about it before
that he will find out soon
that he doesn't want to know
questions.explanation: {并|bìng} + {不|bù} / {没|méi} corrects an expectation: "he doesn't actually know (as you might have assumed)". Without {并|bìng} the sentence simply states that he doesn't know.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct? (I apologised to him.)
questions.explanation: {道歉|dào qiàn} takes no object: the person goes before it with {向|xiàng} or {跟|gēn}: {我|wǒ}{向|xiàng}{他|tā}{道歉|dào qiàn}{了|le} (or {我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{他|tā}{道歉|dào qiàn}{了|le}).

questions.stem: Your new manager says "{有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{你|nǐ}{尽管|jǐn guǎn}{问|wèn}。" What does she mean?
choices: Ask only if it's really important.
Although you have questions, don't ask.
Feel free to ask if you have questions.
questions.explanation: As an adverb before a verb, {尽管|jǐn guǎn} means "feel free to, don't hesitate to": {尽管|jǐn guǎn}{问|wèn} (just ask). {尽管|jǐn guǎn} "although" starts a clause and needs a second clause after it.

questions.stem: Which of these is the formal, written word for "however", used at the start of a sentence in reports and articles?
questions.explanation: {然而|rán ér} (however) is written and formal. {不过|bú guò} and {可是|kě shì} are "but" in everyday speech ({不过|bú guò} softer), and {再说|zài shuō} is "besides, what's more", adding a reason rather than a contrast.

questions.stem: In a meeting, someone says "{我|wǒ}{对|duì}{这个|zhè ge}{计划|jì huà}{有|yǒu}{意见|yì jiàn}。" What do they mean?
choices: They have objections to the plan.
They want to know more about the plan.
questions.explanation: {意见|yì jiàn} is an opinion, but {对|duì}…{有|yǒu}{意见|yì jiàn} usually means a critical one: "I have objections to / a complaint about…". To ask for views gently, people say {你|nǐ}{怎么|zěn me}{看|kàn}？ or {大家|dà jiā}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{看法|kàn fǎ}？ ({看法|kàn fǎ}: a view, lesson 25).

questions.stem: Choose the word: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{我|wǒ}{得|děi}{跟|gēn}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{人|rén}___ {一下|yí xià}。 (I need to talk this over with my family.)
questions.explanation: {商量|shāng liang} is to talk something over in order to decide together: {跟|gēn}…{商量|shāng liang}{一下|yí xià}. {拒绝|jù jué} is to refuse, {打扰|dǎ rǎo} to disturb and {误会|wù huì} to misunderstand.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {我们|wǒ men}{讨|tǎo}___ {了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。 (We discussed it for an hour.)
questions.explanation: {讨论|tǎo lùn} tǎo lùn (to discuss). {=Simplified {论|lùn} is 讠 (speech) + {仑|lún}, the same right half as {轮|lún} lún (a wheel)=}; traditional {+{论|lùn}+} is {言|yán} + 侖, 15 strokes.

questions.stem: A colleague is upset about being given extra work at the last minute. Which reply shows that you understand how they feel?
questions.explanation: {理解|lǐ jiě} is understanding someone's point of view or feelings: {我|wǒ}{理解|lǐ jiě}{你|nǐ} (I understand how you feel). {拒绝|jù jué} is to refuse, {批评|pī píng} to criticise, and {我|wǒ}{误会|wù huì}{你|nǐ}{了|le} is "I misunderstood you".

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {讨论|tǎo lùn} (to discuss): a dipping tone, then a falling one, 3+4.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {支持|zhī chí} (to support): a high level tone, then a rising one, 1+2.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? ___ {议|yì} (to suggest; a suggestion)
questions.explanation: {建议|jiàn yì}: 建 is 聿 wrapped by 廴, which is written last. 健 ({健身|jiàn shēn}, lesson 07) adds 亻, 件 is the measure word ({一|yí}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}) and 见 is "to see": all four are jiàn.

questions.stem: Which character is què, "but, yet"?
questions.explanation: {=Simplified {却|què} is {去|qù} + 卩, and {脚|jiǎo} (foot) has {月|yuè} on the left of {却|què}=} (traditional {+{却|què}+} has {={谷|gǔ}=} instead of {={去|qù}=}). 去 is "to go", and 确 ({正确|zhèng què}, lesson 02) is also què but has 石.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker think of the method?

audio.text: 这个办法不错，不过有点儿麻烦。

choices: It's good, but a bit of a hassle.
It's easy, so they'll use it.
questions.explanation: {这个|zhè ge}{办法|bàn fǎ}{不错|bú cuò} (this method's not bad), {不过|bú guò}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{麻烦|má fan} (but it's a bit of a nuisance): {不过|bú guò} adds a mild reservation.

questions.stem: Listen. How does she feel now?

audio.text: 尽管他已经道歉了，可是她还是很生气。

choices: still angry, even though he apologised
questions.explanation: {尽管|jǐn guǎn}{他|tā}{已经|yǐ jīng}{道歉|dào qiàn}{了|le} (although he has apologised), {可是|kě shì}{她|tā}{还是|hái shi}{很|hěn}{生气|shēng qì} (she's still angry). {还是|hái shi} marks what stays true despite the first clause.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker doing?

audio.text: 对不起，打扰一下，请问郑老师在吗？

choices: politely interrupting to ask for Ms Zheng
telling someone Ms Zheng has gone out
questions.explanation: {打扰|dǎ rǎo}{一下|yí xià} (sorry to bother you) is how you interrupt politely; then {请问|qǐng wèn}{郑|Zhèng}{老师|lǎo shī}{在|zài}{吗|ma}？ (is Ms Zheng here?).

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker think of the plan?

audio.text: 大家都说这个计划好，我却觉得并不怎么样。

choices: It's the best plan they've seen.
Unlike the others, they don't think much of it.
questions.explanation: {大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{说|shuō}{这个|zhè ge}{计划|jì huà}{好|hǎo} (everyone says it's good), {我|wǒ}{却|què}{觉得|jué de}{并|bìng}{不|bù}{怎么样|zěn me yàng} (but I don't think it's up to much). {却|què} marks the contrast, and {并|bìng}{不|bù}{怎么样|zěn me yàng} is "not that great at all".

questions.stem: Read: "{许东|Xǔ Dōng}{觉得|jué de}{孟洁|Mèng Jié}{对|duì}{他|tā}{有|yǒu}{意见|yì jiàn}，{因为|yīn wèi}{她|tā}{从|cóng}{他|tā}{旁边|páng biān}{走|zǒu}{过|guò}，{却|què}{没有|méi yǒu}{跟|gēn}{他|tā}{打招呼|dǎ zhāo hu}。{原来|yuán lái}，{孟洁|Mèng Jié}{的|de}{眼镜|yǎn jìng}{坏|huài}{了|le}，{她|tā}{并|bìng}{没有|méi yǒu}{看见|kàn jiàn}{许东|Xǔ Dōng}。" ({原来|yuán lái}: it turned out; {眼镜|yǎn jìng}: glasses) Why didn't Meng Jie say hello?
choices: She had something against Xu Dong.
She was in a hurry to get to a meeting.
She was angry with everyone that day.
Her glasses were broken and she hadn't seen him.
questions.explanation: {原来|yuán lái}，{孟洁|Mèng Jié}{的|de}{眼镜|yǎn jìng}{坏|huài}{了|le}，{她|tā}{并|bìng}{没有|méi yǒu}{看见|kàn jiàn}{许东|Xǔ Dōng}: it turned out her glasses were broken and she hadn't seen him at all. Xu Dong only thought ({觉得|jué de}) she had something against him: a misunderstanding ({误会|wù huì}).

questions.prompt: Although the work is hard, she never says she's tired.
questions.explanation: {尽管|jǐn guǎn}{工作|gōng zuò}{很|hěn}{辛苦|xīn kǔ}，{但是|dàn shì}{她|tā}{从来|cóng lái}{不|bù}{说|shuō}{累|lèi}。 {尽管|jǐn guǎn} opens the concession (it can also follow the subject: {工作|gōng zuò}{尽管|jǐn guǎn}{很|hěn}{辛苦|xīn kǔ}…), and {但是|dàn shì} starts the clause that holds all the same. {所以|suǒ yǐ} would make it a cause and effect.

questions.stem: Which means "ten or so people"?
questions.explanation: {来|lái} goes after a round number ({十|shí}, {二十|èr shí}, {一百|yì bǎi}…) and before the measure word: {十|shí}{来|lái}{个|gè}{人|rén}. {十|shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{来|lái} would be "ten people are coming".

questions.stem: Choose the word: {春节|Chūn jié}___，{火车|huǒ chē}{票|piào}{很|hěn}{难|nán}{买|mǎi}。 (Around the Spring Festival, train tickets are hard to get.)
questions.explanation: {前后|qián hòu} goes after a point in time: {春节|Chūn jié}{前后|qián hòu}, {八|bā}{点|diǎn}{前后|qián hòu}. {来|lái} goes inside a number ({十|shí}{来|lái}{个|gè}), {大约|dà yuē} before a number ({大约|dà yuē}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}), and {倍|bèi} is "times" ({两|liǎng}{倍|bèi}).

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct? (There were about fifty people.)
questions.explanation: {左右|zuǒ yòu} goes after the number and measure word: {五十|wǔ shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{左右|zuǒ yòu}. {前后|qián hòu} is only for times ({春节|Chūn jié}{前后|qián hòu}), and neither {左右|zuǒ yòu} nor {前后|qián hòu} can go before the number (that's {大约|dà yuē}: {大约|dà yuē}{五十|wǔ shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}).

questions.stem: How do you say ⅓ in Chinese?
questions.explanation: The whole comes first, then {分之|fēn zhī}, then the part: {三|sān}{分之|fēn zhī}{一|yī} ("of three parts, one"). {四|sì}{分之|fēn zhī}{三|sān} is ¾. Percentages work the same way: {百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{三十|sān shí} (30 %).

questions.stem: What is {百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{三十|sān shí}?
questions.explanation: {百分之|bǎi fēn zhī} + number is a percentage: {百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{三十|sān shí} is "thirty of a hundred parts", 30 %. 3 % is {百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{三|sān}, and 0.3 % is {百分之|bǎi fēn zhī}{零|líng}{点|diǎn}{三|sān}.

questions.stem: "{他|tā}{的|de}{工资|gōng zī}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi}。" If I earn 4,000 yuan a month, how much does he earn?
questions.explanation: A {是|shì} B {的|de}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi}: A is twice B. Twice 4,000 is 8,000.

questions.stem: "{去年|qù nián}{公司|gōng sī}{有|yǒu}{一百|yì bǎi}{个|gè}{人|rén}，{今年|jīn nián}{人数|rén shù}{增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{一|yí}{倍|bèi}。" How many people does the company have now? ({增加|zēng jiā}: to increase)
questions.explanation: {增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{一|yí}{倍|bèi} is "increased by one time", i.e. by 100 %: it doubled, from 100 to 200. (Strictly, {增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi} would be tripled.)

questions.stem: Choose the word: ___ {的|de}{同学|tóng xué}{都|dōu}{来|lái}{了|le}。 (All the students came.)
questions.explanation: {所有|suǒ yǒu} (all, every member of a group) goes before a noun, usually with {的|de} and {都|dōu}: {所有|suǒ yǒu}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué}{都|dōu}{来|lái}{了|le}. {整个|zhěng gè} is one whole thing ({整个|zhěng gè}{下午|xià wǔ}), {全都|quán dōu} goes before a verb ({同学|tóng xué}{们|men}{全都|quán dōu}{来|lái}{了|le}), and {一切|yí qiè} (everything, lesson 05) isn't used for people.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {从|cóng}{这儿|zhèr}{到|dào}{公司|gōng sī}{大|dà}___ {要|yào}{四十|sì shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}。 (It takes about forty minutes from here to the office.)
questions.explanation: {大约|dà yuē} dà yuē (about, approximately) goes before the number: {大约|dà yuē}{四十|sì shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}. {约|yuē} is also in {约会|yuē huì} (a date, lesson 23) and {节约|jié yuē} (to save, lesson 28).

questions.stem: Choose the word: {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{银行|yín háng}___ {点儿|diǎnr}{钱|qián}，{晚上|wǎn shang}{要|yào}{用|yòng}。 (I'm going to the bank to take out some money: I need it this evening.)
questions.explanation: {取|qǔ}{钱|qián} is to take money out; {存|cún}{钱|qián} is to put it in (to save), the opposite. {赚|zhuàn}{钱|qián} is to earn it, and {值|zhí} is "to be worth".

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {收入|shōu rù} (income): a high level tone, then a falling one, 1+4.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {密码|mì mǎ} (a password, a PIN): a falling tone, then a dipping one, 4+3.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {原|yuán}___ (to forgive)
questions.explanation: {原谅|yuán liàng}: 谅 has 讠 (speech) + 京. 凉 ({凉|liáng}, cool) has the same 京 with 冫, 量 ({量|liáng}, to measure, lesson 06) and 亮 (bright) are other liang characters.

questions.stem: Which character is cún, "to deposit, to save"?
questions.explanation: 存 and 在 start with the same three strokes; 存 has 子 inside, 在 has 土. 孩 ({孩子|hái zi}) and 字 also contain 子.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker say about the company?

audio.text: 我们公司有五十个人左右，其中女性占三分之一。

choices: It has exactly fifty staff, all women.
It has about fifty staff, a third of them women.
It has fifteen staff, three of them women.
Half its fifty staff are women.
questions.explanation: {五十|wǔ shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{左右|zuǒ yòu} (about fifty people), {其中|qí zhōng}{女性|nǚ xìng}{占|zhàn}{三|sān}{分之|fēn zhī}{一|yī} (of whom women make up a third). {其中|qí zhōng} is "among them" (lesson 03) and {占|zhàn} "to make up".

questions.stem: Listen. How much does the coat cost now?

audio.text: 这件外套原价四百块，现在打八折。

questions.explanation: {原|yuán}{价|jià}{四百|sì bǎi}{块|kuài} (originally 400 yuan), {打|dǎ}{八|bā}{折|zhé} (80 % of the price: 20 % off). 80 % of 400 is 320.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker's problem?

audio.text: 我这个月只剩两百块了，可是离发工资还有十来天。

choices: They have been paid two hundred yuan too little.
They only have two hundred yuan left, with ten-odd days to payday.
They earn two hundred yuan a day.
questions.explanation: {只|zhǐ}{剩|shèng}{两百|liǎng bǎi}{块|kuài}{了|le} (only 200 left) and {离|lí}{发|fā}{工资|gōng zī}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{十|shí}{来|lái}{天|tiān} (ten or so days to go before payday): {剩|shèng} is to be left over, and {十|shí}{来|lái}{天|tiān} is "ten-odd days".

questions.stem: Listen. How does the speaker feel about the phone?

audio.text: 这个手机两千块，用了五年还很好用，真是太值了。

choices: It was well worth the money.
questions.explanation: {用|yòng}{了|le}{五|wǔ}{年|nián}{还|hái}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}{用|yòng} (still works well after five years), {真|zhēn}{是|shì}{太|tài}{值|zhí}{了|le} (it was really worth it). {值|zhí} is "to be worth".

questions.stem: Read and choose the word for the gap: "{五|wǔ}{年|nián}{前|qián}，{大学生|dà xué shēng}{每|měi}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{的|de}{零花钱|líng huā qián}{平均|píng jūn}{八百|bā bǎi}{元|yuán}；{现在|xiàn zài}，{平均|píng jūn}{一千五百|yì qiān wǔ bǎi}{元|yuán}{左右|zuǒ yòu}。{跟|gēn}{五|wǔ}{年|nián}{前|qián}{相比|xiāng bǐ}，{零花钱|líng huā qián}{多|duō}{了|le}{将近|jiāng jìn}___，{可是|kě shì}{能|néng}{存|cún}{下来|xià lái}{的|de}{钱|qián}{却|què}{比|bǐ}{以前|yǐ qián}{少|shǎo}{了|le}。" ({平均|píng jūn}: average; {将近|jiāng jìn}: nearly)
questions.explanation: From 800 to about 1,500 is nearly double: {多|duō}{了|le}{将近|jiāng jìn}{一|yí}{倍|bèi} (more by nearly one time). {多|duō}{了|le}{一半|yí bàn} would be 1,200. {左右|zuǒ yòu} and {前后|qián hòu} mean "about" and can't follow {将近|jiāng jìn}.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: By the end of the year I can save thirty thousand or so yuan.
questions.explanation: {到|dào}{年底|nián dǐ}，{我|wǒ}{能|néng}{存|cún}{三万|sān wàn}{来|lái}{块|kuài}{钱|qián}。 {来|lái} goes after the round number {三万|sān wàn} and before the measure word {块|kuài}. {前后|qián hòu} is only for times ({春节|Chūn jié}{前后|qián hòu}), never for amounts.

questions.stem: In which year did the state of Qin unify the rival states and its king become the first emperor?
questions.explanation: {公元前|gōng yuán qián}221{年|nián} (221 BCE): {秦国|Qín guó}{统一|tǒng yī}{了|le}{这些|zhè xiē}{国家|guó jiā}，{秦国|Qín guó}{的|de}{王|wáng}{成为|chéng wéi}{了|le}{中国|Zhōng guó}{的|de}{第|dì}{一|yī}{个|gè}{皇帝|huáng dì}. 1974 is when the terracotta army was found, and 605 CE is the start of the Sui works on the Grand Canal.

questions.stem: What does the name {秦始皇|Qín Shǐ huáng} mean?
questions.explanation: {秦|Qín} is Qin, {始|shǐ} is "first, beginning" and {皇|huáng} is short for {皇帝|huáng dì} (emperor): the First Emperor of Qin. He died in 210 BCE, and his dynasty fell a few years later.

questions.stem: Which of these was NOT one of the first emperor's standards?
questions.explanation: The standards were of writing ({小篆|xiǎo zhuàn}, the small seal script), weights and measures, coins and the distance between cart wheels, with roads across the empire. The sources describe no standard for speech.

questions.stem: Read: "{这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{铜钱|tóng qián}{是|shì}{圆|yuán}{的|de}，{中间|zhōng jiān}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{方孔|fāng kǒng}，{上面|shàng miàn}{写着|xiě zhe}'{半两|bàn liǎng}'{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{字|zì}。" ({铜钱|tóng qián}: a bronze coin; {圆|yuán}: round; {方孔|fāng kǒng}: a square hole) What did the coin look like?
questions.explanation: {圆|yuán}{的|de} (round), {中间|zhōng jiān}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{方孔|fāng kǒng} (with a square hole in the middle). Some earlier coins were shaped like knives or spades; the round coin with a square hole became the usual Chinese shape for about two thousand years.

questions.stem: The Qin coin was inscribed {半两|bàn liǎng}. What does {半两|bàn liǎng} mean?
questions.explanation: {半|bàn} is half, and {两|liǎng} here is the weight liang (lesson 08's {两|liǎng}): the coin was named after the weight it was meant to have.

questions.stem: How was the terracotta army found?
choices: Archaeologists were looking for the emperor's tomb in 1987.
Builders were making a road near Beijing.
Farmers digging a well near Xi'an found pieces of pottery figures in 1974.
A historian read about it in an old book.
questions.explanation: {一九七四|yī jiǔ qī sì}{年|nián}，{西安|Xī'ān}{附近|fù jìn}{的|de}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{农民|nóng mín}{在|zài}{挖|wā}{井|jǐng}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{发现|fā xiàn}{了|le}{一些|yì xiē}{陶|táo}{做|zuò}{的|de}{人|rén}: in 1974, farmers near Xi'an digging a well ({挖|wā}{井|jǐng}) found figures made of pottery ({陶|táo}). Archaeologists ({考古人员|kǎo gǔ rén yuán}) then uncovered the pits. 1987 is the year of the UNESCO listing.

questions.stem: Read: "{全|quán}{国|guó}{使用|shǐ yòng}{同一|tóng yī}{种|zhǒng}{文字|wén zì}，{这|zhè}{就|jiù}{是|shì}'{小篆|xiǎo zhuàn}'。{这样|zhè yàng}，{各个|gè gè}{地方|dì fang}{的|de}{人|rén}{写|xiě}{的|de}{字|zì}{都|dōu}{一样|yí yàng}，{便于|biàn yú}{交流|jiāo liú}。" ({小篆|xiǎo zhuàn}: the small seal script) What did one script make easier?
choices: communication between people from different places
questions.explanation: {各个|gè gè}{地方|dì fang}{的|de}{人|rén}{写|xiě}{的|de}{字|zì}{都|dōu}{一样|yí yàng}，{便于|biàn yú}{交流|jiāo liú}: characters were written the same way everywhere, making it easier to communicate. {便于|biàn yú} (lesson 13) is the written "so as to make it easy to".

questions.stem: Read: "{秦朝|Qín cháo}{的|de}{时间|shí jiān}{不|bù}{长|cháng}，{仅仅|jǐn jǐn}{十|shí}{几|jǐ}{年|nián}。{然而|rán ér}，{它|tā}{定|dìng}{下|xià}{的|de}{许多|xǔ duō}{标准|biāo zhǔn}，{却|què}{影响|yǐng xiǎng}{了|le}{后来|hòu lái}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}{的|de}{时间|shí jiān}。" ({影响|yǐng xiǎng}: to influence) What is the writer's point?
choices: The standards were dropped when the dynasty ended.
The dynasty lasted for many centuries.
The dynasty was short, but its standards lasted a long time.
questions.explanation: {仅仅|jǐn jǐn}{十|shí}{几|jǐ}{年|nián} (only some fifteen years) is set against {影响|yǐng xiǎng}{了|le}{后来|hòu lái}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}{的|de}{时间|shí jiān} (influenced a long time afterwards). {然而|rán ér} (however) and {却|què} (yet, after the subject) mark the contrast.

questions.stem: What does the phrase "{书|shū}{同|tóng}{文|wén}，{车|chē}{同|tóng}{轨|guǐ}" sum up?
choices: the emperor's love of books and carts
the same script for writing and the same gauge for carts
a rule that every family must own a book and a cart
the roads and canals of the Sui
questions.explanation: {书|shū}{同|tóng}{文|wén}: writing ({书|shū}) shares ({同|tóng}) one script ({文|wén}); {车|chē}{同|tóng}{轨|guǐ}: carts share one gauge ({轨|guǐ}, the ruts or track). The phrase sums up the standards of script and cart width.

questions.stem: When was the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor ({秦始皇陵|Qín Shǐ huáng líng}) inscribed on UNESCO's World Heritage List?
questions.explanation: {一九八七|yī jiǔ bā qī}{年|nián}，{秦始皇陵|Qín Shǐ huáng líng}{被|bèi}{列入|liè rù}{了|le}{世界|shì jiè}{文化|wén huà}{遗产|yí chǎn}: in 1987. 1974 is when the army was found, and 2014 is the year of the Grand Canal's listing.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {公元前|gōng yuán qián}221{年|nián}，{秦国|Qín guó}___ {了|le}{这些|zhè xiē}{国家|guó jiā}。 (In 221 BCE the state of Qin unified these states.)
questions.explanation: {统一|tǒng yī} is to unify, to make into one (or the same): {统一|tǒng yī}{国家|guó jiā}, {统一|tǒng yī}{标准|biāo zhǔn}. {同意|tóng yì} is to agree, {一起|yì qǐ} is together and {一样|yí yàng} is the same: none of them takes {这些|zhè xiē}{国家|guó jiā} as an object.

questions.stem: Listen. What happened in 1974?

audio.text: 一九七四年，西安附近的几个农民在挖井的时候，发现了一些陶做的人。

choices: The emperor's tomb was opened to visitors.
Some farmers digging a well found pottery figures.
A new well was dug for Xi'an.
Farmers made pottery figures for a museum.
questions.explanation: {几|jǐ}{个|gè}{农民|nóng mín}{在|zài}{挖|wā}{井|jǐng}{的|de}{时候|shí hou} (some farmers, while digging a well), {发现|fā xiàn}{了|le}{一些|yì xiē}{陶|táo}{做|zuò}{的|de}{人|rén} (found some figures made of pottery): the first finds of the terracotta army.

questions.stem: Which two cities does the Beijing–Hangzhou Grand Canal ({京杭大运河|Jīng Háng Dà Yùn hé}) link?
questions.explanation: {京|jīng} stands for Beijing ({北京|Běi jīng}) and {杭|háng} for Hangzhou ({杭州|Háng zhōu}): {北|běi}{边|biān}{从|cóng}{北京|Běi jīng}{开始|kāi shǐ}，{南|nán}{边|biān}{到|dào}{浙江|Zhè jiāng}{的|de}{杭州|Háng zhōu}.

questions.stem: Read: "{大运河|Dà Yùn hé}……{长|cháng}{约|yuē}{一千八百|yì qiān bā bǎi}{公里|gōng lǐ}。" About how long is the Grand Canal? ({约|yuē}: about)
questions.explanation: {一千八百|yì qiān bā bǎi}{公里|gōng lǐ} is 1,800 km ({公里|gōng lǐ}: a kilometre). {约|yuē} is the written "about", like {大约|dà yuē}.

questions.stem: Under which dynasty were the earlier canals first joined into one system, with great works from about 605 CE?
questions.explanation: {到|dào}{了|le}{隋朝|Suí cháo}，{皇帝|huáng dì}{下令|xià lìng}{把|bǎ}{这些|zhè xiē}{河道|hé dào}{连|lián}{起来|qǐ lái}: under the Sui ({隋朝|Suí cháo}) the emperor ordered the channels to be joined, and the works began around 605. The Yuan later straightened the route to Beijing.

questions.stem: Why were new sections dug under the Yuan dynasty?
choices: to bring grain from the south to the capital in today's Beijing more directly
to reach the sea at Shanghai
to stop the Yellow River flooding
questions.explanation: {元朝|Yuán cháo}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{首都|shǒu dū}{在|zài}{今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{北京|Běi jīng}。{为了|wèi le}{更|gèng}{快|kuài}{地|de}{把|bǎ}{南方|nán fāng}{的|de}{粮食|liáng shi}{运|yùn}{到|dào}{北京|Běi jīng}，{人们|rén men}{又|yòu}{挖|wā}{了|le}{新|xīn}{的|de}{河道|hé dào}: the capital was in today's Beijing, and grain ({粮食|liáng shi}) from the south had to get there faster.

questions.stem: For centuries, what was the Grand Canal's main load?
choices: tax grain sent to the capital and the armies of the north
questions.explanation: The main job was {漕运|cáo yùn} (cáo yùn): shipping tax grain north. Boats also carried salt, other goods and travellers.

questions.stem: What does "{大运河|Dà Yùn hé}{不|bú}{是|shì}{一|yí}{次|cì}{建成|jiàn chéng}{的|de}。" mean? ({建成|jiàn chéng}: to complete building)
choices: The Grand Canal was finished in a single year.
The Grand Canal has never been finished.
The Grand Canal was built only once.
The Grand Canal wasn't built all at once.
questions.explanation: {不|bú}{是|shì}{一|yí}{次|cì}{建成|jiàn chéng}{的|de}: it wasn't completed in one go. {是|shì}…{的|de} stresses how it was built: in stages, from early local canals to the Sui system and the Yuan route.

questions.stem: Read: "{运河|yùn hé}{不|bú}{再|zài}{绕|rào}{到|dào}{西|xī}{边|biān}{的|de}{洛阳|Luò yáng}，{而|ér}{是|shì}{从|cóng}{南|nán}{到|dào}{北|běi}{几乎|jī hū}{一直|yì zhí}{往|wǎng}{前|qián}，{路程|lù chéng}{短|duǎn}{了|le}{好|hǎo}{几|jǐ}{百|bǎi}{公里|gōng lǐ}。" ({绕|rào}: to go round; {路程|lù chéng}: the distance travelled) What changed?
choices: The canal was extended west to Luoyang.
The canal now ran almost straight north instead of round by Luoyang, and the trip was much shorter.
The canal was closed between north and south.
Boats had to go round Luoyang twice.
questions.explanation: {不|bú}{再|zài}…{而|ér}{是|shì}… (no longer… but instead…): it stopped going round by Luoyang ({不|bú}{再|zài}{绕|rào}{到|dào}{西|xī}{边|biān}{的|de}{洛阳|Luò yáng}) and ran almost straight north ({从|cóng}{南|nán}{到|dào}{北|běi}{几乎|jī hū}{一直|yì zhí}{往|wǎng}{前|qián}), several hundred kilometres shorter ({短|duǎn}{了|le}{好|hǎo}{几|jǐ}{百|bǎi}{公里|gōng lǐ}).

questions.stem: In which year was the Grand Canal inscribed on UNESCO's World Heritage List?
questions.explanation: {二|èr}〇{一四|yī sì}{年|nián}，{大运河|Dà Yùn hé}{被|bèi}{列入|liè rù}{了|le}{世界|shì jiè}{文化|wén huà}{遗产|yí chǎn}: in 2014. 1987 is the year of the First Emperor's mausoleum.

questions.stem: Which of these cities is NOT on the route of today's Beijing–Hangzhou Grand Canal?
questions.explanation: Yangzhou, Suzhou and Hangzhou grew rich along the canal ({运河|yùn hé}{边|biān}{上|shàng}{出现|chū xiàn}{了|le}{许多|xǔ duō}{城市|chéng shì}，{像|xiàng}{扬州|Yáng zhōu}、{苏州|Sū zhōu}、{杭州|Háng zhōu}). Xi'an, the old capital in the north-west, is far from it.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {运河|yùn hé}{是|shì}{人|rén}___ {出来|chū lái}{的|de}{河|hé}，{不|bú}{是|shì}{自然|zì rán}{的|de}{河|hé}。 (A canal is a river dug out by people, not a natural one. {自然|zì rán}: natural)
questions.explanation: {挖|wā} wā is to dig: {挖|wā}{出来|chū lái} (to dig out), {挖|wā}{井|jǐng} (to dig a well). {洗|xǐ} is to wash, {找|zhǎo} to look for, {吃|chī} to eat.

questions.stem: Why were cities such as Yangzhou and Suzhou rich in the past?
choices: They grew on the trade the canal brought.
They were the capitals of the Yuan.
questions.explanation: {运河|yùn hé}{边|biān}{上|shàng}{出现|chū xiàn}{了|le}{许多|xǔ duō}{城市|chéng shì}…{生意|shēng yi}{都|dōu}{做|zuò}{得|de}{很|hěn}{大|dà}: cities grew up along the canal and did a great deal of business. The canal carried grain, salt, goods and people past their doors.

questions.stem: Listen. How is the canal used today?

audio.text: 今天，一些河段上还有船在运货，也有很多人坐船游玩。

choices: Only for carrying grain to the capital.
Boats still carry goods on some stretches, and many people take boat trips.
questions.explanation: {一些|yì xiē}{河段|hé duàn}{上|shàng}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{船|chuán}{在|zài}{运|yùn}{货|huò} (on some stretches boats still carry goods), {也|yě}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{坐|zuò}{船|chuán}{游玩|yóu wán} (and many people take boat trips). {河段|hé duàn} is a stretch of river or canal.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct? (As there are more and more cars, the traffic jams are getting worse.)
choices: {堵车|dǔ chē}{随着|suí zhe}{车|chē}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{多|duō}，{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{严重|yán zhòng}{了|le}。
{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{多|duō}{随着|suí zhe}{车|chē}，{堵车|dǔ chē}{也|yě}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{严重|yán zhòng}{了|le}。
{随着|suí zhe}{车|chē}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{多|duō}，{堵车|dǔ chē}{也|yě}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{严重|yán zhòng}{了|le}。
{车|chē}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{多|duō}{随着|suí zhe}，{堵车|dǔ chē}{也|yě}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{严重|yán zhòng}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: {随着|suí zhe} + the change comes first, and the main clause follows with its own change ({越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{严重|yán zhòng}{了|le}): {随着|suí zhe}{车|chē}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{多|duō}，{堵车|dǔ chē}{也|yě}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{严重|yán zhòng}{了|le}。 {随着|suí zhe} never comes after its noun phrase or inside the main clause.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "When I got to the stop, the bus had already left."?
choices: {我|wǒ}{当|dāng}{到|dào}{车站|chē zhàn}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{车|chē}{已经|yǐ jīng}{开|kāi}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。
{当|dāng}{我|wǒ}{到|dào}{车站|chē zhàn}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{车|chē}{已经|yǐ jīng}{开|kāi}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。
{当|dāng}{到|dào}{车站|chē zhàn}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{车|chē}{已经|yǐ jīng}{开|kāi}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。
{我|wǒ}{到|dào}{车站|chē zhàn}{当|dāng}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{车|chē}{已经|yǐ jīng}{开|kāi}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: {当|dāng} opens the clause, before its subject: {当|dāng}{我|wǒ}{到|dào}{车站|chē zhàn}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}…. {当|dāng} can't come between the subject and the verb, and {的|de}{时候|shí hou} closes the clause. (In speech {当|dāng} can be dropped: {我|wǒ}{到|dào}{车站|chē zhàn}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}….)

questions.stem: A notice says: "{自|zì}{十|shí}{月|yuè}{一|yī}{日|rì}{起|qǐ}，{地铁|dì tiě}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{五|wǔ}{点|diǎn}{开|kāi}{门|mén}。" What does {自|zì}{十|shí}{月|yuè}{一|yī}{日|rì}{起|qǐ} mean?
questions.explanation: {自|zì}…{起|qǐ} is the written "starting from": {自|zì}{十|shí}{月|yuè}{一|yī}{日|rì}{起|qǐ} = {从|cóng}{十|shí}{月|yuè}{一|yī}{日|rì}{开始|kāi shǐ} (from 1 October on). "Until" would be {到|dào}{十|shí}{月|yuè}{一|yī}{日|rì}.

questions.stem: What does "{这|zhè}{趟|tàng}{大巴|dà bā}{的|de}{乘客|chéng kè}{已经|yǐ jīng}{超过|chāo guò}{五十|wǔ shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{了|le}。" mean?
choices: This coach already has more than fifty passengers.
This coach has already overtaken fifty cars.
Fifty passengers have already got off this coach.
This coach can only take fifty passengers.
questions.explanation: {超过|chāo guò} + a number is "more than, to exceed": {超过|chāo guò}{五十|wǔ shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}, over fifty people. {乘客|chéng kè} is a passenger, and {趟|tàng} counts the coach's run. To overtake a car is {超过|chāo guò} + the car ({超过|chāo guò}{前面|qián miàn}{的|de}{车|chē}).

questions.stem: Choose the measure word: {我|wǒ}{得|děi}{去|qù}___ {银行|yín háng}，{下午|xià wǔ}{就|jiù}{回来|huí lái}。 (I have to make a trip to the bank; I'll be back this afternoon.)
questions.explanation: {趟|tàng} counts a trip there and back, often an errand: {去|qù}{一|yí}{趟|tàng}{银行|yín háng}. {座|zuò} is for buildings and mountains ({一|yí}{座|zuò}{楼|lóu}), {辆|liàng} for vehicles, {条|tiáo} for roads and rivers.

questions.stem: Which sentence means the same as "{学校|xué xiào}{距离|jù lí}{市区|shì qū}{四十|sì shí}{公里|gōng lǐ}。"? ({市区|shì qū}: the city)
choices: {学校|xué xiào}{在|zài}{市区|shì qū}{四十|sì shí}{公里|gōng lǐ}。
{学校|xué xiào}{到|dào}{市区|shì qū}{要|yào}{四十|sì shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}。
{学校|xué xiào}{离|lí}{市区|shì qū}{四十|sì shí}{公里|gōng lǐ}。
{学校|xué xiào}{比|bǐ}{市区|shì qū}{大|dà}{四十|sì shí}{公里|gōng lǐ}。
questions.explanation: As a verb, {距离|jù lí} is the written {离|lí}: {学校|xué xiào}{距离|jù lí}{市区|shì qū}{四十|sì shí}{公里|gōng lǐ} = {学校|xué xiào}{离|lí}{市区|shì qū}{四十|sì shí}{公里|gōng lǐ} (the school is 40 km from the city). {分钟|fēn zhōng} would be a time, not a distance.

questions.stem: You see a sign: "{此处|cǐ chù}{不|bù}{能|néng}{停车|tíng chē}". What does it mean?
questions.explanation: {此处|cǐ chù} is "here" in writing ({此|cǐ} this + {处|chù} place), and {停车|tíng chē} is to park: {此处|cǐ chù}{不|bù}{能|néng}{停车|tíng chē}, no parking here. "Stop" alone would be {停|tíng}; a full car park is {没有|méi yǒu}{车位|chē wèi}{了|le}.

questions.stem: A friend asks how you get to work. Which reply sounds most natural in conversation?
choices: {我|wǒ}{乘坐|chéng zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{上班|shàng bān}。
questions.explanation: In a chat, {坐|zuò} is the verb: {我|wǒ}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{上班|shàng bān}. {我|wǒ}{乘坐|chéng zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{上班|shàng bān} is correct but stiff: {乘坐|chéng zuò} is the word of notices and announcements. The other two have the wrong word order (the way of travelling comes before {上班|shàng bān}).

questions.stem: Read part of a notice: "{二|èr}、{火车|huǒ chē}{站|zhàn}{和|hé}{机场|jī chǎng}{附近|fù jìn}{车位|chē wèi}{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}，{停车|tíng chē}{不便|bú biàn}。{请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{尽量|jǐn liàng}{乘坐|chéng zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{或|huò}{公共|gōng gòng}{汽车|qì chē}{前往|qián wǎng}。" ({尽量|jǐn liàng}: as far as possible; {前往|qián wǎng}: to go there) Why does the notice ask people to take the metro or the bus?
choices: The metro and buses are free.
It's hard to park near the stations and the airport.
Cars can't go to the airport.
The buses are faster than cars.
questions.explanation: {车位|chē wèi}{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}，{停车|tíng chē}{不便|bú biàn}: there are few parking spaces, and parking is inconvenient. Nothing is said about prices, speed or a ban on cars.

questions.stem: A holiday notice for 1–7 October says: "{十|shí}{月|yuè}{一|yī}{日|rì}{上午|shàng wǔ}{离开|lí kāi}{本市|běn shì}{的|de}{车|chē}{和|hé}{七|qī}{日|rì}{下午|xià wǔ}{回来|huí lái}{的|de}{车|chē}{会|huì}{特别|tè bié}{多|duō}，{请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{注意|zhù yì}{交警|jiāo jǐng}{的|de}{安排|ān pái}。" ({本市|běn shì}: this city) What can you work out from it?
choices: Many people drive away at the start of the holiday and come back at the end.
The roads are closed from the 1st to the 7th.
The traffic police will be on holiday too.
Cars can't come back into the city before the 7th.
questions.explanation: The busiest times are leaving the city on the first morning ({离开|lí kāi}{本市|běn shì}) and coming back on the last afternoon ({回来|huí lái}): people go away for the holiday by car. The notice asks drivers to follow the traffic police ({交警|jiāo jǐng}); it doesn't close any road.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {速度|sù dù} sù dù (speed): two falling tones, 4+4.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {交通|jiāo tōng} jiāo tōng (traffic, transport): two high level tones, 1+1.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? ___ {车|chē} (to park)
questions.explanation: {停车|tíng chē} tíng chē: {={停|tíng} is 亻 + {亭|tíng}. {亭|tíng} alone (tíng, a pavilion) gives the sound but has no 亻. {信|xìn} and {便|biàn} also have 亻 on the left, but other right sides.=}

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {从|cóng}{机场|jī chǎng}{到|dào}{市区|shì qū}{可以|kě yǐ}{坐|zuò}{大|dà}___。 (You can take a coach from the airport to the city; {市区|shì qū}: the city, lesson 18.)
questions.explanation: {大巴|dà bā} dà bā (a coach). {={巴|bā} has four strokes: the turning stroke, the short vertical, the horizontal, and the vertical-bend-hook last. It also gives the sound in {吧|ba}, {爸|bà} and {把|bǎ}.=}

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: When you see the crossroads ahead, turn right.
questions.explanation: {当|dāng}{你|nǐ}{看|kàn}{到|dào}{前方|qián fāng}{的|de}{十字路口|shí zì lù kǒu}{时|shí}，{向|xiàng}{右|yòu}{转|zhuǎn}。 {当|dāng}…{时|shí} is the written form of {当|dāng}…{的|de}{时候|shí hou}, and {当|dāng} opens the clause before its subject. Speech can drop {当|dāng} ({你|nǐ}{看|kàn}{到|dào}…{时|shí}). {自|zì} (from) doesn't belong: it's a starting point, not "when".

questions.stem: Listen. How often does the coach run?

audio.text: 大巴二十分钟一趟。

questions.explanation: {大巴|dà bā}{二十|èr shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{一|yí}{趟|tàng}: one coach every twenty minutes. Time + {一|yī} + measure word gives a frequency. A ride of twenty minutes would be {坐|zuò}{二十|èr shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}.

questions.stem: Listen to a traveller and a member of staff. What does the traveller need to do?

audio.text: 请问，去机场要换乘吗？要，在下一站换乘十号线。

choices: take a taxi to the airport
stay on until the end of the line
change to line 10 at the next station
get off and take a coach
questions.explanation: {在|zài}{下|xià}{一|yí}{站|zhàn}{换乘|huàn chéng}{十号线|shí hào xiàn}: change to line 10 at the next station. {换乘|huàn chéng} is to change lines or trains.

questions.stem: Listen. How long is the drive when there's no traffic?

audio.text: 我家距离公司十二公里，不堵车的话，开车二十分钟就到了。

questions.explanation: {距离|jù lí}{公司|gōng sī}{十二|shí èr}{公里|gōng lǐ} (twelve kilometres from the office), {不|bù}{堵车|dǔ chē}{的话|de huà}，{开车|kāi chē}{二十|èr shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le} (without traffic, twenty minutes by car). Twelve kilometres is the distance, not the time.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker going to do from now on?

audio.text: 随着天气越来越冷，骑电动车上班越来越不舒服了，我打算以后坐地铁。

questions.explanation: {随着|suí zhe}{天气|tiān qì}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{冷|lěng} (as it gets colder), riding an e-bike is less and less pleasant, so {我|wǒ}{打算|dǎ suàn}{以后|yǐ hòu}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}: from now on the speaker plans to take the metro.

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: {早上|zǎo shang}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}，{路上|lù shang}{车|chē}{很|hěn}{多|duō}，{常常|cháng cháng}___，{所以|suǒ yǐ}{我|wǒ}{一般|yì bān}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{上班|shàng bān}。
questions.explanation: Lots of cars at rush hour mean jams: {常常|cháng cháng}{堵车|dǔ chē}, which is why the writer takes the metro. {停车|tíng chē} is to park, {加油|jiā yóu} to fill up, {路过|lù guò} to pass by.

questions.stem: Choose the pair for a written notice: ___ {天气|tiān qì}{原因|yuán yīn}，{航班|háng bān}{推迟|tuī chí}{起飞|qǐ fēi}，___ {请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{注意|zhù yì}{查看|chá kàn}{通知|tōng zhī}。
questions.explanation: A cause and its result in a notice: {由于|yóu yú}{天气|tiān qì}{原因|yuán yīn}…，{因此|yīn cǐ}…. {虽然|suī rán}…{但是|dàn shì} is "although… but", and {如果|rú guǒ}…{就|jiù} / {只要|zhǐ yào}…{就|jiù} set conditions, which a delay that has already happened isn't.

questions.stem: Choose the words: {飞机|fēi jī}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{才|cái}{起飞|qǐ fēi}，{现在|xiàn zài}{才|cái}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}，{我们|wǒ men}{打车|dǎ chē}{去|qù}{还|hái}___。
questions.explanation: Two hours before take-off there's still time: {还|hái}{来得及|lái de jí}. {来不及|lái bu jí} would be "too late". {来|lái}{得|de}{不|bù}{及|jí} and {不|bù}{来|lái}{及|jí} don't exist: the forms are {来得及|lái de jí} and {来不及|lái bu jí}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {他|tā}{早上|zǎo shang}{起|qǐ}{晚|wǎn}{了|le}，___ {没|méi}{赶上|gǎn shàng}{飞机|fēi jī}。
questions.explanation: {结果|jié guǒ} opens the outcome: he got up late, and as a result he missed the plane. {因为|yīn wèi} would introduce a cause, {如果|rú guǒ} a condition, {虽然|suī rán} a contrast.

questions.stem: What does "{飞机|fēi jī}{快|kuài}{起飞|qǐ fēi}{了|le}。" mean?
choices: The plane is about to take off.
Hurry, the plane is taking off!
questions.explanation: {快|kuài} + verb + {了|le} is "about to": {快|kuài}{起飞|qǐ fēi}{了|le}, it's about to take off. "Hurry up and…" is {赶快|gǎn kuài} + verb ({赶快|gǎn kuài}{登机|dēng jī}{吧|ba}！).

questions.stem: The meeting was at nine; now it's at eight. Which sentence describes the change?
choices: {会议|huì yì}{推迟|tuī chí}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
{会议|huì yì}{提前|tí qián}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
{会议|huì yì}{暂停|zàn tíng}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
questions.explanation: Moving something earlier is {提前|tí qián}: {提前|tí qián}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}. {推迟|tuī chí} moves it later, {取消|qǔ xiāo} cancels it, and {暂停|zàn tíng} stops it for a while. ({会议|huì yì}: a meeting.)

questions.stem: Choose the word: {请|qǐng}{告诉|gào su}{我|wǒ}___ {的|de}{时间|shí jiān}，{我|wǒ}{好|hǎo}{去|qù}{机场|jī chǎng}{接|jiē}{你|nǐ}。 (Please tell me the exact time, so that I can meet you at the airport.)
questions.explanation: Exact information is {准确|zhǔn què}: {准确|zhǔn què}{的|de}{时间|shí jiān}. {准时|zhǔn shí} is "on time" ({飞机|fēi jī}{准时|zhǔn shí}{起飞|qǐ fēi}{了|le}), {顺利|shùn lì} "smooth", {有效|yǒu xiào} "valid". {我|wǒ}{好|hǎo}{去|qù}…: so that I can go (purpose {好|hǎo}).

questions.stem: How do you tell a friend far away "I miss you"?
questions.explanation: Missing a person is {想|xiǎng}: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{想|xiǎng}{你|nǐ}. {错过|cuò guò} is missing something you aimed for, such as a plane or a chance ({错过|cuò guò}{了|le}{飞机|fēi jī}); {赶|gǎn} is rushing to catch.

questions.stem: Read an airport notice: "{由于|yóu yú}{北京|Běi jīng}{地区|dì qū}{有|yǒu}{大雨|dà yǔ}，{因此|yīn cǐ}{您|nín}{乘坐|chéng zuò}{的|de}{成都|Chéng dū}{飞往|fēi wǎng}{北京|Běi jīng}{的|de}{航班|háng bān}{将|jiāng}{推迟|tuī chí}{起飞|qǐ fēi}，{起飞|qǐ fēi}{时间|shí jiān}{暂定|zàn dìng}{为|wéi}{二十二|èr shí èr}{点|diǎn}。{登机|dēng jī}{时间|shí jiān}{和|hé}{登机口|dēng jī kǒu}{如有|rú yǒu}{变化|biàn huà}，{我们|wǒ men}{将|jiāng}{再次|zài cì}{通知|tōng zhī}。" ({地区|dì qū}: area; {暂定|zàn dìng}{为|wéi}: provisionally set at; {如有|rú yǒu}{变化|biàn huà}: if there are changes) Which is true?
choices: For now, the flight is due to leave at 10 p.m.
The gate has already been changed.
questions.explanation: {起飞|qǐ fēi}{时间|shí jiān}{暂定|zàn dìng}{为|wéi}{二十二|èr shí èr}{点|diǎn}: take-off is provisionally 22.00. The rain is in Beijing ({北京|Běi jīng}{地区|dì qū}{有|yǒu}{大雨|dà yǔ}), the flight is delayed, not cancelled, and the gate changes only "if there are any" ({如有|rú yǒu}{变化|biàn huà}).

questions.stem: A manager writes to a colleague before a business trip: "{上|shàng}{次|cì}{去|qù}{广州|Guǎng zhōu}，{飞机|fēi jī}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{起飞|qǐ fēi}，{你|nǐ}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{才|cái}{到|dào}{机场|jī chǎng}，{结果|jié guǒ}{差点儿|chà diǎnr}{没|méi}{赶上|gǎn shàng}{飞机|fēi jī}。{这|zhè}{次|cì}{千万|qiān wàn}{别|bié}{再|zài}{迟到|chí dào}{了|le}。" What does the manager mean?
choices: Last time the colleague nearly missed the plane, so this time they must be on time.
Last time the colleague missed the plane.
Last time the manager was late.
Last time the flight was delayed an hour.
questions.explanation: {差点儿|chà diǎnr}{没|méi}{赶上|gǎn shàng} means "only just caught it" (lesson 10's {差点儿|chà diǎnr}), so the colleague did fly, but only just. {千万|qiān wàn}{别|bié}{再|zài}{迟到|chí dào}{了|le}: whatever you do, don't be late again.

questions.stem: Read the email: "{你|nǐ}{上|shàng}{次|cì}{问|wèn}{我|wǒ}{放假|fàng jià}{去|qù}{哪儿|nǎr}{玩儿|wánr}{好|hǎo}，{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ}{介绍|jiè shào}{一|yí}{个|gè}{地方|dì fang}：{江|jiāng}{边|biān}{的|de}{一|yí}{座|zuò}{小|xiǎo}{城|chéng}。{这|zhè}{座|zuò}{城|chéng}{不|bú}{大|dà}，{可是|kě shì}{已经|yǐ jīng}{有|yǒu}{一千|yì qiān}{多|duō}{年|nián}{的|de}{历史|lì shǐ}{了|le}。{城|chéng}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{座|zuò}{十分|shí fēn}{著名|zhù míng}{的|de}{老|lǎo}{桥|qiáo}，{是|shì}{十三|shí sān}{世纪|shì jì}{修|xiū}{的|de}，{到|dào}{现在|xiàn zài}{还|hái}{能|néng}{走|zǒu}。{站|zhàn}{在|zài}{桥|qiáo}{上|shàng}，{你|nǐ}{能|néng}{看|kàn}{到|dào}{江|jiāng}{两|liǎng}{边|biān}{的|de}{风景|fēng jǐng}：{一边|yì biān}{是|shì}{老|lǎo}{房子|fáng zi}，{一边|yì biān}{是|shì}{绿色|lǜ sè}{的|de}{山|shān}，{景色|jǐng sè}{美|měi}{极|jí}{了|le}。{这里|zhè lǐ}{的|de}{美食|měi shí}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{有名|yǒu míng}。{街|jiē}{上|shàng}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{小吃|xiǎo chī}，{既|jì}{便宜|pián yi}{又|yòu}{好吃|hǎo chī}。{我|wǒ}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{的|de}{是|shì}{一|yì}{种|zhǒng}{鱼|yú}{汤|tāng}，{又|yòu}{鲜|xiān}{又|yòu}{香|xiāng}，{我|wǒ}{一共|yí gòng}{喝|hē}{了|le}{三|sān}{碗|wǎn}。{我|wǒ}{是|shì}{跟|gēn}{着|zhe}{导游|dǎo yóu}{去|qù}{的|de}。{导游|dǎo yóu}{告诉|gào su}{我们|wǒ men}，{每|měi}{到|dào}{节假日|jié jià rì}，{各地|gè dì}{的|de}{游客|yóu kè}{都|dōu}{来|lái}{这里|zhè lǐ}{游玩|yóu wán}，{城|chéng}{里|lǐ}{到处|dào chù}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{人|rén}，{连|lián}{桥|qiáo}{上|shàng}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{难|nán}{走|zǒu}{过去|guò qù}。{所以|suǒ yǐ}，{如果|rú guǒ}{你|nǐ}{想|xiǎng}{安静|ān jìng}{地|de}{参观|cān guān}，{最好|zuì hǎo}{别|bié}{在|zài}{节假日|jié jià rì}{去|qù}。{我|wǒ}{是|shì}{五|wǔ}{月|yuè}{去|qù}{的|de}，{人|rén}{不|bù}{多|duō}，{拍|pāi}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{照片|zhào piàn}，{回来|huí lái}{以后|yǐ hòu}{发|fā}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ}{看|kàn}。{我|wǒ}{觉得|jué de}{这个|zhè ge}{地方|dì fang}{很|hěn}{值得|zhí de}{去|qù}。{最|zuì}{吸引|xī yǐn}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{不|bú}{是|shì}{那|nà}{座|zuò}{著名|zhù míng}{的|de}{桥|qiáo}，{而是|ér shì}{这里|zhè lǐ}{的|de}{人|rén}：{他们|tā men}{说话|shuō huà}{很|hěn}{慢|màn}，{走路|zǒu lù}{很|hěn}{慢|màn}，{生活|shēng huó}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{慢|màn}，{好像|hǎo xiàng}{时间|shí jiān}{在|zài}{这里|zhè lǐ}{停|tíng}{下来|xià lái}{了|le}。" What attracted the writer most?
choices: the slow, unhurried life of the people
questions.explanation: {最|zuì}{吸引|xī yǐn}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{不|bú}{是|shì}{那|nà}{座|zuò}{著名|zhù míng}{的|de}{桥|qiáo}，{而是|ér shì}{这里|zhè lǐ}{的|de}{人|rén}：{他们|tā men}{说话|shuō huà}{很|hěn}{慢|màn}，{走路|zǒu lù}{很|hěn}{慢|màn}，{生活|shēng huó}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{慢|màn}: not the bridge but the people and their slow pace of life, as if time had stopped. {不|bú}{是|shì}…{而是|ér shì} corrects what a reader would expect.

questions.topic: Passive with 叫 and 让
questions.stem: Which sentence means "My wallet's been taken."?
questions.explanation: With {叫|jiào} (or {让|ràng}) the doer must be named: {叫|jiào}{人|rén}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}{了|le} ({人|rén} if you don't know who). The thing affected comes first, and the verb needs a result or {了|le} after it ({拿|ná}{走|zǒu}{了|le}). Without a doer, use {被|bèi}: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{钱包|qián bāo}{被|bèi}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}{了|le}.

questions.topic: Passive with 叫 and 让
questions.stem: Choose the word: {还好|hái hǎo}，{我|wǒ}{的|de}{护照|hù zhào}___ {叫|jiào}{人|rén}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}。 (Luckily my passport hasn't been taken.)
questions.explanation: The negative of a passive with {叫|jiào} / {让|ràng} is {没|méi}, before {叫|jiào}: {没|méi}{叫|jiào}{人|rén}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}. {不|bù} doesn't negate a completed event, and {了|le} or {都|dōu} don't make it negative.

questions.topic: Passive with 叫 and 让
questions.stem: Which word fits a hotel's written notice? {贵重物品|guì zhòng wù pǐn}{如果|rú guǒ}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{房间|fáng jiān}{里|lǐ}___ {人|rén}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}，{旅馆|lǚ guǎn}{不|bú}{负责|fù zé}。 ({贵重物品|guì zhòng wù pǐn}: valuables; {负责|fù zé}: to be responsible)
questions.explanation: {叫|jiào} and {让|ràng} passives belong to speech; a written notice uses {被|bèi}: {被|bèi}{人|rén}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}. {把|bǎ} would make {贵重物品|guì zhòng wù pǐn} the doer, which makes no sense.

questions.topic: Passive with 叫 and 让
questions.stem: What does "{他|tā}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{去|qù}。" mean?
choices: I was sent away by him.
He made me go, or let me go.
questions.explanation: With a person after it and a plain verb, {让|ràng} is "to make, to let" (lesson 12's pivotal sentence): he made or let me go. The passive {让|ràng} needs a thing (or a person) affected first and a result after the verb: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}{让|ràng}{弟弟|dì di}{吃|chī}{了|le}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {你|nǐ}{去|qù}{超市|chāo shì}{的话|de huà}，___ {帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{买|mǎi}{瓶|píng}{水|shuǐ}。 (If you're going to the supermarket, could you get me a bottle of water while you're there?)
questions.explanation: "While you're at it" is {顺便|shùn biàn}. {随便|suí biàn} is "as you like, casual" (lesson 22), {方便|fāng biàn} "convenient", {便宜|pián yi} "cheap": all share {便|biàn}, but only {顺便|shùn biàn} fits.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "We're staying in Chengde for two days."?
choices: {我们|wǒ men}{在|zài}{承德|Chéng dé}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}{待|dāi}。
{我们|wǒ men}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}{在|zài}{承德|Chéng dé}{待|dāi}。
{我们|wǒ men}{在|zài}{承德|Chéng dé}{待|dāi}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}。
{我们|wǒ men}{待|dāi}{在|zài}{承德|Chéng dé}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}。
questions.explanation: The place comes before the verb with {在|zài}, and the length of time after it: {在|zài}{承德|Chéng dé}{待|dāi}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}. ({待|dāi} dāi: to stay, spoken.) A duration never comes before the verb here, and {两|liǎng}{个|gè} needs a noun ({两|liǎng}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}).

questions.stem: Which character fits? {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}___ {了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{房间|fáng jiān}。 (I booked a room online.)
questions.explanation: {订|dìng} dìng, to book or order: {订|dìng}{房间|fáng jiān}. {=It's 讠 + {丁|dīng}; {丁|dīng} gives the sound in all four, but {盯|dīng} (to stare, {目|mù}), {顶|dǐng} (the top, {页|yè}) and {钉|dīng} (a nail, 钅) are other words.=}

questions.stem: At dinner a friend orders {白酒|bái jiǔ}. What will arrive?
questions.explanation: {白酒|bái jiǔ} is clear Chinese spirits (baijiu), often 40 % alcohol or more. White wine is {白|bái}{葡萄酒|pú tao jiǔ}, beer {啤酒|pí jiǔ}.

questions.stem: A hotel notice says: "{入住|rù zhù}{时间|shí jiān}{为|wéi}{下午|xià wǔ}{两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{退房|tuì fáng}{时间|shí jiān}{为|wéi}{中午|zhōng wǔ}{十二|shí èr}{点|diǎn}{以前|yǐ qián}。{如果|rú guǒ}{您|nín}{需要|xū yào}{提前|tí qián}{入住|rù zhù}{或者|huò zhě}{晚|wǎn}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{退房|tuì fáng}，{请|qǐng}{提前|tí qián}{跟|gēn}{前台|qián tái}{联系|lián xì}。" ({退房|tuì fáng}: to check out; {前台|qián tái}: the front desk) A guest wants to keep the room until 2 p.m. on the last day. What should they do?
choices: Ask the front desk in advance.
questions.explanation: Check-out is before noon ({中午|zhōng wǔ}{十二|shí èr}{点|diǎn}{以前|yǐ qián}); a later check-out needs contacting the front desk in advance ({请|qǐng}{提前|tí qián}{跟|gēn}{前台|qián tái}{联系|lián xì}). {为|wéi} wéi here is the written "to be". The notice says nothing about paying.

questions.stem: A hotel notice says: "{大厅|dà tīng}{可以|kě yǐ}{寄|jì}{快递|kuài dì}。{如果|rú guǒ}{您|nín}{需要|xū yào}{把|bǎ}{东西|dōng xi}{寄|jì}{回|huí}{家|jiā}，{前台|qián tái}{可以|kě yǐ}{帮|bāng}{您|nín}{装|zhuāng}{好|hǎo}。" What does this suggest about the guests?
choices: They often work in the hotel.
They often buy things on their trips to send home.
questions.explanation: The hotel offers to post things home and pack them ({寄|jì}{回|huí}{家|jiā}, {装|zhuāng}{好|hǎo}), so its guests are travellers who often buy things, such as souvenirs, to send home. It's an inference: the notice doesn't say it in words.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {提供|tí gōng} tí gōng (to provide): a rising tone, then a high level one, 2+1.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {早餐|zǎo cān} zǎo cān (breakfast): a dipping tone, then a high level one, 3+1.

questions.stem: Which character completes the phrase? ___ {快递|kuài dì} (to send a parcel)
questions.explanation: {寄|jì} jì, to send by post: {寄|jì}{快递|kuài dì}. {={寄|jì} is 宀 over {奇|qí}. {奇|qí} (strange) is its sound part, {骑|qí} (to ride) has {马|mǎ}, and {椅|yǐ} (a chair) has {木|mù}.=}

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{衣服|yī fu}{都|dōu}___ {进|jìn}{背包|bēi bāo}{里|lǐ}{了|le}。 (I've packed all my clothes into my backpack.)
questions.explanation: {装|zhuāng} zhuāng, to pack, to put in: {装|zhuāng}{进|jìn}{背包|bēi bāo}{里|lǐ}. {={壮|zhuàng} on top, {衣|yī} (clothes) below.=}

questions.topic: Passive with 叫 and 让
questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese (a spoken passive).
questions.prompt: My bike's been taken by a friend (a friend has ridden off on it).
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{让|ràng}{朋友|péng you}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 The thing affected first, then {让|ràng} + the doer, then the verb with its result ({骑|qí}{走|zǒu}) and {了|le}. {把|bǎ} would need the doer first: {朋友|péng you}{把|bǎ}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}.

questions.stem: Listen to a guest and the front desk. What does the hotel provide?

audio.text: 请问，房间里提供毛巾和牙膏吗？都提供，纸巾也有。

questions.explanation: {都|dōu}{提供|tí gōng} (both are provided), {纸巾|zhǐ jīn}{也|yě}{有|yǒu} (and tissues too).

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker want?

audio.text: 服务员，结账！

questions.explanation: {结账|jié zhàng} is to pay the bill: {服务|fú wù}{员|yuán}，{结账|jié zhàng}！ calls the waiter to pay ({买单|mǎi dān}！ is also common).

questions.stem: Listen. When are they leaving?

audio.text: 我们在承德住两天，周日下午走。

questions.explanation: {住|zhù}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān} (staying two nights), {周|zhōu}{日|rì}{下午|xià wǔ}{走|zǒu} (leaving on Sunday afternoon). ({待|dāi}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān} says the same in speech.)

questions.stem: Listen. What has happened?

audio.text: 我的钱包叫人拿走了，赶紧给警察打电话吧！

choices: The police have found a wallet.
The speaker has lost a phone.
The speaker has taken someone's wallet.
Someone has taken the speaker's wallet.
questions.explanation: {叫|jiào}{人|rén}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}{了|le}: someone has taken it (a spoken passive: the wallet first, then {叫|jiào} + the doer). So they want to call the police ({给|gěi}{警察|jǐng chá}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}).

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap in a hotel notice: {外出|wài chū}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{请|qǐng}{带|dài}{好|hǎo}{房卡|fáng kǎ}{和|hé}___。 ({外出|wài chū}: to go out; {房卡|fáng kǎ}: a key card)
questions.explanation: When you go out you take your key card and your ID papers: {带|dài}{好|hǎo}{房卡|fáng kǎ}{和|hé}{证件|zhèng jiàn}. Toothpaste, dinner and towels stay in the hotel.
