lì}{地|de}{上|shàng}{了|le}{飞机|fēi jī}。{第|dì}{二|èr}{天|tiān}，{旅馆|lǚ guǎn}{把|bǎ}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{身份证|shēn fèn zhèng}{装|zhuāng}{在|zài}{一|yí}{个|gè}{信封|xìn fēng}{里|lǐ}，{寄|jì}{到|dào}{了|le}{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{的|de}{地址|dì zhǐ}。{我|wǒ}{心里|xīn li}{非常|fēi cháng}{感谢|gǎn xiè}{他们|tā men}。{下|xià}{次|cì}{再|zài}{去|qù}{那里|nà lǐ}{出差|chū chāi}，{我|wǒ}{还|hái}{要|yào}{住|zhù}{这|zhè}{家|jiā}{旅馆|lǚ guǎn}。" ({信封|xìn fēng}: an envelope) Where was the writer's ID card?
choices: in the restaurant where the writer had lunch
in the writer's bag all the time
at the front desk, handed over at check-in and never taken back

questions.stem: Your friend says: "{难道|nán dào}{你|nǐ}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{吗|ma}？" What does your friend mean?
questions.explanation: {难道|nán dào}…{吗|ma} is a rhetorical question: it means the opposite of what it says. {难道|nán dào}{你|nǐ}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{吗|ma}？ = surely you know (don't tell me you didn't know!).

questions.stem: Which question is correct? (Are you going or not?)
questions.explanation: {到底|dào dǐ} goes before the A-not-A verb (or a question word): {你|nǐ}{到底|dào dǐ}{去|qù}{不|bu}{去|qù}？ It doesn't combine with {吗|ma}: ~~{你|nǐ}{到底|dào dǐ}{去|qù}{吗|ma}~~.

questions.stem: Which sentence is NOT correct?
questions.explanation: {忽然|hū rán} is only an adverb ({他|tā}{忽然|hū rán}{笑|xiào}{了|le}), so it can't follow {很|hěn} as an adjective. {突然|tū rán} is both: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{很|hěn}{突然|tū rán} (very sudden).

questions.stem: Choose the word: {我|wǒ}{以为|yǐ wéi}{他|tā}{走|zǒu}{了|le}，___ {他|tā}{在|zài}{楼|lóu}{下|xià}{等|děng}{我|wǒ}。 (I thought he'd gone; it turned out he was waiting for me downstairs.)
questions.explanation: {原来|yuán lái} reveals what was really true all along: "it turned out". {本来|běn lái} is "originally, at first", {从来|cóng lái} "always, never (with {不|bù} / {没|méi})", {将来|jiāng lái} "in the future".

questions.stem: What does "{他|tā}{学|xué}{了|le}{半|bàn}{年|nián}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{竟然|jìng rán}{能|néng}{看|kàn}{中文|Zhōng wén}{小说|xiǎo shuō}{了|le}。" tell you about the speaker?
choices: The speaker is surprised: they didn't expect it.
questions.explanation: {竟然|jìng rán} marks something the speaker didn't expect: after only six months he can already read novels in Chinese.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {他|tā}{很|hěn}{聪明|cōng ming}，___ {考|kǎo}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
questions.explanation: Being clever isn't an event that led him to do something: it's a reason, and its result takes {所以|suǒ yǐ}. {于是|yú shì} joins two events in a story ({钱包|qián bāo}{找不到|zhǎo bu dào}{了|le}，{于是|yú shì}{我们|wǒ men}{给|gěi}{警察|jǐng chá}{打|dǎ}{了|le}{电话|diàn huà}). {接着|jiē zhe} is "then", {从此|cóng cǐ} "from then on".

questions.stem: Choose the word: ___ {我们|wǒ men}{到|dào}{车站|chē zhàn}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{车|chē}{已经|yǐ jīng}{开|kāi}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 (By the time we got to the station, the train had gone.)
questions.explanation: {等到|děng dào} + an event + {的|de}{时候|shí hou}: by the time. {从此|cóng cǐ} is "from then on", {接着|jiē zhe} "then, next", {最终|zuì zhōng} "in the end".

questions.stem: Choose the word: {他|tā}{工作|gōng zuò}{了|le}{十|shí}{年|nián}，{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}___。 (He's worked for ten years and is very experienced.)
questions.explanation: Experience as know-how is {经验|jīng yàn} (lesson 12): {很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{经验|jīng yàn}. {经历|jīng lì} is what happened to you ({一|yí}{次|cì}{难忘|nán wàng}{的|de}{经历|jīng lì}), {回忆|huí yì} a memory, {印象|yìn xiàng} an impression.

questions.stem: Read: "{我|wǒ}{当时|dāng shí}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{还|hái}{不|bú}{太|tài}{好|hǎo}，{不|bù}{敢|gǎn}{跟|gēn}{别人|bié ren}{说话|shuō huà}，{只好|zhǐ hǎo}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{看|kàn}{手机|shǒu jī}。{忽然|hū rán}，{对面|duì miàn}{的|de}{一|yí}{位|wèi}{老人|lǎo rén}{问|wèn}{我|wǒ}：“{小伙子|xiǎo huǒ zi}，{你|nǐ}{是|shì}{哪|nǎ}{国|guó}{人|rén}？”" ({小伙子|xiǎo huǒ zi}: young man) Why didn't the writer talk to anyone at first?
choices: The writer's Chinese wasn't good and they didn't dare.
The writer didn't like the other passengers.
questions.explanation: {汉语|Hàn yǔ}{还|hái}{不|bú}{太|tài}{好|hǎo} (Chinese not very good yet), {不|bù}{敢|gǎn}{跟|gēn}{别人|bié ren}{说话|shuō huà} (didn't dare talk to people), so they looked at their phone alone ({只好|zhǐ hǎo}).

questions.stem: A traveller ends a story: "{最终|zuì zhōng}，{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{西安|Xī'ān}{玩|wán}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}，{参观|cān guān}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{景点|jǐng diǎn}，{可是|kě shì}{最|zuì}{难忘|nán wàng}{的|de}{仍然|réng rán}{是|shì}{火车|huǒ chē}{上|shàng}{的|de}{那个|nà ge}{夜晚|yè wǎn}。" What mattered most to the writer?
questions.explanation: {最|zuì}{难忘|nán wàng}{的|de}{仍然|réng rán}{是|shì}{火车|huǒ chē}{上|shàng}{的|de}{那个|nà ge}{夜晚|yè wǎn}: even after a week of sights, the unforgettable thing is still ({仍然|réng rán}) the night on the train.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {忽然|hū rán} hū rán (suddenly): a high level tone, then a rising one, 1+2.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {印象|yìn xiàng} yìn xiàng (an impression): two falling tones, 4+4.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? ___ {然|rán} (suddenly)
questions.explanation: {忽然|hū rán} hū rán: {={忽|hū} is {勿|wù} over {心|xīn}. {勿|wù} alone has no {心|xīn}; {匆|cōng} (cōng, hurried) has an extra dot inside; {急|jí} (in a hurry) has {心|xīn} too, but another top.=}

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {承德|Chéng dé}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{留下|liú xià}{了|le}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{印|yìn}___。 (Chengde made a very good impression on me.)
questions.explanation: {印象|yìn xiàng} yìn xiàng. {=Write {象|xiàng} without 亻: {像|xiàng} (with 亻) is "to be like" ({好像|hǎo xiàng}). The bottom of {象|xiàng} has four left-falling strokes and a long right-falling one.=}

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: By the time we got to the station, the train had already left.
questions.explanation: {等到|děng dào}{我们|wǒ men}{到|dào}{车站|chē zhàn}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{车|chē}{已经|yǐ jīng}{开|kāi}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 {等到|děng dào} + the event, then what was already true. {从此|cóng cǐ} (from then on) doesn't fit.

questions.stem: Listen. Where was the wallet?

audio.text: 我一拿起外套，钱包竟然从帽子里掉了出来！

choices: in the hood of the coat
questions.explanation: {钱包|qián bāo}…{从|cóng}{帽子|mào zi}{里|lǐ}{掉|diào}{了|le}{出来|chū lái}: the wallet fell out of the hood ({帽子|mào zi}, here the hood of the coat) when the speaker picked up the coat. {竟然|jìng rán}: to the speaker's surprise.

questions.stem: Listen. Why does the speaker say "{真|zhēn}{巧|qiǎo}"?

audio.text: 真巧！我儿子就在英国工作，就在你家乡那个城市。

choices: The speaker is good with their hands.
The speaker is going to Britain.
questions.explanation: {真|zhēn}{巧|qiǎo} is "what a coincidence": the speaker's son works in Britain, in the very city the listener comes from. ({巧|qiǎo} also means "skilful", but not here.)

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker mean?

audio.text: 这么简单的问题，难道你也不会吗？

choices: The speaker can't answer it either.
The question is easy: you should be able to answer it.
The speaker wants to know if you can answer it.
questions.explanation: A rhetorical {难道|nán dào}…{吗|ma} with a negative means a positive: surely you can answer something this easy. It isn't a real question.

questions.stem: Listen. What has the speaker done ever since?

audio.text: 从此，我出门都把钱包装在背包里。

choices: kept the wallet in a backpack when going out
kept the wallet in a coat pocket
questions.explanation: {从此|cóng cǐ} (ever since), {出门|chū mén}{都|dōu}{把|bǎ}{钱包|qián bāo}{装|zhuāng}{在|zài}{背包|bēi bāo}{里|lǐ}: whenever going out, the speaker puts the wallet in the backpack.

questions.stem: Choose the clause for the gap: {我|wǒ}{以为|yǐ wéi}{钱包|qián bāo}{叫|jiào}{人|rén}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}{了|le}，___，{我|wǒ}{真|zhēn}{不好意思|bù hǎo yì si}。
choices: {从此|cóng cǐ}{我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{钱包|qián bāo}{丢|diū}{了|le}
{原来|yuán lái}{是|shì}{掉|diào}{进|jìn}{了|le}{外套|wài tào}{的|de}{帽子|mào zi}{里|lǐ}
questions.explanation: {原来|yuán lái} reveals what had really happened: the wallet had only fallen into the hood of the speaker's coat, hence the embarrassment ({不好意思|bù hǎo yì si}). The other clauses don't follow from "I thought it had been taken".

The writer didn't know the hotel's number.

The hotel was run by her family, and her mother had mentioned a foreign guest.
She worked at the shop next to the hotel.
She had seen the writer at the station.

glad: it was a lucky chance that brought a lasting friendship
questions.explanation: {要是|yào shi}{那|nà}{天|tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{没有|méi yǒu}{迷路|mí lù}，{就|jiù}{不|bú}{会|huì}{认识|rèn shi}{她们|tā men}{了|le}。{这|zhè}{真|zhēn}{是|shì}{太|tài}{巧|qiǎo}{了|le}: had it not happened, the writer would never have met them; what a coincidence. The friendship lasts: a call every Spring Festival ({从此|cóng cǐ}, from then on).

questions.stem: Why are the earth buildings of Fujian called {土楼|tǔ lóu}?
choices: Their walls are made of earth.
They are the colour of earth.
questions.explanation: {土楼|tǔ lóu}{的|de}{墙|qiáng}{是|shì}{用|yòng}{土|tǔ}{做|zuò}{的|de}: the walls are of rammed earth, more than a metre thick at the bottom in some.

questions.stem: Read: "{土楼|tǔ lóu}{有|yǒu}{圆|yuán}{的|de}，{也|yě}{有|yǒu}{方|fāng}{的|de}。" What does it say about their shape?
choices: Some are round and some are square.
questions.explanation: {有|yǒu}{圆|yuán}{的|de}，{也|yě}{有|yǒu}{方|fāng}{的|de}: there are round ones and square ones (and, the lesson adds, other shapes too).

questions.stem: How high is a big tulou usually?
questions.explanation: {一|yí}{座|zuò}{大|dà}{土楼|tǔ lóu}{一般|yì bān}{有|yǒu}{三|sān}{到|dào}{五|wǔ}{层|céng}: three to five storeys, round a courtyard.

questions.stem: Read: "{一|yí}{座|zuò}{土楼|tǔ lóu}{里|lǐ}{住|zhù}{的|de}{往往|wǎng wǎng}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{大|dà}{家族|jiā zú}，{人|rén}{多|duō}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{可以|kě yǐ}{住|zhù}{几|jǐ}{百|bǎi}{个|gè}{人|rén}。" ({家族|jiā zú}: a clan) Who lived in a tulou?
choices: a whole clan, sometimes hundreds of people
questions.explanation: {往往|wǎng wǎng}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{大|dà}{家族|jiā zú}: usually one big clan, up to several hundred people.

questions.stem: In the famous {承启楼|Chéng qǐ Lóu}, what was on the ground floor ({一|yī}{楼|lóu})?
questions.explanation: {一|yī}{楼|lóu}{是|shì}{厨房|chú fáng}，{二|èr}{楼|lóu}{放|fàng}{粮食|liáng shi}，{三|sān}{楼|lóu}{和|hé}{四|sì}{楼|lóu}{是|shì}{卧室|wò shì}: kitchens on the ground floor, grain ({粮食|liáng shi}) above, bedrooms ({卧室|wò shì}) at the top.

questions.stem: A tulou has thick walls, usually only one main gate and few windows on the outside, and grain was stored inside. What was all this for?
choices: to keep out the summer heat only
to make the building look beautiful
to keep the people inside safe
questions.explanation: {土楼|tǔ lóu}{既|jì}{能|néng}{住|zhù}{人|rén}，{又|yòu}{能|néng}{保护|bǎo hù}{一|yì}{家人|jiā rén}{的|de}{安全|ān quán}: a home and a stronghold at once. With one gate and stores inside, a clan could shut its door in troubled times.

questions.stem: Who built the tulou, as the lesson describes it?
choices: the Hakka and the Minnan people
questions.explanation: {建|jiàn}{土楼|tǔ lóu}{的|de}{主要|zhǔ yào}{是|shì}{客家人|Kè jiā rén}{和|hé}{闽南人|Mǐn nán rén}. They were long called "Hakka houses", but research since the 1980s has shown that the Minnan people built them too.

questions.stem: When did 46 Fujian tulou become a World Heritage site?
questions.explanation: 2008{年|nián}，{四十六|sì shí liù}{座|zuò}{福建|Fú jiàn}{土楼|tǔ lóu}{一起|yì qǐ}{成为|chéng wéi}{了|le}{世界|shì jiè}{文化|wén huà}{遗产|yí chǎn}. (1994 is Chengde's Mountain Resort, lesson 18.)

questions.stem: What is the {祖堂|zǔ táng} in the middle of a tulou's courtyard?
questions.explanation: {祖堂|zǔ táng} is an ancestral hall: {家族|jiā zú}{的|de}{人|rén}{在|zài}{这里|zhè lǐ}{祭拜|jì bài}{祖先|zǔ xiān} (the clan honours its ancestors there), and festivals are celebrated there too.

questions.stem: Visitors say: "{站|zhàn}{在|zài}{圆楼|yuán lóu}{的|de}{院子|yuàn zi}{里|lǐ}，{抬头|tái tóu}{只能|zhǐ néng}{看|kàn}{到|dào}{一|yí}{片|piàn}{圆圆|yuán yuán}{的|de}{天空|tiān kōng}。" ({天空|tiān kōng}: the sky) What does this tell you about a round tulou?
choices: It has no roof at all.
The building closes in a ring all round the courtyard.
The courtyard is outside the walls.
You can see the hills from the courtyard.
questions.explanation: Looking up, you see only a round patch of sky: the ring of the building surrounds the courtyard on every side. ({片|piàn} here is lesson 27's measure word, "a patch".)

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker say about the shape of the tulou?

audio.text: 土楼有圆的，也有方的。

choices: They are built in a line.
questions.explanation: {有|yǒu}{圆|yuán}{的|de}，{也|yě}{有|yǒu}{方|fāng}{的|de}: some are round, some square.

questions.stem: Listen. How many people could live in a big tulou?

audio.text: 一座大土楼可以住几百个人。

questions.explanation: {几|jǐ}{百|bǎi}{个|gè}{人|rén}: several hundred people.

questions.stem: What is a {方言|fāng yán}?
choices: a regional variety of spoken Chinese, a dialect
questions.explanation: {方言|fāng yán} is a dialect (HSK 6's word): the regional spoken varieties of Chinese, such as Cantonese or Shanghainese.

questions.stem: In the widely used classification, how many main groups of dialects are there?
questions.explanation: {一般|yì bān}{认为|rèn wéi}…{可以|kě yǐ}{分为|fēn wéi}{七大类|qī dà lèi}: seven groups (Mandarin, Wu, Yue, Min, Hakka, Xiang and Gan). The Language Atlas of China counts ten, adding Jin, Hui and Pinghua.

questions.stem: Which group of dialects has by far the most speakers?
questions.explanation: {说|shuō}{官话|guān huà}{的|de}{人|rén}{最|zuì}{多|duō}: Mandarin, spoken from the northeast to the southwest. Beijing speech is one kind of Mandarin.

questions.stem: Where is {吴语|Wú yǔ} (Wu) mainly spoken?
choices: in Shanghai and the area around it
questions.explanation: Wu is the group of Shanghai, most of Zhejiang and southern Jiangsu ({上海|Shàng hǎi}{一带|yí dài}{的|de}{吴语|Wú yǔ}). Guangdong is Yue's area and Hunan Xiang's.

questions.stem: Read: "{普通话|pǔ tōng huà}{的|de}{发音|fā yīn}{是|shì}{按照|àn zhào}{北京|Běi jīng}{话|huà}{定|dìng}{的|de}，{词语|cí yǔ}{主要|zhǔ yào}{来自|lái zì}{北方话|běi fāng huà}。" ({发音|fā yīn}: pronunciation) What is the pronunciation of {普通话|pǔ tōng huà} based on?
questions.explanation: {按照|àn zhào}{北京|Běi jīng}{话|huà}{定|dìng}{的|de}: fixed according to Beijing speech; the words come mainly from the northern (Mandarin) dialects.

questions.stem: In which year did a State Council directive describe the standard of {普通话|pǔ tōng huà} (Beijing pronunciation, northern dialects as the base, modern written works for grammar)?
questions.explanation: The directive of 6 February 1956 set out that definition. (1980 is roughly when a revised dialectology handbook made the seven groups the usual scheme.)

questions.stem: Two people from different dialect areas can't understand each other's speech. Why can they often still communicate in writing?
choices: Each dialect has its own alphabet.
They write basically the same characters, which keep their meaning.
questions.explanation: {各地|gè dì}{的|de}{人|rén}{写|xiě}{的|de}{汉字|hàn zì}{基本上|jī běn shang}{是|shì}{一样|yí yàng}{的|de}: a character sounds different in each dialect, but its meaning is usually the same ({意思|yì si}{却|què}{往往|wǎng wǎng}{一样|yí yàng}).

questions.stem: Cantonese says {食饭|shí fàn} for "to eat (a meal)". What does Mandarin say?
questions.explanation: Mandarin {吃|chī}{饭|fàn}. {食|shí} is the old word for eating, kept in Cantonese. {做饭|zuò fàn} is to cook, {米饭|mǐ fàn} is rice, and {饭店|fàn diàn} a restaurant or hotel.

questions.stem: In Shanghainese, {侬好|nóng hǎo} is a greeting. What does {侬|nóng} mean?
questions.explanation: {侬|nóng} is "you" in Shanghainese (Mandarin {你|nǐ}), so {侬好|nóng hǎo} is "hello". {阿拉|ā lā} is "we".

questions.stem: Read: "{现在|xiàn zài}，{随着|suí zhe}{普通话|pǔ tōng huà}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{普及|pǔ jí}，{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{既|jì}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{普通话|pǔ tōng huà}，{又|yòu}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{家乡话|jiā xiāng huà}。" ({普及|pǔ jí}: widespread; {家乡话|jiā xiāng huà}: home dialect) What does this tell you about many people today?
choices: They speak both Putonghua and their home dialect.
questions.explanation: {既|jì}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{普通话|pǔ tōng huà}，{又|yòu}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{家乡话|jiā xiāng huà}: they speak both. {随着|suí zhe}{普通话|pǔ tōng huà}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{普及|pǔ jí}: as Putonghua becomes more widespread.

questions.stem: Listen. What might happen?

audio.text: 一个广州人和一个上海人如果都说自己的方言，可能互相听不懂。

choices: They may not understand each other.
They will understand each other easily.
questions.explanation: {如果|rú guǒ}{都|dōu}{说|shuō}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{方言|fāng yán}，{可能|kě néng}{互相|hù xiāng}{听不懂|tīng bu dǒng}: if each speaks their own dialect, they may not understand each other.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker say about characters?

audio.text: 各地的人写的汉字基本上是一样的。

choices: Every area has its own characters.
People everywhere write basically the same characters.
Characters are read the same everywhere.
questions.explanation: {各地|gè dì}{的|de}{人|rén}{写|xiě}{的|de}{汉字|hàn zì}{基本上|jī běn shang}{是|shì}{一样|yí yàng}{的|de}: the characters are basically the same everywhere (though they're read differently).

questions.stem: Which sentence means "She is one of my best friends"?
choices: {她|tā}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{最|zuì}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{朋友|péng you}{之|zhī}{一|yī}。
{她|tā}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{最|zuì}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{之|zhī}{一|yì}{朋友|péng you}。
{她|tā}{是|shì}{之|zhī}{一|yì}{我|wǒ}{最|zuì}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{朋友|péng you}。
{她|tā}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{之|zhī}{一|yí}{最|zuì}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{朋友|péng you}。
questions.explanation: {之|zhī}{一|yī} (one of) comes last, after the whole group: {我|wǒ}{最|zuì}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{朋友|péng you}{之|zhī}{一|yī}. English puts "one of" first, which is why learners move {之|zhī}{一|yī} forward.

questions.stem: A school form asks for your parents' names. Which word does the form use for "father"?
questions.explanation: {父亲|fù qīn} (and {母亲|mǔ qīn}, {父母|fù mǔ}) are the formal words used on forms, in writing and in speeches. {爸爸|bà ba} is what you say at home; {爸|bà} and {老|lǎo}{爸|bà} are even more casual.

questions.stem: In the sentence "{他|tā}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{英语|Yīng yǔ}、{法语|Fǎ yǔ}、{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{等|děng}。" ({法语|Fǎ yǔ}: French), what does {等|děng} tell you?
choices: He is waiting to speak these languages.
He speaks these three languages equally well.
He also speaks other languages: the list goes on.
He speaks exactly these three languages.
questions.explanation: After a list, {等|děng} is the written "and so on, etc.": he speaks these and others. It's the same character as {等|děng} "to wait" (HSK 2), but here it closes a list. With a number after it ({等|děng}{三|sān}{种|zhǒng}{语言|yǔ yán}) it would sum up a complete list.

questions.stem: Read: "{我|wǒ}{去|qù}{过|guo}{北京|Běi jīng}、{上海|Shàng hǎi}、{西安|Xī'ān}{等|děng}{三|sān}{个|gè}{城市|chéng shì}。" How many cities has the speaker been to?
questions.explanation: {等|děng} + a number + a noun sums up a complete list: {北京|Běi jīng}、{上海|Shàng hǎi}、{西安|Xī''ān}{等|děng}{三|sān}{个|gè}{城市|chéng shì} is "three cities: Beijing, Shanghai and Xi'an". Without the number ({北京|Běi jīng}、{上海|Shàng hǎi}、{西安|Xī''ān}{等|děng}{城市|chéng shì}), the list could go on.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: {俩|liǎ} already means "two" with the measure word built in, so no {个|gè} follows it: {我们|wǒ men}{俩|liǎ} (or {我们|wǒ men}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}). {两|liǎng} can't stand without a measure word, and {们|men} doesn't follow {俩|liǎ}.

questions.stem: Your daughter's son is your ___.
questions.explanation: A daughter's children are {外孙|wài sūn} (grandson) and {外孙女|wài sūn nǚ} (granddaughter); a son's children are {孙子|sūn zi} and {孙女|sūn nǚ}. The {外|wài} ("outside") is the same as in {外公|wài gōng} and {外婆|wài pó}, the mother's parents.

questions.stem: How is the first character of 少年 (a teenager) read?
questions.explanation: In {少年|shào nián} the first character is shào, fourth tone: {少年|shào nián}. The same character is shǎo, third tone, when it means "few" ({很|hěn}{少|shǎo}).

questions.stem: Which character completes {家|jiā}___ (a family, a household)?
questions.explanation: {家庭|jiā tíng} is written with {庭|tíng} ({广|guǎng} + {廷|tíng}). {={廷|tíng} is only the inner part; {停|tíng} (to stop) has 亻 and {亭|tíng}; {挺|tǐng} (quite) has 扌 + {廷|tíng}.=} All four share a sound, which is why they're easy to mix up.

questions.stem: Type the spoken word for "the two of us": {我们|wǒ men}___ (characters or pinyin with tone marks)
questions.explanation: {我们|wǒ men}{俩|liǎ} wǒ men liǎ. {俩|liǎ} is a handwriting character: 亻 + {两|liǎng}, "two people".

questions.stem: Build the sentence.
questions.prompt: The Great Wall is one of the most famous places in China.
questions.explanation: {长城|Cháng chéng}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{最|zuì}{有名|yǒu míng}{的|de}{地方|dì fang}{之|zhī}{一|yī}。 {之|zhī}{一|yī} goes after the whole group ({中国|Zhōng guó}{最|zuì}{有名|yǒu míng}{的|de}{地方|dì fang}). The order with {长城|Cháng chéng} at the end ({中国|Zhōng guó}{最|zuì}{有名|yǒu míng}{的|de}{地方|dì fang}{之|zhī}{一|yī}{是|shì}{长城|Cháng chéng}) is also correct.

questions.stem: Read: "{我|wǒ}{的|de}{老家|lǎo jiā}{在|zài}{南方|nán fāng}，{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{那里|nà lǐ}{过|guò}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{快乐|kuài lè}{的|de}{童年|tóng nián}。{上|shàng}{大学|dà xué}___，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}{回去|huí qù}{了|le}。" Which word fits the gap?
questions.explanation: {上|shàng}{大学|dà xué}{之后|zhī hòu} (after starting university), {就|jiù}{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}{回去|huí qù}{了|le} (I hardly ever went back). {之后|zhī hòu} follows the event it's measured from, like {以后|yǐ hòu}.

questions.stem: Read the notice: "{重阳节|Chóng yáng jié}{聚会|jù huì}{通知|tōng zhī}：{为了|wèi le}{让|ràng}{社区|shè qū}{的|de}{老年|lǎo nián}{人|rén}{过|guò}{一|yí}{个|gè}{热闹|rè nao}{的|de}{节日|jié rì}，{本|běn}{社区|shè qū}{将|jiāng}{于|yú}{十|shí}{月|yuè}{十一|shí yī}{日|rì}{下午|xià wǔ}{两|liǎng}{点|diǎn}{在|zài}{社区|shè qū}{活动中心|huó dòng zhōng xīn}{举办|jǔ bàn}{重阳节|Chóng yáng jié}{聚会|jù huì}。{欢迎|huān yíng}{六十|liù shí}{岁|suì}{以上|yǐ shàng}{的|de}{老人|lǎo rén}{参加|cān jiā}，{也|yě}{欢迎|huān yíng}{家长|jiā zhǎng}{带|dài}{孩子|hái zi}{来|lái}，{陪|péi}{老人|lǎo rén}{们|men}{一起|yì qǐ}{过节|guò jié}。{聚会|jù huì}{上|shàng}{有|yǒu}{唱|chàng}{歌|gē}、{跳舞|tiào wǔ}、{讲|jiǎng}{故事|gù shi}{等|děng}{节目|jié mù}，{社区|shè qū}{还|hái}{会|huì}{为|wèi}{每|měi}{位|wèi}{老人|lǎo rén}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{一|yí}{份|fèn}{小|xiǎo}{礼物|lǐ wù}。{参加|cān jiā}{的|de}{老人|lǎo rén}{请|qǐng}{在|zài}{十|shí}{月|yuè}{八|bā}{日|rì}{之前|zhī qián}{到|dào}{社区|shè qū}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}{报名|bào míng}，{也|yě}{可以|kě yǐ}{给|gěi}{工作人员|gōng zuò rén yuán}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}。{如果|rú guǒ}{您|nín}{需要|xū yào}{别人|bié ren}{陪|péi}{您|nín}{来|lái}，{请|qǐng}{提前|tí qián}{告诉|gào su}{我们|wǒ men}。{新城|Xīn chéng}{社区|shè qū}" ({重阳节|Chóng yáng jié}: the Double Ninth Festival, a day for honouring the elderly; {社区|shè qū}: a community; {活动中心|huó dòng zhōng xīn}: an activity centre) Who is the gathering mainly for?
questions.explanation: {欢迎|huān yíng}{六十|liù shí}{岁|suì}{以上|yǐ shàng}{的|de}{老人|lǎo rén}{参加|cān jiā}: people over sixty are invited, and the notice opens with {为了|wèi le}{让|ràng}{社区|shè qū}{的|de}{老年|lǎo nián}{人|rén}{过|guò}{一|yí}{个|gè}{热闹|rè nao}{的|de}{节日|jié rì} (so that the community's elderly have a lively festival). Families with children are welcome too, but to keep the old people company.

choices: buy a ticket at the activity centre
bring a small present for the others
sign up by 8 October, at the office or by phone

The community gives the presents ({社区|shè qū}{还|hái}{会|huì}{为|wèi}{每|měi}{位|wèi}{老人|lǎo rén}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{一|yí}{份|fèn}{小|xiǎo}{礼物|lǐ wù}), and coming with someone is only an option.

questions.stem: Listen. Who is going back to the home town next weekend?

audio.text: 下个周末，我们父子俩要回老家看爷爷。

questions.explanation: {我们|wǒ men}{父子|fù zǐ}{俩|liǎ}: the two of us, father and son. They're going to see {爷爷|yé ye}, who for the son is his grandfather. {兄弟|xiōng dì} would be brothers, {母女|mǔ nǚ} mother and daughter.

questions.stem: Listen. What was it like at home?

audio.text: 今天来了三十多个亲戚，家里特别热闹。

choices: quiet: only a few relatives came
sad: the relatives had to leave early
tiring: the speaker cooked for everyone
questions.explanation: {三十|sān shí}{多|duō}{个|gè}{亲戚|qīn qi} (over thirty relatives) and {特别|tè bié}{热闹|rè nao} (very lively). {热闹|rè nao} is a good thing: full of people and cheerful noise.

questions.stem: Listen. What did Grandma do?

audio.text: 春节的时候，奶奶给每个孙子孙女都包了一个红包。

choices: She cooked for each of her grandchildren.
She bought each grandchild a present.
She gave each of her grandchildren a red envelope.
questions.explanation: {给|gěi}{每|měi}{个|gè}{孙子|sūn zi}{孙女|sūn nǚ}{都|dōu}{包|bāo}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{红包|hóng bāo}: she filled a red envelope (with money) for every grandson and granddaughter. {包|bāo}{红包|hóng bāo} is to fill one, {红包|hóng bāo} the envelope itself.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker's main point?

audio.text: 现在很多年轻人在大城市工作，一年只回一两次家乡。父母老了，常常一个人在家。我觉得，再忙也应该常回家看看。

choices: Young people should move back to their home towns.
Big cities are better places to work.
Parents should move to the big cities.
However busy you are, you should go home often to see your parents.
questions.explanation: The last sentence is the point: {再|zài}{忙|máng}{也|yě}{应该|yīng gāi}{常|cháng}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{看看|kàn kan} (however busy you are, you should go home often). The first sentences describe the situation (young people work far away; parents are often alone).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {童年|tóng nián}, childhood: two rising tones, 2+2.

questions.stem: Which phrase best describes an office where everyone is chatting and laughing?
questions.explanation: {有说有笑|yǒu shuō yǒu xiào} ({有|yǒu}A{有|yǒu}B: having both) is "chatting and laughing". {无忧无虑|wú yōu wú lǜ} is carefree, {一心一意|yì xīn yí yì} wholehearted, {无声无息|wú shēng wú xī} silent, without a trace.

questions.stem: Choose the phrase for the gap: "{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}，{我|wǒ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{都|dōu}{过|guò}{得|de}___，{什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{不用|bú yòng}{担心|dān xīn}。"
questions.explanation: {无忧无虑|wú yōu wú lǜ} ({无|wú}A{无|wú}B: no worries, no cares) fits {什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{不用|bú yòng}{担心|dān xīn} (nothing to worry about). {有说有笑|yǒu shuō yǒu xiào} describes a group chatting, {一言一行|yì yán yì xíng} every word and deed, {有山有水|yǒu shān yǒu shuǐ} a scenic place.

questions.stem: Your friend, who is also your manager, says: "{工作|gōng zuò}{是|shì}{工作|gōng zuò}，{朋友|péng you}{是|shì}{朋友|péng you}。" What does your friend mean?
choices: We can't be friends any more.
Work is more important than friends.
Our friendship doesn't change what the work needs.
questions.explanation: X {是|shì} X，Y {是|shì} Y keeps two things apart: being friends doesn't mean the work gets done differently. It says nothing about ending the friendship.

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: "{她|tā}{很|hěn}___，{从来|cóng lái}{不|bù}{写|xiě}{错|cuò}{字|zì}。"
questions.explanation: {细心|xì xīn} (careful, attentive to detail) goes with {从来|cóng lái}{不|bù}{写|xiě}{错|cuò}{字|zì} (never writes a character wrong). {粗心|cū xīn} is its opposite; {随便|suí biàn} is casual, {害羞|hài xiū} shy.

questions.stem: Which sentence says "I'm proud of you"?
questions.explanation: {为|wèi} + person + {感到|gǎn dào}{骄傲|jiāo ào} (or {为|wèi}{你|nǐ}{骄傲|jiāo ào}) is "proud of". {骄傲|jiāo ào} takes no object directly, so {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{骄傲|jiāo ào}{你|nǐ} is wrong. Describing a person, {他|tā}{很|hěn}{骄傲|jiāo ào} means he's arrogant.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: {很|hěn} goes before {有|yǒu}: {很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{耐心|nài xīn} (very patient). {他|tā}{很|hěn}{耐心|nài xīn} is right too. {很|hěn} can't come after {有|yǒu} here.

questions.stem: You knock a cup off a table by accident. What do you say?
choices: {没关系|méi guān xi}，{我|wǒ}{不|bú}{是|shì}{故意|gù yì}{的|de}。
{对不起|duì bu qǐ}，{我|wǒ}{是|shì}{故意|gù yì}{的|de}。
{对不起|duì bu qǐ}，{我|wǒ}{不|bú}{是|shì}{故意|gù yì}{的|de}。
{对不起|duì bu qǐ}，{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{随便|suí biàn}。
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{不|bú}{是|shì}{故意|gù yì}{的|de}: I didn't mean to ({故意|gù yì}: on purpose). {没关系|méi guān xi} is what the other person says to you; {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{随便|suí biàn} would mean "I'm careless, casual".

questions.stem: A friend asks "{你|nǐ}{想|xiǎng}{吃|chī}{什么|shén me}？" and you answer "{随便|suí biàn}。" What have you said?
questions.explanation: {随便|suí biàn} here is "as you like, anything". Between friends it's fine; with a host, {什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ} sounds more polite, since a bare {随便|suí biàn} can seem as if you don't care.

questions.stem: What does {重要性|zhòng yào xìng} mean?
questions.explanation: The suffix {性|xìng} makes a noun for a quality: {重要|zhòng yào} (important) + {性|xìng} = importance. Likewise {积极性|jī jí xìng} (enthusiasm), {可能性|kě néng xìng} (possibility).

questions.stem: Which character completes ___ {度|dù} (attitude)?
questions.explanation: {态度|tài du} is written with {态|tài}, the handwriting character of this lesson. {={态|tài} is {太|tài} over {心|xīn}: {太|tài} gives the sound tài, {心|xīn} the meaning (a state of mind).=}

questions.stem: Type the word: "attitude" = ___ {度|dù} (the first character, or the whole word in pinyin with tone marks)
questions.explanation: {态度|tài du}: attitude. {态|tài} tài is a handwriting character; {度|dù} is light in this word.

questions.stem: Build the sentence.

choices: Each of them is different, and the writer needn't try to be someone else.

questions.stem: Which word fits a written report? "{这个|zhè ge}{好|hǎo}{消息|xiāo xi}___ {大家|dà jiā}{非常|fēi cháng}{激动|jī dòng}。" ({消息|xiāo xi}: news)
questions.explanation: {使|shǐ} + person + feeling is the written way to say "made (someone feel)"; in speech you'd say {让|ràng}. {对|duì}, {给|gěi} and {被|bèi} don't make a cause here: {被|bèi} would make everyone the receiver of the news's action.

questions.stem: Which sentence uses {使|shǐ} wrongly?
choices: {他|tā}{的话|de huà}{使|shǐ}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{感动|gǎn dòng}。
{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{使|shǐ}{大家|dà jiā}{很|hěn}{失望|shī wàng}。
{经常|jīng cháng}{锻炼|duàn liàn}{可以|kě yǐ}{使|shǐ}{人|rén}{心情|xīn qíng}{愉快|yú kuài}。
questions.explanation: {使|shǐ} only means "to cause" a feeling or a change. "Mum asked me to go and buy food" needs {让|ràng} (or {叫|jiào}): {妈妈|mā ma}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{去|qù}{买|mǎi}{菜|cài}. The other three are correct written sentences.

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: "{这个|zhè ge}{电影|diàn yǐng}{非常|fēi cháng}___，{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{看|kàn}{了|le}{都|dōu}{哭|kū}{了|le}。"
questions.explanation: {感人|gǎn rén} (moving, touching) describes the film. {感动|gǎn dòng} is how the viewers feel ({他们|tā men}{很|hěn}{感动|gǎn dòng}); {激动|jī dòng} and {兴奋|xīng fèn} are excited, not touching.

questions.stem: Your team played well but lost the final by one point. Which do you say?
questions.explanation: {可惜|kě xī} (what a pity) is for bad luck. {无聊|wú liáo} is boring, {羡慕|xiàn mù} to envy, {得意|dé yì} pleased with yourself. For your own mistake you'd use {后悔|hòu huǐ} (to regret) with what you regret: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{后悔|hòu huǐ}{没|méi}{早|zǎo}{点儿|diǎnr}{出门|chū mén}.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I'm never going to that restaurant again"?
choices: {那|nà}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{我|wǒ}{再也|zài yě}{不|bú}{去|qù}{了|le}。
{那|nà}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{我|wǒ}{再也|zài yě}{没|méi}{去|qù}{过|guo}。
questions.explanation: {再也|zài yě}{不|bù} + verb (+ {了|le}) is "never again" from now on. {再也|zài yě}{没|méi}{去|qù}{过|guo} is about the past: "I never went there again", not a decision about the future. The other two orders are wrong.

questions.stem: What does "{这个|zhè ge}{字|zì}{我|wǒ}{怎么|zěn me}{也|yě}{记不住|jì bu zhù}。" mean?
choices: How do I remember this character?
However hard I try, I can't remember this character.
I never want to remember this character.
questions.explanation: {怎么|zěn me}{也|yě} / {怎么|zěn me}{都|dōu} + a negative: "however hard you try, it won't happen". {记不住|jì bu zhù} (can't remember) is the potential complement it goes with.

questions.stem: Your friend, who was late yesterday, complains that you are late. You say: "{还|hái}{说|shuō}{呢|ne}！{你|nǐ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{也|yě}{迟到|chí dào}{了|le}。" What do you mean?
questions.explanation: {还|hái}{说|shuō}{呢|ne} ({还|hái} X {呢|ne}) answers a complaint by pointing out that the other person is no better: "you're one to talk". Context gives the tone: here, teasing.

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: "{天气|tiān qì}{太|tài}{热|rè}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}___ {了|le}！"
questions.explanation: {受不了|shòu bu liǎo}{了|le}: I can't stand it any more. {受不了|shòu bu liǎo} (shòu bu liǎo) is the potential complement "can't bear"; {受得了|shòu de liǎo} (can bear) is used mostly in questions ({你|nǐ}{受得了|shòu de liǎo}{吗|ma}？).

questions.stem: Which sentence is about losing something you had, such as a chance?
choices: {他|tā}{失去|shī qù}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{机会|jī huì}。
questions.explanation: {失去|shī qù} is for losing something abstract or for good: {失去|shī qù}{机会|jī huì} (to lose a chance), {失去|shī qù}{信心|xìn xīn}. A lost object is {丢|diū} ({钥匙|yào shi}{丢|diū}{了|le}); losing a match is {输|shū}.

questions.stem: Which character completes ___ {远|yuǎn} (forever)?

questions.explanation: {永|yǒng}, the handwriting character of this lesson: five strokes, dot first.

questions.stem: Which sentence is wrong?
choices: {对于|duì yú}{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}，{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{看法|kàn fǎ}{不|bù}{一样|yí yàng}。
{对|duì}{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}，{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{看法|kàn fǎ}{不|bù}{一样|yí yàng}。
questions.explanation: An attitude towards a person takes {对|duì}: {他|tā}{对|duì}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}. {对于|duì yú} introduces a topic ({对于|duì yú}{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}), and {对|duì} can do that too. ({看法|kàn fǎ}: a view, lesson 25.)

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: "{我们|wǒ men}{都|dōu}___ {这个|zhè ge}{电视剧|diàn shì jù}{很|hěn}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}。"
questions.explanation: After an adverb such as {都|dōu}, use {对|duì}, not {对于|duì yú}: {我们|wǒ men}{都|dōu}{对|duì}{这个|zhè ge}{电视剧|diàn shì jù}{很|hěn}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}. {对|duì}…{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù} is "interested in". {与|yǔ} and {向|xiàng} don't fit {感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}.

questions.stem: In a newspaper headline, which word is the usual "and"? "{网购|wǎng gòu}___ {环保|huán bǎo}"
questions.explanation: {与|yǔ} is the written "and", usual in headlines and titles (《{老人|Lǎo rén}{与|yǔ}{海|Hǎi}》, The Old Man and the Sea); its spoken partners are {和|hé} and {跟|gēn}. {在|zài}, {还|hái} and {又|yòu} don't join two nouns. ({环保|huán bǎo}: environmental protection, lesson 28.)

questions.stem: What does {而|ér} do in "{南方|nán fāng}{的|de}{冬天|dōng tiān}{很|hěn}{暖和|nuǎn huo}，{而|ér}{北方|běi fāng}{的|de}{冬天|dōng tiān}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}。"? ({暖和|nuǎn huo}: mild, warm)
choices: It contrasts the two halves: "while, whereas".
questions.explanation: {而|ér} between two clauses sets them against each other: the south is mild, while the north is cold. Between two adjectives it adds ({简单|jiǎn dān}{而|ér}{有效|yǒu xiào}, simple and effective).

questions.stem: You want to share an article a friend sent you with other friends. Which verb do you use?
questions.explanation: {转发|zhuǎn fā} is to forward, to share ({转发|zhuǎn fā}{给|gěi}{朋友|péng you}). {回复|huí fù} is to reply, {收听|shōu tīng} to listen to (the radio), {播放|bō fàng} to play (a video, music).

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: "{地铁|dì tiě}{里|lǐ}{手机|shǒu jī}{没有|méi yǒu}___，{电话|diàn huà}{打不通|dǎ bu tōng}。"
questions.explanation: {信号|xìn hào} is a phone signal: {没有|méi yǒu}{信号|xìn hào}, so {打不通|dǎ bu tōng} (can't get through). {信息|xìn xī} is information, {消息|xiāo xi} news or a message, {短信|duǎn xìn} a text.

questions.stem: Which measure word goes with {电视剧|diàn shì jù} (a TV series)?
questions.explanation: {一|yí}{部|bù}{电视剧|diàn shì jù}, {一|yí}{部|bù}{电影|diàn yǐng}: {部|bù} is the measure word for films, series and long works. {本|běn} is for books, {张|zhāng} for flat things, {首|shǒu} for songs and poems.

questions.stem: Which sentence is in the style of a written notice?
choices: {大家|dà jiā}{快|kuài}{来|lái}{看|kàn}{比赛|bǐ sài}{吧|ba}！
{你们|nǐ men}{看|kàn}{不|bu}{看|kàn}{比赛|bǐ sài}{啊|a}？
{欢迎|huān yíng}{大家|dà jiā}{观看|guān kàn}{比赛|bǐ sài}。
questions.explanation: {观看|guān kàn} is the written {看|kàn}, used on notices and in announcements: {欢迎|huān yíng}{大家|dà jiā}{观看|guān kàn}{比赛|bǐ sài} (everyone is welcome to watch the match). The others are spoken questions and invitations.

questions.stem: Which character completes ___ {上|shàng} (online, of a service or event)?
questions.explanation: {线上|xiàn shàng} is written with {线|xiàn} (thread, line). {=All four have {戋|jiān} on the right: {线|xiàn} has 纟 (silk), {钱|qián} has 钅 (metal: money), {浅|qiǎn} has 氵 (water: shallow).=}

questions.stem: Type the written "and": {老人|lǎo rén}___ {海|hǎi} (The Old Man and the Sea), character or pinyin with tone mark
questions.explanation: 《{老人|Lǎo rén}{与|yǔ}{海|Hǎi}》: {与|yǔ}, the written "and", a handwriting character of this lesson{= (three strokes)=}.

questions.stem: Build the sentence.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
choices: {不管|bù guǎn}{天气|tiān qì}{多|duō}{冷|lěng}，{他|tā}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{跑步|pǎo bù}。
{不管|bù guǎn}{天气|tiān qì}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}，{他|tā}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{跑步|pǎo bù}。
{不管|bù guǎn}{天气|tiān qì}{多|duō}{冷|lěng}，{他|tā}{去|qù}{跑步|pǎo bù}。
{虽然|suī rán}{天气|tiān qì}{多|duō}{冷|lěng}，{他|tā}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{跑步|pǎo bù}。
questions.explanation: The {不管|bù guǎn} clause needs an open choice ({多|duō}{冷|lěng}, however cold) and the second clause needs {都|dōu} or {也|yě}. {不管|bù guǎn}{天气|tiān qì}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng} leaves nothing open; {虽然|suī rán} (although) takes a plain statement and {还是|hái shi}, not {多|duō} and {都|dōu}.

questions.stem: Choose the pair for the gaps: "___ {你|nǐ}{去|qù}{哪儿|nǎr}，{我|wǒ}___ {跟|gēn}{你|nǐ}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}。"
questions.explanation: {无论|wú lùn} (no matter) + an open choice ({哪儿|nǎr}) … {都|dōu}: wherever you go, I'll go with you. {如果|rú guǒ} pairs with {就|jiù}, not {才|cái}.

questions.stem: What does "{不管|bù guǎn}{你|nǐ}{同意|tóng yì}{不|bu}{同意|tóng yì}，{我|wǒ}{都|dōu}{要|yào}{去|qù}。" mean?

questions.stem: Choose the words for the gaps: "{上|shàng}{网课|wǎng kè}___ {很|hěn}{方便|fāng biàn}，___ {也|yě}{容易|róng yì}{让|ràng}{人|rén}{分心|fēn xīn}。" ({分心|fēn xīn}: to be distracted)
choices: {一方面|yì fāng miàn}…{另一方面|lìng yì fāng miàn}
questions.explanation: {一方面|yì fāng miàn}…{另一方面|lìng yì fāng miàn} sets out two sides of one thing: convenient on the one hand, distracting on the other. {一边|yì biān}…{一边|yì biān} is two actions at once, {先|xiān}…{然后|rán hòu} a sequence, {越|yuè}…{越|yuè} "the more… the more".

questions.stem: Choose the words for the gaps: "{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{不|bù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{网购|wǎng gòu}。___ {我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}___，{她|tā}{觉得|jué de}{在|zài}{商店|shāng diàn}{里|lǐ}{买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}{更|gèng}{放心|fàng xīn}。"
questions.explanation: {拿|ná} + example + {来说|lái shuō} introduces one example: "Take my mum: …". {在|zài}…{方面|fāng miàn} limits a statement to an area ({在|zài}{学习|xué xí}{方面|fāng miàn}).

questions.stem: Which sentence is wrong?
choices: {他|tā}{是否|shì fǒu}{同意|tóng yì}，{现在|xiàn zài}{还|hái}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}。
{这里|zhè lǐ}{是否|shì fǒu}{可以|kě yǐ}{停车|tíng chē}{吗|ma}？
{请问|qǐng wèn}，{这里|zhè lǐ}{是否|shì fǒu}{可以|kě yǐ}{停车|tíng chē}？
{能否|néng fǒu}{成功|chéng gōng}，{关键|guān jiàn}{在于|zài yú}{大家|dà jiā}{是否|shì fǒu}{努力|nǔ lì}。
questions.explanation: {是否|shì fǒu} already asks the question (whether or not), so {吗|ma} can't follow: {这里|zhè lǐ}{是否|shì fǒu}{可以|kě yǐ}{停车|tíng chē}？ ({在于|zài yú}: to lie in.)

questions.stem: Your friend suggests: "{我们|wǒ men}{周末|zhōu mò}{去|qù}{爬|pá}{山|shān}{吧|ba}！" Which reply praises the suggestion?
questions.explanation: {主意|zhǔ yi} is an idea for what to do, so {好|hǎo}{主意|zhǔ yi}！ (good idea!) is the set reply. {看法|kàn fǎ} is a view on a question and {说法|shuō fǎ} a way of putting it; neither is praised with {好|hǎo} like this. {好|hǎo}{地方|dì fang} is a good place.

questions.stem: What does "{我|wǒ}{怀疑|huái yí}{他|tā}{病|bìng}{了|le}。" mean?
questions.explanation: {怀疑|huái yí} + a clause is "to suspect that…": you think he probably is ill. To doubt a claim, say {我|wǒ}{不|bú}{太|tài}{相信|xiāng xìn} or {怀疑|huái yí} + a noun ({我|wǒ}{怀疑|huái yí}{这个|zhè ge}{说法|shuō fǎ}).

questions.stem: Which character completes {判|pàn}___ (to judge)?

questions.stem: Type the word for "society" (characters or pinyin with tone marks): ___
questions.explanation: {社会|shè huì}. {社|shè} is a handwriting character: 礻 + {土|tǔ}.

questions.stem: Build the sentence.
questions.prompt: However busy she is, she phones her mum every day.
questions.explanation: {不管|bù guǎn}{多|duō}{忙|máng}，{她|tā}{都|dōu}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{给|gěi}{妈妈|mā ma}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}。 The {不管|bù guǎn} clause (with {多|duō} + adjective) comes first, {都|dōu} goes after the subject of the second clause. {她|tā}{不管|bù guǎn}{多|duō}{忙|máng}{都|dōu}{每|měi}{天|tiān}… with the subject first is also correct, and so is {每|měi}{天|tiān}{都|dōu} ({不管|bù guǎn}{多|duō}{忙|máng}，{她|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{都|dōu}{给|gěi}{妈妈|mā ma}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}).

questions.stem: Read: "{旅游|lǚ yóu}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{是否|shì fǒu}{应该|yīng gāi}{跟|gēn}{旅行团|lǚ xíng tuán}？{对于|duì yú}{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}，{每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{的|de}{看法|kàn fǎ}{都|dōu}{不|bù}{一样|yí yàng}。{一方面|yì fāng miàn}，{跟团|gēn tuán}{旅游|lǚ yóu}{确实|què shí}{很|hěn}{方便|fāng biàn}。{导游|dǎo yóu}{会|huì}{安排|ān pái}{好|hǎo}{一切|yí qiè}，{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}、{住|zhù}{旅馆|lǚ guǎn}、{坐|zuò}{车|chē}{都|dōu}{不用|bú yòng}{自己|zì jǐ}{担心|dān xīn}。{拿|ná}{老年|lǎo nián}{人|rén}{来|lái}{说|shuō}，{他们|tā men}{往往|wǎng wǎng}{不|bú}{太|tài}{会|huì}{用|yòng}{手机|shǒu jī}{上|shàng}{的|de}{地图|dì tú}，{也|yě}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{自己|zì jǐ}{找|zhǎo}{路|lù}，{跟团|gēn tuán}{对|duì}{他们|tā men}{来|lái}{说|shuō}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{好|hǎo}{办法|bàn fǎ}。{另外|lìng wài}，{跟团|gēn tuán}{的|de}{价格|jià gé}{普遍|pǔ biàn}{比|bǐ}{自己|zì jǐ}{去|qù}{便宜|pián yi}，{这|zhè}{也|yě}{是|shì}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{选择|xuǎn zé}{跟团|gēn tuán}{的|de}{原因|yuán yīn}。{另一方面|lìng yì fāng miàn}，{跟团|gēn tuán}{也|yě}{有|yǒu}{坏处|huài chu}。{时间|shí jiān}{是|shì}{导游|dǎo yóu}{定|dìng}{的|de}，{每|měi}{个|gè}{景点|jǐng diǎn}{只能|zhǐ néng}{待|dāi}{很|hěn}{短|duǎn}{的|de}{时间|shí jiān}，{想|xiǎng}{多|duō}{看|kàn}{一会儿|yí huìr}{都|dōu}{不行|bù xíng}。{有的|yǒu de}{旅行团|lǚ xíng tuán}{还|hái}{会|huì}{带|dài}{大家|dà jiā}{去|qù}{商店|shāng diàn}{买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}，{让|ràng}{人|rén}{很|hěn}{不|bù}{舒服|shū fu}。{我|wǒ}{的|de}{看法|kàn fǎ}{是|shì}：{不管|bù guǎn}{跟|gēn}{不|bu}{跟团|gēn tuán}，{关键|guān jiàn}{是|shì}{先|xiān}{想|xiǎng}{清楚|qīng chu}{自己|zì jǐ}{想|xiǎng}{要|yào}{什么|shén me}。{如果|rú guǒ}{你|nǐ}{想|xiǎng}{轻松|qīng sōng}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}，{又|yòu}{想|xiǎng}{少|shǎo}{花|huā}{钱|qián}，{跟团|gēn tuán}{是|shì}{不错|bú cuò}{的|de}{选择|xuǎn zé}；{如果|rú guǒ}{你|nǐ}{想|xiǎng}{慢慢|màn màn}{地|de}{了解|liǎo jiě}{一|yí}{个|gè}{地方|dì fang}，{那么|nà me}{最好|zuì hǎo}{自己|zì jǐ}{去|qù}。{实际上|shí jì shàng}，{也|yě}{有|yǒu}{人|rén}{一半|yí bàn}{时间|shí jiān}{跟团|gēn tuán}，{一半|yí bàn}{时间|shí jiān}{自己|zì jǐ}{玩儿|wánr}，{这|zhè}{也|yě}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{好|hǎo}{主意|zhǔ yi}。" ({旅行团|lǚ xíng tuán}: a tour group; {跟团|gēn tuán}: to travel with a tour group) What is the writer's own view?
choices: It depends on what you want from the trip.
Tour groups are always the better choice.
questions.explanation: {不管|bù guǎn}{跟|gēn}{不|bu}{跟团|gēn tuán}，{关键|guān jiàn}{是|shì}{先|xiān}{想|xiǎng}{清楚|qīng chu}{自己|zì jǐ}{想|xiǎng}{要|yào}{什么|shén me}: whether or not you join a group, the key is to know what you want: an easy, cheap trip, or time to get to know a place. {不管|bù guǎn} + a choice ({跟|gēn}{不|bu}{跟|gēn}) + the main clause.

questions.stem: Who was {孟子|Mèng zǐ} (Mencius)?
choices: a Confucian thinker, ranked second only to Confucius in that tradition
a poet of the Tang dynasty
questions.explanation: {孟子|Mèng zǐ} (traditional dates about 372–289 BCE) followed the teaching of Confucius; the Confucian tradition ranks him second only to Confucius. The book of his sayings, 《{孟子|Mèng zǐ}》, became a classic.

questions.stem: Where is the story of Mencius's mother moving house told?
choices: in the 《{列女传|Liè nǚ zhuàn}》 (Biographies of Exemplary Women), traditionally attributed to {刘向|Liú Xiàng}
questions.explanation: The story is in the 《{列女传|Liè nǚ zhuàn}》, a Han-dynasty collection traditionally attributed to the scholar {刘向|Liú Xiàng} (77–6 BCE), written down nearly three centuries after Mencius.

questions.stem: In the story {孟母三迁|Mèng mǔ sān qiān}, the family first lived next to a graveyard ({墓地|mù dì}). What did the boy do there?
choices: He read books with his mother.
He played at burials, copying what the grown-ups did there.
questions.explanation: {孟子|Mèng zǐ}{常常|cháng cháng}{跟|gēn}{邻居|lín jū}{家|jiā}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}{一起|yì qǐ}，{学|xué}{大人|dà ren}{在|zài}{墓地|mù dì}{里|lǐ}{做|zuò}{的|de}{事|shì}，{玩|wán}{埋人|mái rén}{的|de}{游戏|yóu xì}: he copied the grown-ups and played at burying people, so his mother moved.

questions.stem: In the story {孟母三迁|Mèng mǔ sān qiān}, where did the family move second, and what did the boy copy there?
choices: next to a school: the teachers
next to a river: the fishermen
next to a temple: the monks
next to a market: the traders calling out their wares
questions.explanation: {第|dì}{二|èr}{次|cì}，{他们|tā men}{搬|bān}{到|dào}{了|le}{市场|shì chǎng}{旁边|páng biān}……{孟子|Mèng zǐ}{又|yòu}{学|xué}{起|qǐ}{了|le}{做买卖|zuò mǎi mai}{的|de}{人|rén}，{大声|dà shēng}{地|de}{叫卖|jiào mài}{东西|dōng xi}: next to a market, where he copied the traders calling out what they sold.

questions.stem: Read: "{第|dì}{三|sān}{次|cì}，{他们|tā men}{搬|bān}{到|dào}{了|le}{学校|xué xiào}{旁边|páng biān}。{学校|xué xiào}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{老师|lǎo shī}{和|hé}{学生|xué sheng}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{礼貌|lǐ mào}，{见面|jiàn miàn}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{互相|hù xiāng}{行礼|xíng lǐ}。{孟子|Mèng zǐ}{看|kàn}{到|dào}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{也|yě}{学|xué}{着|zhe}{他们|tā men}{的|de}{样子|yàng zi}，{玩|wán}{起|qǐ}{了|le}{祭祀|jì sì}{和|hé}{行礼|xíng lǐ}{的|de}{游戏|yóu xì}。{母亲|mǔ qīn}{高兴|gāo xìng}{地|de}{说|shuō}：“{这|zhè}{才|cái}{是|shì}{孩子|hái zi}{应该|yīng gāi}{住|zhù}{的|de}{地方|dì fang}！”" ({行礼|xíng lǐ}: to bow; {祭祀|jì sì}: a ceremony) Why was the mother happy at last?
choices: Her son was now copying polite, educated people.
questions.explanation: The boy now copied the courteous teachers and students ({学|xué}{着|zhe}{他们|tā men}{的|de}{样子|yàng zi}). The mother's choice of home is about what her son copies.

questions.stem: What does the story of Mencius's mother suggest about how children learn?
choices: Children copy the people around them, so surroundings matter.
Children should choose where to live.
questions.explanation: Each time, the boy copied what he saw around him: burials, trading, then polite manners. The retelling says it in so many words: {孩子|hái zi}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{学|xué}{身边|shēn biān}{的|de}{人|rén}{做|zuò}{的|de}{事|shì}.

questions.stem: Which sentence uses {孟母三迁|Mèng mǔ sān qiān} in its usual sense today?
choices: {孟母三迁|Mèng mǔ sān qiān}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{很|hěn}{有名|yǒu míng}{的|de}{地方|dì fang}。
{他|tā}{一|yì}{年|nián}{搬|bān}{了|le}{三|sān}{次|cì}{家|jiā}，{因为|yīn wèi}{房租|fáng zū}{太|tài}{贵|guì}{了|le}，{真|zhēn}{是|shì}{孟母三迁|Mèng mǔ sān qiān}。
{为了|wèi le}{孩子|hái zi}{上|shàng}{好|hǎo}{学校|xué xiào}，{他们|tā men}{家|jiā}{搬|bān}{了|le}{三|sān}{次|cì}，{真|zhēn}{是|shì}{孟母三迁|Mèng mǔ sān qiān}{啊|a}。
{我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}{姓|xìng}{孟|Mèng}，{所以|suǒ yǐ}{我们|wǒ men}{搬|bān}{了|le}{三|sān}{次|cì}{家|jiā}。
questions.explanation: {孟母三迁|Mèng mǔ sān qiān} is about parents who move, or go to great lengths, for their child's education and surroundings. Moving because the rent is too high has nothing to do with a child.

questions.stem: In {孟母三迁|Mèng mǔ sān qiān}, what does {迁|qiān} mean?
questions.explanation: {迁|qiān} (qiān) is the written word for moving house; in speech, {搬家|bān jiā}. {三|sān}{迁|qiān}: moved three times.

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: "{母亲|mǔ qīn}{看|kàn}{到|dào}{了|le}，{心|xīn}{想|xiǎng}：‘{这个|zhè ge}{地方|dì fang}{不|bú}{适合|shì hé}{孩子|hái zi}{住|zhù}。’___，{她|tā}{带|dài}{着|zhe}{孟子|Mèng zǐ}{搬|bān}{了|le}{家|jiā}。"
questions.explanation: {于是|yú shì} (so, thereupon) joins the decision to what caused it, in a narrative. {但是|dàn shì} would contradict, {因为|yīn wèi} and {如果|rú guǒ} start a cause or a condition.

questions.stem: What does the {子|zǐ} in {孟子|Mèng zǐ} mean?
questions.explanation: {子|zǐ} after a surname is an old title of respect: {孟子|Mèng zǐ} is "Master Meng", as {孔子|Kǒng zǐ} is "Master Kong". The Latin forms Mencius and Confucius come from these titles.

questions.stem: How should we read the story of the three moves, according to what is known about its source?
choices: as an exact record of Mencius's childhood
as a story about Mencius, written down long after his time
questions.explanation: The 《{列女传|Liè nǚ zhuàn}》 was put together in the Han dynasty, nearly three centuries after Mencius, and nobody can say whether the family really moved three times. It's a story about him and a model of a wise parent.

questions.stem: Listen. Why did the family move?

audio.text: 为了让孩子上一个好学校，他们搬到了学校附近。

choices: to be near the parents' work
because the old flat was too small
so that the child could go to a good school
questions.explanation: {为了|wèi le}{让|ràng}{孩子|hái zi}{上|shàng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{好|hǎo}{学校|xué xiào}: so that the child could go to a good school. Some people call this a modern {孟母三迁|Mèng mǔ sān qiān}.

questions.stem: Who was {庄子|Zhuāng zǐ} (Zhuangzi)?
choices: a Daoist thinker of the fourth century BCE, after whom a book is named
a Confucian teacher of the Han dynasty
the author of the 《{列女传|Liè nǚ zhuàn}》
questions.explanation: {庄子|Zhuāng zǐ} (Zhuang Zhou; dates uncertain, given as about 369–286 or 369–298 BCE) was a Daoist thinker; the book 《{庄子|Zhuāng zǐ}》 carries his name, though only its first seven chapters are generally thought to be his own.

questions.stem: In the passage "{昔者|xī zhě}{庄周|Zhuāng Zhōu}{梦为|mèng wéi}{胡蝶|hú dié}，{栩栩然|xǔ xǔ rán}{胡蝶|hú dié}{也|yě}", what did Zhuang Zhou dream?
choices: that a butterfly was chasing him
that he had caught a butterfly
questions.explanation: {梦为|mèng wéi}{胡蝶|hú dié}: dreamt he was ({为|wéi} wéi, "to be, become") a butterfly. {胡蝶|hú dié} is the old way of writing {蝴蝶|hú dié}.

questions.stem: In the line "{俄然觉|é rán jué}，{则蘧蘧然周也|zé qú qú rán Zhōu yě}", what does {觉|jué} mean?
questions.explanation: {觉|jué} here is "to wake up" (in modern Chinese {醒|xǐng}). It has the jué of {觉得|jué de}; {睡觉|shuì jiào} has jiào.

questions.stem: After waking, what was Zhuang Zhou unsure of, in the line "{不知周之梦为胡蝶与|bù zhī Zhōu zhī mèng wéi hú dié yú}，{胡蝶之梦为周与|hú dié zhī mèng wéi Zhōu yú}？"
choices: whether he had dreamt he was a butterfly or was a butterfly now dreaming it was Zhou
questions.explanation: He doesn't know whether Zhou dreamt of being a butterfly, or a butterfly is dreaming of being Zhou. {之|zhī} here links the subject to its verb ("that Zhou dreamt…"), and {与|yú} ends the question, like {吗|ma}.

questions.stem: How is 与 read at the end of "自喻适志与！", where it ends an exclamation?
questions.explanation: At the end of a clause in classical Chinese, {与|yú} is a final particle read yú (also written {欤|yú}). In {周与胡蝶|Zhōu yǔ hú dié} (Zhou and the butterfly) it's yǔ, the "and" of lesson 24. Some transcriptions write yǔ for both.

questions.stem: In the modern word {蝴蝶|hú dié} (butterfly), what was added to the old spelling {胡蝶|hú dié}?
questions.explanation: {={蝴蝶|hú dié} adds {虫|chóng} (insect) to {胡|hú}: the old texts write {胡蝶|hú dié}.=}

questions.stem: What does the passage's last sentence, "{此之谓物化|cǐ zhī wèi wù huà}", say?
choices: "This is the end of the book."
"This is called the transformation of things."
questions.explanation: {此之谓|cǐ zhī wèi}: this is what is called; {物化|wù huà}: the transformation of things, one thing becoming another. {此|cǐ} is the written {这|zhè} (lesson 01).

questions.stem: Which of these is one of the ways readers have interpreted the butterfly story?
choices: as a story about Mencius's mother
as a law of the Qin dynasty
as doubt about how we can be sure what is real
questions.explanation: One common reading: while dreaming we're sure the dream is real, so how can we be sure we aren't dreaming now? Others stress {物化|wù huà} (change between things) or the butterfly's carefree ease. All are interpretations.

questions.stem: Someone says: "{有时候|yǒu shí hou}{我|wǒ}{觉得|jué de}{自己|zì jǐ}{像|xiàng}{庄周梦蝶|Zhuāng Zhōu mèng dié}，{分不清|fēn bu qīng}{是|shì}{梦|mèng}{还是|hái shi}{真|zhēn}{的|de}。" ({分不清|fēn bu qīng}: can't tell apart) What do they feel?
choices: that life feels like a dream, and they can't tell what's real
that they want to keep butterflies
that they have forgotten a dream
questions.explanation: As a set phrase, {庄周梦蝶|Zhuāng Zhōu mèng dié} describes the feeling that life is like a dream, or that you can't be sure what is real.

questions.stem: Which chapter of the 《{庄子|Zhuāng zǐ}》 does the butterfly story end?
choices: the last chapter of the book
《{齐物论|Qí wù lùn}》, the second chapter
a chapter of the 《{论语|Lún yǔ}》
questions.explanation: The story ends the second chapter, 《{齐物论|Qí wù lùn}》 (Qí wù lùn), often translated "On the Equality of Things".

questions.stem: Which modern word means the same as {俄然|é rán} (suddenly) in the passage?
questions.explanation: {俄然|é rán} is "suddenly", in modern Chinese {忽然|hū rán} (lesson 20). {当然|dāng rán} is "of course", {虽然|suī rán} "although", {然后|rán hòu} "then".

questions.stem: In the modern retelling "{他|tā}{觉得|jué de}{非常|fēi cháng}{愉快|yú kuài}，{完全|wán quán}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{自己|zì jǐ}{是|shì}{庄周|Zhuāng Zhōu}。", what did the butterfly forget?
questions.explanation: {完全|wán quán}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{自己|zì jǐ}{是|shì}{庄周|Zhuāng Zhōu}: it completely forgot it was Zhuang Zhou. The classical text says {不知周也|bù zhī Zhōu yě}: it didn't know it was Zhou.

questions.stem: Choose the pair: ___ {明天|míng tiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒ men}___ {要|yào}{去|qù}。 (Even if it rains tomorrow, we're still going.)
questions.explanation: "Even if" is {即使|jí shǐ}…{也|yě}: {即使|jí shǐ}{明天|míng tiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒ men}{也|yě}{要|yào}{去|qù}。 {如果|rú guǒ}…{就|jiù} would make it a plain "if… then", and {只要|zhǐ yào}…{就|jiù} "as long as it rains, we'll go", which isn't the meaning. {虽然|suī rán}…{但是|dàn shì} is for facts, and {但是|dàn shì} can't stand after the subject.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct? (Even if it rains tomorrow, we'll go.)
choices: {虽然|suī rán}{明天|míng tiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{但是|dàn shì}{我们|wǒ men}{也|yě}{去|qù}。
{即使|jí shǐ}{明天|míng tiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒ men}{也|yě}{去|qù}。
{即使|jí shǐ}{明天|míng tiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{去|qù}。
{明天|míng tiān}{即使|jí shǐ}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{也|yě}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}。
questions.explanation: Tomorrow's rain is only a supposition, so it takes {即使|jí shǐ}, with {也|yě} after the subject of the second clause: {即使|jí shǐ}{明天|míng tiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒ men}{也|yě}{去|qù}。 {虽然|suī rán} is for what is already true; {就|jiù} goes with {如果|rú guǒ}, {只要|zhǐ yào} and {既然|jì rán}, not {即使|jí shǐ}; and {也|yě} is an adverb, so it can't come before the subject {我们|wǒ men}.

questions.stem: What does "{就是|jiù shì}{再|zài}{忙|máng}，{我|wǒ}{也|yě}{会|huì}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}。" mean?
choices: It's just that I'm busy, so call me instead.
Only when I'm busy will I call you.
I'm exactly as busy as you are.
However busy I am, I'll call you.
questions.explanation: {就是|jiù shì}…{也|yě} is the spoken "even if", and {就是|jiù shì}{再|zài} + adjective is "however… (it is)": however busy I am, I'll still phone. The {就是|jiù shì} of "it's just that" comes after a good point ({很|hěn}{好看|hǎo kàn}，{就是|jiù shì}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{贵|guì}), not before a clause with {也|yě}.

questions.stem: What does {就是|jiù shì} mean in "{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{外套|wài tào}{很|hěn}{好看|hǎo kàn}，{就是|jiù shì}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{贵|guì}。"?
questions.explanation: After a good point, {就是|jiù shì} adds a small drawback: the coat looks good; it's just a bit expensive. "Even if" would need a {也|yě} clause after it ({就是|jiù shì}{贵|guì}，{我|wǒ}{也|yě}{买|mǎi}), "that is to say" is {就是说|jiù shì shuō}, and "it is exactly" comes before a noun ({这|zhè}{就是|jiù shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{外套|wài tào}).

questions.stem: How do you ask "Could you speak a little more slowly?"
choices: {你|nǐ}{能|néng}{说|shuō}{得|de}{慢|màn}{稍微|shāo wēi}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{吗|ma}？
{你|nǐ}{能|néng}{说|shuō}{得|de}{稍微|shāo wēi}{慢|màn}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{吗|ma}？
questions.explanation: {稍微|shāo wēi} goes before the adjective and {一点儿|yì diǎnr} after it: {说|shuō}{得|de}{稍微|shāo wēi}{慢|màn}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}. {有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{慢|màn} means "a bit (too) slow", a complaint, not a request; {一点儿|yì diǎnr} never goes before an adjective; and {稍微|shāo wēi} can't follow it.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{毛衣|máo yī}___ {大|dà}，{有|yǒu}{小|xiǎo}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{的|de}{吗|ma}？ (This sweater is a bit big; do you have a smaller one?)
questions.explanation: For something a bit too much, unwelcome, {有点儿|yǒu diǎnr} goes before the adjective: {有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{大|dà}. {一点儿|yì diǎnr} goes after an adjective ({小|xiǎo}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}, as in the second half); {稍微|shāo wēi} on its own before {大|dà} sounds unfinished ({稍微|shāo wēi}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{大|dà} would work); {少|shǎo} is "few".

questions.stem: Which sentence would you expect in a written weather report?
choices: {今天|jīn tiān}{夜里|yè lǐ}{会|huì}{比|bǐ}{零|líng}{度|dù}{还|hái}{冷|lěng}{呢|ne}！
{今天|jīn tiān}{夜里|yè lǐ}{最|zuì}{低|dī}{气温|qì wēn}{将|jiāng}{低于|dī yú}{零|líng}{度|dù}。
{今天|jīn tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{可|kě}{冷|lěng}{了|le}，{零下|líng xià}{了|le}{吧|ba}？
{今天|jīn tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{冷|lěng}{不|bu}{冷|lěng}{啊|a}？
questions.explanation: {将|jiāng} (will) and {低于|dī yú} (lower than) are written words, the language of forecasts and notices: tonight's lowest temperature will be below zero. The other three are chatty speech: {呢|ne}, {可|kě}…{了|le}, {吧|ba} and {啊|a} belong to conversation. (In a report, {不|bù}{低于|dī yú} means "no lower than", that is, at least.)

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: "{我|wǒ}{的|de}{老家|lǎo jiā}{在|zài}{中国|Zhōng guó}{北部|běi bù}{的|de}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小|xiǎo}{村|cūn}{里|lǐ}。{那儿|nàr}{的|de}{冬天|dōng tiān}{十分|shí fēn}{寒冷|hán lěng}，___ {是|shì}{一|yī}{月|yuè}，{夜里|yè lǐ}{常常|cháng cháng}{到|dào}{零下|líng xià}{二十|èr shí}{度|dù}。"
questions.explanation: {尤其|yóu qí} (especially, lesson 07) picks out the coldest month: the winters are bitterly cold, especially January. {即使|jí shǐ} would need a {也|yě} clause, {稍微|shāo wēi} makes a difference small, and {低于|dī yú} compares with a number ({低于|dī yú}{零|líng}{度|dù}).

questions.stem: Choose the word: {今天|jīn tiān}___ {很|hěn}{低|dī}，{最|zuì}{高|gāo}{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{三|sān}{度|dù}。 (The temperature is very low today: the high is only three degrees.)
questions.explanation: {气温|qì wēn} is the temperature of the air outside, the one forecasts give. {体温|tǐ wēn} is body temperature, {气候|qì hòu} the climate (the weather year after year, not today's), and {阳光|yáng guāng} sunshine, which isn't "low".

questions.stem: How is the last character read in "{北京|Běi jīng}{的|de}{冬天|dōng tiān}{很|hěn}干。" (Beijing winters are very dry.)?
questions.explanation: "Dry" is {={干|gān}=}, first tone. HSK 3's {干|gàn} (fourth tone) is "to do": {你|nǐ}{在|zài}{干|gàn}{什么|shén me}？ gǎn is the sound of {敢|gǎn} and {赶|gǎn}, and hàn of {汗|hàn} (sweat). Traditional characters write the two words apart: {={乾|gān}=} (dry), {={幹|gàn}=} (to do).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {气候|qì hòu} (climate): two falling tones, 4+4.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {海洋|hǎi yáng} (ocean): a dipping tone, then a rising one, 3+2.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {农|nóng}___ (the countryside)
questions.explanation: {农村|nóng cūn} (the countryside). {={村|cūn} is {木|mù} (tree) + {寸|cùn}, its sound part. {材|cái} ({材料|cái liào}) has {木|mù} + {才|cái}, {树|shù} has {木|mù}, {又|yòu} and {寸|cùn}, and {付|fù} ({支付|zhī fù}) has {亻|rén} + {寸|cùn}.=}

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {天|tiān}{上|shàng}{一|yí}{片|piàn}___ {也|yě}{没有|méi yǒu}。 (There isn't a cloud in the sky.)
questions.explanation: {云|yún}, a cloud. {=In simplified it is {二|èr} over a short turning stroke and a dot (4 strokes).=} {片|piàn} (lesson 27) is the measure word for something flat and spread out. Traditional writes {+{云|yún}+}, with {雨|yǔ} (rain) on top.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Even if it's very cold, he goes running every morning.
questions.explanation: {即使|jí shǐ}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}，{他|tā}{也|yě}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{去|qù}{跑步|pǎo bù}。 {即使|jí shǐ} opens the supposition and {也|yě} follows the subject of the second clause ({他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{也|yě}{去|qù}{跑步|pǎo bù} is fine too, and so is {他|tā} before {即使|jí shǐ}). {就|jiù} doesn't pair with {即使|jí shǐ}.

questions.stem: Listen. What will they do if it rains tomorrow?

audio.text: 即使明天下雨，我们也去爬山。

choices: go only if it stops raining
questions.explanation: {即使|jí shǐ}{明天|míng tiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒ men}{也|yě}{去|qù}{爬山|pá shān}: even if it rains tomorrow, we'll still go hiking. {即使|jí shǐ}…{也|yě} says the rain changes nothing.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker say about today?

audio.text: 今天比昨天稍微暖和一点儿，不过晚上还是要穿厚外套。

choices: It's a little warmer than yesterday.
It's warm enough to go without a coat.
It's exactly as warm as yesterday.
questions.explanation: {比|bǐ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{稍微|shāo wēi}{暖和|nuǎn huo}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}: slightly warmer than yesterday; but in the evening you still need a thick coat ({晚上|wǎn shang}{还是|hái shi}{要|yào}{穿|chuān}{厚|hòu}{外套|wài tào}).

questions.stem: Listen to the forecast. When will it rain?

audio.text: 明天白天晴，最高气温十五度。夜间有雨，最低气温低于五度。

questions.explanation: {白天|bái tiān}{晴|qíng} (sunny in the daytime), {夜间|yè jiān}{有|yǒu}{雨|yǔ} (rain at night). {夜间|yè jiān} is the written "at night", and {低于|dī yú}{五|wǔ}{度|dù} "below five degrees".

questions.stem: Listen. How does the speaker feel about going?

audio.text: 天气预报说，明天零下十度。可是就是再冷，我也要去看雪。

choices: They will go only if it gets warmer.
They are worried and will stay in.
They are set on going, however cold it is.
questions.explanation: {就是|jiù shì}{再|zài}{冷|lěng}，{我|wǒ}{也|yě}{要|yào}{去|qù}: however cold it is, I'm going to go and see the snow. The forecast ({天气预报|tiān qì yù bào}) of minus ten changes nothing.

questions.stem: Read the post: "{我|wǒ}{去年|qù nián}{秋天|qiū tiān}{来|lái}{到|dào}{英国|Yīng guó}{北部|běi bù}{读书|dú shū}。{这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{气候|qì hòu}{跟|gēn}{北京|Běi jīng}{很|hěn}{不|bù}{一样|yí yàng}：{冬天|dōng tiān}{不|bú}{太|tài}{冷|lěng}，{最|zuì}{低|dī}{气温|qì wēn}{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}{低于|dī yú}{零|líng}{度|dù}，{可是|kě shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{有|yǒu}{五六|wǔ liù}{天|tiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{下午|xià wǔ}{四|sì}{点|diǎn}{天|tiān}{就|jiù}{黑|hēi}{了|le}。{刚|gāng}{来|lái}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{我|wǒ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{都|dōu}{带|dài}{伞|sǎn}，{后来|hòu lái}{发现|fā xiàn}{这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{人|rén}{即使|jí shǐ}{下|xià}{着|zhe}{雨|yǔ}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}{打伞|dǎ sǎn}，{于是|yú shì}{我|wǒ}{也|yě}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{一|yí}{件|jiàn}{厚|hòu}{外套|wài tào}，{把|bǎ}{伞|sǎn}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{了|le}。" ({英国|Yīng guó}: Britain; {天黑|tiān hēi}: to get dark; {打伞|dǎ sǎn}: to hold up an umbrella; {于是|yú shì}: so, lesson 28) What can you tell about the writer now?
choices: They have got used to the local way of dealing with rain.
They still take an umbrella every day.
They find the winters colder than in Beijing.
They never go out when it rains.
questions.explanation: The text doesn't say "I've got used to it", but you can work it out: at first they took an umbrella every day; then, seeing that people hardly use one even in the rain ({即使|jí shǐ}{下|xià}{着|zhe}{雨|yǔ}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}{打伞|dǎ sǎn}), they bought a thick coat and left the umbrella at home, as the locals do. The winters are milder than Beijing's ({冬天|dōng tiān}{不|bú}{太|tài}{冷|lěng}，{最|zuì}{低|dī}{气温|qì wēn}{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}{低于|dī yú}{零|líng}{度|dù}).

{湿|shī}: damp, humid; {海风|hǎi fēng}: the sea breeze) Why does the writer feel cold indoors in the south in winter?
choices: The houses have no central heating.
It is often minus ten degrees.
The writer has no warm clothes.
questions.explanation: {房子|fáng zi}{里|lǐ}{没有|méi yǒu}{暖气|nuǎn qì}，{即使|jí shǐ}{穿|chuān}{着|zhe}{很|hěn}{厚|hòu}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}，{坐|zuò}{在|zài}{房间|fáng jiān}{里|lǐ}{也|yě}{觉得|jué de}{冷|lěng}: no heating, so even in thick clothes it feels cold indoors ({即使|jí shǐ}…{也|yě}, even if). Minus ten and snow describe the north.

{湿|shī}: damp, humid; {海风|hǎi fēng}: the sea breeze) What is summer like where the writer lives now?
choices: often above 35 degrees and very humid

{湿|shī}: damp, humid; {海风|hǎi fēng}: the sea breeze) Why does the writer suggest coming after October?

The writer will be on holiday.
It is the only time you can see the stars.

Flowers are there all year round ({一|yì}{年|nián}{四季|sì jì}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{花|huā}).

questions.stem: Choose the measure word: {院子|yuàn zi}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{三|sān}___ {苹果|píng guǒ}{树|shù}。 (There are three apple trees in the yard.)
questions.explanation: Trees and other plants take {棵|kē}: {三|sān}{棵|kē}{苹果|píng guǒ}{树|shù}. {张|zhāng} is for flat things ({一|yì}{张|zhāng}{纸|zhǐ}), {只|zhī} for most animals ({一|yì}{只|zhī}{猫|māo}), {条|tiáo} for long thin things and some animals ({一|yì}{条|tiáo}{鱼|yú}, {一|yì}{条|tiáo}{河|hé}).

questions.stem: Choose the measure word: {客厅|kè tīng}{的|de}{墙|qiáng}{上|shàng}{挂|guà}{着|zhe}{一|yì}___ {画|huà}。 (A painting hangs on the living-room wall.)
questions.explanation: Paintings, drawings and maps take {幅|fú}: {一|yì}{幅|fú}{画|huà}, {一|yì}{幅|fú}{地图|dì tú}. {棵|kē} is for plants, {片|piàn} for thin flat pieces or stretches ({一|yí}{片|piàn}{叶子|yè zi}), {双|shuāng} for pairs ({一|yì}{双|shuāng}{鞋|xié}). (In conversation you'll also hear {一|yì}{张|zhāng}{画|huà}; {幅|fú} is the standard word.)

questions.stem: How do you say "a slice of bread"?
questions.explanation: A thin flat piece takes {片|piàn}: {一|yí}{片|piàn}{面包|miàn bāo}, {一|yí}{片|piàn}{叶子|yè zi}, {两|liǎng}{片|piàn}{药|yào} (two tablets). {幅|fú} is for pictures, {棵|kē} for plants, {只|zhī} for animals.

questions.stem: Which sentence uses {有着|yǒu zhe} correctly?
choices: {我们|wǒ men}{没有|méi yǒu}{着|zhe}{时间|shí jiān}。
{他|tā}{昨天|zuó tiān}{有着|yǒu zhe}{一|yí}{个|gè}{问题|wèn tí}。
{这|zhè}{座|zuò}{城市|chéng shì}{有着|yǒu zhe}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}{的|de}{历史|lì shǐ}。
questions.explanation: {有着|yǒu zhe} is the written "have" for an abstract quality, usually with a modifier: {有着|yǒu zhe}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}{的|de}{历史|lì shǐ}. It isn't used for people or things you have ({我|wǒ}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{哥哥|gē ge}), for one event in the past, or in the negative ({没有|méi yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}).

questions.stem: Which sentence means "This knife is for cutting fruit."? ({切|qiē}: to cut)
choices: {这|zhè}{把|bǎ}{刀|dāo}{用来|yòng lái}{是|shì}{切|qiē}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}{的|de}。
{这|zhè}{把|bǎ}{刀|dāo}{是|shì}{切|qiē}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}{用来|yòng lái}{的|de}。
{这|zhè}{把|bǎ}{刀|dāo}{是|shì}{用来|yòng lái}{切|qiē}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}{的|de}。
{这|zhè}{把|bǎ}{刀|dāo}{是|shì}{用|yòng}{切|qiē}{来|lái}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}{的|de}。
questions.explanation: {是|shì}{用来|yòng lái} + verb + {的|de} says what a thing is for: {这|zhè}{把|bǎ}{刀|dāo}{是|shì}{用来|yòng lái}{切|qiē}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}{的|de}。 {用来|yòng lái} comes straight before the verb it introduces, and the whole phrase sits between {是|shì} and {的|de}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{技术|jì shù}{已经|yǐ jīng}___ {很|hěn}{多|duō}{方面|fāng miàn}。 (This technology is already used in many areas.)
questions.explanation: {用于|yòng yú} + noun (written) is "is used in / for": {用于|yòng yú}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{方面|fāng miàn}. {用来|yòng lái} needs a verb after it ({用来|yòng lái}{做|zuò}{茶|chá}). {有着|yǒu zhe} would mean "has many aspects", and {分为|fēn wéi} "is divided into".

questions.stem: Choose the word: {一|yì}{年|nián}___ {四|sì}{个|gè}{季节|jì jié}。 (The year is divided into four seasons.)
questions.explanation: {分为|fēn wéi} (written; spoken {分成|fēn chéng}) is "is divided into": {一|yì}{年|nián}{分为|fēn wéi}{四|sì}{个|gè}{季节|jì jié}. {为|wéi} is wéi here. {产生|chǎn shēng} and {引起|yǐn qǐ} are "to cause, produce", {用于|yòng yú} "is used for".

questions.stem: How are the two marked characters read in "{我|wǒ}{爷爷|yé ye}种{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}种{花|huā}。" (My grandpa has planted many kinds of flowers.)?
questions.explanation: The first is the verb "to plant", {种|zhòng} (fourth tone); the second follows {很|hěn}{多|duō} as a measure word, "kinds", {种|zhǒng} (third tone). Traditional writes both as {+{种|zhǒng}+}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {他|tā}{的|de}{话|huà}___ {了|le}{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{注意|zhù yì}。 (What he said caught everyone's attention.)
questions.explanation: Attention, a reaction set off in other people, is "caused" with {引起|yǐn qǐ}: {引起|yǐn qǐ}{注意|zhù yì}. {产生|chǎn shēng} goes with things that come into being ({产生|chǎn shēng}{兴趣|xìng qù}, {产生|chǎn shēng}{影响|yǐng xiǎng}), {有着|yǒu zhe} is "has", and {用于|yòng yú} "is used for".

questions.stem: Choose the word: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{很|hěn}___，{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{月|yuè}。 (This book is very thick: it took me a month to read.)
questions.explanation: A thick book, coat or layer of snow is {厚|hòu} (lesson 26). {粗|cū} and {细|xì} are thick and thin for long round things ({粗|cū}{的|de}{树|shù}, {细|xì}{的|de}{线|xiàn}), and {深|shēn} is deep.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: These leaves can be used to make tea.

questions.stem: Listen. How does the speaker feel about their work?

questions.stem: Read: "{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{阳台|yáng tái}{上|shàng}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{种|zhǒng}{很|hěn}{少见|shǎo jiàn}{的|de}{植物|zhí wù}，{是|shì}{朋友|péng you}{从|cóng}{外地|wài dì}{带|dài}{来|lái}{的|de}。{它|tā}{的|de}{叶子|yè zi}{又|yòu}{小|xiǎo}{又|yòu}{厚|hòu}，{里面|lǐ miàn}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{水|shuǐ}。{朋友|péng you}{说|shuō}，{这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{植物|zhí wù}{的|de}{老家|lǎo jiā}{一|yì}{年|nián}{只|zhǐ}{下|xià}{几|jǐ}{次|cì}{雨|yǔ}，{所以|suǒ yǐ}{即使|jí shǐ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{不|bù}{给|gěi}{它|tā}{浇水|jiāo shuǐ}，{它|tā}{也|yě}{能|néng}{活|huó}。{我|wǒ}{试|shì}{了|le}{试|shì}，{果然|guǒ rán}{是|shì}{这样|zhè yàng}。" ({阳台|yáng tái}: balcony; {浇水|jiāo shuǐ}: to water; {果然|guǒ rán}: just as expected) What can you work out about the plant's leaves?
choices: They store water, so the plant can survive without rain.
They fall off when it is dry.
They are thin so that they dry quickly.
questions.explanation: The text doesn't say why the leaves are thick, but it puts the facts side by side: the leaves are small and thick, with a lot of water inside ({里面|lǐ miàn}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{水|shuǐ}); the plant comes from a place with little rain, and it lives even if you don't water it for a month ({即使|jí shǐ}…{也|yě}{能|néng}{活|huó}). So the leaves hold water for the dry times.

questions.stem: Read: "{熊|xióng}{是|shì}{一|yì}{种|zhǒng}{很|hěn}{大|dà}{的|de}{动物|dòng wù}，{世界|shì jiè}{上|shàng}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{地方|dì fang}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{熊|xióng}。{科学家|kē xué jiā}{一般|yì bān}{把|bǎ}{熊|xióng}{分为|fēn wéi}{八|bā}{种|zhǒng}，{其中|qí zhōng}{最|zuì}{有名|yǒu míng}{的|de}{是|shì}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}{和|hé}{北极熊|běi jí xióng}。{熊|xióng}{的|de}{身体|shēn tǐ}{很|hěn}{大|dà}，{四|sì}{条|tiáo}{腿|tuǐ}{很|hěn}{粗|cū}，{力气|lì qi}{也|yě}{非常|fēi cháng}{大|dà}。{别|bié}{看|kàn}{它们|tā men}{走路|zǒu lù}{的|de}{样子|yàng zi}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{慢|màn}，{跑|pǎo}{起来|qǐ lái}{速度|sù dù}{其实|qí shí}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}。{熊|xióng}{的|de}{鼻子|bí zi}{也|yě}{特别|tè bié}{厉害|lì hai}，{能|néng}{闻|wén}{到|dào}{很|hěn}{远|yuǎn}{的|de}{地方|dì fang}{的|de}{食物|shí wù}。{大|dà}{部分|bù fen}{熊|xióng}{什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{吃|chī}：{植物|zhí wù}{的|de}{叶子|yè zi}、{水果|shuǐ guǒ}、{小|xiǎo}{动物|dòng wù}{和|hé}{鱼|yú}，{都|dōu}{是|shì}{它们|tā men}{的|de}{食物|shí wù}。{不过|bú guò}{也|yě}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{种|zhǒng}{熊|xióng}{不|bù}{一样|yí yàng}：{北极熊|běi jí xióng}{主要|zhǔ yào}{吃|chī}{肉|ròu}，{而|ér}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}{几乎|jī hū}{只|zhǐ}{吃|chī}{竹子|zhú zi}。{很|hěn}{多|duō}{生活|shēng huó}{在|zài}{寒冷|hán lěng}{地方|dì fang}{的|de}{熊|xióng}{有着|yǒu zhe}{一|yí}{个|gè}{特别|tè bié}{的|de}{习惯|xí guàn}：{冬天|dōng tiān}{到来|dào lái}{以前|yǐ qián}，{它们|tā men}{会|huì}{大量|dà liàng}{地|de}{吃|chī}{东西|dōng xi}，{让|ràng}{自己|zì jǐ}{长|zhǎng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{胖|pàng}。{然后|rán hòu}，{它们|tā men}{找|zhǎo}{一|yí}{个|gè}{山洞|shān dòng}，{在|zài}{里面|lǐ miàn}{睡|shuì}{过|guò}{整个|zhěng gè}{冬天|dōng tiān}，{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{不|bù}{吃|chī}{也|yě}{不|bù}{喝|hē}。{科学家|kē xué jiā}{把|bǎ}{这|zhè}{叫作|jiào zuò}“{冬眠|dōng mián}”。{现在|xiàn zài}，{有的|yǒu de}{熊|xióng}{生活|shēng huó}{的|de}{地方|dì fang}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{小|xiǎo}，{数量|shù liàng}{也|yě}{在|zài}{不断|bú duàn}{下降|xià jiàng}。{怎样|zěn yàng}{让|ràng}{熊|xióng}{有|yǒu}{更|gèng}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}{环境|huán jìng}，{已经|yǐ jīng}{成|chéng}{了|le}{全球|quán qiú}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{科学家|kē xué jiā}{研究|yán jiū}{的|de}{问题|wèn tí}。" ({北极熊|běi jí xióng}: a polar bear; {竹子|zhú zi}: bamboo; {山洞|shān dòng}: a cave; {冬眠|dōng mián}: to hibernate) How many kinds of bear do scientists usually count?
questions.explanation: {科学家|kē xué jiā}{一般|yì bān}{把|bǎ}{熊|xióng}{分为|fēn wéi}{八|bā}{种|zhǒng}: scientists usually divide bears into eight kinds ({分为|fēn wéi}, "divide into"), the giant panda and the polar bear among them ({其中|qí zhōng}).

{竹子|zhú zi}: bamboo; {山洞|shān dòng}: a cave; {冬眠|dōng mián}: to hibernate) What do most bears eat?

questions.explanation: {大|dà}{部分|bù fen}{熊|xióng}{什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{吃|chī}：{植物|zhí wù}{的|de}{叶子|yè zi}、{水果|shuǐ guǒ}、{小|xiǎo}{动物|dòng wù}{和|hé}{鱼|yú}: most bears eat a bit of everything. Only meat is the polar bear, and almost only bamboo the giant panda: the two exceptions.
