questions.explanation: {冬天|dōng tiān}{到来|dào lái}{以前|yǐ qián}，{它们|tā men}{会|huì}{大量|dà liàng}{地|de}{吃|chī}{东西|dōng xi}，{让|ràng}{自己|zì jǐ}{长|zhǎng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{胖|pàng}。{然后|rán hòu}，{它们|tā men}{找|zhǎo}{一|yí}{个|gè}{山洞|shān dòng}，{在|zài}{里面|lǐ miàn}{睡|shuì}{过|guò}{整个|zhěng gè}{冬天|dōng tiān}: they eat a lot and fatten up, then sleep the winter away in a cave: hibernation ({冬眠|dōng mián}).

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct? (Many people choose to take the metro to protect the environment.)
choices: {很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{而|ér}{为了|wèi le}{保护|bǎo hù}{环境|huán jìng}{选择|xuǎn zé}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}。
{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{为了|wèi le}{而|ér}{保护|bǎo hù}{环境|huán jìng}{选择|xuǎn zé}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}。
{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{为了|wèi le}{保护|bǎo hù}{环境|huán jìng}{而|ér}{选择|xuǎn zé}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}。
{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{选择|xuǎn zé}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{而|ér}{为了|wèi le}{保护|bǎo hù}{环境|huán jìng}。
questions.explanation: {为了|wèi le} + purpose + {而|ér} + action: {为了|wèi le}{保护|bǎo hù}{环境|huán jìng}{而|ér}{选择|xuǎn zé}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}. {而|ér} marks the step from the purpose to what is done, so it stands between them, never before {为了|wèi le} or after the action.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {明天|míng tiān}{要|yào}{下雨|xià yǔ}，___ {你|nǐ}{带|dài}{把|bǎ}{伞|sǎn}{吧|ba}。 (It's going to rain tomorrow, so take an umbrella.)
questions.explanation: Advice about the future takes {所以|suǒ yǐ}. {于是|yú shì} tells what happened next in a story ({下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}，{于是|yú shì}{我们|wǒ men}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{了|le}) and can't introduce a suggestion. {即使|jí shǐ} would need {也|yě}, and {而|ér} doesn't link a cause to advice.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {他|tā}{听说|tīng shuō}{塑料袋|sù liào dài}{对|duì}{环境|huán jìng}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}，___ {每|měi}{次|cì}{买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}{都|dōu}{自己|zì jǐ}{带|dài}{袋子|dài zi}。 (He heard plastic bags were bad for the environment, so now he takes his own bag every time.)
questions.explanation: One event (hearing about plastic bags) leads to the next (taking his own bag): {于是|yú shì}. {即使|jí shǐ} and {尽管|jǐn guǎn} are "even if" and "although", and {不如|bù rú} compares ("not as good as").

questions.stem: What does "{你|nǐ}{不|bù}{说|shuō}{我|wǒ}{也|yě}{知道|zhī dào}。" mean?
choices: If you don't tell me, I won't know.
Even if you don't tell me, I know.
Tell me, and I'll know too.
questions.explanation: A compressed sentence: {不|bù}…{也|yě} is "even if not…, still…", the same as {即使|jí shǐ}{你|nǐ}{不|bù}{说|shuō}，{我|wǒ}{也|yě}{知道|zhī dào}. "If you don't tell me, I won't know" would be {你|nǐ}{不|bù}{说|shuō}{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "However busy you are, you have to eat."?
questions.explanation: {再|zài} + adjective + {也|yě}: "however… still": {再|zài}{忙|máng}{也|yě}{要|yào}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn} (spoken in full: {就是|jiù shì}{再|zài}{忙|máng}，{也|yě}{要|yào}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}). {就|jiù} doesn't fit "however", and {再|zài} must come before the adjective.

questions.stem: What does "{你|nǐ}{不|bù}{来|lái}{我|wǒ}{不|bù}{走|zǒu}。" mean?
choices: I won't leave until you come.
You don't come, and I don't go.
If you go, I won't come.
Neither of us wants to go.
questions.explanation: {不|bù}…{不|bù}… is "if not…, then not…": if you don't come, I won't leave, that is, I'll wait until you come. It's the pattern of the set phrase {不见不散|bú jiàn bú sàn} (see you there: I'll wait until we meet).

questions.stem: Which would you see on a sign meaning "No smoking"?
questions.explanation: Signs use {禁止|jìn zhǐ} + verb, with the written {吸烟|xī yān}: {禁止|jìn zhǐ}{吸烟|xī yān}. {别|bié}{抽烟|chōu yān}{了|le}{吧|ba} is a friendly spoken request, {你|nǐ}{不|bù}{能|néng}{抽烟|chōu yān}{吗|ma} a question, and {抽烟|chōu yān}{禁止|jìn zhǐ} has the wrong order ({禁止|jìn zhǐ} comes first, like any verb).

questions.stem: Choose the word: {为了|wèi le}___ {垃圾|lā jī}，{我们|wǒ men}{少|shǎo}{用|yòng}{塑料袋|sù liào dài}。 (To cut down on rubbish, we use fewer plastic bags.)
questions.explanation: {减少|jiǎn shǎo} is to reduce: {减少|jiǎn shǎo}{垃圾|lā jī}. {增加|zēng jiā} and {增长|zēng zhǎng} are its opposites (more, not less), and {浪费|làng fèi} is to waste.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {菜|cài}{点|diǎn}{得|de}{太|tài}{多|duō}{了|le}，{吃|chī}{不|bu}{完|wán}{就|jiù}___ {了|le}。 (We've ordered too much: if we can't finish it, it'll go to waste.)
questions.explanation: Food left uneaten is wasted: {浪费|làng fèi}. {节约|jié yuē} is its opposite (to save), {污染|wū rǎn} is to pollute and {禁止|jìn zhǐ} to prohibit.

questions.stem: Where does the sentence "{于是|yú shì}{他|tā}{决定|jué dìng}{骑|qí}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{上班|shàng bān}。" fit best? "{小李|Xiǎo Lǐ}{家|jiā}{离|lí}{公司|gōng sī}{不|bù}{远|yuǎn}，{以前|yǐ qián}{他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{开车|kāi chē}{上班|shàng bān}。(A) {去年|qù nián}{他|tā}{看|kàn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{关于|guān yú}{空气|kōng qì}{污染|wū rǎn}{的|de}{节目|jié mù}。(B) {现在|xiàn zài}{他|tā}{已经|yǐ jīng}{骑|qí}{了|le}{一|yì}{年|nián}{了|le}。(C) {他|tā}{觉得|jué de}{身体|shēn tǐ}{也|yě}{比|bǐ}{以前|yǐ qián}{好|hǎo}{了|le}。(D)"
questions.explanation: {于是|yú shì} needs an event before it that leads to the decision: the programme about air pollution. After it, {现在|xiàn zài}{他|tā}{已经|yǐ jīng}{骑|qí}{了|le} {一|yì}{年|nián}{了|le} follows naturally. At A nothing has happened yet to cause the change; at C and D he is already cycling.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {环保|huán bǎo} (environmental protection): a rising tone, then a dipping one, 2+3.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {污染|wū rǎn} (pollution): a high level tone, then a dipping one, 1+3.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? {禁|jìn}___ (to prohibit)
questions.explanation: {禁止|jìn zhǐ} jìn zhǐ. {={止|zhǐ} has four strokes: the short vertical in the middle first. {正|zhèng} ({正确|zhèng què}) has one more horizontal on top; {上|shàng} and {土|tǔ} have only one vertical.=}

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {这|zhè}{几|jǐ}{年|nián}{来|lái}{中国|Zhōng guó}{留学|liú xué}{的|de}{人|rén}___ {加|jiā}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。 (The number of people coming to China to study has grown a lot in recent years.)
questions.explanation: {增加|zēng jiā} zēng jiā (to increase). {={增|zēng} is {土|tǔ} + {曾|céng} (15 strokes); {曾|céng} gives the sound.=}

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: To protect the environment, he cycles to work every day.
questions.explanation: {为了|wèi le}{保护|bǎo hù}{环境|huán jìng}，{他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{骑|qí}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{上班|shàng bān}。 The purpose with {为了|wèi le} comes first (the subject can come before it: {他|tā}{为了|wèi le}{保护|bǎo hù}{环境|huán jìng}， …). {于是|yú shì} tells what happened next in a story; it doesn't state a purpose.

questions.stem: Listen to the announcement. What should drivers do?

audio.text: 这儿禁止停车，请把车停到前面的停车场。

choices: park in the car park ahead
wait for a parking space here
questions.explanation: {这儿|zhèr}{禁止|jìn zhǐ}{停车|tíng chē} (no parking here), {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{车|chē}{停|tíng}{到|dào}{前面|qián miàn}{的|de}{停车场|tíng chē chǎng} (please park in the car park ahead).

questions.stem: Listen. What did they do in the end?

audio.text: 下了一天的雨，于是我们没去公园，在家看了一个电影。

choices: went to the park in the rain
stayed at home and watched a film
waited for the rain to stop and went out
questions.explanation: {下|xià}{了|le}{一|yì}{天|tiān}{的|de}{雨|yǔ} (it rained all day), {于是|yú shì} (so) {我们|wǒ men}{没|méi}{去|qù}{公园|gōng yuán}，{在|zài}{家|jiā}{看|kàn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{电影|diàn yǐng} (we didn't go to the park; we watched a film at home).

questions.stem: Listen. What should the staff do from next week?

audio.text: 为了减少垃圾，从下周起，公司不再提供塑料杯子，请大家自己带杯子。

questions.explanation: {不再|bú zài}{提供|tí gōng}{塑料|sù liào}{杯子|bēi zi} (plastic cups will no longer be provided), {请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{自己|zì jǐ}{带|dài}{杯子|bēi zi} (please bring your own). The purpose comes first: {为了|wèi le}{减少|jiǎn shǎo}{垃圾|lā jī}.

questions.stem: Listen. How does the speaker feel?

audio.text: 你不说我也知道乱扔垃圾不对。可是周围一个垃圾桶也没有，我能怎么办？

choices: They are proud of what they did.
They didn't know it was wrong.
They know it was wrong but feel they had no choice.

questions.stem: The erhu is played with a bow. How do you say "play the erhu"?
questions.explanation: A bowed instrument is "pulled": {拉|lā}{二胡|èr hú}, {拉|lā}{小提琴|xiǎo tí qín}. {弹|tán} is for the piano and plucked strings, {吹|chuī} for wind instruments ({吹|chuī}{笛子|dí zi}), {打|dǎ} for drums.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {他|tā}{在|zài}{这个|zhè ge}{电影|diàn yǐng}{里|lǐ}___ {一|yí}{个|gè}{医生|yī shēng}。 (He plays a doctor in this film.)
questions.explanation: "To play (a part)" is {演|yǎn}: {演|yǎn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{医生|yī shēng}. {演出|yǎn chū} is a performance or "to perform, put on (a show)", and doesn't take a role as its object; {演员|yǎn yuán} is the actor; {演唱|yǎn chàng} is to sing on stage.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{这个|zhè ge}{演出|yǎn chū}。{首先|shǒu xiān}，{演员|yǎn yuán}{演|yǎn}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}；___，{音乐|yīn yuè}{很|hěn}{好听|hǎo tīng}；{最后|zuì hòu}，{票|piào}{也|yě}{不|bú}{贵|guì}。
questions.explanation: {首先|shǒu xiān}…{其次|qí cì}…{最后|zuì hòu} lists points: first, second, finally. {总之|zǒng zhī} sums up at the end, {于是|yú shì} tells what happened next in a story, and {即使|jí shǐ} is "even if".

questions.stem: Choose the word for a step in time: {首先|shǒu xiān}{把|bǎ}{手|shǒu}{洗|xǐ}{干净|gān jìng}，___ {吃|chī}{饭|fàn}。 (First wash your hands, then eat.)
questions.explanation: Steps in time follow {首先|shǒu xiān} with {然后|rán hòu}: {首先|shǒu xiān}…{然后|rán hòu}…. {其次|qí cì} is for the second point of an argument, {总之|zǒng zhī} for a conclusion, and {而且|ér qiě} adds "and what's more".

questions.stem: Choose the word to open the last sentence of a composition: "……___，{这|zhè}{是|shì}{一|yí}{次|cì}{难忘|nán wàng}{的|de}{演出|yǎn chū}。"
questions.explanation: {总之|zǒng zhī} (in short, all in all) opens a conclusion. {首先|shǒu xiān} and {其次|qí cì} introduce the first and second points, and {于是|yú shì} tells what happened next.

questions.stem: Where does the sentence "{其次|qí cì}，{音乐|yīn yuè}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{好听|hǎo tīng}。" fit best? "{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{昨天|zuó tiān}{的|de}{演出|yǎn chū}。{首先|shǒu xiān}，{演员|yǎn yuán}{演|yǎn}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。(A) {最后|zuì hòu}，{票|piào}{也|yě}{不|bú}{贵|guì}。(B) {总之|zǒng zhī}，{我|wǒ}{还|hái}{想|xiǎng}{再|zài}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{一|yí}{次|cì}。(C)"
questions.explanation: {其次|qí cì} is the second point, so it comes between {首先|shǒu xiān} and {最后|zuì hòu}: at A. After {最后|zuì hòu} (B) or {总之|zǒng zhī} (C), a second point is out of place.

questions.stem: A picture shows a girl playing the piano on a stage; the word given is {弹|tán}. Which sentence does the writing task best?
choices: {她|tā}{在|zài}{台上|tái shàng}{弹|tán}{钢琴|gāng qín}，{弹|tán}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
questions.explanation: The task wants a sentence that uses the word and says something about the picture: {她|tā}{在|zài}{台上|tái shàng}{弹|tán}{钢琴|gāng qín}，{弹|tán}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo} (she's playing the piano on stage, and playing well). The others are correct Chinese but don't describe the picture (the last doesn't even use {弹|tán}). ({乐器|yuè qì}: a musical instrument.)

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {钢琴|gāng qín} (piano): a high level tone, then a rising one, 1+2.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {艺术|yì shù} (art): two falling tones, 4+4.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word? ___ {剧|jù} (Peking opera)
questions.explanation: {京剧|jīng jù} jīng jù. {=All four contain {京|jīng}: {景|jǐng} ({景色|jǐng sè}, lesson 18) puts {日|rì} on top of it, {就|jiù} adds {尤|yóu} on the right, and {凉|liáng} ({凉快|liáng kuai}) adds 冫 on the left. {京|jīng} alone is the capital, the {京|jīng} of {北京|Běi jīng}.=}

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {我|wǒ}{爷爷|yé ye}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{听|tīng}___ {剧|jù}。 (My grandpa loves listening to Peking opera.)
questions.explanation: {京剧|jīng jù} jīng jù. {={京|jīng}: 亠, then {口|kǒu}, then {小|xiǎo} (8 strokes).=}

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: First of all, I want to thank everyone for their support.
questions.explanation: {首先|shǒu xiān}，{我|wǒ}{要|yào}{感谢|gǎn xiè}{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{支持|zhī chí}。 {首先|shǒu xiān} opens the first point; {其次|qí cì} would be a second one, out of place at the start.

questions.stem: Listen. What is on at the theatre tonight?

audio.text: 今天晚上七点半，剧院有一场京剧演出。

choices: a film at half past eight
questions.explanation: {七|qī}{点|diǎn}{半|bàn} (half past seven), {一|yì}{场|chǎng}{京剧|jīng jù}{演出|yǎn chū} (a Peking opera performance; {场|chǎng} is its measure word).

questions.stem: Listen. Why didn't the speaker go?

audio.text: 这个歌手的歌声很好听，可是她的演唱会票太贵了，我没去。

choices: They had to work that evening.
questions.explanation: {歌声|gē shēng}{很|hěn}{好听|hǎo tīng} (her singing is lovely), {可是|kě shì}…{票|piào}{太|tài}{贵|guì}{了|le} (but the tickets were too expensive): the reason comes after {可是|kě shì}. ({演唱会|yǎn chàng huì}: a singer's concert.)

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker ask the audience to do?

audio.text: 首先，感谢大家来看我们的演出。其次，演出的时候请大家把手机关上。

questions.explanation: {首先|shǒu xiān} thanks the audience; {其次|qí cì} makes the second point: {演出|yǎn chū}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{把|bǎ}{手机|shǒu jī}{关上|guān shàng} (please switch your phones off during the show).

questions.stem: Listen. How does the speaker feel about the play?

audio.text: 说实话，这个话剧我已经看了两次了，还想再看一次。

choices: They liked it at first but not now.
They love it and want to see it again.
questions.explanation: {看|kàn}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{次|cì}{了|le}，{还|hái}{想|xiǎng}{再|zài}{看|kàn}{一|yí}{次|cì}: they've seen it twice and want to see it once more. {说实话|shuō shí huà} is "to be honest".

questions.stem: Read: "{昨天|zuó tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{的|de}{钢琴|gāng qín}{演出|yǎn chū}{非常|fēi cháng}{精彩|jīng cǎi}。{钢琴家|gāng qín jiā}{今年|jīn nián}{才|cái}{二十|èr shí}{岁|suì}，{可是|kě shì}{弹|tán}{得|de}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{也|yě}{不|bù}{比|bǐ}{那些|nà xiē}{有名|yǒu míng}{的|de}{钢琴家|gāng qín jiā}{差|chà}。{最后|zuì hòu}{一|yì}{首|shǒu}{弹|tán}{完|wán}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{观众|guān zhòng}{站|zhàn}{起来|qǐ lái}{鼓掌|gǔ zhǎng}，{鼓|gǔ}{了|le}{五|wǔ}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{还|hái}{不|bù}{停|tíng}，{她|tā}{只好|zhǐ hǎo}{又|yòu}{弹|tán}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{首|shǒu}。" ({鼓掌|gǔ zhǎng}: to clap, HSK 5) Why did the pianist play two more pieces?
choices: The audience wouldn't stop clapping: they wanted more.
She had made a mistake and played them again.
The famous pianists asked her to.
questions.explanation: The text doesn't say "they asked for more", but the order of events shows it: the audience stood and clapped for five minutes and didn't stop ({鼓|gǔ}{了|le}{五|wǔ}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{还|hái}{不|bù}{停|tíng}), so she had to play two more ({只好|zhǐ hǎo}{又|yòu}{弹|tán}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{首|shǒu}). {一点儿|yì diǎnr}{也|yě}{不|bù}{比|bǐ}…{差|chà} is "not at all worse than", that is, as good as the famous pianists.

collect them free from the school's office before the 28th, two at most each

questions.stem: Read the notice: "{新年|xīn nián}{音乐会|yīn yuè huì}　{各位|gè wèi}{老师|lǎo shī}、{各位|gè wèi}{同学|tóng xué}：{为了|wèi le}{庆祝|qìng zhù}{新年|xīn nián}，{学校|xué xiào}{艺术|yì shù}{学院|xué yuàn}{将|jiāng}{在|zài}{十二|shí'èr}{月|yuè}{三十|sān shí}{日|rì}{晚上|wǎn shang}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}，{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{剧院|jù yuàn}{举办|jǔ bàn}{新年|xīn nián}{音乐会|yīn yuè huì}。{这|zhè}{次|cì}{演出|yǎn chū}{一共|yí gòng}{有|yǒu}{十|shí}{个|gè}{节目|jié mù}。{首先|shǒu xiān}，{艺术|yì shù}{学院|xué yuàn}{的|de}{两|liǎng}{位|wèi}{钢琴|gāng qín}{老师|lǎo shī}{会|huì}{为|wèi}{大家|dà jiā}{弹|tán}{几|jǐ}{首|shǒu}{中国|Zhōng guó}{作品|zuò pǐn}；{其次|qí cì}，{学生|xué sheng}{合唱团|hé chàng tuán}{将|jiāng}{演唱|yǎn chàng}{几|jǐ}{首|shǒu}{大家|dà jiā}{熟悉|shú xī}{的|de}{老|lǎo}{歌|gē}；{然后|rán hòu}{是|shì}{京剧|jīng jù}{和|hé}{话剧|huà jù}{演员|yǎn yuán}{的|de}{表演|biǎo yǎn}；{最后|zuì hòu}，{所有|suǒ yǒu}{的|de}{演员|yǎn yuán}{会|huì}{和|hé}{观众|guān zhòng}{一起|yì qǐ}{唱|chàng}{一|yì}{首|shǒu}{新年|xīn nián}{歌|gē}。{演出|yǎn chū}{是|shì}{免费|miǎn fèi}{的|de}，{可是|kě shì}{剧院|jù yuàn}{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{五百|wǔ bǎi}{个|gè}{座位|zuò wèi}，{所以|suǒ yǐ}{请|qǐng}{在|zài}{二十八|èr shí bā}{日|rì}{以前|yǐ qián}{到|dào}{艺术|yì shù}{学院|xué yuàn}{办公室|bàn gōng shì}{拿|ná}{票|piào}，{每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{最|zuì}{多|duō}{拿|ná}{两|liǎng}{张|zhāng}。{请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{注意|zhù yì}：{一|yī}、{请|qǐng}{提前|tí qián}{十五|shí wǔ}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{进入|jìn rù}{剧院|jù yuàn}，{演出|yǎn chū}{开始|kāi shǐ}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{要|yào}{等|děng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{节目|jié mù}{结束|jié shù}{才|cái}{能|néng}{进去|jìn qù}。{二|èr}、{演出|yǎn chū}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{手机|shǒu jī}{关|guān}{上|shàng}，{禁止|jìn zhǐ}{拍照|pāi zhào}。{三|sān}、{请|qǐng}{不要|bú yào}{在|zài}{剧院|jù yuàn}{里|lǐ}{吃|chī}{东西|dōng xi}。{我们|wǒ men}{相信|xiāng xìn}，{这|zhè}{将|jiāng}{是|shì}{一|yì}{场|chǎng}{精彩|jīng cǎi}{的|de}{演出|yǎn chū}。{欢迎|huān yíng}{大家|dà jiā}{来|lái}{听|tīng}，{也|yě}{欢迎|huān yíng}{带|dài}{家人|jiā rén}{和|hé}{朋友|péng you}{一起|yì qǐ}{来|lái}！　{艺术|yì shù}{学院|xué yuàn}　{十二|shí'èr}{月|yuè}{十五|shí wǔ}{日|rì}" ({音乐会|yīn yuè huì}: a concert; {合唱团|hé chàng tuán}: a choir) Someone arrives after the concert has started. What must they do?
choices: wait for the end of a piece before going in
go home: latecomers can't go in
collect a new ticket at the office
questions.explanation: {演出|yǎn chū}{开始|kāi shǐ}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{要|yào}{等|děng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{节目|jié mù}{结束|jié shù}{才|cái}{能|néng}{进去|jìn qù}: once the concert has begun, you wait for an item to finish before going in. {才|cái} after the condition: "only then".

questions.stem: According to the reports on the sample papers that this course used, how many questions does the new HSK 4 written exam have?
questions.explanation: As reported: listening 32, reading 32 and writing 6, 70 questions in about 85 minutes (the 85 is minutes, not questions). The speaking test, about 20 minutes, comes on top. Check the official site, chinesetest.cn, before you register: formats can change.

questions.stem: In the reported format, which part of the written exam asks you to put sentences back into a passage?
questions.explanation: The reading part, as reported, has three kinds of task: a word for each gap (six choices, one extra), short passages with questions, and putting sentences back into a passage.

questions.stem: In the reported format, how long must the short text in the writing part be at least?
questions.explanation: As reported, the last writing task is a short text of at least 80 characters; the other five items are sentences with given words about pictures. (The 2021 standard's level 4 speaks of 300 characters for its own, larger level; the exam asks for less.)

questions.stem: Choose the word for the gap: {他|tā}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}___ {流利|liú lì}。 (He speaks Chinese very fluently.)
questions.explanation: Decide the part of speech first: after {说|shuō}{得|de} and before the adjective {流利|liú lì} comes a degree adverb, {非常|fēi cháng}. {即使|jí shǐ}, {于是|yú shì} and {而且|ér qiě} join clauses; they can't modify an adjective.

questions.stem: What does "{难道|nán dào}{你|nǐ}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{明天|míng tiān}{考试|kǎo shì}{吗|ma}？" mean?
choices: Do you know whether there's an exam tomorrow?
You must know there's an exam tomorrow!
There isn't an exam tomorrow, is there?
I don't know about tomorrow's exam.
questions.explanation: {难道|nán dào}…{吗|ma} is rhetorical: a negative question that makes a positive point. "Surely you know there's an exam tomorrow!" It isn't a real question, and the speaker isn't unsure.

questions.stem: Choose the word: ___ {你|nǐ}{已经|yǐ jīng}{决定|jué dìng}{了|le}，{就|jiù}{别|bié}{再|zài}{担心|dān xīn}{了|le}。 (Since you've already decided, stop worrying.)
questions.explanation: "Since (given that)… then" is {既然|jì rán}…{就|jiù} (lesson 01). {即使|jí shǐ} pairs with {也|yě}, {尽管|jǐn guǎn} with {但是|dàn shì} / {还是|hái shi}, {不管|bù guǎn} with {都|dōu}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: ___ {天气|tiān qì}{多么|duō me}{冷|lěng}，{他|tā}{都|dōu}{坚持|jiān chí}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{跑步|pǎo bù}。 (However cold it is, he keeps running every day.)
questions.explanation: {多么|duō me} (or a question word) after the first word and {都|dōu} in the second clause: {不管|bù guǎn}…{都|dōu} (lesson 25). {即使|jí shǐ} would take {也|yě} and no {多么|duō me}; {既然|jì rán} needs {就|jiù}; {尽管|jǐn guǎn} is for a single fact, not "whatever". ({坚持|jiān chí}: to keep at it.)

questions.stem: Choose the word: ___ {工作|gōng zuò}{很|hěn}{忙|máng}，{但是|dàn shì}{他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{都|dōu}{学|xué}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。 (Although he is busy at work, he studies Chinese for an hour every day.)
questions.explanation: A fact (he is busy) and a contrast with {但是|dàn shì}: {尽管|jǐn guǎn}…{但是|dàn shì} (lesson 14). {即使|jí shǐ} is for a supposition and pairs with {也|yě}; {既然|jì rán} pairs with {就|jiù}; {只要|zhǐ yào} with {就|jiù}.

questions.stem: What does "{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{不如|bù rú}{骑|qí}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{快|kuài}。" mean?
choices: The metro is faster than cycling.
Cycling is faster than the metro.
The metro and cycling are equally fast.
Neither the metro nor cycling is fast.
questions.explanation: A {不如|bù rú} B + adjective: A is not as… as B (lesson 09). Taking the metro isn't as fast as cycling, so cycling is faster.

questions.stem: Which sentence means the same as "{我|wǒ}{不得不|bù dé bú}{去|qù}。"?
questions.explanation: {不得不|bù dé bù} is a double negative (lesson 10): "can't not", that is, have to: {我|wǒ}{必须|bì xū}{去|qù} (I must go). {不用|bú yòng} is "don't need to", the opposite.

questions.stem: What does "{我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{叫|jiào}{人|rén}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。" mean?
choices: I called someone to ride my bike.
Someone rode off on my bike.
My bike is called by someone.
questions.explanation: {叫|jiào} + doer + verb is a spoken passive (lesson 19), like {被|bèi}: my bike was ridden off by someone. Here {叫|jiào} doesn't mean "to call".

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Please check your homework carefully once.
questions.explanation: {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{作业|zuò yè}{认真|rèn zhēn}{地|de}{检查|jiǎn chá}{一|yí}{遍|biàn}。 The extended {把|bǎ} sentence (lesson 02): {把|bǎ} + object, an adverbial before the verb ({认真|rèn zhēn}{地|de}), and the frequency after it ({一|yí}{遍|biàn}). {被|bèi} would make it passive, which a request can't be.

questions.stem: Putting sentences back into a passage: which word at the start of a sentence tells you that a cause must come just before it?
questions.explanation: {于是|yú shì} (so, and then) needs an event before it that leads to what follows; so do {因此|yīn cǐ} and {所以|suǒ yǐ}. {首先|shǒu xiān} opens a list, and {尽管|jǐn guǎn} and {即使|jí shǐ} open a clause of their own.

questions.stem: Write the missing character (in characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {这|zhè}{次|cì}{面试|miàn shì}{他|tā}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{结果|jié guǒ}{很|hěn}{顺|shùn}___。 (He prepared well for the interview, and it went smoothly.)
questions.explanation: {顺利|shùn lì} shùn lì (smooth, without a hitch: lesson 17), a level-4 handwriting character from {流利|liú lì} (lesson 12). {={利|lì} is 禾 + 刂.=}

questions.stem: What does "{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{由|yóu}{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}{负责|fù zé}。" mean?
choices: Xiao Wang is in charge of this.
This happened because of Xiao Wang.
Xiao Wang is not responsible for this.
questions.explanation: {由|yóu} + person + verb marks who does a job, in writing (lesson 13): this is Xiao Wang's responsibility. Because of him would be {由于|yóu yú}{小王|Xiǎo Wáng} or {因为|yīn wèi}{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}.

questions.stem: Listen. Will the speaker go to the Peking opera this Saturday?

audio.text: 我本来想周六去看京剧，可是公司让我加班，只好下次再去了。

questions.explanation: {本来|běn lái}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù} (I was going to), {可是|kě shì}{公司|gōng sī}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{加班|jiā bān} (but my company wants me to work), {只好|zhǐ hǎo}{下|xià}{次|cì}{再|zài}{去|qù}{了|le} (so it'll have to be next time). The answer follows {可是|kě shì}.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker mean?

audio.text: 你难道没看通知吗？明天的考试推迟到下周一了。

choices: The listener should know the exam has moved to next Monday.
The speaker hasn't seen the notice yet.
questions.explanation: {难道|nán dào}{没|méi}{看|kàn}{通知|tōng zhī}{吗|ma}？ is rhetorical: "didn't you read the notice?", meaning you should have. The news follows: {推迟|tuī chí}{到|dào}{下周|xià zhōu}{一|yī} (postponed to next Monday), not cancelled ({取消|qǔ xiāo}).

questions.stem: Listen to the announcement. What should candidates do first?

audio.text: 各位考生，听力考试现在开始。请先看题，再听录音。

questions.explanation: {请|qǐng}{先|xiān}{看|kàn}{题|tí}，{再|zài}{听|tīng}{录音|lù yīn}: read the questions first, then listen to the recording ({录音|lù yīn}). It's the strategy of this lesson too: read the choices before the audio.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {顺利|shùn lì} (smoothly): two falling tones, 4+4.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {考生|kǎo shēng} (exam candidate): a dipping tone, then a high level one, 3+1.

questions.stem: Read the notice for a Chinese exam at a language school: "{考生|kǎo shēng}{须知|xū zhī}　{一|yī}、{请|qǐng}{在|zài}{考试|kǎo shì}{开始|kāi shǐ}{前|qián}{三十|sān shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{到|dào}{考场|kǎo chǎng}。{考试|kǎo shì}{开始|kāi shǐ}{二十|èr shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{迟到|chí dào}{的|de}{考生|kǎo shēng}{不|bù}{能|néng}{再|zài}{进入|jìn rù}{考场|kǎo chǎng}。{二|èr}、{进入|jìn rù}{考场|kǎo chǎng}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{请|qǐng}{带|dài}{好|hǎo}{身份证|shēn fèn zhèng}{和|hé}{准考证|zhǔn kǎo zhèng}，{把|bǎ}{它们|tā men}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}，{方便|fāng biàn}{老师|lǎo shī}{检查|jiǎn chá}。{三|sān}、{手机|shǒu jī}、{手表|shǒu biǎo}{等|děng}{东西|dōng xi}{必须|bì xū}{关|guān}{上|shàng}，{放|fàng}{在|zài}{考场|kǎo chǎng}{前面|qián miàn}{的|de}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}，{不|bù}{能|néng}{带|dài}{到|dào}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{座位|zuò wèi}{上|shàng}。{四|sì}、{考试|kǎo shì}{分为|fēn wéi}{听力|tīng lì}、{阅读|yuè dú}{和|hé}{写作|xiě zuò}{三|sān}{个|gè}{部分|bù fen}。{听力|tīng lì}{部分|bù fen}{的|de}{录音|lù yīn}{只|zhǐ}{播放|bō fàng}{一|yí}{遍|biàn}，{请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{认真|rèn zhēn}{听|tīng}。{听力|tīng lì}{结束|jié shù}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{大家|dà jiā}{有|yǒu}{五|wǔ}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{的|de}{时间|shí jiān}{把|bǎ}{答案|dá'àn}{写|xiě}{在|zài}{答题卡|dá tí kǎ}{上|shàng}。{五|wǔ}、{考试|kǎo shì}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{不|bù}{能|néng}{跟|gēn}{别人|bié ren}{说话|shuō huà}，{也|yě}{不|bù}{能|néng}{看|kàn}{别人|bié ren}{的|de}{答案|dá'àn}，{否则|fǒu zé}{这|zhè}{次|cì}{考试|kǎo shì}{的|de}{成绩|chéng jì}{就|jiù}{没有|méi yǒu}{用|yòng}{了|le}。{六|liù}、{如果|rú guǒ}{在|zài}{考试|kǎo shì}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{身体|shēn tǐ}{不|bù}{舒服|shū fu}，{或者|huò zhě}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{问题|wèn tí}，{请|qǐng}{举|jǔ}{手|shǒu}{告诉|gào su}{老师|lǎo shī}，{不要|bú yào}{自己|zì jǐ}{离开|lí kāi}{座位|zuò wèi}。{七|qī}、{考试|kǎo shì}{结束|jié shù}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{试卷|shì juàn}{和|hé}{答题卡|dá tí kǎ}{都|dōu}{留|liú}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}，{等|děng}{老师|lǎo shī}{收|shōu}{完|wán}{以后|yǐ hòu}{再|zài}{离开|lí kāi}{考场|kǎo chǎng}。{最后|zuì hòu}，{祝|zhù}{各位|gè wèi}{考生|kǎo shēng}{考试|kǎo shì}{顺利|shùn lì}，{取得|qǔ dé}{好|hǎo}{成绩|chéng jì}！" ({须知|xū zhī}: points to note; {考场|kǎo chǎng}: the exam room; {准考证|zhǔn kǎo zhèng}: an admission ticket (for an exam); {答题卡|dá tí kǎ}: an answer sheet; {试卷|shì juàn}: an exam paper; {写作|xiě zuò}: writing; {录音|lù yīn}: a recording) Which candidate may not go into the exam room?
choices: one who arrives thirty minutes early
one who has a mobile phone
one who arrives more than twenty minutes after the start
questions.explanation: {考试|kǎo shì}{开始|kāi shǐ}{二十|èr shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{迟到|chí dào}{的|de}{考生|kǎo shēng}{不|bù}{能|néng}{再|zài}{进入|jìn rù}{考场|kǎo chǎng}: from twenty minutes after the start, latecomers can't go in. A phone is allowed in the room, switched off on the front table.

questions.stem: Which Chinese instrument has seven strings, no bridges, and is played lying flat on a table?
questions.explanation: The guqin: seven strings, plucked, played flat on a table, and no bridges. The guzheng is also played flat but has movable bridges (usually 21 strings); the pipa (four strings) and the erhu (two) are held upright.

questions.stem: How do you say "to play the erhu", a bowed instrument?
questions.explanation: The erhu is bowed, so the verb is {拉|lā} (to pull): {拉|lā}{二胡|èr hú}. The guqin, guzheng and pipa are plucked: {弹|tán}{古琴|gǔ qín}, {弹|tán}{古筝|gǔ zhēng}, {弹|tán}{琵琶|pí pa}.

questions.stem: What is unusual about the bow of the erhu?
choices: It is made of bamboo strings.
Its hair passes between the two strings.
It is used to strike the strings.
questions.explanation: The hair of the erhu's bow passes between its two strings, so bow and instrument stay together. It is drawn across the strings, as with any bow.

questions.stem: On a guzheng, what do the small movable bridges under the strings do?
choices: They change the tuning when they are moved.
They stop the strings from breaking.
questions.explanation: Each string of the guzheng rests on its own movable bridge; moving it changes the string's pitch, so the bridges set the tuning. The guqin has none, the easiest way to tell the two zithers apart.

questions.stem: According to UNESCO, in which year was "guqin and its music" proclaimed a Masterpiece of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity?
questions.explanation: In 2003; in 2008 it was inscribed on the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity, along with the other proclaimed Masterpieces.

questions.stem: Read the programme note: "{琵琶|pí pa}{有|yǒu}{四|sì}{根|gēn}{弦|xián}，{演员|yǎn yuán}{抱|bào}{着|zhe}{它|tā}{弹|tán}。{这|zhè}{首|shǒu}{曲子|qǔ zi}{讲|jiǎng}{的|de}{是|shì}{两千|liǎng qiān}{多|duō}{年|nián}{前|qián}{的|de}{一|yì}{场|chǎng}{大战|dà zhàn}，{演员|yǎn yuán}{弹|tán}{得|de}{非常|fēi cháng}{快|kuài}，{你|nǐ}{好像|hǎo xiàng}{能|néng}{听|tīng}{到|dào}{马|mǎ}{的|de}{声音|shēng yīn}。" ({根|gēn}: measure word for strings; {曲子|qǔ zi}: piece of music) What does the note say about the piece?
choices: It is a slow love song.
It describes a great battle and is played very fast.
It was written two thousand years ago.
It is played on four instruments.
questions.explanation: {讲|jiǎng}{的|de}{是|shì}{两千|liǎng qiān}{多|duō}{年|nián}{前|qián}{的|de}{一|yì}{场|chǎng}{大战|dà zhàn} (it tells of a great battle over two thousand years ago) and {弹|tán}{得|de}{非常|fēi cháng}{快|kuài} (played very fast). The battle is ancient; the note doesn't say the music is that old. {四|sì}{根|gēn}{弦|xián} is the pipa's four strings.

questions.stem: Read the programme note: "{古琴|gǔ qín}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{最|zuì}{古老|gǔ lǎo}{的|de}{乐器|yuè qì}{之一|zhī yī}……{它|tā}{的|de}{声音|shēng yīn}{不|bú}{大|dà}，{很|hěn}{安静|ān jìng}，{适合|shì hé}{在|zài}{小|xiǎo}{房间|fáng jiān}{里|lǐ}{听|tīng}。" ({古老|gǔ lǎo}: ancient; {乐器|yuè qì}: instrument) Where does the note suggest the guqin sounds best?
questions.explanation: {声音|shēng yīn}{不|bú}{大|dà}，{很|hěn}{安静|ān jìng} (its sound isn't loud; it's quiet), {适合|shì hé}{在|zài}{小|xiǎo}{房间|fáng jiān}{里|lǐ}{听|tīng} (suited to listening in a small room). UNESCO likewise describes it as played "in intimate settings".

questions.stem: Read the programme note: "{二胡|èr hú}{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{两|liǎng}{根|gēn}{弦|xián}，{用|yòng}{弓|gōng}{来|lái}{拉|lā}。{它|tā}{的|de}{声音|shēng yīn}{很|hěn}{像|xiàng}{人|rén}{的|de}{歌声|gē shēng}，{可以|kě yǐ}{表达|biǎo dá}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{感情|gǎn qíng}。" ({弓|gōng}: bow; {表达|biǎo dá}: to express) What is the erhu's sound compared to?
questions.explanation: {它|tā}{的|de}{声音|shēng yīn}{很|hěn}{像|xiàng}{人|rén}{的|de}{歌声|gē shēng}: its sound is very like a human singing voice, and it can express many feelings ({表达|biǎo dá}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{感情|gǎn qíng}).

questions.stem: A concert programme ends: "{最后|zuì hòu}，{所有|suǒ yǒu}{的|de}{演员|yǎn yuán}{一起|yì qǐ}{演奏|yǎn zòu}{这|zhè}{首|shǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{中国|Zhōng guó}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{会|huì}{唱|chàng}{的|de}{歌|gē}。{欢迎|huān yíng}{大家|dà jiā}{跟|gēn}{着|zhe}{一起|yì qǐ}{唱|chàng}！" ({演奏|yǎn zòu}: to perform) What does this suggest about the last piece?
choices: Only the best performer plays it.
It is new and nobody knows it yet.
It is a well-known song that the audience can sing along to.
The audience must not make any sound.
questions.explanation: {很|hěn}{多|duō}{中国|Zhōng guó}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{会|huì}{唱|chàng} (many Chinese people can sing it) and {欢迎|huān yíng}{大家|dà jiā}{跟|gēn}{着|zhe}{一起|yì qǐ}{唱|chàng} (you're welcome to sing along): a familiar song, played by everyone together ({所有|suǒ yǒu}{的|de}{演员|yǎn yuán}{一起|yì qǐ}).

questions.stem: Which piece is a famous solo for the pipa?
choices: 《{二泉映月|Èr quán yìng yuè}》 (Moon Reflected on Second Spring)
《{渔舟唱晚|Yú zhōu chàng wǎn}》 (Fishing Boats Singing at Dusk)
《{十面埋伏|Shí miàn mái fú}》 (Ambush from Ten Sides)
questions.explanation: 《{十面埋伏|Shí miàn mái fú}》 is the pipa's best-known solo. 《{流水|Liú shuǐ}》 is a guqin piece, 《{二泉映月|Èr quán yìng yuè}》 an erhu piece by Hua Yanjun (Abing), and 《{渔舟唱晚|Yú zhōu chàng wǎn}》 a guzheng piece.

questions.stem: In 乐器 (musical instrument), how is 乐 read?
questions.explanation: In words about music, {乐|yuè} is yuè: {音乐|yīn yuè}, {乐器|yuè qì}, {乐曲|yuè qǔ}. In {快乐|kuài lè} (happy) the same character is lè.

questions.stem: What does {独奏|dú zòu} mean on a concert programme?
questions.explanation: {独奏|dú zòu} is a solo, one player alone; {合奏|hé zòu} is an ensemble, players together. ({独|dú}: alone; {合|hé}: together.)

questions.stem: In the Analects, what does "{子曰|Zǐ yuē}" at the start of an entry mean?
questions.explanation: {子|zǐ} (master) is how the Analects refers to Confucius, and {曰|yuē} is the classical "to say" (modern {说|shuō}): "the Master said".

questions.stem: In "{学|xué}{而|ér}{不|bù}{思|sī}{则|zé}{罔|wǎng}，{思|sī}{而|ér}{不|bù}{学|xué}{则|zé}{殆|dài}。", which modern word is closest to {则|zé}?
questions.explanation: {则|zé} is "then, in that case", the {则|zé} of {否则|fǒu zé} (otherwise): {学|xué}{而|ér}{不|bù}{思|sī}，{就|jiù}{会|huì}… ({而|ér} is the "and yet, but" between the two verbs.)

questions.stem: Which paraphrase fits "{学|xué}{而|ér}{不|bù}{思|sī}{则|zé}{罔|wǎng}，{思|sī}{而|ér}{不|bù}{学|xué}{则|zé}{殆|dài}。"?
choices: Learn first, and think only when you are old.
Learning without thinking leaves you lost; thinking without learning puts you at risk.
Thinking is more important than learning.
Only teachers should think about what they learn.
questions.explanation: The two halves mirror each other: {学|xué} without {思|sī} leads to {罔|wǎng} (confusion), {思|sī} without {学|xué} to {殆|dài} (danger, or, in some readings, idleness). Neither is ranked above the other: the line asks for both.

questions.stem: In "{己|jǐ}{所|suǒ}{不|bú}{欲|yù}，{勿|wù}{施|shī}{于|yú}{人|rén}。", what does {勿|wù} mean?
questions.explanation: {勿|wù} is the classical "do not", like {不要|bú yào}; you still see it on signs ({请勿|qǐng wù}{吸烟|xī yān}, lesson 28). {己|jǐ} is oneself, {所|suǒ}{欲|yù} "what one wants", {施|shī}{于|yú}{人|rén} "do to others".

questions.stem: Which modern Chinese sentence says the same as "{己|jǐ}{所|suǒ}{不|bú}{欲|yù}，{勿|wù}{施|shī}{于|yú}{人|rén}。"?
choices: {自己|zì jǐ}{想要|xiǎng yào}{的|de}，{都|dōu}{给|gěi}{别人|bié ren}。
{别人|bié ren}{不|bù}{想要|xiǎng yào}{的|de}，{自己|zì jǐ}{也|yě}{不要|bú yào}。
{自己|zì jǐ}{不|bú}{愿意|yuàn yì}{别人|bié ren}{对|duì}{自己|zì jǐ}{做|zuò}{的|de}{事|shì}，{也|yě}{不要|bú yào}{对|duì}{别人|bié ren}{做|zuò}。
{别人|bié ren}{做|zuò}{什么|shén me}，{自己|zì jǐ}{也|yě}{做|zuò}{什么|shén me}。
questions.explanation: {己|jǐ} is "oneself" and {人|rén} "others": what you don't want for yourself, don't do to others. The second choice turns the roles round, and the others change the meaning.

questions.stem: In Analects 15.24, the disciple Zigong ({子贡|Zǐ gòng}) asks for one word to live by. Which word does the Master give?
questions.explanation: {子曰|Zǐ yuē}：{其|qí}{恕|shù}{乎|hū}！{己|jǐ}{所|suǒ}{不|bú}{欲|yù}，{勿|wù}{施|shī}{于|yú}{人|rén}。 "Surely it's {恕|shù}!": putting yourself in another's place, judging how you treat others by how you would feel in their position.

questions.stem: In "{知|zhī}{之|zhī}{为|wéi}{知|zhī}{之|zhī}，{不|bù}{知|zhī}{为|wéi}{不|bù}{知|zhī}，{是|shì}知{也|yě}。", how is the last 知 read in most modern editions?
questions.explanation: The last {知|zhì} stands for {智|zhì}, wisdom, and is read {知|zhì}. The others are {知|zhī}, to know. {为|wéi} is "to take as", and {是|shì} the classical "this".

questions.stem: In "{知|zhī}{之|zhī}{为|wéi}{知|zhī}{之|zhī}，{不|bù}{知|zhī}{为|wéi}{不|bù}{知|zhī}，{是|shì}{知|zhì}{也|yě}。", what does {是|shì} mean?
questions.explanation: In classical Chinese {是|shì} is often "this" (modern {这|zhè}): "this is wisdom". You know the use from {于是|yú shì} ("upon this", lesson 28).

questions.stem: Which modern paraphrase fits "{知|zhī}{之|zhī}{为|wéi}{知|zhī}{之|zhī}，{不|bù}{知|zhī}{为|wéi}{不|bù}{知|zhī}，{是|shì}{知|zhì}{也|yě}。"?
choices: {知道|zhī dào}{就是|jiù shì}{知道|zhī dào}，{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{就是|jiù shì}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}，{这|zhè}{才|cái}{是|shì}{真正|zhēn zhèng}{的|de}{聪明|cōng ming}。
{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{的|de}{事情|shì qing}，{就|jiù}{说|shuō}{自己|zì jǐ}{知道|zhī dào}。
{知道|zhī dào}{的|de}{人|rén}{很|hěn}{多|duō}，{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{的|de}{人|rén}{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}。
{只有|zhǐ yǒu}{老师|lǎo shī}{才|cái}{知道|zhī dào}{答案|dá'àn}。
questions.explanation: "To take what you know as known, and what you don't know as not known: that is wisdom." The line is often quoted against pretending to know.

questions.stem: What is the Analects (《{论语|Lún yǔ}》)?
choices: a history of the Qin dynasty written by Confucius
sayings and conversations of Confucius and his disciples, put together by his followers
questions.explanation: The Analects collects short entries, sayings and conversations, put together by Confucius's followers after his death (traditionally dated 551–479 BCE); it is not a single work he wrote.

questions.stem: In "{己|jǐ}{所|suǒ}{不|bú}{欲|yù}", what does {所|suǒ} + verb ({所|suǒ}{欲|yù}) mean?
questions.explanation: {所|suǒ} + verb makes "what (one)…": {所|suǒ}{欲|yù}, what one wants; in modern Chinese, …{的|de}({东西|dōng xi}). {己|jǐ}{所|suǒ}{不|bú}{欲|yù} is "what you yourself do not want".

questions.stem: Which pair of halves mirror each other, with two characters swapped?
questions.explanation: {学|xué}{而|ér}{不|bù}{思|sī} and {思|sī}{而|ér}{不|bù}{学|xué} use the same four characters, with {学|xué} and {思|sī} changing places: the parallel shape that makes the saying easy to remember. {己|jǐ}{所|suǒ}{不|bú}{欲|yù} / {勿|wù}{施|shī}{于|yú}{人|rén} balance "oneself" against "others" but use different characters.

glossary.definition: The formal style of notices, signs, formal emails, news and exam texts ({书面语|shū miàn yǔ}). Many of its words are short forms from classical Chinese, each with an everyday partner: {此|cǐ} for {这|zhè}, {此外|cǐ wài} for {还|hái}{有|yǒu}, {入|rù} for {进|jìn}, {将|jiāng} for {会|huì}, {与|yǔ} for {和|hé}. Using them in a chat sounds stiff.

A word that points out which person or thing is meant: {这|zhè}, {那|nà}, the written {此|cǐ} (this), and {各|gè} (each, every), as in {各位|gè wèi}, {各种|gè zhǒng}, {各个|gè gè}. {任何|rèn hé} (any) belongs with them. A demonstrative goes before a noun or a measure word.

A complex sentence that takes a fact both speakers accept and draws a conclusion from it: {既然|jì rán}{你|nǐ}{已经|yǐ jīng}{决定|jué dìng}{了|le}，{就|jiù}{别|bié}{担心|dān xīn}{了|le}。 (Since you've decided, stop worrying.) The second clause is usually a suggestion, a decision or a question, with {就|jiù}, {那|nà}, {还|hái} or {也|yě}; {既然|jì rán} never pairs with {所以|suǒ yǐ}.

A sentence that goes one step further than expected: {连|lián}{小孩儿|xiǎo háir}{都|dōu}{知道|zhī dào} (even a child knows), {他|tā}{很|hěn}{忙|máng}，{甚至|shèn zhì}{周末|zhōu mò}{也|yě}{工作|gōng zuò} (he even works at weekends), {她|tā}{不仅|bù jǐn}{会|huì}{唱歌|chàng gē}，{还|hái}{会|huì}{跳舞|tiào wǔ} (not only… but also). HSK 3 met it with {不但|bú dàn}…{而且|ér qiě}.

A complex sentence that rejects one idea and puts the right one in its place: {不|bú}{是|shì} A ，{而是|ér shì} B (not A, but B). {我|wǒ}{不|bú}{是|shì}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}，{而是|ér shì}{没有|méi yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}。 Compare {不|bú}{是|shì} A ，{就是|jiù shì} B, which lists the only two possibilities (either A or B).

Two clauses held together by a pair of linking words, such as {因为|yīn wèi}…{所以|suǒ yǐ}, {虽然|suī rán}…{但是|dàn shì}, {既然|jì rán}…{就|jiù}, {不仅|bù jǐn}…{还|hái} or {不|bú}{是|shì}…{而是|ér shì}. A linking word that is an adverb ({就|jiù}, {也|yě}, {都|dōu}, {还|hái}) goes after the subject of its clause; a conjunction ({既然|jì rán}, {不仅|bù jǐn}) starts its clause or follows the subject.
Who or what the sentence is about, usually first: {我|wǒ} in {我|wǒ}{是|shì}{学生|xué sheng}. Chinese often leaves it out when it is clear.
The person or thing a verb acts on, after the verb: {书|shū} in {我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{书|shū}. A {把|bǎ} sentence moves the object before the verb.
A word that describes a verb, an adjective or a whole sentence, placed after the subject and before the verb: {也|yě}, {都|dōu}, {就|jiù}, {已经|yǐ jīng}, {本来|běn lái}, {从来|cóng lái}, {重新|chóng xīn}.

A verb that goes before another verb to add ability, permission, wish or necessity: {会|huì}, {能|néng}, {可以|kě yǐ}, {要|yào}, {想|xiǎng}, {应该|yīng gāi}, {得|děi}. In a {把|bǎ} sentence it goes before {把|bǎ}.

A two-syllable verb made of a verb and its object, which other words can split: {毕业|bì yè} → {毕|bì}{了|le}{业|yè}, {报名|bào míng} → {报|bào}{了|le}{名|míng}. A separable verb takes no further object: {大学|dà xué}{毕业|bì yè}, not {毕业|bì yè}{大学|dà xué}.

subject + {把|bǎ} + object + verb + something more: the object comes before the verb to say what is done to it. The verb never stands alone at the end: it takes a complement, a place, {了|le}, {一下|yí xià} or a number of times ({把|bǎ}{课文|kè wén}{读|dú}{了|le}{三|sān}{遍|biàn}). Negatives and modal verbs go before {把|bǎ}.

The word between a number (or {这|zhè}, {那|nà}, {各|gè}) and a noun: {一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}, {一|yì}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng}, {一|yì}{首|shǒu}{歌|gē}, {一|yì}{台|tái}{打印机|dǎ yìn jī}, {一|yì}{场|chǎng}{比赛|bǐ sài}, {一|yí}{项|xiàng}{活动|huó dòng}.

A measure word that counts how many times an action happens, after the verb: {读|dú}{了|le}{三|sān}{遍|biàn} (read three times through), {去|qù}{过|guo}{两|liǎng}{次|cì} (been twice). {遍|biàn} counts going through from start to finish, {次|cì} occasions.

A word or phrase after a verb that says how the action turned out: a result ({做|zuò}{完|wán}), a direction ({拿|ná}{来|lái}), a degree ({说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}) or a possibility ({听|tīng}{不|bu}{懂|dǒng}).
A verb or adjective right after a verb that gives its result: {做|zuò}{完|wán} (finish doing), {写|xiě}{错|cuò} (write wrongly), {看|kàn}{清楚|qīng chu} (see clearly).
A verb of movement after the main verb that gives its direction: {带|dài}{来|lái}, {拿|ná}{出来|chū lái}, {交|jiāo}{上去|shàng qù} (hand in).

{得|de} or {不|bu} between a verb and its complement says whether the result is possible: {听|tīng}{得|de}{懂|dǒng} (can understand), {查|chá}{不|bu}{到|dào} (can't find), {停|tíng}{不|bu}{下来|xià lái} (can't stop). The {不|bu} is light.
The official spelling of Mandarin in the Latin alphabet, with tone marks: {专业|zhuān yè} is zhuān yè. This course shows it over every character; the Pinyin switch hides it.

The pitch pattern of a syllable, which changes its meaning: first (high, level) ā, second (rising) á, third (dipping) ǎ, fourth (falling) à, and the neutral tone. {连|lián} (even) and {脸|liǎn} (face) differ only in tone.
A short, light syllable with no tone of its own, written without a mark: the second syllable of {知识|zhī shi}, {例子|lì zi}, and {了|le}, {的|de}, {着|zhe}.

A tone that changes before another: two third tones are said second + third ({允许|yǔn xǔ} sounds yún xǔ; the pinyin keeps the marks), and {一|yī} and {不|bù} change before a fourth tone ({一切|yí qiè}, {不是|bú shì}), which this course writes.
The part of a character under which dictionaries list it, often a hint to the meaning: 讠 (speech) in {误|wù}, 纟 (silk) in {继|jì}, {贝|bèi} (shell, money) in {资|zī}.
Any part a character is built from: {例|lì} is 亻 + {列|liè}; {章|zhāng} is {立|lì} over {早|zǎo}.

A component that once gave a character its sound, and often still does: {各|gè} in {格|gé}, {其|qí} in {基|jī} and {期|qī}, {受|shòu} in {授|shòu}. Many sound parts have drifted with time, so treat them as hints.

The standard forms of mainland China, made official from 1956 (the Chinese Character Simplification Scheme) and set out in the 2013 table of 8,105 standard characters; also used in Singapore and Malaysia. This course is written in them.
The fuller character forms used in Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau and in many overseas communities. This course's switch shows them in their Taiwan forms with mainland vocabulary.
The earliest large body of Chinese writing ({甲骨文|jiǎ gǔ wén}), carved on tortoise shells and ox bones for divination in the late Shang dynasty, roughly 1250–1050 BCE; recognised as writing in 1899.
Writing cast into ritual bronze vessels and bells ({金文|jīn wén}), mainly of the late Shang and Western Zhou dynasties; its lines are thicker and rounder than those of the oracle bones.
The script of the state of Qin ({小篆|xiǎo zhuàn}), regular and symmetrical, with even curving lines; it became the standard across China after the Qin unification of 221 BCE.
The flat, square brush script ({隶书|lì shū}) that developed from the Warring States period to the early Han; from it on, characters are built of strokes rather than drawn lines.

The script of print and careful handwriting today ({楷书|kǎi shū}), both simplified and traditional; it grew out of clerical script in the Han and Three Kingdoms periods and matured in the Tang dynasty.
A fast handwriting style ({草书|cǎo shū}) in which strokes run together; many simplified characters come from cursive shapes made regular, such as {={书|shū}=} and {={车|chē}=}.
A classical poem of four lines ({绝句|jué jù}), each of five or seven characters, such as Du Fu's "{两个黄鹂鸣翠柳|liǎng gè huáng lí míng cuì liǔ}".

A complement after a verb or adjective that says how something is done or how strong it is. HSK 3's form is {得|de} + a description: {他|tā}{跑|pǎo}{得|de}{很|hěn}{快|kuài} (he runs fast), negative {跑|pǎo}{得|de}{不|bú}{快|kuài}. HSK 4 adds two complements of extreme degree, both spoken: adjective or feeling verb + {死|sǐ}{了|le}, "terribly, to death" ({疼|téng}{死|sǐ}{了|le}, {累|lèi}{死|sǐ}{了|le}, {饿|è}{死|sǐ}{了|le}; no {很|hěn} and no {得|de}; an object can come between: {气|qì}{死|sǐ}{我|wǒ}{了|le}), and verb or adjective + {得|de} + ({很|hěn}){厉害|lì hai}, "badly, severely" ({咳嗽|ké sou}{得|de}{厉害|lì hai}, {疼|téng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{厉害|lì hai}). Compare the neutral {极|jí}{了|le} ({好|hǎo}{极|jí}{了|le}). Taught in lesson 06.

An adverb that says how often something happens. It goes after the subject and before the verb. From most to least often: {总是|zǒng shì} (always), {老是|lǎo shi} (always, as a complaint: {你|nǐ}{怎么|zěn me}{老是|lǎo shi}{迟到|chí dào}？), {常常|cháng cháng} / {经常|jīng cháng} (often), {往往|wǎng wǎng} (tends to: a pattern seen in a situation, {周末|zhōu mò}{他|tā}{往往|wǎng wǎng}{去|qù}{爬|pá}{山|shān}; not for plans or requests, where {常常|cháng cháng} is used), {偶尔|ǒu ěr} (occasionally), {从来|cóng lái}{不|bù} / {没|méi} (never). Taught in lesson 07.

An ordinary noun used as a measure word for what it holds or covers. Containers: {一|yì}{杯|bēi}{茶|chá}, {一|yì}{碗|wǎn}{饭|fàn}, {一|yì}{瓶|píng}{水|shuǐ}, {一|yì}{盒|hé}{饼干|bǐng gān}. Places and parts of the body, with {一|yī} only, mean "a whole… full" or "covered in": {一|yì}{桌子|zhuō zi}{菜|cài} (a whole tableful of food), {一|yì}{屋子|wū zi}{人|rén} (a roomful of people), {一|yì}{脸|liǎn}{汗|hàn} (a face covered in sweat), {一|yì}{身|shēn}{汗|hàn} (sweating all over). With another number they count the containers ({两|liǎng}{桌子|zhuō zi}{菜|cài}, two tables of food). Taught in lesson 08.

A comparison saying that A falls short of B: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{不如|bù rú}{他|tā} (my Chinese isn't as good as his). An adjective at the end says in what way, and it is normally a good quality: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{的|de}{菜|cài}{不如|bù rú}{那|nà}{家|jiā}{的|de}{好吃|hǎo chī} (the food here isn't as good as there). No {很|hěn} before the adjective. For "less expensive" use {比|bǐ}…{便宜|pián yi} or {没有|méi yǒu}…{贵|guì}, not {不如|bù rú}…{贵|guì}. Before a verb, {不如|bù rú} makes a suggestion: {我们|wǒ men}{不如|bù rú}{打车|dǎ chē}{吧|ba} (we might as well take a taxi). Taught in lesson 09.

A number of times as much, with {倍|bèi} (times): A {是|shì} B {的|de}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi} (A is twice B); A {比|bǐ} B {多|duō}{一|yí}{倍|bèi} or {贵|guì}{了|le}{一|yí}{倍|bèi} (A is B plus one more B: twice as much), so {多|duō}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi} is three times as much; {增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{一|yí}{倍|bèi} (has doubled). Discounts count the tenths you pay: {打|dǎ}{八|bā}{折|zhé} is 80 % of the price, 20 % off. Taught in lesson 09; {倍|bèi} is lesson 15's word.

Two negative words that cancel out and make a strong positive: {不得不|bù dé bù} + verb (have no choice but to: {我|wǒ}{不得不|bù dé bù}{走|zǒu}), {不|bù}{能|néng}{不|bù} + verb (can't not, must), {没有|méi yǒu} + noun + {不|bù} + verb (there's no one who doesn't: {没有|méi yǒu}{人|rén}{不|bù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{她|tā}, everyone likes her), and the emphatic, spoken {非|fēi} + verb + {不|bù}{可|kě} (simply must: {我|wǒ}{非|fēi}{去|qù}{不|bù}{可|kě}). Taught in lesson 10.

A second clause, opened by {否则|fǒu zé} (otherwise), that says what happens if the first clause is not followed: {你|nǐ}{得|děi}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{走|zǒu}，{否则|fǒu zé}{会|huì}{迟到|chí dào}。 (You'd better leave early, otherwise you'll be late.) The first clause is usually advice, a rule or a necessity. {否则|fǒu zé} is a little formal; speech often uses {不然|bù rán} or {要不|yào bù}. It is the reverse of an if-sentence: "A, otherwise B" = "if not A, then B" ({如果|rú guǒ}{你|nǐ}{不|bù}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{走|zǒu}，{就|jiù}{会|huì}{迟到|chí dào}).

A sentence in which one noun is both the object of the first verb and the subject of the second: {老师|lǎo shī}{让|ràng}{我们|wǒ men}{写|xiě}{文章|wén zhāng} ({我们|wǒ men} is told, and writes). Besides {让|ràng} / {叫|jiào} / {请|qǐng} (making or asking someone do something), the first verb can be one of liking or praising ({我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{她|tā}{做|zuò}{事|shì}{认真|rèn zhēn}: I like her for being conscientious), of choosing or naming ({大家|dà jiā}{选|xuǎn}{他|tā}{当|dāng}{班长|bān zhǎng}: everyone chose him as monitor) or of causing a feeling ({这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{高兴|gāo xìng}). The pivot comes straight after the first verb, and a negative goes before the first verb ({他|tā}{的|de}{回答|huí dá}{没|méi}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{满意|mǎn yì}).

A word that marks the agent, the one who carries out an action. In written Chinese {由|yóu} + doer + verb says whose task or decision something is: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{由|yóu}{小王|Xiǎo Wáng}{负责|fù zé} (Xiao Wang is responsible for this), {今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{会|huì}{由|yóu}{郑|Zhèng}{老师|lǎo shī}{主持|zhǔ chí}. Unlike {被|bèi}, which marks something done to the subject, {由|yóu} makes the subject the task itself and the doer the one in charge of it. {由|yóu} also means "from" in writing ({由此|yóu cǐ}{进入|jìn rù}, enter here).

A complex sentence that admits a fact in its first clause and says in the second what holds all the same: {尽管|jǐn guǎn}{工作|gōng zuò}{很|hěn}{辛苦|xīn kǔ}，{但是|dàn shì}{她|tā}{从来|cóng lái}{不|bù}{说|shuō}{累|lèi}。 (Although the work is hard, she never says she's tired.) The first clause takes {尽管|jǐn guǎn} or {虽然|suī rán} (HSK 2); the second takes {但是|dàn shì}, {可是|kě shì}, {还是|hái shi} or {却|què} (after its subject). For a mere possibility ("even if"), Chinese uses {即使|jí shǐ}…{也|yě} instead.

A number given as roughly so much. {来|lái} goes after a round number and before the measure word ({十|shí}{来|lái}{个|gè}{人|rén}, ten or so people); {左右|zuǒ yòu} goes after the number and measure word or a time ({三十|sān shí}{岁|suì}{左右|zuǒ yòu}, {八|bā}{点|diǎn}{左右|zuǒ yòu}); {前后|qián hòu} goes after a point in time only ({春节|Chūn jié}{前后|qián hòu}); {大约|dà yuē} goes before the number ({大约|dà yuē}{四十|sì shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}). From HSK 1–3: {十|shí}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}, {二十|èr shí}{多|duō}{岁|suì}, {差不多|chà bu duō}. {前后|qián hòu} never follows an amount: say {五十|wǔ shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{左右|zuǒ yòu}.

aliases: passive with 叫 and 让
glossary.definition: {叫|jiào} or {让|ràng} used like {被|bèi} in everyday speech: the thing affected comes first, then {叫|jiào} / {让|ràng}, the doer, and a verb with a result or {了|le}: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{钱包|qián bāo}{叫|jiào}{人|rén}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 Unlike {被|bèi}, the doer must be named ({人|rén} if you don't know who), and the pattern isn't used in writing. {没|méi} goes before {叫|jiào} / {让|ràng}: {钱包|qián bāo}{没|méi}{叫|jiào}{人|rén}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}。
glossary.topic: Passive with 叫 and 让

glossary.definition: A question that asks nothing: it makes a statement strongly and means the opposite of what it says. {难道|nán dào}{你|nǐ}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{吗|ma}？ (Don't tell me you didn't know!) means you must have known; {难道|nán dào} + a positive expresses disbelief. Questions such as {这|zhè}{不|bú}{是|shì}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}{吗|ma}？ (Isn't that great?) and {谁|shéi}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}？ (Who wouldn't want to go?) work the same way.

In a story, a clause that says what happened next because of the event before it, usually opened by {于是|yú shì} (and so, thereupon): {钱包|qián bāo}{找不到|zhǎo bu dào}{了|le}，{于是|yú shì}{我们|wǒ men}{给|gěi}{警察|jǐng chá}{打|dǎ}{了|le}{电话|diàn huà}。 {于是|yú shì} joins events in time order; for a reason and its result, or a conclusion, use {所以|suǒ yǐ}, and don't pair {于是|yú shì} with {因为|yīn wèi}.

The written partner of {的|de}: it links a modifier to the noun it describes. Classical Chinese used it everywhere; modern Chinese keeps it in fixed words ({之前|zhī qián}, {之后|zhī hòu}, {之间|zhī jiān}, {之中|zhī zhōng}, {之|zhī}{一|yī}), in fractions ({三分之一|sān fēn zhī yī}) and in formal phrases ({父母|fù mǔ}{之|zhī}{爱|ài}, a parent's love). In speech, use {的|de}.

A written-style suffix after a verb or a noun that makes a word for a person who does that thing, like English "-er" or "-ist": {作者|zuò zhě} (author), {读者|dú zhě} (reader), {记者|jì zhě} (journalist), {爱好者|ài hào zhě} (enthusiast). It doesn't make new words freely; for "the person who…", use a {的|de} phrase ({买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}{的|de}{人|rén}).

A frame of two fixed characters and two slots that turns two related words into a compact four-character phrase: {有|yǒu}A{有|yǒu}B (having both: {有说有笑|yǒu shuō yǒu xiào}, chatting and laughing), {无|wú}A{无|wú}B (having neither: {无忧无虑|wú yōu wú lǜ}, carefree) and {一|yī}A{一|yī}B (every single…, wholly: {一心一意|yì xīn yí yì}, wholeheartedly). The phrases are set: learn each one whole, and use the frame to recognise new ones. Four-character idioms with a story behind them ({成语|chéng yǔ}) are a separate, larger group.

A frame of fixed words with one or two slots, learned and used as a unit: X {是|shì} X，Y {是|shì} Y ({工作|gōng zuò}{是|shì}{工作|gōng zuò}，{朋友|péng you}{是|shì}{朋友|péng you}), {再也|zài yě}{不|bù} + verb, {怎么|zěn me}{都|dōu}{不|bù} + verb, {还|hái} X {呢|ne}, {拿|ná}…{来说|lái shuō}, {在|zài}…{方面|fāng miàn}, {说|shuō}{什么|shén me}{也|yě}{得|děi} + verb. The reference sheet *Fixed formats at HSK 4* lists them all.

A suffix after an adjective or a verb that makes a noun for the quality, like English "-ness" or "-ity": {积极性|jī jí xìng} (enthusiasm, motivation), {重要性|zhòng yào xìng} (importance), {可能性|kě néng xìng} (possibility). Common in written Chinese.

A suffix after a noun or an adjective that makes "a sense of…, a feeling of…": {安全感|ān quán gǎn} (a sense of security), {幸福感|xìng fú gǎn} (a sense of happiness), {责任感|zé rèn gǎn} (a sense of responsibility).

The written way to say that something causes a feeling or a change: X + {使|shǐ} + person + feeling: {这个|zhè ge}{消息|xiāo xi}{使|shǐ}{大家|dà jiā}{很|hěn}{激动|jī dòng} (the news made everyone very excited). It is the written partner of {让|ràng} in the same place, but {使|shǐ} only means "to cause": it can't mean "to let" or "to ask someone to", and in conversation it sounds stiff.

A complex sentence that says the result holds whatever the condition: {不管|bù guǎn} (spoken), {无论|wú lùn} or {不论|bú lùn} (more formal) + an open choice, then {都|dōu} or {也|yě} before the verb of the second clause: {不管|bù guǎn}{天气|tiān qì}{怎么样|zěn me yàng}，{他|tā}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{跑步|pǎo bù} (whatever the weather, he goes running). The open choice is a question word ({谁|shéi}, {什么|shén me}, {怎么|zěn me}, {多|duō} + adjective), A {还是|hái shi} B, or A {不|bù} A; a plain statement can't follow {不管|bù guǎn} (for that, use {虽然|suī rán}).

aliases: on the one hand… on the other hand
glossary.definition: A pair of linking words that sets out two sides of one question, or two reasons for one thing: {上|shàng}{网课|wǎng kè}{一方面|yì fāng miàn}{很|hěn}{方便|fāng biàn}，{另一方面|lìng yì fāng miàn}{也|yě}{容易|róng yì}{让|ràng}{人|rén}{分心|fēn xīn} (online classes are convenient, but they also make it easy to get distracted). The second clause often has {也|yě} or {还|hái}. Unlike English "on the one hand… on the other", the two sides can also point the same way ("partly… and partly…").

A complex sentence that grants a possibility and says it changes nothing: {即使|jí shǐ}{明天|míng tiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒ men}{也|yě}{去|qù}。 (Even if it rains tomorrow, we'll go.) The first clause is a supposition, often an extreme one; the second takes {也|yě} after its subject. Spoken Chinese often uses {就是|jiù shì}…{也|yě} ({就是|jiù shì}{再|zài}{忙|máng}，{你|nǐ}{也|yě}{得|děi}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}). For a fact, use {虽然|suī rán}…{但是|dàn shì} instead.

The written way to state a purpose: {为了|wèi le} + purpose + {而|ér} + action: {为了|wèi le}{保护|bǎo hù}{环境|huán jìng}{而|ér}{少|shǎo}{开车|kāi chē}。 {而|ér} marks the step from the purpose to what is done and has no meaning of its own to translate. A shorter form puts a noun after {为|wèi}: {为|wèi}{健康|jiàn kāng}{而|ér}{运动|yùn dòng}。 In conversation, {而|ér} is usually dropped ({为了|wèi le}{保护|bǎo hù}{环境|huán jìng}，{我|wǒ}{少|shǎo}{开车|kāi chē}) or the purpose comes at the end with {是|shì}{为了|wèi le}.

A complex sentence packed into one breath, with no connector at the start: two short clauses and an adverb that shows how they are related. {不|bù}…{也|yě} (even if not, still): {你|nǐ}{不|bù}{说|shuō}{我|wǒ}{也|yě}{知道|zhī dào}。 {再|zài}…{也|yě} (however… still): {再|zài}{忙|máng}{也|yě}{要|yào}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}。 {一|yī}…{就|jiù} (as soon as): {他|tā}{一|yí}{到|dào}{家|jiā}{就|jiù}{睡|shuì}{了|le}。 {不|bù}…{不|bù} (if not, then not): {你|nǐ}{不|bù}{来|lái}{我|wǒ}{不|bù}{走|zǒu}。 Most have a full form with {即使|jí shǐ}, {就是|jiù shì} or {如果|rú guǒ}.

A word that shows how the parts of a text fit together: {首先|shǒu xiān} (first), {其次|qí cì} (second), {然后|rán hòu} (then), {最后|zuì hòu} (finally), {另外|lìng wài} and {此外|cǐ wài} (besides), {总之|zǒng zhī} (in short). {首先|shǒu xiān}…{其次|qí cì}…{最后|zuì hòu} lists points; {首先|shǒu xiān}…{然后|rán hòu} lists steps in time. In the exam they are the clues for putting sentences back into a passage, and they give your own writing and speaking a clear shape.

The Chinese Proficiency Test ({汉语|Hàn yǔ}{水平|shuǐ píng}{考试|kǎo shì}), the standard test of Chinese for learners. Its new version (HSK 3.0, syllabus published in November 2025 and in force from July 2026) has nine levels. Level 4, as reported from the sample papers, has a written exam of 70 questions (listening 32, reading 32, writing 6) in about 85 minutes and a speaking test of 5 tasks in about 20 minutes. Check chinesetest.cn for the current format.

The spoken part of the new HSK. In the 2026 pilot rounds it was registered for together with the written exam at levels 3–6 (one report says that in Japan the two can still be registered separately). At level 4, as reported: retelling two short passages you hear, telling a story from three numbered photos, and answering two questions, about 20 minutes in all including about 10 minutes of preparation.
Reading quickly for the general idea: the title, the first sentence and the last sentence of a text, to know what it is about before you answer questions on it.
Reading to find one fact: read the question first, then look through the text for the time, place, number or name it asks for, without reading every word.

The reading task of putting sentences back into the gaps of a passage. Follow the links: {首先|shǒu xiān}, {其次|qí cì}, {最后|zuì hòu} keep their order; {于是|yú shì}, {因此|yīn cǐ}, {所以|suǒ yǐ} need a cause just before them; {但是|dàn shì}, {可是|kě shì}, {却|què} need something to contrast with; {他|tā}, {这|zhè} and {这样|zhè yàng} point back to something already named; {也|yě} and {还|hái} add to something of the same kind.

references.title: 把 and 被 at HSK 4 (with 叫 and 让)
references.body:
## {把|bǎ}: the doer does something to a definite thing

The {把|bǎ} sentence (HSK 3): doer + {把|bǎ} + the thing + verb + something after the verb. HSK 4 (lesson 02)
adds these endings:

| Pattern | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| {把|bǎ} + thing + verb + {了|le} | {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{作业|zuò yè}{交|jiāo}{了|le}。 | I've handed in my homework. |
| {把|bǎ} + thing + verb + {一下|yí xià} | {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{答案|dá'àn}{改|gǎi}{一下|yí xià}。 | Please correct the answer. |
| {把|bǎ} + thing + verb + frequency | {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{课文|kè wén}{读|dú}{了|le}{三|sān}{遍|biàn}。 | I read the text three times. |
| {把|bǎ} + thing + verb + {了|le} + duration | {他|tā}{把|bǎ}{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{想|xiǎng}{了|le}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}{时间|shí jiān}。 | He thought about this question for a long time. |
| adverbial + {把|bǎ} … verb | {他|tā}{认真|rèn zhēn}{地|de}{把|bǎ}{作业|zuò yè}{检查|jiǎn chá}{了|le}{一|yí}{遍|biàn}。 | He checked his homework carefully once. |
| {把|bǎ} + thing + verb + result / direction / place | {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{衣服|yī fu}{装|zhuāng}{进|jìn}{背包|bēi bāo}{里|lǐ}{了|le}。 | I packed my clothes into my backpack. |
| {没|méi} / {别|bié} + {把|bǎ} … | {别|bié}{把|bǎ}{护照|hù zhào}{忘|wàng}{在|zài}{旅馆|lǚ guǎn}。 | Don't leave your passport at the hotel. |
| {把|bǎ} + thing + verb + {了|le} (a request) | {赶紧|gǎn jǐn}{把|bǎ}{卡|kǎ}{停|tíng}{了|le}。 | Get the card stopped, quick. |

- The thing after {把|bǎ} is definite (the homework, my passport): you know which one.
- The verb never stands alone: it needs {了|le}, {一下|yí xià}, a frequency, a result, a direction or a place.
- {没|méi}, {别|bié}, {不|bù} and modal verbs ({能|néng}, {要|yào}, {应该|yīng gāi}) go **before** {把|bǎ}: ~~{我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{作业|zuò yè}{没|méi}{交|jiāo}{给|gěi}{老师|lǎo shī}~~ → {我|wǒ}{没|méi}{把|bǎ}{作业|zuò yè}{交|jiāo}{给|gěi}{老师|lǎo shī}.
- An adverb of manner can go before {把|bǎ} ({他|tā}{认真|rèn zhēn}{地|de}{把|bǎ}{作业|zuò yè}…) or after it ({他|tā}{把|bǎ}{作业|zuò yè}{认真|rèn zhēn}{地|de}{检查|jiǎn chá}{了|le}{一|yí}{遍|biàn}); both are
  common (lesson 02).

## {被|bèi}, {叫|jiào} and {让|ràng}: something happens to the subject

| | {被|bèi} (HSK 3) | {叫|jiào} / {让|ràng} (HSK 4, lesson 19) |
|---|---|---|
| Example | {我|wǒ}{的|de}{钱包|qián bāo}{被|bèi}{人|rén}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 | {我|wǒ}{的|de}{钱包|qián bāo}{叫|jiào}{人|rén}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 / {我|wǒ}{的|de}{钱包|qián bāo}{让|ràng}{人|rén}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 |
| Without the doer | {我|wǒ}{的|de}{钱包|qián bāo}{被|bèi}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 | — (the doer must be there: {叫|jiào}{人|rén}, {让|ràng}{人|rén}) |
| Negative | {我|wǒ}{的|de}{钱包|qián bāo}{没|méi}{被|bèi}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}。 | {我|wǒ}{的|de}{钱包|qián bāo}{没|méi}{叫|jiào}{人|rén}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}。 |
| Register | speech and writing | speech only |
| Events | mostly unwelcome | mostly unwelcome |

- After the verb: a result ({拿|ná}{走|zǒu}, {吃|chī}{完|wán}, {打|dǎ}{破|pò}), a direction ({拿|ná}{出去|chū qù}), a place ({放|fàng}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}) or {了|le}.
- {让|ràng} also means "to let, to make" ({他|tā}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{去|qù}: he let / made me go). When the subject is a thing, {让|ràng} is
  clearly passive: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}{让|ràng}{弟弟|dì di}{吃|chī}{了|le}.
- Writing uses {被|bèi}: {贵重物品|guì zhòng wù pǐn}{被|bèi}{人|rén}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}，{旅馆|lǚ guǎn}{不|bú}{负责|fù zé}。

## The same event from two sides

| Doer first: {把|bǎ} | Thing first: {被|bèi} / {叫|jiào} / {让|ràng} |
|---|---|
| {弟弟|dì di}{把|bǎ}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}{吃|chī}{了|le}。 | {我|wǒ}{的|de}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}{被|bèi}{弟弟|dì di}{吃|chī}{了|le}。 / {我|wǒ}{的|de}{蛋糕|dàn gāo}{叫|jiào}{弟弟|dì di}{吃|chī}{了|le}。 |
| {有|yǒu}{人|rén}{把|bǎ}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{钱包|qián bāo}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 | {我|wǒ}{的|de}{钱包|qián bāo}{被|bèi}{人|rén}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 / {我|wǒ}{的|de}{钱包|qián bāo}{让|ràng}{人|rén}{拿|ná}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 |
| {朋友|péng you}{把|bǎ}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 | {我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{被|bèi}{朋友|péng you}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 / {我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{让|ràng}{朋友|péng you}{骑|qí}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 |
| {警察|jǐng chá}{没|méi}{把|bǎ}{他|tā}{的|de}{车|chē}{拉|lā}{走|zǒu}。 | {他|tā}{的|de}{车|chē}{没|méi}{被|bèi}{警察|jǐng chá}{拉|lā}{走|zǒu}。 |

({有|yǒu}{人|rén}: someone. {拉|lā}{走|zǒu}: to tow away.)

Choose by what you're talking about: start with the doer and use {把|bǎ} when you're describing what
someone did to something; start with the thing and use {被|bèi} (or {叫|jiào} / {让|ràng} in speech) when you're saying
what happened to it.

references.title: The 441 characters of HSK 4
references.body:
Every new character of this course in the order it is taught. With the 655 of HSK 1–3 they make the 1,096 characters of the level. Pinyin gives the readings our words use ("and others" when the character has more readings in later levels). Radical is the one the stroke-order data (Make Me a Hanzi) gives, which is usually but not always the radical a dictionary files it under. Strokes follow mainland stroke order. ✎ marks the 150 characters HSK expects you to write by hand at level 4; the second table lists all 400 handwriting characters of levels 1–4.

The list shows the simplified forms the course teaches, so it stays in simplified characters when the script switch is on Traditional; the Traditional column gives the Taiwan form the switch shows ("same" when the two scripts write it alike, and the form each of our words uses when a character has two). Radicals and stroke counts are those of the simplified form.

references.title: Comparing at HSK 4 (不如, 跟…相比, 一天比一天, 倍)
references.body:
HSK 4's comparisons, with the HSK 3 patterns they build on (the HSK 3 sheet "Comparing" has those in
full). In every pattern, degree words go after the adjective, and {很|hěn}, {非常|fēi cháng} and {太|tài} aren't used:
not ~~{比|bǐ}{他|tā}{很|hěn}{高|gāo}~~, ~~{不如|bù rú}{他|tā}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}~~.

## The patterns

| Pattern | Example | Meaning | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| A {比|bǐ} B + adj. (HSK 3) | {地铁|dì tiě}{比|bǐ}{公交车|gōng jiāo chē}{快|kuài}。 | The metro is faster than the bus. | HSK 3 |
| A {没有|méi yǒu} B ({那么|nà me}) + adj. (HSK 3) | {公交车|gōng jiāo chē}{没有|méi yǒu}{地铁|dì tiě}{那么|nà me}{快|kuài}。 | The bus isn't as fast as the metro. | HSK 3 |
| A {跟|gēn} B {一样|yí yàng} (+ adj.) (HSK 3) | {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{跟|gēn}{那|nà}{件|jiàn}{一样|yí yàng}{贵|guì}。 | This one is as dear as that one. | HSK 3 |
| A {不如|bù rú} B | {我|wǒ}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{不如|bù rú}{他|tā}。 | My Chinese isn't as good as his. | 09 |
| A {不如|bù rú} B + adj. | {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{的|de}{菜|cài}{不如|bù rú}{那|nà}{家|jiā}{的|de}{好吃|hǎo chī}。 | The food here isn't as good as at that place. | 09 |
| {跟|gēn} / {和|hé} / {与|yǔ} B {相比|xiāng bǐ}，… | {跟|gēn}{去年|qù nián}{相比|xiāng bǐ}，{今年|jīn nián}{的|de}{价格|jià gé}{高|gāo}{了|le}{不|bù}{少|shǎo}。 | Compared with last year, prices are a good deal higher this year. | 09 |
| {一|yī} + M + {比|bǐ} + {一|yī} + M + adj. | {天气|tiān qì}{一|yì}{天|tiān}{比|bǐ}{一|yì}{天|tiān}{冷|lěng}。 | It's getting colder by the day. | 09 |
| A {是|shì} B {的|de} N {倍|bèi} | {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{的|de}{价格|jià gé}{是|shì}{那|nà}{件|jiàn}{的|de}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi}。 | This one costs twice as much as that one. | 09, 15 |
| A {比|bǐ} B + adj. + {了|le} N {倍|bèi} | {今年|jīn nián}{的|de}{房租|fáng zū}{比|bǐ}{去年|qù nián}{贵|guì}{了|le}{一|yí}{倍|bèi}。 | The rent has doubled since last year. | 09, 15 |

## {不如|bù rú}

- The adjective after {不如|bù rú} is normally a good quality ({好|hǎo}, {好吃|hǎo chī}, {便宜|pián yi}, {方便|fāng biàn}, {漂亮|piào liang}, {快|kuài}): A falls short of B.
  For "less expensive", use {比|bǐ}…{便宜|pián yi} or {没有|méi yǒu}…{贵|guì}.
- With no adjective, {不如|bù rú} means "isn't as good as": {坐|zuò}{公交车|gōng jiāo chē}{不如|bù rú}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}.
- Before a verb it's a suggestion, "might as well": {下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{不如|bù rú}{打车|dǎ chē}{吧|ba}。
- {没有|méi yǒu}…{那么|nà me} and {不如|bù rú} often say the same; {不如|bù rú} sounds more like a verdict.

## {跟|gēn}…{相比|xiāng bǐ}

- Opens the sentence and sets the standard; the rest says how things differ: {跟|gēn}{大|dà}{商场|shāng chǎng}{相比|xiāng bǐ}，{这儿|zhèr}{便宜|pián yi}{多|duō}{了|le}。
- {和|hé} replaces {跟|gēn} freely; {与|yǔ} is the written form ({与|yǔ}{去年|qù nián}{相比|xiāng bǐ}, in reports and the news).

## {一|yī} + M + {比|bǐ} + {一|yī} + M

| Phrase | Meaning |
|---|---|
| {一|yì}{天|tiān}{比|bǐ}{一|yì}{天|tiān} | day by day |
| {一|yì}{年|nián}{比|bǐ}{一|yì}{年|nián} | year by year |
| {一|yí}{次|cì}{比|bǐ}{一|yí}{次|cì} | every time (better, worse…) |
| {一|yí}{个|gè}{比|bǐ}{一|yí}{个|gè} | each one more… than the last: {他|tā}{的|de}{孩子|hái zi}{一|yí}{个|gè}{比|bǐ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{高|gāo}。 |

It stresses a steady, step-by-step change. {越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè} (HSK 3) is close, but only says the direction.

## Multiples and percentages

| Chinese | Meaning |
|---|---|
| A {是|shì} B {的|de}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi} | A is twice B |
| A {比|bǐ} B {多|duō}{一|yí}{倍|bèi} / {贵|guì}{了|le}{一|yí}{倍|bèi} | A is twice B (B + one more B) |
| A {比|bǐ} B {多|duō}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi} | A is three times B |
| {增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{一|yí}{倍|bèi} (lesson 15) | has doubled |
| {百|bǎi}{分|fēn}{之|zhī}{二十|èr shí} (lesson 15) | twenty per cent |
| {打|dǎ}{八|bā}{折|zhé} | 20 % off (you pay 80 %) |
| {打|dǎ}{五|wǔ}{折|zhé} | half price |

Because {多|duō}{一|yí}{倍|bèi} and {是|shì}{两|liǎng}{倍|bèi} mean the same, people sometimes mix them up in speech; when the amount
matters, say the numbers.

## Not as… as: choosing

| You want to say | Natural | Avoid |
|---|---|---|
| This place is cheaper. | {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{比|bǐ}{那|nà}{家|jiā}{便宜|pián yi}。 | {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{不如|bù rú}{那|nà}{家|jiā}{贵|guì} sounds odd: {不如|bù rú} takes a good quality |
| The bus is slower. | {公交车|gōng jiāo chē}{没有|méi yǒu}{地铁|dì tiě}{快|kuài}。 / {公交车|gōng jiāo chē}{不如|bù rú}{地铁|dì tiě}{快|kuài}。 | ~~{公交车|gōng jiāo chē}{不如|bù rú}{地铁|dì tiě}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}~~ |
| It gets colder every day. | {天气|tiān qì}{一|yì}{天|tiān}{比|bǐ}{一|yì}{天|tiān}{冷|lěng}。 | ~~{一|yì}{天|tiān}{比|bǐ}{一|yì}{天|tiān}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}~~ |

references.title: Complex sentences of HSK 4
references.body:
Every pair of linking words that HSK 4 teaches, by what the two clauses do, with the HSK 1–3 pairs
they grow from. As before, a linking word that is an adverb ({就|jiù}, {也|yě}, {都|dōu}, {还|hái}, {才|cái}, {却|què}, {更|gèng}) goes after
the subject of its clause and before the verb; a conjunction ({既然|jì rán}, {不仅|bù jǐn}, {尽管|jǐn guǎn}, {即使|jí shǐ}, {不管|bù guǎn}, {由于|yóu yú})
starts its clause or follows its subject. The written ones (marked *w*) belong in notices, essays
and the news. The earlier pairs are in the HSK 3 sheet "Complex sentences of HSK 2 and HSK 3".

## Cause, inference and result

| Pattern | Example | Meaning | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| {既然|jì rán}…{就|jiù}… | {既然|jì rán}{你|nǐ}{不|bù}{舒服|shū fu}，{就|jiù}{早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{吧|ba}。 | Since you're not feeling well, go home early. | 01 |
| {由于|yóu yú}…{因此|yīn cǐ} / {所以|suǒ yǐ}… (*w*) | {由于|yóu yú}{天气|tiān qì}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}，{因此|yīn cǐ}{比赛|bǐ sài}{推迟|tuī chí}{了|le}。 | Owing to the bad weather, the match was postponed. | 17 |
| …，{结果|jié guǒ}… | {他|tā}{没|méi}{带|dài}{伞|sǎn}，{结果|jié guǒ}{全身|quán shēn}{都|dōu}{湿|shī}{了|le}。 | He took no umbrella, and as a result he got soaked. | 17 |
| …，{于是|yú shì}… (*w*) | {雨|yǔ}{停|tíng}{了|le}，{于是|yú shì}{我们|wǒ men}{继续|jì xù}{往|wǎng}{前|qián}{走|zǒu}。 | The rain stopped, so we walked on. | 28 |

{既然|jì rán} takes a fact both sides accept and draws a conclusion (a suggestion, decision or question); it
never pairs with {所以|suǒ yǐ}. {因为|yīn wèi}…{所以|suǒ yǐ} (HSK 2) simply gives a cause.

## Adding and going further (progression)

| Pattern | Example | Meaning | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| {连|lián}…{都|dōu} / {也|yě}… | {他|tā}{连|lián}{一|yí}{个|gè}{字|zì}{都|dōu}{没|méi}{写|xiě}。 | He didn't write a single character. | 03 |
| …，{甚至|shèn zhì}… | {他|tā}{很|hěn}{忙|máng}，{甚至|shèn zhì}{周末|zhōu mò}{也|yě}{要|yào}{工作|gōng zuò}。 | He's very busy: he even has to work at weekends. | 03 |
| {连|lián}…{都|dōu}…，{更|gèng}… | {连|lián}{老师|lǎo shī}{都|dōu}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}，{我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{更|gèng}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}{了|le}。 | Even the teacher doesn't know, so we certainly don't. | 03 |
| {不仅|bù jǐn} / {不光|bù guāng}…{还|hái} / {而且|ér qiě} / {也|yě}… | {她|tā}{不仅|bù jǐn}{会|huì}{唱歌|chàng gē}，{还|hái}{会|huì}{跳舞|tiào wǔ}。 | She can not only sing but dance too. | 04 |
| …，{并且|bìng qiě}… | {他|tā}{报|bào}{了|le}{名|míng}，{并且|bìng qiě}{交|jiāo}{了|le}{钱|qián}。 | He signed up and also paid. | 04 |
| …，{加上|jiā shàng}… | {天气|tiān qì}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}，{加上|jiā shàng}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{路上|lù shang}{人|rén}{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}。 | It was cold, and with the rain on top, there were few people out. | 04 |
| …，{另外|lìng wài} / {此外|cǐ wài}… | {这|zhè}{门|mén}{课|kè}{有|yǒu}{笔试|bǐ shì}，{另外|lìng wài}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{口语|kǒu yǔ}{考试|kǎo shì}。 | The course has a written exam, and an oral one as well. | 04, 01 |

{不仅|bù jǐn} (written and spoken) and {不光|bù guāng} (spoken) work like {不但|bú dàn} (HSK 3): with one subject, the subject
comes first ({她|tā}{不仅|bù jǐn}…); with two, {不仅|bù jǐn} comes before the first subject and the second clause has {也|yě}.

## Correction and choice

| Pattern | Example | Meaning | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| {不|bú}{是|shì}…{而是|ér shì}… | {他|tā}{不|bú}{是|shì}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}，{而是|ér shì}{没有|méi yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}。 | It isn't that he doesn't want to go: he has no time. | 05 |
| {不|bú}{是|shì}…{就是|jiù shì}… | {周末|zhōu mò}{他|tā}{不|bú}{是|shì}{看|kàn}{书|shū}，{就是|jiù shì}{上网|shàng wǎng}。 | At weekends he either reads or goes online. | 05 |

{不|bú}{是|shì} A {而是|ér shì} B corrects (not A, but B); {不|bú}{是|shì} A {就是|jiù shì} B lists the only two possibilities (either A or B).

## Concession and contrast

| Pattern | Example | Meaning | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| {尽管|jǐn guǎn}…{但是|dàn shì} / {可是|kě shì} / {还是|hái shi}… | {尽管|jǐn guǎn}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}，{他|tā}{还是|hái shi}{坚持|jiān chí}{写|xiě}{完|wán}{了|le}。 | Although he was tired, he kept going and finished. | 14 |
| …，{然而|rán ér}… (*w*) | {计划|jì huà}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{然而|rán ér}{没有|méi yǒu}{人|rén}{支持|zhī chí}。 | The plan was good; however, no one supported it. | 14 |
| …，{不过|bú guò}… | {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{不错|bú cuò}，{不过|bú guò}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{贵|guì}。 | This restaurant's good, though a bit expensive. | 14 |
| …，(subject) {却|què}… | {我|wǒ}{等|děng}{了|le}{他|tā}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}，{他|tā}{却|què}{没|méi}{来|lái}。 | I waited an hour for him, but he never came. | 14 |
| {即使|jí shǐ}…{也|yě}… | {即使|jí shǐ}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{比赛|bǐ sài}{也|yě}{会|huì}{继续|jì xù}。 | Even if it rains, the match will go on. | 26 |
| {就是|jiù shì}…{也|yě}… (spoken) | {就是|jiù shì}{再|zài}{忙|máng}，{也|yě}{要|yào}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}。 | However busy you are, you have to eat. | 26 |

{尽管|jǐn guǎn} states a fact (although); {即使|jí shǐ} and {就是|jiù shì} imagine (even if). {却|què} is an adverb: it comes after the
subject ({他|tā}{却|què}…), never before it.

## Conditions

| Pattern | Example | Meaning | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| {要是|yào shi}…{就|jiù}… (spoken) | {要是|yào shi}{明天|míng tiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{不|bú}{去|qù}{了|le}。 | If it rains tomorrow, we won't go. | 11 |
| …，{否则|fǒu zé}… | {快|kuài}{走|zǒu}{吧|ba}，{否则|fǒu zé}{要|yào}{迟到|chí dào}{了|le}。 | Let's hurry, or we'll be late. | 11 |
| {不管|bù guǎn} / {无论|wú lùn} / {不论|bú lùn}…{都|dōu} / {也|yě}… | {不管|bù guǎn}{天气|tiān qì}{怎么样|zěn me yàng}，{他|tā}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{跑步|pǎo bù}。 | Whatever the weather, he goes running. | 25 |

{不管|bù guǎn} (spoken), {无论|wú lùn} and {不论|bú lùn} (more written) need a question word, an A-not-A form or two choices in
their clause: {不管|bù guǎn}{谁|shéi}, {无论|wú lùn}{多|duō}{忙|máng}, {不论|bú lùn}{去|qù}{不|bu}{去|qù}.

## Purpose

| Pattern | Example | Meaning | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| …，{好|hǎo}… | {早点儿|zǎo diǎnr}{去|qù}，{好|hǎo}{买|mǎi}{到|dào}{票|piào}。 | Go early, so that you can get tickets. | 11 |
| {为了|wèi le}…{而|ér}… (*w*) | {很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{为了|wèi le}{保护|bǎo hù}{环境|huán jìng}{而|ér}{少|shǎo}{开车|kāi chē}。 | Many people drive less in order to protect the environment. | 28 |

## Listing and organising

| Pattern | Example | Meaning | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| {既|jì}…{又|yòu} / {也|yě}… | {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衣服|yī fu}{既|jì}{便宜|pián yi}{又|yòu}{好看|hǎo kàn}。 | This is both cheap and nice. | 18 |
| {一|yì}{方面|fāng miàn}…{另|lìng}{一|yì}{方面|fāng miàn}… | {一|yì}{方面|fāng miàn}{要|yào}{学习|xué xí}，{另|lìng}{一|yì}{方面|fāng miàn}{也|yě}{要|yào}{休息|xiū xi}。 | On the one hand you have to study; on the other, you need rest too. | 25 |
| {首先|shǒu xiān}…{其次|qí cì}…{最后|zuì hòu}… | {首先|shǒu xiān}{要|yào}{多|duō}{听|tīng}，{其次|qí cì}{要|yào}{多|duō}{说|shuō}，{最后|zuì hòu}{还|hái}{要|yào}{多|duō}{写|xiě}。 | First listen a lot, then speak a lot, and finally write a lot too. | 29 |

## Compressed sentences

| Pattern | Example | Meaning | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| {不|bù}…{也|yě}… | {你|nǐ}{不|bù}{说|shuō}{我|wǒ}{也|yě}{知道|zhī dào}。 | Even if you don't say it, I know. | 28 |

references.title: Fixed formats at HSK 4
references.body:
## What a fixed format is

A fixed format is a frame of fixed words with one or two slots, used as a unit: you learn the frame,
then fill the slot. Level 4 has about a dozen. This sheet lists them with the lesson that teaches
each, an example and what it means.

## Opinions and examples

| Format | Use | Example | Meaning | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {在|zài} + area + {方面|fāng miàn} | limits a statement to one area | {在|zài}{学习|xué xí}{方面|fāng miàn}，{他|tā}{从来|cóng lái}{不|bú}{让|ràng}{父母|fù mǔ}{担心|dān xīn}。 | When it comes to studying, he never worries his parents. | 25 |
| {拿|ná} + example + {来说|lái shuō} | introduces one example | {拿|ná}{我|wǒ}{来说|lái shuō}，{我|wǒ}{更|gèng}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{在|zài}{教室|jiào shì}{上课|shàng kè}。 | Take me: I prefer classes in the classroom. | 25 |
| {对于|duì yú} + topic + {来说|lái shuō} | "for…, from the point of view of…" | {对于|duì yú}{学生|xué sheng}{来说|lái shuō}，{最|zuì}{重要|zhòng yào}{的|de}{是|shì}{学习|xué xí}。 | For students, the most important thing is studying. | 24 |
| ({也|yě}){就是说|jiù shì shuō} | "in other words" | {他|tā}{说|shuō}{他|tā}{很|hěn}{忙|máng}，{也就是说|yě jiù shì shuō}，{他|tā}{今天|jīn tiān}{不|bù}{来|lái}{了|le}。 | He says he's busy: in other words, he isn't coming. | 25 |

## Feelings and decisions

| Format | Use | Example | Meaning | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {再也|zài yě}{不|bù} + verb (+ {了|le}) | never again, from now on | {那|nà}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{我|wǒ}{再也|zài yě}{不|bú}{去|qù}{了|le}。 | I'm never going to that restaurant again. | 23 |
| {再也|zài yě}{没|méi} + verb (+ {过|guo}) | never again, since then | {他|tā}{走|zǒu}{了|le}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{再也|zài yě}{没|méi}{回来|huí lái}{过|guo}。 | After he left, he never came back. | 23 |
| {怎么|zěn me}{都|dōu} / {怎么|zěn me}{也|yě} + {不|bù} / {没|méi} + verb | however hard you try | {我|wǒ}{怎么|zěn me}{都|dōu}{睡不着|shuì bu zháo}。 | I just couldn't get to sleep. | 23 |
| {还|hái} + X + {呢|ne} | "and you call yourself X!", "look who's talking" | {你|nǐ}{还|hái}{大学生|dà xué shēng}{呢|ne}，{这个|zhè ge}{字|zì}{都|dōu}{不|bú}{认识|rèn shi}？ | And you call yourself a university student? | 23 |
| {说|shuō}{什么|shén me}{也|yě}{得|děi} + verb | whatever happens, must | {这|zhè}{次|cì}{比赛|bǐ sài}，{我|wǒ}{说|shuō}{什么|shén me}{也|yě}{得|děi}{参加|cān jiā}。 | I'm taking part in this competition, whatever it takes. | 25 |
| X + {就|jiù}{是|shì}{了|le} | "just X, that's all; don't worry" | {你|nǐ}{放心|fàng xīn}{就|jiù}{是|shì}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{一定|yí dìng}{按时|àn shí}{到|dào}。 | Just don't worry: I'll be there on time. | 25 |
| {够|gòu} + adjective + {的|de} | "really quite…" | {今天|jīn tiān}{够|gòu}{冷|lěng}{的|de}，{多|duō}{穿|chuān}{点儿|diǎnr}{吧|ba}。 | It's pretty cold today: wear something warm. | 08 |

## Comparing and keeping apart

| Format | Use | Example | Meaning | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| X {是|shì} X，Y {是|shì} Y | keeps two things apart | {工作|gōng zuò}{是|shì}{工作|gōng zuò}，{朋友|péng you}{是|shì}{朋友|péng you}。 | Work is work and friends are friends. | 22 |
| {一|yī} + M + {比|bǐ} + {一|yī} + M | more and more, each one more than the last | {天气|tiān qì}{一|yì}{天|tiān}{比|bǐ}{一|yì}{天|tiān}{冷|lěng}{了|le}。 | It's getting colder by the day. | 09 |

## Also at level 4

Two more frames of the level-4 grammar outline, for recognition:

| Format | Use | Example | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| V + {一|yī} + X + {是|shì} + {一|yī} + X | every little bit counts | {时间|shí jiān}{不|bù}{多|duō}{了|le}，{能|néng}{复习|fù xí}{一|yì}{点儿|diǎnr}{是|shì}{一|yì}{点儿|diǎnr}。 | There isn't much time left: every bit of revision helps. |
| X {就|jiù} X ({点儿|diǎnr}) {吧|ba} | "so it's X, never mind" | {贵|guì}{就|jiù}{贵|guì}{点儿|diǎnr}{吧|ba}，{质量|zhì liàng}{好|hǎo}{就|jiù}{行|xíng}。 | So it's a bit dear, never mind: the quality is good. |

## Four-character patterns (lesson 22)

| Pattern | Meaning | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| {有|yǒu}A{有|yǒu}B | having both, in good measure | {有说有笑|yǒu shuō yǒu xiào} (chatting and laughing), {有山有水|yǒu shān yǒu shuǐ} (scenic), {有吃有喝|yǒu chī yǒu hē} (plenty to eat and drink) |
