vocab.note: A time noun, often set against {现在|xiàn zài}: {过去|guò qù}…，{现在|xiàn zài}…. The same characters are the verb {过去|guò qù} (to go over, HSK 2).
vocab.example: {过去|guò qù}{我|wǒ}{不|bù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{运动|yùn dòng}，{现在|xiàn zài}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{跑步|pǎo bù}。
vocab.exampleEn: I used to dislike sport; now I go running every day.

vocab.note: {变|biàn} (change) + {成|chéng} (into): always names the result. {水|shuǐ}{变成|biàn chéng}{了|le}{冰|bīng}。
vocab.example: {天|tiān}{冷|lěng}{了|le}，{水|shuǐ}{变成|biàn chéng}{了|le}{冰|bīng}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's got cold, and the water has turned to ice.

vocab.note: Often before a whole clause: {我|wǒ}{发现|fā xiàn}{手机|shǒu jī}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}。 For finding something you looked for, say {找|zhǎo}{到|dào}.
vocab.example: {到|dào}{了|le}{公司|gōng sī}，{我|wǒ}{才|cái}{发现|fā xiàn}{手机|shǒu jī}{不见|bú jiàn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Only when I got to the office did I notice my phone was missing.

vocab.note: Alone as an answer ({当然|dāng rán}！) or before a verb or {是|shì}: {当然|dāng rán}{可以|kě yǐ}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{想|xiǎng}{跟|gēn}{我们|wǒ men}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{吗|ma}？——{当然|dāng rán}{想|xiǎng}！
vocab.exampleEn: Do you want to come with us? — Of course I do!

vocab.note: Corrects what people think: {大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{说|shuō}{很|hěn}{难|nán}，{其实|qí shí}{很|hěn}{容易|róng yì}。
vocab.example: {他|tā}{看起来|kàn qǐ lai}{很|hěn}{年轻|nián qīng}，{其实|qí shí}{已经|yǐ jīng}{五十|wǔ shí}{岁|suì}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He looks young, but actually he's already fifty.

vocab.note: Before the examples: {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{运动|yùn dòng}，{比如|bǐ rú}{游泳|yóu yǒng}、{爬|pá}{山|shān}。 Also {比如|bǐ rú}{说|shuō}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{吃|chī}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}，{比如|bǐ rú}{西瓜|xī guā}、{香蕉|xiāng jiāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: I like fruit, for example watermelon and bananas.

vocab.note: At the start ({关于|guān yú}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}，…) or before a noun with {的|de}: {一|yì}{本|běn}{关于|guān yú}{中国|Zhōng guó}{历史|lì shǐ}{的|de}{书|shū}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{看|kàn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{关于|guān yú}{大熊猫|dà xióng māo}{的|de}{节目|jié mù}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd like to watch a programme about giant pandas.

vocab.note: A student studying in a country not their own, wherever that is.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{班|bān}{有|yǒu}{二十|èr shí}{个|gè}{留学生|liú xué shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are twenty international students in our class.

vocab.note: {名|míng} (name) + {单|dān} (a list, as in {菜单|cài dān}). {在|zài}{名单|míng dān}{上|shàng} (on the list).
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{看看|kàn kan}{名单|míng dān}{上|shàng}{有|yǒu}{没有|méi yǒu}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{名字|míng zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please check whether your name is on the list.

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{机会|jī huì} + verb: {有|yǒu}{机会|jī huì}{的话|de huà}，{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{看看|kàn kan}。 A good chance to do something: {一|yí}{个|gè}…{的|de}{好|hǎo}{机会|jī huì}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{练习|liàn xí}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{的|de}{好|hǎo}{机会|jī huì}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is a good opportunity to practise Chinese.

vocab.note: The second syllable is light: guān xi. {跟|gēn}…{有|yǒu}{关系|guān xi} (to have to do with); {没关系|méi guān xi} (it doesn't matter) is literally "no connection".
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}{的|de}{关系|guān xi}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The two of them get on very well.

vocab.note: {校|xiào} (school) + {园|yuán} (garden, park). {校园|xiào yuán}{生活|shēng huó}: campus life.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{校园|xiào yuán}{很|hěn}{大|dà}，{也|yě}{很|hěn}{漂亮|piào liang}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our campus is big and beautiful.

vocab.note: {图书|tú shū} (books, written) + {馆|guǎn} (a building for a purpose). {去|qù}{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}{借|jiè}{书|shū}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{下午|xià wǔ}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}{看|kàn}{书|shū}。
vocab.exampleEn: I go to the library to read every afternoon.

vocab.note: A little more formal than {帮|bāng}, and also a noun: {谢谢|xiè xie}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{帮助|bāng zhù}！ {帮忙|bāng máng} takes no object (×{帮忙|bāng máng}{我|wǒ}).
vocab.example: {刚|gāng}{来|lái}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{同学|tóng xué}{们|men}{帮助|bāng zhù}{了|le}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: When I'd just arrived, my classmates helped me a lot.

vocab.note: Separable, with no object after it: {跟|gēn}{他|tā}{见面|jiàn miàn} (not ×{见面|jiàn miàn}{他|tā}), {见|jiàn}{过|guo}{一|yí}{次|cì}{面|miàn}. By chance is {遇见|yù jiàn}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{明天|míng tiān}{下午|xià wǔ}{在|zài}{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}{门口|mén kǒu}{见面|jiàn miàn}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's meet at the library entrance tomorrow afternoon.

vocab.note: A decision about the future, before a verb ({我|wǒ}{打算|dǎ suàn}{明年|míng nián}{去|qù}), or a noun ({你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{打算|dǎ suàn}？). Compare {想|xiǎng} (a wish) and {准备|zhǔn bèi} (get ready).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{打算|dǎ suàn}{明年|míng nián}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}{留学|liú xué}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm planning to go and study in China next year.

vocab.note: At school or university; in everyday speech also "boys, lads", even for adults.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{班|bān}{的|de}{男生|nán shēng}{都|dōu}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{踢|tī}{足球|zú qiú}。
vocab.exampleEn: The boys in our class all like playing football.

vocab.note: At school or university; in everyday speech also "girls", even for adults. {女|nǚ} has ü: type nv3.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{班|bān}{女生|nǚ shēng}{比|bǐ}{男生|nán shēng}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are more women than men in this class.

vocab.note: {校|xiào} (school) + {长|zhǎng} (head of). Also the president of a university. Polite address: {王校长|Wáng xiào zhǎng}.
vocab.example: {校长|xiào zhǎng}{明天|míng tiān}{来|lái}{我们|wǒ men}{班|bān}{看看|kàn kan}。
vocab.exampleEn: The head teacher is coming to see our class tomorrow.

vocab.note: {去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}{留学|liú xué} (go to study in China), {在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{留学|liú xué}. It splits like a separable verb: {留|liú}{过|guo}{学|xué}, {留|liú}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{年|nián}{学|xué}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{留|liú}{过|guo}{学|xué}，{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: She studied in Beijing, and she speaks Chinese very well.

vocab.note: Borrow: {跟|gēn} / {向|xiàng} + person + {借|jiè} + thing. Lend: {借|jiè}{给|gěi} + person + thing ({我|wǒ}{借|jiè}{给|gěi}{他|tā}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{可以|kě yǐ}{跟|gēn}{你|nǐ}{借|jiè}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Can I borrow a book from you?

vocab.note: The same character as {还|hái} (still, also). {还|huán}{书|shū} (return books), {还|huán}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ} (give it back to you). {他|tā}{还|hái}{没|méi}{还|huán}: he hasn't returned it yet.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{我|wǒ}{明天|míng tiān}{还|huán}{你|nǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'll give you this book back tomorrow.

vocab.note: {本科生|běn kē shēng} is an undergraduate student; {读|dú}{本科|běn kē}: to do a first degree.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{本科|běn kē}{学|xué}{的|de}{是|shì}{新闻|xīn wén}。
vocab.exampleEn: She studied journalism as an undergraduate.

vocab.example: {下午|xià wǔ}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{学生|xué sheng}{在|zài}{操场|cāo chǎng}{上|shàng}{跑步|pǎo bù}。
vocab.exampleEn: In the afternoon lots of students run on the sports ground.

vocab.note: Something has changed since: {我|wǒ}{本来|běn lái}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}，{后来|hòu lái}{没|méi}{去|qù}。 With {就|jiù}: it goes without saying ({他|tā}{本来|běn lái}{就|jiù}{很|hěn}{瘦|shòu}). Compare {原来|yuán lái} (lesson 20), which can also mean "so it turns out".
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{本来|běn lái}{打算|dǎ suàn}{坐|zuò}{火车|huǒ chē}，{后来|hòu lái}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{机票|jī piào}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd originally planned to take the train, but then I bought a plane ticket.

vocab.note: Written style, in set phrases: {此次|cǐ cì}, {此外|cǐ wài}, {在此|zài cǐ}, {此时|cǐ shí}. In speech: {这|zhè}.
vocab.example: {此时|cǐ shí}，{教室|jiào shì}{里|lǐ}{很|hěn}{安静|ān jìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: At this moment the classroom was quiet.

vocab.note: Written style, for an event or occasion; in speech {这|zhè}{次|cì}.
vocab.example: {此次|cǐ cì}{考试|kǎo shì}{一共|yí gòng}{有|yǒu}{三百|sān bǎi}{名|míng}{学生|xué sheng}{参加|cān jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: Three hundred students are taking this exam.

vocab.note: {从来|cóng lái}{不|bù} + verb: never (as a habit). {从来|cóng lái}{没|méi} + verb + {过|guo}: never once. Rare without a negative; then with {都|dōu}: {他|tā}{从来|cóng lái}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{认真|rèn zhēn}。
vocab.example: {他|tā}{从来|cóng lái}{不|bù}{迟到|chí dào}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's never late.

vocab.note: Starts a new point in a written text, with a comma after it. In speech: {还|hái}{有|yǒu}, {另外|lìng wài}.
vocab.example: {学校|xué xiào}{有|yǒu}{三|sān}{个|gè}{食堂|shí táng}。{此外|cǐ wài}，{东|dōng}{边|biān}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{咖啡|kā fēi}{馆|guǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The university has three canteens. There's also a café on the east side.

vocab.note: Before some nouns ({各|gè}{国|guó}, {各|gè}{班|bān}) and measure words ({各位|gè wèi}, {各种|gè zhǒng}); often with {都|dōu}. Before a verb: each ({我们|wǒ men}{各|gè}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{一|yì}{本|běn}).
vocab.example: {各|gè}{国|guó}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}{都|dōu}{来|lái}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Students from every country came.

vocab.note: Stresses that no member of the set is left out; more formal than {每|měi}{个|gè}.
vocab.example: {各个|gè gè}{学院|xué yuàn}{都|dōu}{有|yǒu}{自己|zì jǐ}{的|de}{食堂|shí táng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Every college has its own canteen.

vocab.note: Polite address in a speech or notice: {各位|gè wèi}{同学|tóng xué}, {各位|gè wèi}{老师|lǎo shī}, {各位|gè wèi}. Not with {们|men}.
vocab.example: {各位|gè wèi}{同学|tóng xué}，{大家|dà jiā}{好|hǎo}！
vocab.exampleEn: Hello, everyone!

vocab.note: Before a noun: {各种|gè zhǒng}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}. The set phrase {各种各样|gè zhǒng gè yàng}: all sorts of.
vocab.example: {超市|chāo shì}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{各种|gè zhǒng}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}。
vocab.exampleEn: The supermarket has all kinds of fruit.

vocab.note: A job title in writing and on forms ({一|yì}{名|míng}{中学|zhōng xué}{教师|jiào shī}). Never used to address someone: say {老师|lǎo shī}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{是|shì}{一|yì}{名|míng}{中学|zhōng xué}{教师|jiào shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's a secondary-school teacher.

vocab.note: Addressed with the surname: {罗|Luó}{教授|jiào shòu} (Professor Luo). {教|jiào} is jiào here.
vocab.example: {夏|Xià}{教授|jiào shòu}{的|de}{课|kè}{很|hěn}{受欢迎|shòu huān yíng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Professor Xia's classes are very popular.

vocab.note: A course or a whole curriculum; one class you take is {一|yì}{门|mén}{课|kè}. {课程表|kè chéng biǎo}: a course timetable.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{学期|xué qī}{我|wǒ}{选|xuǎn}{了|le}{四|sì}{门|mén}{课程|kè chéng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've chosen four courses this term.

vocab.note: Join an organisation, team or group: {加入|jiā rù}{学生会|xué sheng huì}. You {参加|cān jiā} an event or an activity.
vocab.example: {欢迎|huān yíng}{你|nǐ}{加入|jiā rù}{我们|wǒ men}{学院|xué yuàn}！
vocab.exampleEn: Welcome to our college!

vocab.note: Takes an accepted fact and draws a conclusion: {既然|jì rán}…，(subject) {就|jiù}… Not with {所以|suǒ yǐ}.
vocab.example: {既然|jì rán}{你|nǐ}{已经|yǐ jīng}{决定|jué dìng}{了|le}，{就|jiù}{别|bié}{担心|dān xīn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Since you've made up your mind, stop worrying.

vocab.note: Written, for a whole school or class: {全|quán}{校|xiào}{师生|shī shēng}.
vocab.example: {学校|xué xiào}{的|de}{师生|shī shēng}{都|dōu}{来|lái}{参加|cān jiā}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The teachers and students of the school all came.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{中午|zhōng wǔ}{一般|yì bān}{在|zài}{食堂|shí táng}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: We usually have lunch in the canteen.

vocab.note: Written style and in words: {入学|rù xué}, {加入|jiā rù}, {入口|rù kǒu} (lesson 16). In speech: {进|jìn}.
vocab.example: {病从口入|bìng cóng kǒu rù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Illness gets in through the mouth. (a saying)

vocab.note: {九|jiǔ}{月|yuè}{入学|rù xué}: to start in September; {入学|rù xué}{考试|kǎo shì}: an entrance exam.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}2025{年|nián}{入学|rù xué}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: He started at the university in 2025.

vocab.note: Takes an object directly: {适应|shì yìng}{新|xīn}{环境|huán jìng}, {适应|shì yìng}{这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{天气|tiān qì}.
vocab.example: {刚|gāng}{来|lái}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{我|wǒ}{还|hái}{不|bú}{太|tài}{适应|shì yìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: When I'd just arrived, I wasn't used to it yet.

vocab.note: {对|duì}…{很|hěn}{熟悉|shú xī}: to know something well; as a verb, to get to know: {熟悉|shú xī}{一下|yí xià}{环境|huán jìng}. {熟|shú} is often said shóu in speech.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{对|duì}{这儿|zhèr}{很|hěn}{熟悉|shú xī}，{我|wǒ}{带|dài}{你|nǐ}{去|qù}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: I know this place well, so I'll take you.

vocab.note: Before a noun, usually without a measure word: {任何|rèn hé}{人|rén}, {任何|rèn hé}{问题|wèn tí}. With {都|dōu} / {也|yě} before the verb ({任何|rèn hé}{人|rén}{都|dōu}…), or after a negative ({没有|méi yǒu}{任何|rèn hé}{问题|wèn tí}).
vocab.example: {有|yǒu}{任何|rèn hé}{问题|wèn tí}，{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ}{问|wèn}{我|wǒ}。
vocab.exampleEn: If you have any questions at all, you can ask me.

vocab.note: A college or school within a university ({外语学院|wài yǔ xué yuàn}), or a smaller institution.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{学院|xué yuàn}{有|yǒu}{三百|sān bǎi}{多|duō}{个|gè}{学生|xué sheng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our college has over three hundred students.

vocab.note: {你|nǐ}{是|shì}{什么|shén me}{专业|zhuān yè}{的|de}？ As an adjective: professional ({他|tā}{做|zuò}{得|de}{很|hěn}{专业|zhuān yè}).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{是|shì}{什么|shén me}{专业|zhuān yè}{的|de}？
vocab.exampleEn: What's your major?

vocab.note: WORDS.tsv lists it as a verb (to sit a written exam); it is taught here as the noun, as in {笔试|bǐ shì}{和|hé}{口语|kǒu yǔ}.
vocab.example: {笔试|bǐ shì}{一共|yí gòng}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
vocab.exampleEn: The written exam lasts two hours.

vocab.note: Redo something from the beginning, often to replace a first try: {重新|chóng xīn}{写|xiě}, {重新|chóng xīn}{开始|kāi shǐ}. Compare {再|zài} (once more, to come) and {又|yòu} (again, it happened).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{句子|jù zi}{写|xiě}{得|de}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}，{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{重新|chóng xīn}{写|xiě}。
vocab.exampleEn: This sentence isn't good; I want to rewrite it.

vocab.note: Read chóng: the short form of {重新|chóng xīn}, before one-syllable verbs: {重写|chóng xiě}, {重做|chóng zuò}, {重来|chóng lái}. The same character is zhòng in {重要|zhòng yào} and {重点|zhòng diǎn}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{字|zì}{写|xiě}{错|cuò}{了|le}，{你|nǐ}{重写|chóng xiě}{一|yí}{个|gè}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: You've written this character wrong; write it again.

vocab.note: The answer written down, often the answer key: {把|bǎ}{答案|dá àn}{写|xiě}{在|zài}{这儿|zhèr}. Replying to someone is {回答|huí dá}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{答案|dá àn}{写|xiě}{在|zài}{这儿|zhèr}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please write your answers here.

vocab.note: Measure word {台|tái}: {一|yì}{台|tái}{打印机|dǎ yìn jī}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{家|jiā}{的|de}{打印机|dǎ yìn jī}{坏|huài}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our printer at home is broken.

vocab.note: Also "a fraction" in maths (lesson 15).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{考试|kǎo shì}{他|tā}{的|de}{分数|fēn shù}{很|hěn}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: He got a very high mark in this exam.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{都|dōu}{认真|rèn zhēn}{做|zuò}{功课|gōng kè}。
vocab.exampleEn: He does his homework carefully every evening.

vocab.example: {寒假|hán jià}{我|wǒ}{打算|dǎ suàn}{去|qù}{南方|nán fāng}{玩儿|wánr}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm planning to go south for a trip in the winter holiday.

vocab.note: {答|dá}{题|tí}: to answer questions; {答|dá}{对|duì} / {答|dá}{错|cuò}: to get it right / wrong.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{我|wǒ}{答|dá}{错|cuò}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I got this question wrong.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{把|bǎ}{时间表|shí jiān biǎo}{打印|dǎ yìn}{一下|yí xià}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd like to print out the timetable.

vocab.note: Separable: {点|diǎn}{了|le}{名|míng}.
vocab.example: {上课|shàng kè}{以前|yǐ qián}，{老师|lǎo shī}{先|xiān}{点名|diǎn míng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Before class the teacher takes the register.

vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{这|zhè}{页|yè}{复印|fù yìn}{两|liǎng}{张|zhāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please make two copies of this page.

vocab.note: {改|gǎi}{作业|zuò yè}: to mark homework; {改|gǎi}{时间|shí jiān}: to change the time; {改成|gǎi chéng}: to change into.
vocab.example: {老师|lǎo shī}{正在|zhèng zài}{改|gǎi}{我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{作业|zuò yè}。
vocab.exampleEn: The teacher is marking our homework.

vocab.note: For people, products and exams: {合格|hé gé}{的|de}{老师|lǎo shī} (a qualified teacher). Passing an exam is also {及格|jí gé}.
vocab.example: {口语|kǒu yǔ}{和|hé}{笔试|bǐ shì}{都|dōu}{要|yào}{合格|hé gé}。
vocab.exampleEn: Both the oral and the written exam have to be passed.

vocab.note: A noun ({有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{错误|cuò wù}) and a formal adjective ({错误|cuò wù}{的|de}{答案|dá àn}). In speech "wrong" is {错|cuò}. WORDS.tsv lists the adjective first; the lesson teaches the noun first.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{作业|zuò yè}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{错误|cuò wù}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are a lot of mistakes in your homework.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{基础|jī chǔ}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: He has a good grounding in Chinese.

vocab.note: {教|jiào} is jiào here.
vocab.example: {王|Wáng}{老师|lǎo shī}{的|de}{教学|jiào xué}{方法|fāng fǎ}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Teacher Wang's teaching methods are very good.

vocab.example: {每|měi}{位|wèi}{考生|kǎo shēng}{有|yǒu}{十|shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Each candidate has ten minutes.

vocab.note: {课堂|kè táng}{上|shàng}: in class. The room itself is {教室|jiào shì}.
vocab.example: {课堂|kè táng}{上|shàng}{不|bù}{能|néng}{用|yòng}{手机|shǒu jī}。
vocab.exampleEn: You can't use your phone in class.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{口语|kǒu yǔ}{比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: His spoken Chinese is better than mine.

vocab.note: {交|jiāo}{作业|zuò yè}, {交|jiāo}{表|biǎo} (hand in a form); also {交|jiāo}{朋友|péng you} (to make friends) and {交|jiāo}{钱|qián} (to pay).
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{上午|shàng wǔ}{要|yào}{交|jiāo}{作业|zuò yè}。
vocab.exampleEn: The homework has to be handed in tomorrow morning.

vocab.note: In words: {周末|zhōu mò}, {期末|qī mò}, {月|yuè}{末|mò}. Don't confuse with {未|wèi} (the top horizontal of {末|mò} is the longer one).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{月|yuè}{末|mò}{我|wǒ}{要|yào}{去|qù}{上海|Shàng hǎi}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm going to Shanghai at the end of this month.

vocab.note: {期末|qī mò}{考试|kǎo shì}: end-of-term exams.
vocab.example: {期末|qī mò}{考试|kǎo shì}{在|zài}{六|liù}{月|yuè}。
vocab.exampleEn: The end-of-term exams are in June.

vocab.note: {期中|qī zhōng}{考试|kǎo shì}: mid-term exams.
vocab.example: {下|xià}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{就|jiù}{是|shì}{期中|qī zhōng}{考试|kǎo shì}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The mid-term exams are next week.

vocab.example: {考试|kǎo shì}{时间表|shí jiān biǎo}{在|zài}{学院|xué yuàn}{网站|wǎng zhàn}{上|shàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The exam timetable is on the college website.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{的|de}{试题|shì tí}{不|bú}{太|tài}{难|nán}。
vocab.exampleEn: The questions this time weren't too hard.

vocab.example: {暑假|shǔ jià}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{海|hǎi}{边|biān}{玩儿|wánr}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: We went to the seaside in the summer holiday.

vocab.note: A period of time ({学期|xué qī}, {期中|qī zhōng}) and, with a number, an issue or an intake: {第|dì}{一|yī}{期|qī}, {这|zhè}{期|qī}{杂志|zá zhì} (this issue of the magazine; {杂志|zá zhì}: lesson 03).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{我们|wǒ men}{学校|xué xiào}{第|dì}{一|yī}{期|qī}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}。
vocab.exampleEn: These are our school's first intake of students.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{听力|tīng lì}{不|bú}{太|tài}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: My listening isn't very good.

vocab.note: {对|duì}…{很|hěn}{严格|yán gé}: strict with someone; {严格|yán gé}{要求|yāo qiú}: to demand a lot.
vocab.example: {王|Wáng}{老师|lǎo shī}{对|duì}{学生|xué sheng}{很|hěn}{严格|yán gé}。
vocab.exampleEn: Teacher Wang is strict with her students.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{台|tái}{打印机|dǎ yìn jī}, {一|yì}{台|tái}{电脑|diàn nǎo}, {一|yì}{台|tái}{空调|kōng tiáo}. The track keeps {台|tái} in traditional script.
vocab.example: {办公室|bàn gōng shì}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{台|tái}{打印机|dǎ yìn jī}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are two printers in the office.

vocab.note: {重|zhòng} is zhòng here.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{考试|kǎo shì}{的|de}{重点|zhòng diǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is the focus of the exam.

vocab.note: {预习|yù xí} before class, {复习|fù xí} after it.
vocab.example: {上课|shàng kè}{以前|yǐ qián}{要|yào}{先|xiān}{预习|yù xí}{课文|kè wén}。
vocab.exampleEn: You should prepare the text before class.

vocab.note: {允许|yǔn xǔ} + person + verb: {老师|lǎo shī}{不|bù}{允许|yǔn xǔ}{我们|wǒ men}{用|yòng}{手机|shǒu jī}.
vocab.example: {考试|kǎo shì}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{不|bù}{允许|yǔn xǔ}{说话|shuō huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: No talking during the exam.

meanings: to study by oneself (in set time)
vocab.note: Time set aside for study at school: {星期|xīng qī}{五|wǔ}{下午|xià wǔ}{是|shì}{自习|zì xí}; {晚自习|wǎn zì xí}: evening study.
vocab.example: {下午|xià wǔ}{没|méi}{课|kè}，{我们|wǒ men}{在|zài}{教室|jiào shì}{自习|zì xí}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are no classes this afternoon, so we're studying in the classroom.

vocab.note: Formal: {正确|zhèng què}{的|de}{答案|dá àn}, {回答|huí dá}{正确|zhèng què}. "You're right" is still {你|nǐ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{对|duì}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{答案|dá àn}{是|shì}{正确|zhèng què}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: Your answer is correct.

vocab.note: {仔|zǐ} is zǐ here.
vocab.example: {考试|kǎo shì}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{要|yào}{仔细|zǐ xì}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}。
vocab.exampleEn: Be careful in the exam.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{新|xīn}{词语|cí yǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of new words and expressions in this article.

vocab.note: A little more formal than {找|zhǎo} or {查|chá}: {查找|chá zhǎo}{资料|zī liào}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{图书馆|tú shū guǎn}{查找|chá zhǎo}{资料|zī liào}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm looking up material in the library.

vocab.note: {者|zhě}: a person who… ({作者|zuò zhě}, {读者|dú zhě}). The verb "to read" is {读|dú}, {看|kàn} or {阅读|yuè dú}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{杂志|zá zhì}{的|de}{读者|dú zhě}{大多|dà duō}{是|shì}{年轻|nián qīng}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: Most of this magazine's readers are young people.

vocab.note: {把|bǎ}…{翻译|fān yì}{成|chéng}…: translate something into… Also a translator ({她|tā}{是|shì}{一|yì}{名|míng}{翻译|fān yì}).
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{这个|zhè ge}{句子|jù zi}{翻译|fān yì}{成|chéng}{英文|Yīng wén}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please translate this sentence into English.

vocab.note: {内容|nèi róng}{丰富|fēng fù} (full of content), {丰富|fēng fù}{的|de}{经验|jīng yàn} (rich experience); also a verb, to enrich.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{的|de}{内容|nèi róng}{很|hěn}{丰富|fēng fù}。
vocab.exampleEn: This book is full of interesting content.

vocab.note: A formal {更|gèng}, usually before a two-syllable word: {更加|gèng jiā}{努力|nǔ lì}, {更加|gèng jiā}{丰富|fēng fù}.
vocab.example: {考试|kǎo shì}{快|kuài}{到|dào}{了|le}，{大家|dà jiā}{学习|xué xí}{更加|gèng jiā}{努力|nǔ lì}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The exams are coming, so everyone is working even harder.

vocab.note: {举|jǔ}{个|gè}{例子|lì zi}: to give an example.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{能|néng}{举|jǔ}{个|gè}{例子|lì zi}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Can you give an example?

vocab.note: A verb ({给|gěi}{他|tā}{回信|huí xìn}) and the reply itself ({收到|shōu dào}{他|tā}{的|de}{回信|huí xìn}).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{还|hái}{没|méi}{给|gěi}{他|tā}{回信|huí xìn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I haven't written back to him yet.

vocab.note: Names a thing or explains a term; a little more formal than {叫|jiào}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{花|huā}{叫作|jiào zuò}{牡丹|mǔ dān}。
vocab.exampleEn: This flower is called the peony.

vocab.note: In speech usually said in full: {举|jǔ}{个|gè}{例子|lì zi} ({举|jǔ} + {个|gè} + {例子|lì zi}).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{能|néng}{举例|jǔ lì}{说|shuō}{一下|yí xià}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Can you explain with an example?

vocab.note: Introduces examples, mostly in writing; in speech {比如|bǐ rú}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{运动|yùn dòng}，{例如|lì rú}{游泳|yóu yǒng}{和|hé}{跑步|pǎo bù}。
vocab.exampleEn: He likes lots of sports, for example swimming and running.

vocab.note: Also a row or a column (in a table).
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{要|yào}{买|mǎi}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}{列|liè}{一下|yí xià}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please make a list of the things we need to buy.

vocab.note: {连|lián} + the extreme case + {都|dōu} / {也|yě}: {连|lián}{小孩儿|xiǎo háir}{都|dōu}{知道|zhī dào}. With a negative: {连|lián}{一|yí}{个|gè}{字|zì}{都|dōu}{没|méi}{写|xiě}. ({连|lián} also means "to link", in {连|lián}{起来|qǐ lái}.)
vocab.example: {他|tā}{太|tài}{忙|máng}{了|le}，{连|lián}{饭|fàn}{都|dōu}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{吃|chī}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's so busy he even forgot to eat.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{考试|kǎo shì}{的|de}{内容|nèi róng}{是|shì}{第|dì}{一|yī}{课|kè}{到|dào}{第|dì}{五|wǔ}{课|kè}。
vocab.exampleEn: This exam covers lessons 1 to 5.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng}, {一|yì}{篇|piān}{日记|rì jì}, {一|yì}{篇|piān}{作文|zuò wén}. WORDS.tsv lists it as a noun; it is taught as the measure word.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{写|xiě}{了|le}{一|yì}{篇|piān}{日记|rì jì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I wrote a diary entry yesterday.

vocab.note: "The common speech": the standard language of mainland China.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{普通话|pǔ tōng huà}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: He speaks very good Mandarin.

vocab.note: Points back to a group just mentioned: {二十|èr shí}{个|gè}{学生|xué sheng}，{其中|qí zhōng}{五|wǔ}{个|gè}{是|shì}{留学生|liú xué shēng}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{班|bān}{有|yǒu}{二十|èr shí}{个|gè}{学生|xué sheng}，{其中|qí zhōng}{五|wǔ}{个|gè}{是|shì}{留学生|liú xué shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are twenty students in our class, five of whom are international students.

vocab.note: {写|xiě}{日记|rì jì}: to keep a diary.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{写|xiě}{日记|rì jì}。
vocab.exampleEn: She writes in her diary every evening.

vocab.note: {按|àn}{顺序|shùn xù}: in order ({按|àn}: by, lesson 13).
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{句子|jù zi}{的|de}{顺序|shùn xù}{不|bú}{对|duì}。
vocab.exampleEn: These sentences are in the wrong order.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{首|shǒu}{歌|gē}, {一|yì}{首|shǒu}{诗|shī}. {首|shǒu} is also "head, first" in {首都|shǒu dū} and {首先|shǒu xiān}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{首|shǒu}{歌|gē}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}。
vocab.exampleEn: I really like this song.

vocab.note: Before the most extreme item: {三|sān}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}，{甚至|shèn zhì}{四|sì}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}. Often with {连|lián}: {甚至|shèn zhì}{连|lián}{饭|fàn}{都|dōu}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{吃|chī}.
vocab.example: {这儿|zhèr}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}，{五|wǔ}{月|yuè}{甚至|shèn zhì}{还|hái}{会|huì}{下|xià}{雪|xuě}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's very cold here; it can even snow in May.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{图|tú}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of pictures in this book.

vocab.note: Measure word {篇|piān}: {一|yì}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng}{写|xiě}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: This article is very well written.

vocab.example: {汉字|hàn zì}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{的|de}{文字|wén zì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Chinese characters are China's writing system.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{本|běn}{小说|xiǎo shuō} (a book), {一|yì}{篇|piān}{小说|xiǎo shuō} (a short story as a piece of writing).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{最近|zuì jìn}{在|zài}{看|kàn}{一|yì}{本|běn}{小说|xiǎo shuō}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm reading a novel at the moment.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{信|xìn}{里|lǐ}{提到|tí dào}{了|le}{你|nǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: He mentioned you in his letter.

vocab.example: {汉语|Hàn yǔ}{的|de}{语法|yǔ fǎ}{不|bú}{太|tài}{难|nán}。
vocab.exampleEn: Chinese grammar isn't too hard.

vocab.note: Measure word {本|běn}; {一|yì}{期|qī}{杂志|zá zhì}: an issue. Traditional {+{杂志|zá zhì}+}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{每|měi}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{买|mǎi}{一|yì}{本|běn}{杂志|zá zhì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I buy a magazine every month.

vocab.example: {看|kàn}{书|shū}{可以|kě yǐ}{学|xué}{到|dào}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{知识|zhī shi}。
vocab.exampleEn: You can learn a lot from reading.

vocab.example: {写|xiě}{论文|lùn wén}{要|yào}{查找|chá zhǎo}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{资料|zī liào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Writing a thesis means looking up a lot of material.

vocab.note: A writer by profession. The author of a particular work is its {作者|zuò zhě}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{是|shì}{一|yí}{位|wèi}{有名|yǒu míng}{的|de}{作家|zuò jiā}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's a well-known writer.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{过|guo}{他|tā}{的|de}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{作品|zuò pǐn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've read many of his works.

vocab.note: The author of a particular book or article: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{的|de}{作者|zuò zhě}. A writer by profession is a {作家|zuò jiā}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng}{的|de}{作者|zuò zhě}{是|shì}{谁|shéi}？
vocab.exampleEn: Who's the author of this article?

vocab.note: Formal, also the noun "reading": {阅读|yuè dú}{能力|néng lì} (reading ability). In speech {看|kàn}{书|shū}, {读|dú}{书|shū}.
vocab.example: {每|měi}{天|tiān}{阅读|yuè dú}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}，{对|duì}{学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{帮助|bāng zhù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Reading for half an hour a day helps a lot with learning Chinese.

vocab.note: {他|tā}{是|shì}{自学|zì xué}{的|de}{英语|Yīng yǔ}: he taught himself English.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{的|de}{日语|Rì yǔ}{是|shì}{自学|zì xué}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: She taught herself Japanese.

vocab.note: {报名|bào míng}{参加|cān jiā}{比赛|bǐ sài}: to sign up for a contest. Separable: {报|bào}{了|le}{名|míng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{已经|yǐ jīng}{报名|bào míng}{参加|cān jiā}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{比赛|bǐ sài}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've already signed up for the Chinese contest.

vocab.note: Usually by a teacher or a boss, in front of others.
vocab.example: {老师|lǎo shī}{在|zài}{课堂|kè táng}{上|shàng}{表扬|biǎo yáng}{了|le}{他|tā}。
vocab.exampleEn: The teacher praised him in class.

meanings: to take part in a contest
vocab.note: Written: {参赛|cān sài}{的|de}{人|rén} (contestants), {参赛|cān sài}{人数|rén shù}.
vocab.example: {今年|jīn nián}{参赛|cān sài}{的|de}{学生|xué sheng}{比|bǐ}{去年|qù nián}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: More students are taking part in the contest this year than last.

vocab.note: Spoken praise: {你|nǐ}{真|zhēn}{棒|bàng}！{太|tài}{棒|bàng}{了|le}！ ({棒|bàng} is also a stick.)
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{演讲|yǎn jiǎng}{太|tài}{棒|bàng}{了|le}！
vocab.exampleEn: Your speech was brilliant!

vocab.note: Like {不仅|bù jǐn} and {不但|bú dàn}, with {还|hái} / {而且|ér qiě} / {也|yě} in the second clause; everyday speech.
vocab.example: {这儿|zhèr}{不光|bù guāng}{有|yǒu}{中国|Zhōng guó}{学生|xué sheng}，{也|yě}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{留学生|liú xué shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: There aren't only Chinese students here; there are lots of international students too.

vocab.note: Joins verbs or clauses, not nouns; a little formal. {不仅|bù jǐn}…{并且|bìng qiě}… is possible too.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{报|bào}{了|le}{名|míng}，{并且|bìng qiě}{交|jiāo}{了|le}{钱|qián}。
vocab.exampleEn: He signed up and also paid.

vocab.note: {不仅|bù jǐn}…{还|hái} / {而且|ér qiě} / {也|yě}: not only… but also. One subject goes before {不仅|bù jǐn}; {不仅如此|bù jǐn rú cǐ}: not only that.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{不仅|bù jǐn}{会|huì}{唱歌|chàng gē}，{还|hái}{会|huì}{跳舞|tiào wǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: She can not only sing but dance too.

meanings: (measure word for games, shows and events)
vocab.note: {一|yì}{场|chǎng}{比赛|bǐ sài}, {一|yì}{场|chǎng}{电影|diàn yǐng}, {一|yì}{场|chǎng}{考试|kǎo shì}. {场|chǎng} is also a place, as in {操场|cāo chǎng}, {市场|shì chǎng}.
vocab.example: {昨天|zuó tiān}{的|de}{那|nà}{场|chǎng}{比赛|bǐ sài}{你|nǐ}{看|kàn}{了|le}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Did you watch yesterday's match?

vocab.example: {下|xià}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{学校|xué xiào}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{场|chǎng}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{大赛|dà sài}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a Chinese contest at the university next month.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{队|duì}{有|yǒu}{五|wǔ}{个|gè}{队员|duì yuán}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our team has five members.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{我们|wǒ men}{队|duì}{的|de}{队长|duì zhǎng}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's our team captain.

vocab.note: {球队|qiú duì} (a ball team, lesson 07); {排队|pái duì} (to queue, lesson 09).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{想|xiǎng}{加入|jiā rù}{我们|wǒ men}{队|duì}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Do you want to join our team?

vocab.note: The opponent is the object: {打败|dǎ bài}{了|le}{三|sān}{班|bān}. With {被|bèi}: {被|bèi}…{打败|dǎ bài} (to be beaten).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{打败|dǎ bài}{了|le}{三|sān}{班|bān}。
vocab.exampleEn: We beat Class 3.

vocab.note: {鼓励|gǔ lì} + person + verb: {老师|lǎo shī}{鼓励|gǔ lì}{我|wǒ}{报名|bào míng}. Also a noun: {谢谢|xiè xie}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{鼓励|gǔ lì}.
vocab.example: {王|Wáng}{老师|lǎo shī}{鼓励|gǔ lì}{我|wǒ}{参加|cān jiā}{比赛|bǐ sài}。
vocab.exampleEn: Teacher Wang encouraged me to take part in the contest.

vocab.example: {有|yǒu}{人|rén}{在|zài}{外面|wài miàn}{喊|hǎn}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{名字|míng zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Someone's outside calling my name.

vocab.note: {一等奖|yī děng jiǎng} (first prize), {得|dé}{奖|jiǎng} (to win a prize).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{得|dé}{了|le}{二等奖|èr děng jiǎng}。
vocab.exampleEn: She won second prize.

vocab.example: {第一名|dì yī míng}{有|yǒu}{一千|yì qiān}{块|kuài}{奖金|jiǎng jīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: First place gets a thousand yuan in prize money.

vocab.note: WORDS.tsv lists it first as a verb ("to move about, exercise"); taught here as the noun. Measure word {项|xiàng} or {个|gè}.
vocab.example: {学校|xué xiào}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{有意思|yǒu yì si}{的|de}{活动|huó dòng}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of interesting activities at the university.

vocab.note: With prizes, places, results and chances: {获得|huò dé}{第一名|dì yī míng}, {获得|huò dé}{机会|jī huì}. In speech {得|dé} / {得到|dé dào}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{获得|huò dé}{了|le}{第一名|dì yī míng}。
vocab.exampleEn: He won first place.

vocab.note: {获奖|huò jiǎng}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué}: the prizewinners.
vocab.example: {获奖|huò jiǎng}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué}{可以|kě yǐ}{去|qù}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{参加|cān jiā}{全|quán}{国|guó}{大赛|dà sài}。
vocab.exampleEn: The prizewinners can go to Shanghai for the national contest.

vocab.note: Neutral to formal; also for reaching a stage: {进入|jìn rù}{最后|zuì hòu}{一|yì}{场|chǎng} (get into the final).
vocab.example: {十|shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{进入|jìn rù}{了|le}{最后|zuì hòu}{一|yì}{场|chǎng}{比赛|bǐ sài}。
vocab.exampleEn: Ten people got into the final.

vocab.note: {举手|jǔ shǒu}: to raise your hand. Also in {举例|jǔ lì}, {举办|jǔ bàn}, {举行|jǔ xíng}.
vocab.example: {知道|zhī dào}{答案|dá àn}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué}{请|qǐng}{举手|jǔ shǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: Those who know the answer, raise your hands.

vocab.note: The organiser is usually the subject: {学校|xué xiào}{举办|jǔ bàn}{了|le}{一|yì}{场|chǎng}{大赛|dà sài}. Compare {举行|jǔ xíng} (the event takes place).
vocab.example: {学校|xué xiào}{每|měi}{年|nián}{都|dōu}{举办|jǔ bàn}{一|yí}{次|cì}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{大赛|dà sài}。
vocab.exampleEn: The university holds a Chinese contest every year.

vocab.note: Often the event is the subject, with a time or place: {比赛|bǐ sài}{在|zài}{礼堂|lǐ táng}{举行|jǔ xíng}. The verb for ceremonies and meetings.
vocab.example: {比赛|bǐ sài}{在|zài}{大|dà}{礼堂|lǐ táng}{举行|jǔ xíng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The contest takes place in the main hall.

vocab.note: Adds a further reason or circumstance; {再|zài}{加上|jiā shàng} in speech.
vocab.example: {天气|tiān qì}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}，{加上|jiā shàng}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{来|lái}{的|de}{人|rén}{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: It was cold, and with the rain on top, few people came.

vocab.note: Starts a new point (written partner: {此外|cǐ wài}); before a number or noun, "the other": {另外|lìng wài}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{门|mén}{课|kè}{有|yǒu}{笔试|bǐ shì}，{另外|lìng wài}{还|hái}{有|yǒu}{口语|kǒu yǔ}{考试|kǎo shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The course has a written exam, and an oral exam as well.

vocab.example: {今年|jīn nián}{的|de}{参赛|cān sài}{人数|rén shù}{是|shì}{历年|lì nián}{最|zuì}{多|duō}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: This year's number of contestants is the highest ever.

vocab.note: A verb ({排|pái}{好|hǎo}, {排队|pái duì}) and a row: {第|dì}{一|yī}{排|pái} (the front row).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{坐|zuò}{在|zài}{第|dì}{一|yī}{排|pái}。
vocab.exampleEn: We're sitting in the front row.

vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{获奖|huò jiǎng}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{庆祝|qìng zhù}{一下|yí xià}{吧|ba}！
vocab.exampleEn: You've won a prize; let's go and celebrate!

vocab.note: A game or a match, never a thing (losing a thing is {丢|diū}). {输|shū}{给|gěi}…: lose to…
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{输|shū}{给|gěi}{了|le}{三|sān}{班|bān}。
vocab.exampleEn: We lost to Class 3.

vocab.example: {老师|lǎo shī}{让|ràng}{我们|wǒ men}{分|fēn}{成|chéng}{三|sān}{个|gè}{小组|xiǎo zǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: The teacher had us split into three groups.

vocab.note: {一|yí}{项|xiàng}{比赛|bǐ sài} (an event), {一|yí}{项|xiàng}{活动|huó dòng}, {一|yí}{项|xiàng}{工作|gōng zuò} (a task).
vocab.example: {大赛|dà sài}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{项|xiàng}{比赛|bǐ sài}。
vocab.exampleEn: The contest has two events.

vocab.note: A noun ({分|fēn}{成|chéng}{三|sān}{个|gè}{组|zǔ}) and a verb, to form: {组|zǔ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{队|duì}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{组|zǔ}{有|yǒu}{四|sì}{个|gè}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are four people in our group.

vocab.note: {邀请|yāo qǐng} + person + verb; more formal than {请|qǐng}. Also a noun: {谢谢|xiè xie}{您|nín}{的|de}{邀请|yāo qǐng}.
vocab.example: {学院|xué yuàn}{邀请|yāo qǐng}{获奖|huò jiǎng}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué}{参加|cān jiā}{晚会|wǎn huì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The college has invited the prizewinners to an evening party.

vocab.note: The game ({赢|yíng}{了|le}{比赛|bǐ sài}) or, in speech, the opponent ({赢|yíng}{了|le}{三|sān}{班|bān}).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{赢|yíng}{了|le}！
vocab.exampleEn: We won!

vocab.note: Something earned: {赢得|yíng dé}{掌声|zhǎng shēng} (applause), {赢得|yíng dé}{支持|zhī chí} (support).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{的|de}{演讲|yǎn jiǎng}{赢得|yíng dé}{了|le}{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{掌声|zhǎng shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Her speech won everyone's applause.

vocab.example: {今年|jīn nián}{我们|wǒ men}{学院|xué yuàn}{有|yǒu}{三百|sān bǎi}{名|míng}{毕业生|bì yè shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our college has three hundred graduates this year.

vocab.note: The degree and its holder: {读|dú}{博士|bó shì} (to do a PhD), {钱|Qián}{博士|bó shì} (Dr Qian). A medical doctor is {医生|yī shēng}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{在|zài}{英国|Yīng guó}{读|dú}{博士|bó shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's doing a PhD in Britain.

meanings: to apply to sit an entrance exam
vocab.note: With the school or course you hope to enter: {报考|bào kǎo}{研究生|yán jiū shēng}, {报考|bào kǎo}{北京大学|Běi jīng Dà xué}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{今年|jīn nián}{报考|bào kǎo}{了|le}{研究生|yán jiū shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's sitting the postgraduate entrance exam this year.

vocab.note: Separable and without an object: {大学|dà xué}{毕业|bì yè} (graduate from university), {毕|bì}{了|le}{业|yè}. Written: {毕业|bì yè}{于|yú} + the school.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{明年|míng nián}{大学|dà xué}{毕业|bì yè}。
vocab.exampleEn: I graduate from university next year.

vocab.note: {为|wéi} is wéi here (the written "to be"). {成为|chéng wéi}{一|yì}{名|míng}{记者|jì zhě}: to become a journalist.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{想|xiǎng}{成为|chéng wéi}{一|yì}{名|míng}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: She wants to become a teacher.

vocab.note: {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{成功|chéng gōng}！ Good luck (I wish you success)!
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{他|tā}{终于|zhōng yú}{成功|chéng gōng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This time he finally succeeded.

vocab.note: The national exam Chinese school-leavers take to enter university.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{高考|gāo kǎo}{考|kǎo}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: He did very well in the gaokao.

vocab.example: {再|zài}{难|nán}{也|yě}{不|bú}{要|yào}{放弃|fàng qì}。
vocab.exampleEn: However hard it gets, don't give up.

vocab.note: For bigger changes ({改变|gǎi biàn}{计划|jì huà}, {改变|gǎi biàn}{生活|shēng huó}); {改|gǎi} is the short everyday verb, {变|biàn} for something changing by itself.
vocab.example: {来|lái}{中国|Zhōng guó}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{我|wǒ}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}{改变|gǎi biàn}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: My life has changed a lot since I came to China.

vocab.note: Written: contrast between two clauses ({哥哥|gē ge}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{运动|yùn dòng}，{而|ér}{弟弟|dì di}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{看|kàn}{书|shū}), or joining two adjectives ({简单|jiǎn dān}{而|ér}{有用|yǒu yòng}). In {而且|ér qiě}, {而是|ér shì}, {然而|rán ér}.
vocab.example: {哥哥|gē ge}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{运动|yùn dòng}，{而|ér}{弟弟|dì di}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{看|kàn}{书|shū}。
vocab.exampleEn: My older brother likes sport, while my younger brother likes reading.

vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{毕业|bì yè}{以后|yǐ hòu}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{计划|jì huà}？
vocab.exampleEn: What are your plans after you graduate?

vocab.note: The longer view; {今后|jīn hòu} is "from now on".
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{将来|jiāng lái}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: One day I'd like to work in China.

vocab.example: {她|tā}{申请|shēn qǐng}{了|le}{学校|xué xiào}{的|de}{奖学金|jiǎng xué jīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: She applied for a university scholarship.

vocab.note: {教|jiào} is jiào here.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{受|shòu}{了|le}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{教育|jiào yù}。
vocab.exampleEn: He received a very good education in Beijing.

vocab.note: Starts from the present moment; {将来|jiāng lái} is somewhere ahead.
vocab.example: {今后|jīn hòu}{我|wǒ}{会|huì}{更加|gèng jiā}{努力|nǔ lì}。
vocab.exampleEn: From now on I'll work even harder.

vocab.note: Especially one's dream job: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{理想|lǐ xiǎng}{是|shì}{当|dāng}{医生|yī shēng}. As an adjective: ideal ({很|hěn}{理想|lǐ xiǎng}).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{理想|lǐ xiǎng}{是|shì}{成为|chéng wéi}{一|yì}{名|míng}{医生|yī shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: My dream is to become a doctor.

vocab.example: {休息|xiū xi}{一下|yí xià}，{我们|wǒ men}{再|zài}{继续|jì xù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's have a break and then carry on.

vocab.note: {让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{考虑|kǎo lǜ}{一下|yí xià} : let me think about it.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{考虑|kǎo lǜ}{过|guo}{去|qù}{国外|guó wài}{留学|liú xué}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Have you thought about studying abroad?

vocab.note: Written, for something that will happen soon; in speech {快要|kuài yào}…{了|le}.
vocab.example: {你们|nǐ men}{将要|jiāng yào}{离开|lí kāi}{学校|xué xiào}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: You'll soon be leaving the university.

vocab.note: Written future: {典礼|diǎn lǐ}{将|jiāng}{在|zài}{六|liù}{月|yuè}{举行|jǔ xíng}. In lesson 13 it also stands for {把|bǎ} in written instructions ({请|qǐng}{将|jiāng}…).
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{将|jiāng}{有|yǒu}{大|dà}{雨|yǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: There will be heavy rain tomorrow.

vocab.note: {做梦|zuò mèng}: to have a dream (lesson 20).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{做|zuò}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{梦|mèng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I had a dream last night.

vocab.note: What you're heading for; {目的|mù dì} is why you do something.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{今年|jīn nián}{的|de}{目标|mù biāo}{是|shì}{通过|tōng guò} HSK {四级|sì jí}。
vocab.exampleEn: My goal this year is to pass HSK 4.

vocab.note: {的|dì} is dì here.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{来|lái}{中国|Zhōng guó}{的|de}{目的|mù dì}{是|shì}{什么|shén me}？
vocab.exampleEn: What is your purpose in coming to China?

vocab.example: {人生|rén shēng}{不|bú}{是|shì}{一|yí}{次|cì}{考试|kǎo shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Life isn't an exam.

vocab.note: A dream you hope to make real; also a verb, to dream of. WORDS.tsv lists the verb first; taught here as the noun.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{梦想|mèng xiǎng}{是|shì}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}{留学|liú xué}。
vocab.exampleEn: His dream is to study in China.

vocab.note: {申请|shēn qǐng}{奖学金|jiǎng xué jīn}, {申请|shēn qǐng}{签证|qiān zhèng}; with a verb: {申请|shēn qǐng}{去|qù}{英国|Yīng guó}{留学|liú xué}. Also a noun: an application.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{申请|shēn qǐng}{去|qù}{英国|Yīng guó}{读|dú}{硕士|shuò shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's applied to do a master's in Britain.

vocab.note: {失败|shī bài}{是|shì}{成功|chéng gōng}{之|zhī}{母|mǔ} : failure is the mother of success (a saying).
vocab.example: {失败|shī bài}{了|le}{也|yě}{没关系|méi guān xi}，{再|zài}{试|shì}{一|yí}{次|cì}。
vocab.exampleEn: It doesn't matter if you fail; try again.

meanings: fine (happy, of life or the future)
vocab.note: For life, the future, memories, wishes: {美好|měi hǎo}{的|de}{将来|jiāng lái}, {美好|měi hǎo}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}.
vocab.example: {祝|zhù}{你们|nǐ men}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{美好|měi hǎo}{的|de}{将来|jiāng lái}！
vocab.exampleEn: I wish you a bright future!

vocab.note: {读|dú}{硕士|shuò shì}: to do a master's.
vocab.example: {英国|Yīng guó}{的|de}{硕士|shuò shì}{只|zhǐ}{要|yào}{一|yì}{年|nián}。
vocab.exampleEn: A master's in Britain only takes a year.

vocab.note: {读|dú}{研究生|yán jiū shēng}: to do a postgraduate degree.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{毕业|bì yè}{以后|yǐ hòu}{想|xiǎng}{读|dú}{研究生|yán jiū shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: She wants to go on to postgraduate study after she graduates.

vocab.note: Pass an exam ({通过|tōng guò}{考试|kǎo shì}); as a preposition, "through, by way of": {通过|tōng guò}{朋友|péng you}{认识|rèn shi}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{通过|tōng guò}{了|le} HSK {三级|sān jí}{考试|kǎo shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He passed the HSK 3 exam.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{一生|yì shēng}{都|dōu}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: He worked in a school all his life.

vocab.note: {祝|zhù} + person + wish, for the future: {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{生日|shēng rì}{快乐|kuài lè}, {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{一切|yí qiè}{顺利|shùn lì}. For something achieved, {祝贺|zhù hè}.
vocab.example: {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{生日|shēng rì}{快乐|kuài lè}！
vocab.exampleEn: Happy birthday!

vocab.note: {祝贺|zhù hè} + person + what was achieved: {祝贺|zhù hè}{你|nǐ}{毕业|bì yè}{了|le}. Not for wishes (that's {祝|zhù}).
vocab.example: {祝贺|zhù hè}{你|nǐ}{获奖|huò jiǎng}！
vocab.exampleEn: Congratulations on your prize!

vocab.note: {一切|yí qiè}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}; {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{一切|yí qiè}{顺利|shùn lì} (all the best). Before a noun: {一切|yí qiè}{问题|wèn tí}.
vocab.example: {谢谢|xiè xie}{你|nǐ}{为|wèi}{我|wǒ}{做|zuò}{的|de}{一切|yí qiè}。
vocab.exampleEn: Thank you for everything you've done for me.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{感冒|gǎn mào}{了|le}，{鼻子|bí zi}{很|hěn}{不|bù}{舒服|shū fu}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've got a cold, and my nose is really bothering me.

vocab.note: Read dàifu, with a light second syllable: the spoken word, and what patients call a doctor to their face. {医生|yī shēng} is the neutral word, and the one for your own job.
vocab.example: {大夫|dài fu}，{我|wǒ}{的|de}{病|bìng}{严重|yán zhòng}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Doctor, is it serious?

vocab.note: Light second syllable: gēbo.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{打|dǎ}{篮球|lán qiú}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{胳膊|gē bo}{受伤|shòu shāng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He hurt his arm playing basketball.

vocab.example: {护士|hù shi}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{量|liáng}{了|le}{体温|tǐ wēn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The nurse took my temperature.

vocab.note: {肚子|dù zi}{疼|téng} is a stomach ache.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{肚子|dù zi}{疼|téng}，{什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{吃|chī}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've got a stomach ache and don't feel like eating anything.

vocab.note: Also a verb, close to {觉得|jué de}: {我|wǒ}{感觉|gǎn jué}{好|hǎo}{多|duō}{了|le} (I feel much better).
vocab.example: {吃|chī}{了|le}{药|yào}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{我|wǒ}{感觉|gǎn jué}{好|hǎo}{多|duō}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: After taking the medicine I feel much better.

meanings: to give or have an injection
vocab.note: Separable: {打|dǎ}{了|le}{一|yì}{针|zhēn} (had an injection).
vocab.example: {小|xiǎo}{孩子|hái zi}{都|dōu}{怕|pà}{打针|dǎ zhēn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Little children are all scared of injections.

vocab.note: Mostly before {得|de} ({咳|ké}{得|de}{很|hěn}{厉害|lì hai}) or in {咳嗽|ké sou}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{晚上|wǎn shang}{咳|ké}{得|de}{睡|shuì}{不|bu}{好|hǎo}{觉|jiào}。
vocab.exampleEn: At night he coughs so much he can't sleep properly.

vocab.note: Light second syllable: késou.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{咳嗽|ké sou}{得|de}{很|hěn}{厉害|lì hai}，{已经|yǐ jīng}{三|sān}{天|tiān}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He has a bad cough; it's been three days.

vocab.note: For a likely, unwelcome outcome, before the verb phrase or the clause. "To be afraid of" is {怕|pà}.
vocab.example: {这么|zhè me}{晚|wǎn}{了|le}，{他|tā}{恐怕|kǒng pà}{不|bú}{会|huì}{来|lái}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's so late: I'm afraid he won't come now.

vocab.note: liáng as the verb; as the noun "amount" ({少量|shǎo liàng}, {数量|shù liàng}) it's liàng.
vocab.example: {护士|hù shi}{给|gěi}{他|tā}{量|liáng}{了|le}{一下|yí xià}{体温|tǐ wēn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The nurse took his temperature.

vocab.note: Before a verb ({及时|jí shí}{告诉|gào su}{我|wǒ}) or after {得|de} ({来|lái}{得|de}{很|hěn}{及时|jí shí}, just in time).
vocab.example: {有|yǒu}{问题|wèn tí}{请|qǐng}{及时|jí shí}{告诉|gào su}{我|wǒ}。
vocab.exampleEn: If there's a problem, let me know promptly.

vocab.note: After {得|de} it says "badly": {疼|téng}{得|de}{厉害|lì hai}. On its own it's often praise: {你|nǐ}{真|zhēn}{厉害|lì hai}！
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{头|tóu}{疼|téng}{得|de}{厉害|lì hai}。
vocab.exampleEn: Last night I had a terrible headache.

vocab.example: {多|duō}{喝|hē}{水|shuǐ}{对|duì}{皮肤|pí fū}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Drinking plenty of water is good for your skin.

vocab.example: {大夫|dài fu}，{我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma}{的|de}{情况|qíng kuàng}{怎么样|zěn me yàng}？
vocab.exampleEn: Doctor, how is my mother doing?

vocab.note: Separable: {受|shòu}{了|le}{伤|shāng}, {受|shòu}{了|le}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{伤|shāng}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{踢|tī}{足球|zú qiú}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{受伤|shòu shāng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He got hurt playing football.

vocab.note: For the body or the mind: {我|wǒ}{心里|xīn li}{很|hěn}{难受|nán shòu} (I feel awful about it).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{头|tóu}{疼|téng}{得|de}{厉害|lì hai}，{很|hěn}{难受|nán shòu}。
vocab.exampleEn: My head hurts badly; I feel awful.

vocab.note: Before {要|yào}, {别|bié}, {不要|bú yào} or {不|bù}{能|néng} in advice and warnings. In numbers it's still "ten million".
vocab.example: {下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}，{开车|kāi chē}{千万|qiān wàn}{要|yào}{小心|xiǎo xīn}！
vocab.exampleEn: It's raining: be sure to drive carefully!

vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{体温|tǐ wēn}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Your temperature's a little high.

vocab.note: Read xuè; in everyday speech some phrases are also said xiě.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{手|shǒu}{出|chū}{血|xuè}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: His hand is bleeding.

vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{每|měi}{年|nián}{都|dōu}{让|ràng}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{医院|yī yuàn}{体检|tǐ jiǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The company sends us to the hospital for a check-up every year.

vocab.note: More written than {疼|téng}, and mostly in compounds: {头痛|tóu tòng}, {肚子|dù zi}{痛|tòng}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{胳膊|gē bo}{受伤|shòu shāng}{了|le}，{痛|tòng}{得|de}{很|hěn}{厉害|lì hai}。
vocab.exampleEn: His arm was injured, and it hurt badly.

vocab.note: Also {头|tóu}{疼|téng} in speech.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{头痛|tóu tòng}，{没|méi}{去|qù}{上课|shàng kè}。
vocab.exampleEn: I had a headache yesterday and didn't go to class.

vocab.note: For illnesses, problems and mistakes, not for people.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{病|bìng}{不|bù}{严重|yán zhòng}，{休息|xiū xi}{几|jǐ}{天|tiān}{就|jiù}{好|hǎo}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: His illness isn't serious; a few days' rest and he'll be fine.

vocab.note: {戴|dài}{眼镜|yǎn jìng} is to wear glasses ({戴|dài}, lesson 09).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{眼镜|yǎn jìng}{找|zhǎo}{不|bu}{到|dào}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I can't find my glasses.

vocab.note: {院|yuàn} a hospital or college, {长|zhǎng} its head.
vocab.example: {医院|yī yuàn}{的|de}{院长|yuàn zhǎng}{也|yě}{来|lái}{看|kàn}{他|tā}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Even the head of the hospital came to see him.

vocab.example: {体温|tǐ wēn}{三十六|sān shí liù}{度|dù}{五|wǔ}，{很|hěn}{正常|zhèng cháng}。
vocab.exampleEn: 36.5 degrees: perfectly normal.

vocab.note: Also "stage, step" in a process ({下|xià}{一|yí}{步|bù}, the next step).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{至少|zhì shǎo}{走|zǒu}{六千|liù qiān}{步|bù}。
vocab.exampleEn: I walk at least six thousand steps a day.

vocab.note: At the time that was set: {按时|àn shí}{吃|chī}{药|yào}, {按时|àn shí}{交|jiāo}{作业|zuò yè}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{要|yào}{按时|àn shí}{吃|chī}{药|yào}。
vocab.exampleEn: You must take your medicine at the right times.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{动作|dòng zuò}{不|bù}{难|nán}，{你|nǐ}{试试|shì shi}。
vocab.exampleEn: This movement isn't hard: try it.

vocab.note: Light second syllable. {下功夫|xià gōng fu}: to put in the effort.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{从小|cóng xiǎo}{就|jiù}{学|xué}{中国|Zhōng guó}{功夫|gōng fu}。
vocab.exampleEn: He has learned kung fu since he was little.

vocab.note: {出|chū}{汗|hàn}: to sweat; {一|yì}{身|shēn}{汗|hàn}: sweating all over.
vocab.example: {跑|pǎo}{完|wán}{步|bù}，{我|wǒ}{出|chū}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{汗|hàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: After my run I was sweating a lot.

vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{要|yào}{好好|hǎo hǎo}{放松|fàng sōng}{一下|yí xià}。
vocab.exampleEn: At the weekend you need to relax properly.

vocab.note: Before a verb: {好好|hǎo hǎo}{休息|xiū xi}, {好好|hǎo hǎo}{学习|xué xí}. In Beijing speech often hǎohāor ({好好儿|hǎo hāor}).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{病|bìng}{了|le}，{要|yào}{好好|hǎo hǎo}{休息|xiū xi}。
vocab.exampleEn: You're ill: you need a proper rest.

vocab.example: {公司|gōng sī}{旁边|páng biān}{新|xīn}{开|kāi}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{健身房|jiàn shēn fáng}。
vocab.exampleEn: A new gym has opened next to the company.

vocab.note: {教|jiāo} is jiào here.
vocab.example: {教练|jiào liàn}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{先|xiān}{跑|pǎo}{十|shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The trainer had me run for ten minutes first.

vocab.note: Light second syllable: lìqi. {力气|lì qi}{大|dà}: strong.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{没有|méi yǒu}{力气|lì qi}{了|le}，{休息|xiū xi}{一下|yí xià}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've got no strength left: let's take a break.

vocab.note: Literally "add oil": a cheer, encouragement, and filling up at a petrol station ({加油站|jiā yóu zhàn}).
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{考试|kǎo shì}，{加油|jiā yóu}！
vocab.exampleEn: You've got your exam tomorrow: good luck!

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{健身|jiàn shēn}{三|sān}{次|cì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I work out three times a week.

vocab.note: Sleepy, not tired from effort ({累|lèi}). Traditional {睏|kùn}; {困难|kùn nan} (difficulty) keeps {={困|kùn}=}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{太|tài}{困|kùn}{了|le}，{先|xiān}{睡|shuì}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm too sleepy: I'm going to bed.

vocab.note: Spoken; light second syllable. For a neutral habit use {总是|zǒng shì}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{怎么|zěn me}{老是|lǎo shi}{迟到|chí dào}？
vocab.exampleEn: Why are you always late?

vocab.example: {她|tā}{是|shì}{学校|xué xiào}{排球|pái qiú}{队|duì}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's on the university volleyball team.

vocab.note: Played with {打|dǎ}: {打|dǎ}{乒乓球|pīng pāng qiú}.
vocab.example: {下课|xià kè}{以后|yǐ hòu}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{打|dǎ}{乒乓球|pīng pāng qiú}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's go and play table tennis after class.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{球队|qiú duì}{又|yòu}{赢|yíng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our team won again.

vocab.note: {迷|mí} is a fan of anything: {足球|zú qiú}{迷|mí}, {歌|gē}{迷|mí}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{足球|zú qiú}{迷|mí}，{每|měi}{场|chǎng}{比赛|bǐ sài}{都|dōu}{看|kàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's a football fan: he watches every match.

vocab.example: {跑|pǎo}{完|wán}{步|bù}，{我|wǒ}{全身|quán shēn}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{汗|hàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: After my run I was sweating all over.

vocab.note: Mostly in words and set phrases: {全身|quán shēn}, {一|yì}{身|shēn}{汗|hàn}, {身|shēn}{上|shàng} (on you).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{身|shēn}{上|shàng}{没|méi}{带|dài}{钱|qián}。
vocab.exampleEn: I haven't got any money on me.

vocab.note: Separable; doubled as {散|sàn}{散步|sàn bù} (have a little walk).
vocab.example: {晚饭|wǎn fàn}{以后|yǐ hòu}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{散散步|sàn san bù}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's go for a walk after dinner.

vocab.note: An adverb ({我|wǒ}{平常|píng cháng}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}{起床|qǐ chuáng}) or an adjective ({平常|píng cháng}{的|de}{一|yì}{天|tiān}).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{平常|píng cháng}{不|bù}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kā fēi}。
vocab.exampleEn: I don't usually drink coffee.

vocab.note: Opposite of {重|zhòng}. {轻|qīng}{一点儿|yì diǎnr} is also "more gently".
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{箱子|xiāng zi}{很|hěn}{轻|qīng}，{我|wǒ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{就|jiù}{能|néng}{搬|bān}。
vocab.exampleEn: This box is light: I can carry it on my own.

vocab.note: A state; the verb "to relax" is {放松|fàng sōng}.
vocab.example: {考|kǎo}{完|wán}{试|shì}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{轻松|qīng sōng}。
vocab.exampleEn: After the exam everyone was relaxed.

vocab.note: Only before a noun: {日常|rì cháng}{生活|shēng huó}, {日常|rì cháng}{用语|yòng yǔ}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{讲|jiǎng}{的|de}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{人|rén}{的|de}{日常|rì cháng}{生活|shēng huó}。
vocab.exampleEn: This book is about Chinese people's everyday life.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{偶尔|ǒu ěr}{也|yě}{喝|hē}{一|yì}{杯|bēi}{咖啡|kā fēi}。
vocab.exampleEn: I have a coffee once in a while too.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{体重|tǐ zhòng}{比|bǐ}{去年|qù nián}{少|shǎo}{了|le}{五|wǔ}{公斤|gōng jīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I weigh five kilos less than last year.

vocab.note: {效果|xiào guǒ}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}: it works well.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{药|yào}{的|de}{效果|xiào guǒ}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: This medicine works really well.

vocab.note: {压力|yā lì}{很|hěn}{大|dà}: under a lot of pressure.
vocab.example: {最近|zuì jìn}{工作|gōng zuò}{压力|yā lì}{很|hěn}{大|dà}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's been a lot of pressure at work lately.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}{把|bǎ}{桌子|zhuō zi}{抬|tái}{进去|jìn qù}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's carry the table in between the two of us.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{抬头|tái tóu}{看|kàn}{了|le}{看|kàn}{天|tiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: He looked up at the sky.

vocab.note: {躺|tǎng}{在|zài}{床|chuáng}{上|shàng}: lying on the bed.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{躺|tǎng}{在|zài}{沙发|shā fā}{上|shàng}{看|kàn}{电视|diàn shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's lying on the sofa watching television.

vocab.note: Said at bedtime, not as a goodbye in the evening (that's {再见|zài jiàn}).
vocab.example: {晚安|wǎn ān}，{明天|míng tiān}{见|jiàn}！
vocab.exampleEn: Good night, see you tomorrow!

vocab.note: The moment of waking; getting up is {起床|qǐ chuáng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{早上|zǎo shang}{六|liù}{点|diǎn}{就|jiù}{醒|xǐng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I woke up at six this morning.

vocab.example: {别|bié}{把|bǎ}{书|shū}{压|yā}{在|zài}{下面|xià miàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't squash the book underneath.

vocab.note: Sums up a pattern in a situation, from experience; not for plans or requests ({常常|cháng cháng}).
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{他|tā}{往往|wǎng wǎng}{去|qù}{爬|pá}{山|shān}。
vocab.exampleEn: At weekends he tends to go hiking.

vocab.note: A little more formal than {早上|zǎo shang}.
vocab.example: {早晨|zǎo chén}{的|de}{公园|gōng yuán}{里|lǐ}{人|rén}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: The park is busy in the early morning.

vocab.note: zhòng ({重|zhòng}#chong2, chóng, is "again", lesson 02). {体重|tǐ zhòng}: body weight.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{箱子|xiāng zi}{太|tài}{重|zhòng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This box is too heavy.

vocab.note: Almost always with {习惯|xí guàn}: {养成|yǎng chéng}{好|hǎo}{习惯|xí guàn}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{养成|yǎng chéng}{了|le}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{跑步|pǎo bù}{的|de}{习惯|xí guàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's got into the habit of running every day.

meanings: to touch (zháo, the result in falling asleep)
vocab.note: zháo, after a verb: {睡|shuì}{着|zháo} (fall asleep), {找|zhǎo}{着|zháo} (find); also {着火|zháo huǒ} (catch fire). The particle zhe is another word.
vocab.example: {昨天|zuó tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{一直|yì zhí}{没|méi}{睡|shuì}{着|zháo}。
vocab.exampleEn: I couldn't get to sleep at all last night.

vocab.note: Before a noun usually {尤其|yóu qí}{是|shì}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{运动|yùn dòng}，{尤其|yóu qí}{是|shì}{游泳|yóu yǒng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I love sport, especially swimming.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{至少|zhì shǎo}{等|děng}{了|le}{你|nǐ}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}！
vocab.exampleEn: I waited at least half an hour for you!

vocab.note: A "dry cake": {饼|bǐng} (a round flat cake) + "dry". Traditional {餅乾|bǐng gān}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{饿|è}{了|le}，{先|xiān}{吃|chī}{几|jǐ}{块|kuài}{饼干|bǐng gān}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm hungry: I'll have a few biscuits first.

vocab.note: The leaves you buy; the drink is {茶|chá}.
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{茶叶|chá yè}{是|shì}{朋友|péng you}{从|cóng}{杭州|Háng zhōu}{带|dài}{来|lái}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: These tea leaves were brought by a friend from Hangzhou.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{家|jiā}{的|de}{厨房|chú fáng}{很|hěn}{小|xiǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our kitchen is very small.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{的|de}{厨师|chú shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's a chef at a restaurant.

vocab.note: Counted with {把|bǎ}: {一|yì}{把|bǎ}{刀|dāo}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{把|bǎ}{刀|dāo}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}，{你|nǐ}{小心|xiǎo xīn}{点儿|diǎnr}。
vocab.exampleEn: This knife is very sharp: be careful.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{要|yào}{一|yì}{杯|bēi}{苹果|píng guǒ}{汁|zhī}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd like a glass of apple juice.

vocab.note: {四|sì}{道|dào}{菜|cài} (four dishes), {一|yí}{道|dào}{题|tí} (a question). Also "road, way" in {道路|dào lù} (lesson 16).
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{晚饭|wǎn fàn}{有|yǒu}{四|sì}{道|dào}{菜|cài}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are four dishes for dinner today.

vocab.note: dào. Read dǎo it's "to fall over".
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ}{倒|dào}{杯|bēi}{茶|chá}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let me pour you a cup of tea.

vocab.note: {够|gòu}{了|le} (that's enough); {够|gòu} + adjective + {的|de}: really… ({够|gòu}{辣|là}{的|de}).
vocab.example: {两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}{吃|chī}{这些|zhè xiē}{菜|cài}{够|gòu}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is enough food for two.

vocab.note: {一|yí}{顿|dùn}{饭|fàn}, {三|sān}{顿|dùn}{饭|fàn}; {说|shuō}{了|le}{他|tā}{一|yí}{顿|dùn} (gave him a talking-to).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{请|qǐng}{你|nǐ}{吃|chī}{一|yí}{顿|dùn}{饭|fàn}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let me treat you to a meal.

vocab.example: {别|bié}{吃|chī}{太|tài}{多|duō}{零食|líng shí}，{快|kuài}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't eat too many snacks: it's nearly dinner time.

vocab.note: Light second syllable. With a filling it's a {包子|bāo zi}.
vocab.example: {北方|běi fāng}{人|rén}{早上|zǎo shang}{常常|cháng cháng}{吃|chī}{馒头|mán tou}。
vocab.exampleEn: In the north people often have steamed buns in the morning.

meanings: to have a meal together (as a group)
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{我们|wǒ men}{班|bān}{聚餐|jù cān}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our class is having a meal together at the weekend.

vocab.note: {烤|kǎo}{鸭|yā} (roast duck), {烤|kǎo}{面包|miàn bāo} (toast).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{只|zhī}{鸡|jī}{烤|kǎo}{得|de}{很|hěn}{香|xiāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This chicken is nicely roasted.

vocab.note: Also of a hard life: {生活|shēng huó}{很|hěn}{苦|kǔ}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{药|yào}{太|tài}{苦|kǔ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This medicine is too bitter.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{不|bú}{太|tài}{能|néng}{吃|chī}{辣|là}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: I can't really eat spicy food.

vocab.note: Of food and drink: {菜|cài}{凉|liáng}{了|le} (the food's gone cold). HSK 3's {凉快|liáng kuai} is pleasantly cool weather.
vocab.example: {汤|tāng}{凉|liáng}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{去|qù}{热|rè}{一下|yí xià}。
vocab.exampleEn: The soup's gone cold: I'll heat it up.

vocab.example: {杯子|bēi zi}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{水|shuǐ}{太|tài}{满|mǎn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The glass is too full.

vocab.note: The weight, ten to a {斤|jīn}. "Two liang" is {二两|èr liǎng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{要|yào}{二两|èr liǎng}{饺子|jiǎo zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd like two liang (100 g) of dumplings.

vocab.note: Light second syllable.
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{葡萄|pú tao}{很|hěn}{甜|tián}。
vocab.exampleEn: These grapes are very sweet.

vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{们|men}{都|dōu}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{喝|hē}{汽水|qì shuǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Children all love fizzy drinks.

vocab.note: A sound borrowing, like {咖啡|kā fēi}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{块|kuài}{巧克力|qiǎo kè lì}{很|hěn}{甜|tián}。
vocab.exampleEn: This piece of chocolate is very sweet.

vocab.note: Packaged and sold: {食品|shí pǐn}{店|diàn} (a food shop), {食品|shí pǐn}{安全|ān quán} (food safety).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{商店|shāng diàn}{卖|mài}{各种|gè zhǒng}{食品|shí pǐn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This shop sells all sorts of food.

vocab.note: Food as what people or animals eat.
vocab.example: {冬天|dōng tiān}{要|yào}{多|duō}{吃|chī}{热|rè}{的|de}{食物|shí wù}。
vocab.exampleEn: In winter you should eat more hot food.

vocab.note: Written style (recipes, instructions); in speech {一点儿|yì diǎnr}.
vocab.example: {放|fàng}{少量|shǎo liàng}{的|de}{盐|yán}。
vocab.exampleEn: Add a small amount of salt.

vocab.note: {生|shēng}{鸡蛋|jī dàn} (a raw egg); the opposite is {熟|shú}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{块|kuài}{肉|ròu}{还是|hái shi}{生|shēng}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: This piece of meat is still raw.

vocab.note: shú (in speech often shóu). Also "familiar" in {熟悉|shú xī} (lesson 01).
vocab.example: {鸡蛋|jī dàn}{熟|shú}{了|le}，{可以|kě yǐ}{吃|chī}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The eggs are done: you can eat them.

vocab.note: Written; in speech {公斤|gōng jīn}.
vocab.example: {水果|shuǐ guǒ}{店|diàn}{门口|mén kǒu}{写|xiě}{着|zhe}：{苹果|píng guǒ}{每|měi}{千克|qiān kè}{十二|shí èr}{元|yuán}。
vocab.exampleEn: The sign at the fruit shop door says: apples, 12 yuan a kilo.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{早饭|zǎo fàn}{喝|hē}{一|yì}{瓶|píng}{酸奶|suān nǎi}。
vocab.exampleEn: I have a bottle of yoghurt for breakfast.

vocab.note: {喝|hē}{汤|tāng} (to have soup).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{汤|tāng}{很|hěn}{鲜|xiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: This soup is very tasty.

vocab.note: After a noun: {鱼|yú}{味|wèi} (a fishy taste).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{汤|tāng}{有|yǒu}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{鱼|yú}{味|wèi}。
vocab.exampleEn: This soup tastes a bit of fish.

vocab.note: Light second syllable.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{菜|cài}{味道|wèi dao}{怎么样|zěn me yàng}？
vocab.exampleEn: How does this dish taste?

vocab.note: Also {番茄|fān qié} fānqié.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{要|yào}{买|mǎi}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{西红柿|xī hóng shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I want to buy two tomatoes.

vocab.example: {汤|tāng}{里|lǐ}{再|zài}{放|fàng}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{盐|yán}。
vocab.exampleEn: Put a little more salt in the soup.

vocab.note: The action; "smells good" is {香|xiāng}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{闻闻|wén wen}，{这|zhè}{是|shì}{什么|shén me}{味道|wèi dao}？
vocab.exampleEn: Smell this: what is that smell?

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{苹果|píng guǒ}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{酸|suān}。
vocab.exampleEn: This apple is a bit sour.

vocab.example: {刚|gāng}{买|mǎi}{的|de}{鱼|yú}{做|zuò}{的|de}{汤|tāng}{特别|tè bié}{鲜|xiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: Soup made with freshly bought fish is especially tasty.

vocab.example: {汤|tāng}{太|tài}{咸|xián}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The soup is too salty.

vocab.note: {好|hǎo}{香|xiāng}！ (That smells wonderful!)
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{做|zuò}{的|de}{菜|cài}{真|zhēn}{香|xiāng}！
vocab.exampleEn: The food you've cooked smells wonderful!

vocab.note: {加油|jiā yóu} (come on!) is lesson 07's.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{菜|cài}{油|yóu}{太|tài}{多|duō}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This dish has too much oil in it.

vocab.note: Eaten at the Mid-Autumn Festival.
vocab.example: {中秋节|Zhōng qiū jié}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{大家|dà jiā}{都|dōu}{吃|chī}{月饼|yuè bǐng}。
vocab.exampleEn: At the Mid-Autumn Festival everyone eats mooncakes.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{菜|cài}{的|de}{做法|zuò fǎ}{很|hěn}{简单|jiǎn dān}。
vocab.exampleEn: This dish is simple to make.

vocab.note: A noun ({达到|dá dào}{标准|biāo zhǔn}) and an adjective ({标准|biāo zhǔn}{的|de}{普通话|pǔ tōng huà}).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{说|shuō}{一|yì}{口|kǒu}{标准|biāo zhǔn}{的|de}{普通话|pǔ tōng huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: He speaks standard Putonghua.

vocab.note: A {不如|bù rú} B (+ a good quality): {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{不如|bù rú}{那|nà}{家|jiā}{好吃|hǎo chī}. Before a verb, a suggestion: {不如|bù rú}{打车|dǎ chē}{吧|ba}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{不如|bù rú}{他|tā}。
vocab.exampleEn: My Chinese isn't as good as his.

vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{低价|dī jià}{卖|mài}{旧|jiù}{货|huò}。
vocab.exampleEn: They sell second-hand goods cheaply.

vocab.example: {他|tā}{用|yòng}{高价|gāo jià}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{这|zhè}{辆|liàng}{旧|jiù}{车|chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: He paid a high price for this old car.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{店|diàn}{的|de}{顾客|gù kè}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: This shop has lots of customers.

vocab.note: Separable: {打|dǎ}{八|bā}{折|zhé} (20 % off: you pay eight tenths).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{毛衣|máo yī}{打|dǎ}{八|bā}{折|zhé}。
vocab.exampleEn: This sweater is 20 % off.

meanings: to wear (glasses, a hat, a watch)
vocab.note: For things put on (hats, glasses, watches); clothes and shoes take {穿|chuān}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{戴|dài}{着|zhe}{眼镜|yǎn jìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's wearing glasses.

vocab.note: {付|fù}{钱|qián}, {付|fù}{房租|fáng zū}.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{我|wǒ}{来|lái}{付|fù}{钱|qián}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm paying today.

vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{购买|gòu mǎi}{门票|mén piào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please buy tickets online.

vocab.note: Written; in speech {买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{购物|gòu wù}。
vocab.exampleEn: She loves shopping.

vocab.note: {逛|guàng}{街|jiē}, {逛|guàng}{商店|shāng diàn}, {逛|guàng}{公园|gōng yuán}.
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{逛|guàng}{商店|shāng diàn}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Let's go round the shops at the weekend.

vocab.note: {一|yí}{份|fèn}{饭|fàn}, {两|liǎng}{份|fèn}{报纸|bào zhǐ}, {一|yí}{份|fèn}{工作|gōng zuò}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{要|yào}{一|yí}{份|fèn}{饺子|jiǎo zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'd like a portion of dumplings.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{是|shì}{这|zhè}{家|jiā}{超市|chāo shì}{的|de}{会员|huì yuán}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm a member of this supermarket.

vocab.note: {新|xīn}{到|dào}{的|de}{货|huò} (new stock), {送|sòng}{货|huò} (deliver goods), {假|jiǎ}{货|huò} (fakes).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{店|diàn}{的|de}{货|huò}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{新|xīn}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everything in this shop is new stock.

vocab.note: The general word, written and spoken.
vocab.example: {这里|zhè lǐ}{的|de}{东西|dōng xi}{价格|jià gé}{不|bù}{高|gāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Prices here aren't high.

vocab.note: Light second syllable.
vocab.example: {价钱|jià qian}{怎么样|zěn me yàng}？
vocab.exampleEn: How's the price?

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{快递|kuài dì}{到|dào}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: My parcel has arrived.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{毛衣|máo yī}{是|shì}{妈妈|mā ma}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{买|mǎi}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: Mum bought me this sweater.

vocab.note: Worn with {戴|dài}; counted with {顶|dǐng}.
vocab.example: {外面|wài miàn}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}，{戴|dài}{上|shàng}{帽子|mào zi}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's cold outside: put a hat on.

vocab.note: {降|jiàng} is "to fall"; a price rise is {涨价|zhǎng jià}.
vocab.example: {冬天|dōng tiān}{快|kuài}{过去|guò qù}{了|le}，{毛衣|máo yī}{都|dōu}{降价|jiàng jià}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Winter's nearly over, and sweaters have all come down in price.

vocab.note: jiǎ. {假|jiǎ}{货|huò} (fakes). The same character read jià is HSK 3's {放假|fàng jià}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{包|bāo}{是|shì}{假|jiǎ}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: This bag is a fake.

vocab.note: On signs and labels: {男士|nán shì}{衬衫|chèn shān} (men's shirts).
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{男士|nán shì}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}。
vocab.exampleEn: These are all men's clothes.

vocab.note: {什么|shén me}{牌子|pái zi}{的|de}？ (What brand is it?)
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{是|shì}{什么|shén me}{牌子|pái zi}{的|de}？
vocab.exampleEn: What make is your phone?

vocab.example: {他|tā}{穿|chuān}{了|le}{一|yì}{双|shuāng}{新|xīn}{皮鞋|pí xié}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's wearing a new pair of leather shoes.

vocab.example: {超市|chāo shì}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{商品|shāng pǐn}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of goods in the supermarket.

vocab.note: Also the market in the economic sense.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{常常|cháng cháng}{去|qù}{市场|shì chǎng}{买|mǎi}{菜|cài}。
vocab.exampleEn: I often go to the market for food.

vocab.note: Only "free of charge"; "not busy" is {有空|yǒu kòng}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{公园|gōng yuán}{是|shì}{免费|miǎn fèi}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: This park is free.

vocab.note: Separable: {排|pái}{了|le}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{队|duì}.
vocab.example: {买|mǎi}{票|piào}{的|de}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{在|zài}{排队|pái duì}。
vocab.exampleEn: The people buying tickets are all queuing.

vocab.example: {扫码|sǎo mǎ}{就|jiù}{可以|kě yǐ}{付|fù}{钱|qián}。
vocab.exampleEn: You can pay just by scanning the code.

meanings: to come to the door (to deliver, serve)
vocab.note: {送|sòng}{货|huò}{上门|shàng mén} (home delivery).
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{可以|kě yǐ}{送|sòng}{货|huò}{上门|shàng mén}。
vocab.exampleEn: They can deliver to your door.

vocab.example: {送|sòng}{货|huò}{上门|shàng mén}{要|yào}{收费|shōu fèi}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Do you charge for delivery?

vocab.note: Counted with {双|shuāng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{三|sān}{双|shuāng}{袜子|wà zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: I bought three pairs of socks.

vocab.example: {天|tiān}{冷|lěng}{了|le}，{穿|chuān}{件|jiàn}{外套|wài tào}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's got cold: put a jacket on.

vocab.example: {现在|xiàn zài}{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}{有|yǒu}{人|rén}{用|yòng}{现金|xiàn jīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Hardly anyone uses cash now.

vocab.example: {进|jìn}{门|mén}{请|qǐng}{脱|tuō}{鞋|xié}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please take your shoes off when you come in.

vocab.note: {跟|gēn} / {和|hé} / {与|yǔ} B {相比|xiāng bǐ}, …
vocab.example: {跟|gēn}{去年|qù nián}{相比|xiāng bǐ}，{今年|jīn nián}{的|de}{价格|jià gé}{高|gāo}{了|le}{不|bù}{少|shǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Compared with last year, prices are a good deal higher this year.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{店|diàn}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}{质量|zhì liàng}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The clothes in this shop are good quality.

vocab.note: Written and in apps; in speech {付|fù}.
vocab.example: {可以|kě yǐ}{用|yòng}{手机|shǒu jī}{支付|zhī fù}。
vocab.exampleEn: You can pay by phone.

vocab.note: The plain word; {卫生间|wèi shēng jiān} is politer.
vocab.example: {请问|qǐng wèn}，{厕所|cè suǒ}{在|zài}{哪儿|nǎr}？
vocab.exampleEn: Excuse me, where's the toilet?

vocab.note: In words: {窗口|chuāng kǒu}, {窗|chuāng}{外|wài} (outside the window).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{坐|zuò}{在|zài}{窗|chuāng}{边|biān}{看|kàn}{书|shū}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's sitting by the window reading.

vocab.note: Light second syllable.
vocab.example: {风|fēng}{太|tài}{大|dà}{了|le}，{把|bǎ}{窗户|chuāng hu}{关|guān}{上|shàng}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's very windy: shut the window.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{把|bǎ}{桌子|zhuō zi}{擦|cā}{干净|gān jìng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've wiped the table clean.

vocab.note: The owner's verb; the tenant's is {租|zū}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{套|tào}{房子|fáng zi}{出租|chū zū}。
vocab.exampleEn: This flat is to let.

vocab.note: With an unwanted event, {差点儿|chà diǎnr} and {差点儿|chà diǎnr}{没|méi} both mean "nearly happened, but didn't".
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{今天|jīn tiān}{差点儿|chà diǎnr}{迟到|chí dào}。
vocab.exampleEn: I was nearly late today.

vocab.note: Double negation: something forces you.
vocab.example: {下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{不得不|bù dé bú}{坐|zuò}{出租车|chū zū chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: It was raining, so we had no choice but to take a taxi.

vocab.note: Light second syllable. {床|chuáng}{底下|dǐ xia} (under the bed).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{鞋|xié}{在|zài}{床|chuáng}{底下|dǐ xia}。
vocab.exampleEn: Your shoes are under the bed.

vocab.note: {杯子|bēi zi}{底|dǐ} (the bottom of the cup), {年底|nián dǐ} (end of the year).
vocab.example: {杯子|bēi zi}{底|dǐ}{有|yǒu}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{水|shuǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a little water in the bottom of the cup.

vocab.example: {超市|chāo shì}{在|zài}{银行|yín háng}{对面|duì miàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The supermarket is opposite the bank.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{房东|fáng dōng}{人|rén}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our landlady is really nice.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{月|yuè}{的|de}{房租|fáng zū}{我|wǒ}{已经|yǐ jīng}{付|fù}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've already paid this month's rent.

vocab.note: Also "to hang up" (the phone): {挂|guà}{电话|diàn huà}.
vocab.example: {把|bǎ}{衣服|yī fu}{挂|guà}{起来|qǐ lái}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Hang your clothes up.

vocab.note: Counted with {件|jiàn}. Traditional {家具|jiā jù} here (s2tw gives {傢俱|jiā jù}).
vocab.example: {新|xīn}{房子|fáng zi}{里|lǐ}{的|de}{家具|jiā jù}{都|dōu}{是|shì}{新|xīn}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: All the furniture in the new flat is new.

vocab.example: {她|tā}{站|zhàn}{在|zài}{镜子|jìng zi}{前面|qián miàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's standing in front of the mirror.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{在|zài}{客厅|kè tīng}{看|kàn}{电视|diàn shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: We're watching television in the living room.

vocab.note: Opposite of {推|tuī}.
vocab.example: {门|mén}{上|shàng}{写|xiě}{着|zhe}"{拉|lā}"。
vocab.exampleEn: The door says "Pull".

vocab.note: The second syllable is fà (hair, as in {头发|tóu fa}). {理发|lǐ fà}{店|diàn}: a barber's.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{明天|míng tiān}{去|qù}{理发|lǐ fà}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm getting my hair cut tomorrow.

vocab.note: kōng; {空|kòng} (free time) is lesson 15's.
vocab.example: {冰箱|bīng xiāng}{是|shì}{空|kōng}{的|de}，{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{买|mǎi}{点儿|diǎnr}{东西|dōng xi}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: The fridge is empty: let's go and buy something.

vocab.note: {灯|dēng}{不|bú}{亮|liàng}{了|le} (the light isn't working).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{房间|fáng jiān}{很|hěn}{亮|liàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This room is very bright.

vocab.example: {房间|fáng jiān}{太|tài}{乱|luàn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The room is a mess.

vocab.note: Nearly always with a result: {弄|nòng}{坏|huài}, {弄|nòng}{脏|zāng}, {弄|nòng}{好|hǎo}, {弄|nòng}{丢|diū}.
vocab.example: {谁|shéi}{把|bǎ}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{弄|nòng}{坏|huài}{了|le}？
vocab.exampleEn: Who broke my phone?

vocab.note: Glass, clothes, skin; machines that stop working are {坏|huài}.
vocab.example: {窗户|chuāng hu}{的|de}{玻璃|bō li}{破|pò}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The window glass is broken.

vocab.note: {敲|qiāo}{门|mén} (to knock at the door).
vocab.example: {有|yǒu}{人|rén}{在|zài}{敲|qiāo}{门|mén}。
vocab.exampleEn: Someone's knocking at the door.

vocab.note: Light second syllable. {收拾|shōu shi}{东西|dōng xi} (to pack).
vocab.example: {快|kuài}{把|bǎ}{房间|fáng jiān}{收拾|shōu shi}{一下|yí xià}！
vocab.exampleEn: Tidy your room!

vocab.note: Opposite of {拉|lā}; {推迟|tuī chí} (to postpone) is lesson 17's.
vocab.example: {门|mén}{上|shàng}{写|xiě}{着|zhe}"{推|tuī}"。
vocab.exampleEn: The door says "Push".

vocab.note: {电话|diàn huà}{响|xiǎng}{了|le} (the phone's ringing).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{响|xiǎng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: My phone's ringing.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{坏|huài}{了|le}，{得|děi}{修|xiū}{一|yi}{修|xiū}。
vocab.exampleEn: My bike's broken: it needs fixing.

vocab.note: {修理|xiū lǐ}{费|fèi}: repair costs.
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{师傅|shī fu}{来|lái}{修理|xiū lǐ}{窗户|chuāng hu}。
vocab.exampleEn: The repairman is coming to fix the window tomorrow.

vocab.note: {打扫|dǎ sǎo}{卫生|wèi shēng} (to do the cleaning).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{很|hěn}{卫生|wèi shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This restaurant is very clean.

vocab.note: Light second syllable; counted with {把|bǎ}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{钥匙|yào shi}{找|zhǎo}{不|bu}{到|dào}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I can't find my keys.

vocab.example: {孩子|hái zi}{们|men}{在|zài}{院子|yuàn zi}{里|lǐ}{玩儿|wánr}。
vocab.exampleEn: The children are playing in the yard.

vocab.example: {房子|fáng zi}{周围|zhōu wéi}{很|hěn}{安静|ān jìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's quiet around the house.

vocab.note: {着|zháo} is zháo, as in {睡|shuì}{着|zhe}.
vocab.example: {厨房|chú fáng}{差点儿|chà diǎnr}{着火|zháo huǒ}{了|le}！
vocab.exampleEn: The kitchen nearly caught fire!

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{整理|zhěng lǐ}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{书|shū}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm sorting out my books.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{租|zū}{了|le}{一|yí}{套|tào}{两|liǎng}{室|shì}{一|yì}{厅|tīng}{的|de}{房子|fáng zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: We've rented a two-bedroom flat.

vocab.note: After a reason: what you did because nothing else would do.
vocab.example: {商店|shāng diàn}{关|guān}{门|mén}{了|le}，{他|tā}{只好|zhǐ hǎo}{明天|míng tiān}{再|zài}{来|lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: The shop was shut, so he'll have to come back tomorrow.

vocab.note: What an employer does: {招聘|zhāo pìn}{广告|guǎng gào} (a job advertisement). The person who answers it {应聘|yìng pìn}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{公司|gōng sī}{在|zài}{招聘|zhāo pìn}{两|liǎng}{名|míng}{司机|sī jī}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our company is recruiting two drivers.

vocab.note: The applicant's side of {招聘|zhāo pìn}. {应|yìng} is fourth tone here, not {应该|yīng gāi}'s first.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{去|qù}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{网站|wǎng zhàn}{应聘|yìng pìn}{编辑|biān jí}{的|de}{工作|gōng zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: She applied for an editor's job at a website.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{看|kàn}{到|dào}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{招聘|zhāo pìn}{广告|guǎng gào}。
vocab.exampleEn: I saw a job advertisement online.

vocab.note: Met with {符合|fú hé}: {符合|fú hé}{条件|tiáo jiàn}. Also living conditions: {条件|tiáo jiàn}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{工作|gōng zuò}{的|de}{条件|tiáo jiàn}{不|bú}{太|tài}{高|gāo}，{很|hěn}{多|duō}{学生|xué sheng}{都|dōu}{符合|fú hé}。
vocab.exampleEn: The requirements for this job aren't very high; plenty of students meet them.

vocab.note: Takes a condition, requirement or rule, never a person: {我|wǒ}{符合|fú hé}{你们|nǐ men}{的|de}{条件|tiáo jiàn}。
vocab.example: {要是|yào shi}{你|nǐ}{符合|fú hé}{条件|tiáo jiàn}，{就|jiù}{给|gěi}{我们|wǒ men}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: If you meet the requirements, give us a call.

vocab.note: The word of forms and advertisements; in speech, ask {多|duō}{大|dà} or {几|jǐ}{岁|suì}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{工作|gōng zuò}{对|duì}{年龄|nián líng}{没有|méi yǒu}{要求|yāo qiú}。
vocab.exampleEn: This job has no age requirement.

vocab.note: A form asks {性别|xìng bié}; the answer is {男|nán} or {女|nǚ}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{写|xiě}{上|shàng}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{名字|míng zi}、{年龄|nián líng}{和|hé}{性别|xìng bié}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please write your name, age and sex on the form.

vocab.note: Formal (news, forms, statistics); in speech {男|nán}{的|de} or {男人|nán rén}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{工作|gōng zuò}{男性|nán xìng}、{女性|nǚ xìng}{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ}{做|zuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: Both men and women can do this job.

vocab.note: Formal (news, forms, statistics); in speech {女|nǚ}{的|de} or {女人|nǚ rén}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{职业|zhí yè}{的|de}{女性|nǚ xìng}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{多|duō}。
