vocab.example: {下课|xià kè}{之后|zhī hòu}，{我们|wǒ men}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{食堂|shí táng}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: After class, let's go to the canteen together.

vocab.note: {朋友|péng you}{之间|zhī jiān}, {两|liǎng}{个|gè}{城市|chéng shì}{之间|zhī jiān}.
vocab.example: {朋友|péng you}{之间|zhī jiān}{应该|yīng gāi}{互相|hù xiāng}{帮助|bāng zhù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Friends should help each other.

vocab.note: After a time, an event or a clause: {吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{之前|zhī qián}. Alone: "before, previously".
vocab.example: {睡觉|shuì jiào}{之前|zhī qián}，{我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{看|kàn}{一会儿|yí huìr}{书|shū}。
vocab.exampleEn: Before I go to sleep, I like to read for a while.

vocab.note: Usually {在|zài}…{之中|zhī zhōng}; in speech, {里|lǐ}.
vocab.example: {在|zài}{这些|zhè xiē}{同学|tóng xué}{之中|zhī zhōng}，{她|tā}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{最|zuì}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Among these classmates, her Chinese is the best.

vocab.note: {中年|zhōng nián}{人|rén}: a middle-aged person.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{爸爸|bà ba}{已经|yǐ jīng}{是|shì}{中年|zhōng nián}{人|rén}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: My dad is middle-aged now.

vocab.note: Written suffix: {作者|zuò zhě}, {读者|dú zhě}, {记者|jì zhě}, {爱好者|ài hào zhě}. Learn each word; it doesn't make new ones freely.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{的|de}{读者|dú zhě}{大多|dà duō}{是|shì}{年轻|nián qīng}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: Most readers of this book are young people.

vocab.note: Written: {三分之一|sān fēn zhī yī}, {父母|fù mǔ}{之|zhī}{爱|ài}, and in {之前|zhī qián}, {之后|zhī hòu}, {之间|zhī jiān}, {之|zhī}{一|yī}.
vocab.example: {长城|Cháng chéng}{是|shì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{最|zuì}{有名|yǒu míng}{的|de}{地方|dì fang}{之|zhī}{一|yī}。
vocab.exampleEn: The Great Wall is one of the most famous places in China.

vocab.note: Mostly said of oneself: {我|wǒ}{真|zhēn}{笨|bèn}！ Calling someone else {笨|bèn} is rude.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{真|zhēn}{笨|bèn}，{又|yòu}{把|bǎ}{钥匙|yào shi}{忘|wàng}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{里|lǐ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: How stupid of me: I've left my keys at home again.

vocab.note: {诚实|chéng shí}{的|de}{人|rén}: an honest person.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{诚实|chéng shí}{的|de}{人|rén}，{从来|cóng lái}{不|bù}{说|shuō}{假话|jiǎ huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's an honest person: he never tells lies.

vocab.note: The opposite of {细心|xì xīn}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{太|tài}{粗心|cū xīn}{了|le}，{这个|zhè ge}{字|zì}{又|yòu}{写|xiě}{错|cuò}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: You're so careless: you've written this character wrong again.

vocab.note: {害羞|hài xiū}{得|de}{脸红|liǎn hóng}: so shy one blushes.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{很|hěn}{害羞|hài xiū}，{不|bù}{敢|gǎn}{在|zài}{课|kè}{上|shàng}{说话|shuō huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's very shy and doesn't dare speak in class.

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{好笑|hǎo xiào}{的|de}？ What's so funny?
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{故事|gù shi}{太|tài}{好笑|hǎo xiào}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: This story is so funny.

vocab.note: {我|wǒ}{不|bú}{是|shì}{故意|gù yì}{的|de}: I didn't mean to.
vocab.example: {对不起|duì bu qǐ}，{我|wǒ}{不|bú}{是|shì}{故意|gù yì}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: Sorry, I didn't mean to.

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{礼貌|lǐ mào} (polite), {没有|méi yǒu}{礼貌|lǐ mào} (rude); {很|hěn}{礼貌|lǐ mào} in speech.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{孩子|hái zi}{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{礼貌|lǐ mào}。
vocab.exampleEn: This child has very good manners.

vocab.note: Light {泼|pō}: huó po. Of people, especially children, and of writing.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{性格|xìng gé}{很|hěn}{活泼|huó po}，{朋友|péng you}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's very outgoing and has lots of friends.

vocab.note: Describing someone: arrogant. {为|wèi}…{感到|gǎn dào}{骄傲|jiāo ào}: to be proud of.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{考|kǎo}{了|le}{第|dì}{一|yī}{名|míng}，{可是|kě shì}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{也|yě}{不|bù}{骄傲|jiāo ào}。
vocab.exampleEn: He came top, but he's not at all conceited.

vocab.note: Light {气|qì}: kè qi. {别|bié}{客气|kè qi} (don't stand on ceremony); {你|nǐ}{太|tài}{客气|kè qi}{了|le} (you shouldn't have).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{对|duì}{每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{客气|kè qi}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's polite to everyone.

vocab.note: {懒得|lǎn de} + verb: can't be bothered to.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{太|tài}{懒|lǎn}{了|le}，{周末|zhōu mò}{一直|yì zhí}{在|zài}{床|chuáng}{上|shàng}{躺|tǎng}{着|zhe}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's so lazy: he lies in bed all weekend.

vocab.note: {冷静|lěng jìng}{下来|xià lái}: to calm down.
vocab.example: {遇到|yù dào}{问题|wèn tí}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{要|yào}{先|xiān}{冷静|lěng jìng}{下来|xià lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: When you hit a problem, first calm down.

vocab.note: The person takes {跟|gēn}: {跟|gēn}{你|nǐ}{开玩笑|kāi wán xiào}. {开|kāi}{什么|shén me}{玩笑|wán xiào}！ You must be joking!
vocab.example: {别|bié}{生气|shēng qì}，{我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{你|nǐ}{开玩笑|kāi wán xiào}{呢|ne}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't be cross: I'm only joking.

vocab.note: Light {气|qì}: pí qi. {发脾气|fā pí qi}: to lose one's temper.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{爸爸|bà ba}{脾气|pí qi}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{从来|cóng lái}{不|bù}{生气|shēng qì}。
vocab.exampleEn: My dad is very good-tempered: he never gets angry.

vocab.note: Adjective and noun: {很|hěn}{耐心|nài xīn}, {有|yǒu}{耐心|nài xīn}.
vocab.example: {王老师|Wáng lǎo shī}{对|duì}{学生|xué sheng}{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{耐心|nài xīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Teacher Wang is very patient with her students.

vocab.note: Of men; also "cool" of things and actions.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{穿|chuān}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{衣服|yī fu}{真|zhēn}{帅|shuài}！
vocab.exampleEn: You look really handsome in that!

vocab.note: Light {度|dù}: tài du. {服务|fú wù}{态度|tài du}: the way staff treat customers.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{的|de}{服务|fú wù}{态度|tài du}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The service at this restaurant is very friendly.

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{特点|tè diǎn}？ What's special about it?
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{茶|chá}{的|de}{特点|tè diǎn}{是|shì}{很|hěn}{香|xiāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: What's special about this tea is its fragrance.

vocab.note: Light {话|huà}: xiào hua. {讲|jiǎng}{笑话|xiào hua} (to tell jokes); {别|bié}{笑话|xiào hua}{我|wǒ} (don't laugh at me).
vocab.example: {爷爷|yé ye}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{给|gěi}{我们|wǒ men}{讲|jiǎng}{笑话|xiào hua}。
vocab.exampleEn: Grandpa loves telling us jokes.

vocab.note: {性格|xìng gé}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}, {性格|xìng gé}{活泼|huó po}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{俩|liǎ}{的|de}{性格|xìng gé}{很|hěn}{不|bù}{一样|yí yàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The two of us have very different personalities.

vocab.note: Too casual, careless; and "as you like": {随便|suí biàn}{坐|zuò} (sit anywhere).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{想|xiǎng}{喝|hē}{什么|shén me}？——{随便|suí biàn}，{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: What would you like to drink? — Anything, I don't mind.

vocab.note: Written {没有|méi yǒu}: {无|wú}{人|rén} (nobody), {无法|wú fǎ}, {无聊|wú liáo}, {无|wú}A{无|wú}B.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{下午|xià wǔ}{无|wú}{课|kè}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are no classes this afternoon.

vocab.note: The opposite of {粗心|cū xīn}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{做|zuò}{事|shì}{很|hěn}{细心|xì xīn}，{从来|cóng lái}{不|bù}{出|chū}{错|cuò}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's very careful in her work and never makes mistakes.

vocab.note: Makes nouns: {积极性|jī jí xìng}, {重要性|zhòng yào xìng}, {可能性|kě néng xìng}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{都|dōu}{知道|zhī dào}{学|xué}{外语|wài yǔ}{的|de}{重要性|zhòng yào xìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: We all know how important it is to learn a foreign language.

vocab.note: Light {子|zi}. {看样子|kàn yàng zi}: by the look of it.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{笑|xiào}{的|de}{样子|yàng zi}{很|hěn}{可爱|kě ài}。
vocab.exampleEn: He looks sweet when he smiles.

vocab.note: {尊重|zūn zhòng}{别人|bié ren}{的|de}{想法|xiǎng fǎ}: to respect other people's ideas.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{要|yào}{尊重|zūn zhòng}{每|měi}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: We should respect every person.

vocab.note: {勇敢|yǒng gǎn}{地|de} + verb: bravely.
vocab.example: {小女孩|xiǎo nǚ hái}{很|hěn}{勇敢|yǒng gǎn}，{打针|dǎ zhēn}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{没|méi}{哭|kū}。
vocab.exampleEn: The little girl was very brave and didn't cry when she had her injection.

vocab.note: A sound loan from English "humour" (1920s).
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{老师|lǎo shī}{很|hěn}{幽默|yōu mò}，{上课|shàng kè}{常常|cháng cháng}{讲|jiǎng}{笑话|xiào hua}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our teacher is very funny and often tells jokes in class.

vocab.note: {对|duì}…{很|hěn}{友好|yǒu hǎo}: friendly to…
vocab.example: {这里|zhè lǐ}{的|de}{人|rén}{对|duì}{外国|wài guó}{人|rén}{很|hěn}{友好|yǒu hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: People here are very friendly to foreigners.

vocab.note: Love between partners; {爱|ài} is love in general.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{关于|guān yú}{爱情|ài qíng}{的|de}{电影|diàn yǐng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This is a film about love.

vocab.note: {有|yǒu}{爱心|ài xīn}: kind, caring.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{爱心|ài xīn}，{常常|cháng cháng}{帮助|bāng zhù}{别人|bié ren}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's very caring and often helps other people.

vocab.note: {抱|bào}{一下|yí xià} (a hug); {抱|bào}{着|zhe}{孩子|hái zi} (holding a child).
vocab.example: {妈妈|mā ma}{抱|bào}{着|zhe}{孩子|hái zi}{在|zài}{门口|mén kǒu}{等|děng}{车|chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: The mother is waiting for the bus at the door with her child in her arms.

vocab.note: ā at the start of a sentence (surprise, admiration); the particle a at the end is HSK 2's.
vocab.example: {啊|ā}，{下|xià}{雪|xuě}{了|le}！
vocab.exampleEn: Oh, it's snowing!

vocab.note: {他们|tā men}{感情|gǎn qíng}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}: they're very close.
vocab.example: {他们|tā men}{俩|liǎ}{感情|gǎn qíng}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The two of them are very close.

vocab.note: Verb and noun: {说说|shuō shuo}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{感受|gǎn shòu} (tell us how you feel about it).
vocab.example: {去|qù}{了|le}{中国|Zhōng guó}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{我|wǒ}{感受|gǎn shòu}{到|dào}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{不同|bù tóng}{的|de}{文化|wén huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: After going to China I experienced many different ways of life.

vocab.note: Takes a verb or clause: {后悔|hòu huǐ}{没|méi}{去|qù}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{后悔|hòu huǐ}{没有|méi yǒu}{早|zǎo}{点儿|diǎnr}{学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: I really regret not learning Chinese sooner.

vocab.note: dé yì. Often a little smug.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{考|kǎo}{了|le}{第|dì}{一|yī}，{很|hěn}{得意|dé yì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He came top and was very pleased with himself.

vocab.note: {别|bié}{烦|fán}{我|wǒ} (leave me alone); {烦人|fán rén} (annoying).
vocab.example: {每|měi}{天|tiān}{都|dōu}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{真|zhēn}{烦|fán}！
vocab.exampleEn: It rains every day: how annoying!

vocab.note: Adjective and noun: {年轻|nián qīng}{人|rén}{的|de}{烦恼|fán nǎo} (young people's worries).
vocab.example: {别|bié}{为|wèi}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{小|xiǎo}{事|shì}{烦恼|fán nǎo}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't worry about such a small thing.

vocab.note: Describes the story or the event; how you feel is {感动|gǎn dòng}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{电影|diàn yǐng}{非常|fēi cháng}{感人|gǎn rén}。
vocab.exampleEn: This film is very moving.

vocab.note: How you feel; also a verb: {他|tā}{的话|de huà}{感动|gǎn dòng}{了|le}{大家|dà jiā}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的话|de huà}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{感动|gǎn dòng}。
vocab.exampleEn: What he said really touched me.

vocab.note: Makes "a sense of…": {安全感|ān quán gǎn}, {幸福感|xìng fú gǎn}, {责任感|zé rèn gǎn}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{做|zuò}{事|shì}{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{责任感|zé rèn gǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: He has a strong sense of responsibility.

vocab.note: Strong emotion of any kind: {别|bié}{激动|jī dòng} (calm down).
vocab.example: {听|tīng}{到|dào}{这个|zhè ge}{好|hǎo}{消息|xiāo xi}，{她|tā}{激动|jī dòng}{得|de}{哭|kū}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: When she heard the good news, she was so moved she cried.

vocab.note: Also of situations: {工作|gōng zuò}{很|hěn}{紧张|jǐn zhāng} (work is intense).
vocab.example: {第|dì}{一|yī}{次|cì}{上|shàng}{台|tái}{说话|shuō huà}，{我|wǒ}{非常|fēi cháng}{紧张|jǐn zhāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The first time I spoke on stage, I was very nervous.

vocab.note: About bad luck: {太|tài}{可惜|kě xī}{了|le}！ For your own act, {后悔|hòu huǐ}.
vocab.example: {太|tài}{可惜|kě xī}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{差|chà}{一|yì}{分|fēn}{就|jiù}{赢|yíng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: What a shame: we lost by just one point.

vocab.note: Of people, places and evenings.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{很|hěn}{浪漫|làng màn}，{常常|cháng cháng}{给|gěi}{女朋友|nǚ péng you}{送|sòng}{花|huā}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's very romantic and often gives his girlfriend flowers.

vocab.note: {内心|nèi xīn}{深处|shēn chù}: in the depths of one's heart.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{看起来|kàn qǐ lai}{很|hěn}{冷静|lěng jìng}，{可是|kě shì}{内心|nèi xīn}{很|hěn}{紧张|jǐn zhāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: He looks calm, but inside he's very nervous.

vocab.note: {生气|shēng qì} (to be angry); {气|qì}{死|sǐ}{我|wǒ}{了|le} (I'm furious).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{还|hái}{在|zài}{生|shēng}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{气|qì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's still angry with me.

vocab.note: Abstract or for ever: {失去|shī qù}{机会|jī huì}, {失去|shī qù}{信心|xìn xīn}. A lost object: {丢|diū}.
vocab.example: {别|bié}{失去|shī qù}{信心|xìn xīn}，{你|nǐ}{一定|yí dìng}{能|néng}{考|kǎo}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Don't lose heart: you're sure to do well in the exam.

vocab.note: {对|duì}…{很|hěn}{失望|shī wàng}; {别|bié}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{失望|shī wàng} (don't let me down).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{对|duì}{这|zhè}{次|cì}{的|de}{成绩|chéng jì}{很|hěn}{失望|shī wàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'm disappointed with my results this time.

vocab.note: Written {让|ràng} + person + feeling or change. It can't mean "let".
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{好|hǎo}{消息|xiāo xi}{使|shǐ}{大家|dà jiā}{非常|fēi cháng}{高兴|gāo xìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The good news made everyone very happy.

vocab.note: shòu bu liǎo; positive {受得了|shòu de liǎo} (can bear).
vocab.example: {天气|tiān qì}{太|tài}{热|rè}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{受不了|shòu bu liǎo}{了|le}！
vocab.exampleEn: It's too hot: I can't stand it!

vocab.note: Stronger than {难过|nán guò}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{的|de}{小|xiǎo}{狗|gǒu}{丢|diū}{了|le}，{她|tā}{伤心|shāng xīn}{了|le}{好|hǎo}{几|jǐ}{天|tiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: Her puppy went missing and she was heartbroken for days.

vocab.note: Agreement or "I'm listening". Dictionaries also give ǹg (the syllabus writes ǹg).
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{明天|míng tiān}{来|lái}{吗|ma}？——{嗯|èn}，{我|wǒ}{来|lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: Are you coming tomorrow? — Mm, I am.

vocab.note: {一|yí}{束|shù}{鲜花|xiān huā}: a bunch of flowers.
vocab.example: {桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}{放|fàng}{着|zhe}{一|yí}{束|shù}{鲜花|xiān huā}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a bunch of flowers on the table.

vocab.note: The heart, and the mind and feelings: {心里|xīn li} (in one's heart).
vocab.example: {听|tīng}{到|dào}{这个|zhè ge}{消息|xiāo xi}，{我|wǒ}{的|de}{心|xīn}{跳|tiào}{得|de}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}。
vocab.exampleEn: When I heard the news, my heart started racing.

vocab.note: {心情|xīn qíng}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo} / {不|bù}{好|hǎo}.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{天气|tiān qì}{好|hǎo}，{我|wǒ}{的|de}{心情|xīn qíng}{也|yě}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The weather's nice today, and I'm in a good mood too.

vocab.note: A deep, lasting happiness: {祝|zhù}{你们|nǐ men}{幸福|xìng fú}！ A happy moment is {高兴|gāo xìng}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{一|yì}{家人|jiā rén}{生活|shēng huó}{得|de}{很|hěn}{幸福|xìng fú}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our family lives a very happy life.

vocab.note: A friendly envy, close to admiration.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{真|zhēn}{羡慕|xiàn mù}{你|nǐ}{能|néng}{去|qù}{英国|Yīng guó}{留学|liú xué}。
vocab.exampleEn: I really envy you studying in Britain.

vocab.note: Strong; among friends also a teasing "you're awful!".
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{讨厌|tǎo yàn}{下雨|xià yǔ}{天|tiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: I hate rainy days.

vocab.note: Of a person ({我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{无聊|wú liáo}) or a thing ({电影|diàn yǐng}{很|hěn}{无聊|wú liáo}).
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{一|yí}{个|gè}{人|rén}{在|zài}{家|jiā}，{太|tài}{无聊|wú liáo}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Being home alone at the weekend is so boring.

vocab.note: {兴|xīng} is xīng here.
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{去|qù}{旅行|lǚ xíng}，{孩子|hái zi}{们|men}{兴奋|xīng fèn}{得|de}{睡不着|shuì bu zháo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The children are so excited about tomorrow's trip they can't sleep.

meanings: to arrange to meet (ask someone out)
vocab.note: {约|yuē}{朋友|péng you} (arrange to meet a friend). Also "about" in {大约|dà yuē} (lesson 15).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{约|yuē}{了|le}{朋友|péng you}{明天|míng tiān}{去|qù}{爬|pá}{山|shān}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've arranged to go hiking with a friend tomorrow.

vocab.note: Noun and verb: {有|yǒu}{个|gè}{约会|yuē huì}; {他们|tā men}{在|zài}{约会|yuē huì}.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{有|yǒu}{个|gè}{约会|yuē huì}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've got a date tonight.

vocab.note: Of a time or an experience: {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{周末|zhōu mò}{愉快|yú kuài}！
vocab.example: {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{旅行|lǚ xíng}{愉快|yú kuài}！
vocab.exampleEn: Have a pleasant trip!

vocab.note: {永远|yǒng yuǎn}{不|bú}{会|huì}{忘记|wàng jì}: will never forget.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{永远|yǒng yuǎn}{不|bú}{会|huì}{忘记|wàng jì}{那|nà}{一|yì}{天|tiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: I'll never forget that day.

vocab.note: {播放|bō fàng}{视频|shì pín}, {播放|bō fàng}{音乐|yīn yuè}; {播放不了|bō fàng bu liǎo} (won't play).
vocab.example: {电视|diàn shì}{上|shàng}{正在|zhèng zài}{播放|bō fàng}{一|yí}{部|bù}{老|lǎo}{电影|diàn yǐng}。
vocab.exampleEn: An old film is on TV.

vocab.note: For films, TV series, long works, and phones: {一|yí}{部|bù}{电影|diàn yǐng}. Also "department" ({部门|bù mén}, lesson 13).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{部|bù}{电影|diàn yǐng}{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{了|le}{三|sān}{遍|biàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've seen this film three times.

vocab.note: Counted with {部|bù}.
vocab.example: {妈妈|mā ma}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{都|dōu}{看|kàn}{电视剧|diàn shì jù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Mum watches a TV series every evening.

vocab.note: {发|fā}{短信|duǎn xìn}: to send a text.
vocab.example: {到|dào}{了|le}{以后|yǐ hòu}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{发|fā}{个|gè}{短信|duǎn xìn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Send me a text when you get there.

vocab.note: In speech, {网|wǎng} or {网上|wǎng shàng}.
vocab.example: {互联网|hù lián wǎng}{使|shǐ}{人们|rén men}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}{更|gèng}{方便|fāng biàn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The internet has made people's lives more convenient.

vocab.note: {发出|fā chū}{通知|tōng zhī} (to issue a notice); {发出|fā chū}{声音|shēng yīn} (to make a sound).
vocab.example: {学校|xué xiào}{发出|fā chū}{通知|tōng zhī}，{明天|míng tiān}{放假|fàng jià}。
vocab.exampleEn: The school has sent out a notice: tomorrow is a holiday.

vocab.note: In speech, {发|fā}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{在|zài}{下午|xià wǔ}{五|wǔ}{点|diǎn}{以前|yǐ qián}{发送|fā sòng}{材料|cái liào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please send the materials before 5 p.m.

vocab.note: Written {看|kàn}, on notices and in announcements.
vocab.example: {欢迎|huān yíng}{大家|dà jiā}{来|lái}{观看|guān kàn}{比赛|bǐ sài}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone is welcome to come and watch the match.

vocab.note: Noun and verb: {听|tīng}{广播|guǎng bō} (listen to the radio).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{爷爷|yé ye}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{都|dōu}{听|tīng}{广播|guǎng bō}。
vocab.exampleEn: My grandpa listens to the radio every morning.

vocab.note: {国际|guó jì}{新闻|xīn wén}, {国际|guó jì}{学生|xué sheng}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{国际|guó jì}{学校|xué xiào}{当|dāng}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: He teaches at an international school.

vocab.note: Formal; not after an adverb or modal verb, and not for an attitude towards a person (use {对|duì}).
vocab.example: {对于|duì yú}{这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}，{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{看法|kàn fǎ}{不|bù}{一样|yí yàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: People have different views on this question.

vocab.note: {记|jì} (to record) + {者|zhě}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{是|shì}{一|yì}{名|míng}{新闻|xīn wén}{记者|jì zhě}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's a news reporter.

vocab.note: A little formal; in a chat, {回|huí}.
vocab.example: {收到|shōu dào}{邮件|yóu jiàn}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{请|qǐng}{尽快|jǐn kuài}{回复|huí fù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please reply as soon as you get the email.

vocab.note: For information and knowledge, in writing; in speech, {得到|dé dào}.
vocab.example: {现在|xiàn zài}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{从|cóng}{网上|wǎng shàng}{获取|huò qǔ}{新闻|xīn wén}。
vocab.exampleEn: Nowadays many people get their news online.

vocab.note: Verb and adjective: {流行|liú xíng}{歌曲|gē qǔ} (pop songs).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{首|shǒu}{歌|gē}{现在|xiàn zài}{特别|tè bié}{流行|liú xíng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This song is really popular at the moment.

vocab.note: {看|kàn}{视频|shì pín}, {拍|pāi}{视频|shì pín}; in speech also "to video-call".
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{拍|pāi}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小|xiǎo}{狗|gǒu}{的|de}{视频|shì pín}。
vocab.exampleEn: I made a video of a puppy.

vocab.note: {收听|shōu tīng}{广播|guǎng bō}, {收听|shōu tīng}{节目|jié mù}.
vocab.example: {欢迎|huān yíng}{收听|shōu tīng}{今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{节目|jié mù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Welcome to today's programme.

vocab.note: Of a radio show or a talk; a film's or a match's audience is {观众|guān zhòng}.
vocab.example: {各位|gè wèi}{听众|tīng zhòng}，{大家|dà jiā}{好|hǎo}！
vocab.exampleEn: Good day, listeners!

vocab.note: {网上|wǎng shàng}{的|de}{图片|tú piàn}: pictures online.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{图片|tú piàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of pictures in this article.

vocab.note: {打开|dǎ kāi}{网页|wǎng yè}: to open a web page.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{网页|wǎng yè}{打不开|dǎ bu kāi}。
vocab.exampleEn: This web page won't open.

vocab.note: People online in general, or a friend you met online.
vocab.example: {很|hěn}{多|duō}{网友|wǎng yǒu}{都|dōu}{转发|zhuǎn fā}{了|le}{这个|zhè ge}{视频|shì pín}。
vocab.exampleEn: Lots of internet users have shared this video.

vocab.note: {把|bǎ}{网址|wǎng zhǐ}{发|fā}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}: send me the address.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{把|bǎ}{网址|wǎng zhǐ}{发|fā}{给|gěi}{我|wǒ}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: Send me the web address.

vocab.note: With {线下|xiàn xià}: {线上|xiàn shàng}{课程|kè chéng}, {线上|xiàn shàng}{线下|xiàn xià}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{活动|huó dòng}{线上|xiàn shàng}{线下|xiàn xià}{都|dōu}{可以|kě yǐ}{报名|bào míng}。
vocab.exampleEn: You can sign up for this event online or in person.

vocab.note: The in-person side of a service or event: {线下|xiàn xià}{活动|huó dòng}.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{下|xià}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{线下|xiàn xià}{读书会|dú shū huì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Next month we have an in-person reading group.

vocab.note: Light {息|xī}: xiāo xi. {好|hǎo}{消息|xiāo xi}; {发|fā}{消息|xiāo xi} (send a message).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{好|hǎo}{消息|xiāo xi}{要|yào}{告诉|gào su}{你|nǐ}！
vocab.exampleEn: I've got some good news to tell you!

vocab.note: {没有|méi yǒu}{信号|xìn hào}: no signal.
vocab.example: {地铁|dì tiě}{里|lǐ}{手机|shǒu jī}{没有|méi yǒu}{信号|xìn hào}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's no phone signal on the underground.

vocab.note: The general word; {获取|huò qǔ}{信息|xìn xī} (to obtain information).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{网站|wǎng zhàn}{上|shàng}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{有用|yǒu yòng}{的|de}{信息|xìn xī}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's lots of useful information on this website.

vocab.note: After {打|dǎ} for calls: {打通|dǎ tōng}{了|le}, {打不通|dǎ bu tōng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{给|gěi}{他|tā}{打|dǎ}{了|le}{三|sān}{次|cì}{电话|diàn huà}，{都|dōu}{没|méi}{打通|dǎ tōng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I rang him three times and never got through.

vocab.note: New products, services, programmes: {推出|tuī chū}{新|xīn}{节目|jié mù}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{网站|wǎng zhàn}{推出|tuī chū}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{新|xīn}{节目|jié mù}。
vocab.exampleEn: This website has launched a new programme.

vocab.note: {网上|wǎng shàng}{购物|gòu wù}, shortened.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}{去|qù}{商店|shāng diàn}，{一般|yì bān}{都|dōu}{网购|wǎng gòu}。
vocab.exampleEn: I rarely go to shops: I usually shop online.

vocab.note: {转发|zhuǎn fā}{给|gěi}{朋友|péng you}: to forward to friends.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{篇|piān}{文章|wén zhāng}{我|wǒ}{已经|yǐ jīng}{转发|zhuǎn fā}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've already forwarded the article to you.

vocab.note: Written {和|hé} / {跟|gēn}: {与|yǔ}…{有关|yǒu guān}, {与|yǔ}…{相比|xiāng bǐ}; in titles.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{与|yǔ}{他|tā}{没有|méi yǒu}{关系|guān xi}。
vocab.exampleEn: This has nothing to do with him.

vocab.note: Formal, like {无论|wú lùn} ({不管|bù guǎn} is the spoken one); with {都|dōu} / {也|yě}.
vocab.example: {不论|bú lùn}{刮|guā}{风|fēng}{还是|hái shi}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{都|dōu}{去|qù}{上班|shàng bān}。
vocab.exampleEn: Whether it's windy or raining, he goes to work every day.

vocab.note: With an open choice and {都|dōu} / {也|yě}: {不管|bù guǎn}{多|duō}{忙|máng}，{都|dōu}…. Also "not to care about": {我|wǒ}{不管|bù guǎn}.
vocab.example: {不管|bù guǎn}{多|duō}{忙|máng}，{她|tā}{都|dōu}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{给|gěi}{妈妈|mā ma}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: However busy she is, she phones her mum every day.

vocab.note: {多数|duō shù}{人|rén}, {大多数|dà duō shù} (the great majority).
vocab.example: {多数|duō shù}{同学|tóng xué}{同意|tóng yì}{这个|zhè ge}{办法|bàn fǎ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Most of the students agree with this plan.

vocab.note: In {方法|fāng fǎ}, {办法|bàn fǎ}, {看法|kàn fǎ}, {说法|shuō fǎ}; alone in writing, "law": {守法|shǒu fǎ} (to obey the law).
vocab.example: {每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{都|dōu}{应该|yīng gāi}{懂|dǒng}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{法|fǎ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone should know a little about the law.

vocab.note: {法律|fǎ lǜ}{问题|wèn tí}: a legal question.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{大学|dà xué}{学|xué}{的|de}{是|shì}{法律|fǎ lǜ}。
vocab.exampleEn: He studied law at university.

vocab.note: {在|zài}…{方面|fāng miàn} (in terms of…); {一方面|yì fāng miàn}…{另一方面|lìng yì fāng miàn}.
vocab.example: {在|zài}{学习|xué xí}{方面|fāng miàn}，{他|tā}{从来|cóng lái}{不|bú}{让|ràng}{父母|fù mǔ}{担心|dān xīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: When it comes to studying, he never worries his parents.

vocab.note: {生活方式|shēng huó fāng shì} (way of life); {用|yòng}{这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{方式|fāng shì}.
vocab.example: {每|měi}{个|gè}{人|rén}{的|de}{学习|xué xí}{方式|fāng shì}{都|dōu}{不|bù}{一样|yí yàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Everyone has their own way of learning.

vocab.note: Noun and adjective: {关键|guān jiàn}{是|shì}…; {关键|guān jiàn}{的|de}{问题|wèn tí}.
vocab.example: {学|xué}{好|hǎo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{的|de}{关键|guān jiàn}{是|shì}{多|duō}{练习|liàn xí}。
vocab.exampleEn: The key to learning Chinese well is lots of practice.

vocab.note: hǎo chù as the word list gives it; many speakers make it light, hǎo chu. {对|duì}…{有|yǒu}{好处|hǎo chù}: good for…
vocab.example: {每|měi}{天|tiān}{运动|yùn dòng}{对|duì}{身体|shēn tǐ}{有|yǒu}{好处|hǎo chù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Exercising every day is good for you.

vocab.note: diào chá. {做|zuò}{调查|diào chá}: to do a survey.
vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{班|bān}{做|zuò}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{调查|diào chá}。
vocab.exampleEn: Our class did a survey.

vocab.note: In speech, "I reckon": {估计|gū jì}{他|tā}{不|bù}{来|lái}{了|le}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{估计|gū jì}{他|tā}{今天|jīn tiān}{不|bú}{会|huì}{来|lái}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I reckon he won't come today.

vocab.note: The opposite of {简单|jiǎn dān}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{的|de}{复杂|fù zá}。
vocab.exampleEn: This question is more complicated than I thought.

vocab.note: Written: {从中|cóng zhōng}{学|xué}{到|dào}{很|hěn}{多|duō} (learn a lot from it).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{失败|shī bài}{了|le}，{可是|kě shì}{我|wǒ}{从中|cóng zhōng}{学|xué}{到|dào}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: I failed this time, but I learned a lot from it.

vocab.note: Light {处|chù}: huài chu.
vocab.example: {玩|wán}{手机|shǒu jī}{太|tài}{久|jiǔ}{对|duì}{眼睛|yǎn jing}{有|yǒu}{坏处|huài chu}。
vocab.exampleEn: Too much time on your phone is bad for your eyes.

vocab.note: {对|duì}…{的|de}{看法|kàn fǎ}; {你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{看法|kàn fǎ}？
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{对|duì}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{看法|kàn fǎ}？
vocab.exampleEn: What's your view on this?

vocab.note: + clause: to suspect that…; + noun: to doubt.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{怀疑|huái yí}{他|tā}{说|shuō}{的|de}{不|bú}{是|shì}{真|zhēn}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: I suspect what he said isn't true.

vocab.note: Adverb in speech ({他|tā}{肯定|kěn dìng}{知道|zhī dào}); verb "to affirm, approve" ({肯定|kěn dìng}{了|le}{我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{想法|xiǎng fǎ}).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{肯定|kěn dìng}{知道|zhī dào}{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事|shì}。
vocab.exampleEn: He definitely knows about this.

vocab.note: {少|shǎo} is shǎo here.
vocab.example: {只有|zhǐ yǒu}{少数|shǎo shù}{人|rén}{反对|fǎn duì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Only a few people are against it.

vocab.note: {社会|shè huì}{问题|wèn tí} (a social problem); {走向|zǒu xiàng}{社会|shè huì} (to go out into the world).
vocab.example: {大学|dà xué}{毕业|bì yè}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{我们|wǒ men}{就|jiù}{要|yào}{走向|zǒu xiàng}{社会|shè huì}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: After university we'll be going out into the world.

vocab.note: Noun and adjective: {实际情况|shí jì qíng kuàng} (the actual situation); {不|bú}{太|tài}{实际|shí jì} (not very realistic).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{计划|jì huà}{不|bú}{太|tài}{实际|shí jì}。
vocab.exampleEn: This plan isn't very realistic.

vocab.note: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{说法|shuō fǎ}: this claim, this way of putting it.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{说法|shuō fǎ}{不|bú}{太|tài}{准确|zhǔn què}。
vocab.exampleEn: That way of putting it isn't quite accurate.

vocab.note: Verb and noun: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{判断|pàn duàn}{是|shì}{对|duì}{的|de}.
vocab.example: {很|hěn}{难|nán}{判断|pàn duàn}{他|tā}{说|shuō}{的|de}{是|shì}{不|bu}{是|shì}{真|zhēn}{话|huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's hard to judge whether he's telling the truth.

vocab.note: Noun and verb: {有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{区别|qū bié}？
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{词|cí}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{区别|qū bié}？
vocab.exampleEn: What's the difference between these two words?

vocab.note: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{情况|qíng kuàng}{很|hěn}{普遍|pǔ biàn}; {普遍|pǔ biàn}{认为|rèn wéi} (it is generally thought).
vocab.example: {现在|xiàn zài}{网购|wǎng gòu}{已经|yǐ jīng}{很|hěn}{普遍|pǔ biàn}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Online shopping is very common now.

vocab.note: Confirms what was said: {确实|què shí}{是|shì}{这样|zhè yàng} (that's quite true).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{确实|què shí}{很|hěn}{难|nán}。
vocab.exampleEn: This question really is hard.

vocab.note: Corrects an impression.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{看起来|kàn qǐ lai}{很|hěn}{年轻|nián qīng}，{实际上|shí jì shàng}{已经|yǐ jīng}{五十|wǔ shí}{岁|suì}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: He looks young, but in fact he's already fifty.

vocab.note: Written {是|shì}{不|bu}{是|shì}; no {吗|ma} after it.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{是否|shì fǒu}{同意|tóng yì}，{现在|xiàn zài}{还|hái}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Whether he agrees isn't known yet.

vocab.note: Written {能|néng}{不|bu}{能|néng}.
vocab.example: {能否|néng fǒu}{成功|chéng gōng}，{就|jiù}{看|kàn}{大家|dà jiā}{是否|shì fǒu}{努力|nǔ lì}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Whether we succeed depends on whether everyone works hard.

vocab.note: What you think, including plans: {我|wǒ}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{想法|xiǎng fǎ}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè}{想法|xiǎng fǎ}：{周末|zhōu mò}{我们|wǒ men}{去|qù}{爬|pá}{山|shān}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've got an idea: let's go hiking at the weekend.

vocab.note: {同样|tóng yàng}{的|de}{错误|cuò wù} (the same mistake); {同样|tóng yàng}，… (likewise, …).
vocab.example: {学生|xué sheng}{要|yào}{尊重|zūn zhòng}{老师|lǎo shī}，{同样|tóng yàng}，{老师|lǎo shī}{也|yě}{要|yào}{尊重|zūn zhòng}{学生|xué sheng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Students should respect their teachers; likewise, teachers should respect their students.

vocab.note: {完全|wán quán}{同意|tóng yì}, {完全|wán quán}{不|bù}{一样|yí yàng}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{完全|wán quán}{同意|tóng yì}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{看法|kàn fǎ}。
vocab.exampleEn: I completely agree with you.

vocab.note: {相反|xiāng fǎn}{的|de}{方向|fāng xiàng} (the opposite direction); {相反|xiāng fǎn}，… (on the contrary).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{不但|bú dàn}{没|méi}{生气|shēng qì}，{相反|xiāng fǎn}，{还|hái}{表扬|biǎo yáng}{了|le}{我|wǒ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Far from being angry, he praised me.

vocab.note: Formal; in speech, {一样|yí yàng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{字|zì}{的|de}{读音|dú yīn}{相同|xiāng tóng}。
vocab.exampleEn: These two characters are pronounced the same.

vocab.note: With an open choice and {都|dōu} / {也|yě}.
vocab.example: {无论|wú lùn}{你|nǐ}{去|qù}{哪儿|nǎr}，{我|wǒ}{都|dōu}{跟|gēn}{你|nǐ}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Wherever you go, I'll go with you.

vocab.note: Light {意|yì}: zhǔ yi. {好|hǎo}{主意|zhǔ yi}！; {出主意|chū zhǔ yi} (to suggest what to do).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{是|shì}{个|gè}{好|hǎo}{主意|zhǔ yi}！
vocab.exampleEn: That's a good idea!

vocab.note: Before a noun or verb: {真正|zhēn zhèng}{的|de}{朋友|péng you}.
vocab.example: {他|tā}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{真正|zhēn zhèng}{的|de}{朋友|péng you}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's a true friend of mine.

vocab.note: Softer than {可能|kě néng} in a guess.
vocab.example: {也许|yě xǔ}{他|tā}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{今天|jīn tiān}{开会|kāi huì}。
vocab.exampleEn: Perhaps he's forgotten there's a meeting today.

vocab.note: Direction + {部|bù} (part): {北部|běi bù}, {南部|nán bù}, {东部|dōng bù}, {西部|xī bù}, the part of a named place: {中国|Zhōng guó}{北部|běi bù}. HSK 3's {北方|běi fāng} is "the North" as a broad area.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{的|de}{老家|lǎo jiā}{在|zài}{中国|Zhōng guó}{北部|běi bù}，{冬天|dōng tiān}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}。
vocab.exampleEn: My hometown is in the north of China, and the winters are cold.

vocab.note: Of the wind ({风|fēng}{吹|chuī}, {风|fēng}{吹|chuī}{得|de}{很|hěn}{大|dà}) or with your mouth ({吹一吹|chuī yi chuī}: blow on it).
vocab.example: {外面|wài miàn}{风|fēng}{吹|chuī}{得|de}{很|hěn}{大|dà}，{你|nǐ}{多|duō}{穿|chuān}{点儿|diǎnr}{衣服|yī fu}。
vocab.exampleEn: The wind is blowing hard outside; put on more clothes.

vocab.note: {村|cūn}{里|lǐ}: in the village. The countryside as a whole is {农村|nóng cūn}.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{爷爷|yé ye}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{一|yí}{个|gè}{很|hěn}{小|xiǎo}{的|de}{村|cūn}{里|lǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: My grandpa lives in a very small village.

vocab.note: The natural world as a place to be: {走|zǒu}{进|jìn}{大自然|dà zì rán} (get out into nature). Lesson 27's {自然|zì rán} is also "natural".
vocab.example: {周末|zhōu mò}{我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{去|qù}{大自然|dà zì rán}{里|lǐ}{走走|zǒu zou}。
vocab.exampleEn: At weekends I like to get out into nature for a walk.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{都|dōu}{生活|shēng huó}{在|zài}{地球|dì qiú}{上|shàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: We all live on the earth.

vocab.note: In forecasts and on labels: {高温|gāo wēn}{天气|tiān qì} (a heat wave). The opposite is {低温|dī wēn}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{几|jǐ}{天|tiān}{有|yǒu}{三十五|sān shí wǔ}{度|dù}{以上|yǐ shàng}{的|de}{高温|gāo wēn}，{中午|zhōng wǔ}{最好|zuì hǎo}{别|bié}{出门|chū mén}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's heat over thirty-five degrees these days; best not to go out at midday.

vocab.note: The oceans in general, a written word; one sea or the seaside is {海|hǎi}.
vocab.example: {海洋|hǎi yáng}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{我们|wǒ men}{还|hái}{不|bù}{了解|liǎo jiě}{的|de}{动物|dòng wù}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are many animals in the oceans that we still don't know much about.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{水果|shuǐ guǒ}{要|yào}{放|fàng}{在|zài}{低温|dī wēn}{的|de}{地方|dì fang}。
vocab.exampleEn: This kind of fruit should be kept somewhere cold.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{东部|dōng bù}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{新|xīn}{楼|lóu}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are lots of new buildings in the east of the city.

vocab.note: Light: {阳光|yáng guāng} (sunshine), {灯光|dēng guāng} (lamplight). Also an adverb, "only, just" ({光说不做|guāng shuō bú zuò}: all talk), the {光|guāng} of {不光|bù guāng} (lesson 04), and "used up": {钱|qián}{花|huā}{光|guāng}{了|le}.
vocab.example: {房间|fáng jiān}{里|lǐ}{光|guāng}{不够|bú gòu}，{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{不|bu}{清楚|qīng chu}。
vocab.exampleEn: There isn't enough light in the room; I can't see clearly.

meanings: to arrive (of a time or season)
vocab.note: Mostly written, of times and events rather than people: {冬天|dōng tiān}{的|de}{到来|dào lái}, {新年|xīn nián}{就|jiù}{要|yào}{到来|dào lái}{了|le}.
vocab.example: {随着|suí zhe}{冬天|dōng tiān}{的|de}{到来|dào lái}，{天黑|tiān hēi}{得|de}{越|yuè}{来|lái}{越|yuè}{早|zǎo}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: With the coming of winter, it's getting dark earlier and earlier.

vocab.note: A {低于|dī yú} B = A {比|bǐ} B {低|dī}, in reports and notices. {不|bù}{低于|dī yú}: no lower than, at least.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{夜里|yè lǐ}{的|de}{最|zuì}{低|dī}{气温|qì wēn}{将|jiāng}{低于|dī yú}{零|líng}{度|dù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Tonight's lowest temperature will be below zero.

vocab.example: {今年|jīn nián}{的|de}{气温|qì wēn}{高于|gāo yú}{往年|wǎng nián}。
vocab.exampleEn: This year's temperatures are higher than in other years.

vocab.note: The opposite of {高|gāo}: {气温|qì wēn}{很|hěn}{低|dī}, {价格|jià gé}{很|hěn}{低|dī}. {低头|dī tóu}: to lower your head.
vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{气温|qì wēn}{很|hěn}{低|dī}，{出门|chū mén}{要|yào}{多|duō}{穿|chuān}{衣服|yī fu}。
vocab.exampleEn: The temperature is very low today; wear plenty when you go out.

vocab.note: The opposite of {薄|báo} (thin, HSK 5). {厚|hòu}{衣服|yī fu}: warm, thick clothes; {厚厚|hòu hòu}{的|de}{雪|xuě}: deep snow. A thick rope or tree is {粗|cū} (lesson 27).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{很|hěn}{厚|hòu}，{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{月|yuè}。
vocab.exampleEn: This book is very thick; it took me a month to read.

vocab.note: A written word for a hard cold: {寒冷|hán lěng}{的|de}{冬天|dōng tiān}. In speech, {冷|lěng} or {很|hěn}{冷|lěng}.
vocab.example: {东北|dōng běi}{的|de}{冬天|dōng tiān}{十分|shí fēn}{寒冷|hán lěng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Winters in the northeast are bitterly cold.

vocab.note: First tone, gān; HSK 3's {干|gàn} is "to do". Traditional writes them apart: {={乾|gān}=} (dry), {={幹|gàn}=} (to do). Also in {干净|gān jìng} and {饼干|bǐng gān}.
vocab.example: {衣服|yī fu}{已经|yǐ jīng}{干|gān}{了|le}，{可以|kě yǐ}{收|shōu}{起来|qǐ lái}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The clothes are dry now; you can bring them in.

vocab.note: The {火|huǒ} of {火车|huǒ chē} (train) and {着火|zháo huǒ} (to catch fire, lesson 10).
vocab.example: {天|tiān}{冷|lěng}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{大家|dà jiā}{坐|zuò}{在|zài}{火|huǒ}{旁边|páng biān}{聊天|liáo tiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: When it's cold, everyone sits by the fire and chats.

meanings: to fall, come down (temperature, prices; written)
vocab.note: Mostly written: {气温|qì wēn}{降|jiàng}{到|dào}{零|líng}{度|dù}. In speech, {下降|xià jiàng} or {降低|jiàng dī} (lesson 15). Also in {降价|jiàng jià} and {降落|jiàng luò}.
vocab.example: {晚上|wǎn shang}{气温|qì wēn}{降|jiàng}{到|dào}{了|le}{零下|líng xià}{五|wǔ}{度|dù}。
vocab.exampleEn: In the evening the temperature fell to minus five.

vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{要|yào}{降温|jiàng wēn}{了|le}，{别|bié}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{带|dài}{外套|wài tào}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's going to turn colder tomorrow; don't forget your coat.

vocab.note: Of water and tears: {河|hé}{水|shuǐ}{向|xiàng}{东|dōng}{流|liú}, {流|liú}{眼泪|yǎn lèi} (to shed tears). Also in {流利|liú lì} and {流行|liú xíng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{河|hé}{从|cóng}{山|shān}{上|shàng}{流|liú}{下来|xià lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: This river flows down from the mountains.

meanings: to fall (leaves, rain); to set (the sun)
vocab.note: Written and in set phrases: {叶子|yè zi}{落|luò}{了|le} (the leaves have fallen), {太阳|tài yang}{落|luò}{山|shān}{了|le} (the sun has set). The everyday verb for things falling is {掉|diào} (lesson 20).
vocab.example: {太阳|tài yang}{已经|yǐ jīng}{落|luò}{山|shān}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: The sun has already set; let's go home.

vocab.note: A supposition that changes nothing; the second clause takes {也|yě}: {即使|jí shǐ}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{我们|wǒ men}{也|yě}{去|qù}。 For a fact, use {虽然|suī rán}…{但是|dàn shì}. Spoken: {就是|jiù shì}…{也|yě}.
vocab.example: {即使|jí shǐ}{很|hěn}{忙|máng}，{他|tā}{也|yě}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{给|gěi}{妈妈|mā ma}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: Even when he's busy, he phones his mum every day.

vocab.note: Spoken "even if", with {也|yě}: {就是|jiù shì}{再|zài}{忙|máng}，{你|nǐ}{也|yě}{得|děi}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}。 Before a noun, "is exactly" ({这|zhè}{就是|jiù shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{家|jiā}); after a good point, "it's just that…" ({很|hěn}{好看|hǎo kàn}，{就是|jiù shì}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{贵|guì}).
vocab.example: {就是|jiù shì}{明天|míng tiān}{下|xià}{大|dà}{雨|yǔ}，{我|wǒ}{也|yě}{要|yào}{去|qù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Even if it pours tomorrow, I'm going.

vocab.note: Before the number: {零下|líng xià}{十|shí}{度|dù} (−10°).
vocab.example: {北京|Běi jīng}{一|yī}{月|yuè}{的|de}{晚上|wǎn shang}{常常|cháng cháng}{是|shì}{零下|líng xià}{十|shí}{度|dù}{左右|zuǒ yòu}。
vocab.exampleEn: Evenings in Beijing in January are often around minus ten.

vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{国家|guó jiā}{的|de}{南部|nán bù}{一|yì}{年|nián}{四季|sì jì}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{暖和|nuǎn huo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The south of this country is warm all year round.

vocab.note: The farming countryside, the opposite of {城市|chéng shì}: {在|zài}{农村|nóng cūn}{长大|zhǎng dà} (to grow up in the country).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{奶奶|nǎi nai}{在|zài}{农村|nóng cūn}{长大|zhǎng dà}，{现在|xiàn zài}{还|hái}{常常|cháng cháng}{回|huí}{村|cūn}{里|lǐ}{看看|kàn kan}。
vocab.exampleEn: My grandma grew up in the countryside and still often goes back to her village.

vocab.note: The weather a place has year after year. One day's weather is {天气|tiān qì}.
vocab.example: {这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{气候|qì hòu}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{冬天|dōng tiān}{不|bù}{冷|lěng}，{夏天|xià tiān}{也|yě}{不|bú}{热|rè}。
vocab.exampleEn: The climate here is lovely: winters aren't cold, and summers aren't hot either.

vocab.note: The temperature outside, in forecasts: {最|zuì}{高|gāo}{气温|qì wēn}, {最|zuì}{低|dī}{气温|qì wēn}. {温度|wēn dù} is any temperature; {体温|tǐ wēn} the body's.
vocab.example: {明天|míng tiān}{最|zuì}{高|gāo}{气温|qì wēn}{二十|èr shí}{度|dù}，{很|hěn}{适合|shì hé}{出去|chū qù}{玩|wán}{儿|ér}。
vocab.exampleEn: Tomorrow's high is twenty degrees: just right for going out.

vocab.note: Pleasantly warm (weather, a room, clothes), the opposite of {凉快|liáng kuai}. Neutral second syllable: nuǎn huo.
vocab.example: {外面|wài miàn}{很|hěn}{冷|lěng}，{屋|wū}{里|lǐ}{很|hěn}{暖和|nuǎn huo}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's cold outside, but nice and warm indoors.

vocab.note: Deep ({水|shuǐ}{很|hěn}{深|shēn}), dark for colours ({深|shēn}{蓝色|lán sè}), late at night ({夜|yè}{深|shēn}{了|le}). The opposite is {浅|qiǎn} (shallow, HSK 5).
vocab.example: {这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{水|shuǐ}{很|hěn}{深|shēn}，{孩子|hái zi}{不|bù}{能|néng}{下去|xià qù}{游泳|yóu yǒng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The water's deep here; children mustn't go in to swim.

vocab.note: The written one-syllable form of {稍微|shāo wēi}: {请|qǐng}{稍|shāo}{等|děng} (one moment, please), {气温|qì wēn}{稍|shāo}{低|dī}.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{稍|shāo}{等|děng}，{经理|jīng lǐ}{马上|mǎ shàng}{就|jiù}{来|lái}。
vocab.exampleEn: One moment, please; the manager will be right with you.

vocab.note: Usually with a small amount after the adjective or verb: {稍微|shāo wēi}{暖和|nuǎn huo}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}, {稍微|shāo wēi}{等|děng}{一下|yí xià}, {稍微|shāo wēi}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{大|dà}.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{能|néng}{说|shuō}{得|de}{稍微|shāo wēi}{慢|màn}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Could you speak a little more slowly?

vocab.note: Written ℃ after a number (25℃); in speech, often just {度|dù}: {二十五|èr shí wǔ}{度|dù}.
vocab.example: {水|shuǐ}{到|dào}{一百|yì bǎi}{摄氏度|shè shì dù}{就|jiù}{会|huì}{开|kāi}。
vocab.exampleEn: Water boils at a hundred degrees Celsius.

vocab.note: Any temperature: a room, water, food. Outdoor air is {气温|qì wēn}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{房间|fáng jiān}{的|de}{温度|wēn dù}{太|tài}{高|gāo}{了|le}，{开|kāi}{一下|yí xià}{窗户|chuāng hu}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's too warm in this room; let's open a window.

vocab.example: {中国|Zhōng guó}{西部|xī bù}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{高|gāo}{山|shān}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are many high mountains in western China.

vocab.note: The stars in the night sky; neutral second syllable. A film star is {明星|míng xīng} (HSK 5).
vocab.example: {农村|nóng cūn}{的|de}{晚上|wǎn shang}{能|néng}{看见|kàn jiàn}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{星星|xīng xing}。
vocab.exampleEn: At night in the countryside you can see lots of stars.

vocab.example: {今天|jīn tiān}{阳光|yáng guāng}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{我们|wǒ men}{出去|chū qù}{走走|zǒu zou}{吧|ba}。
vocab.exampleEn: It's lovely and sunny today; let's go out for a walk.

vocab.note: Measure word {片|piàn} (lesson 27) or {朵|duǒ}: {一|yí}{片|piàn}{云|yún}. {多|duō}{云|yún}: cloudy, in forecasts.
vocab.example: {天|tiān}{上|shàng}{一|yí}{片|piàn}{云|yún}{也|yě}{没有|méi yǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: There isn't a cloud in the sky.

vocab.note: Neutral second syllable. {大部分|dà bù fen} (most), {一部分|yí bù fen} (a part, some), {部分|bù fen}{学生|xué sheng} (some students).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{的|de}{第|dì}{一部分|yí bù fen}{比较|bǐ jiào}{难|nán}。
vocab.exampleEn: The first part of this book is rather hard.

meanings: to give rise to (interest, an effect)
vocab.note: For something that comes into being: {产生|chǎn shēng}{兴趣|xìng qù}, {产生|chǎn shēng}{影响|yǐng xiǎng}, {产生|chǎn shēng}{问题|wèn tí}. A reaction set off in someone is {引起|yǐn qǐ}.
vocab.example: {看|kàn}{了|le}{那个|nà ge}{电影|diàn yǐng}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{我|wǒ}{对|duì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{历史|lì shǐ}{产生|chǎn shēng}{了|le}{兴趣|xìng qù}。
vocab.exampleEn: After seeing that film, I became interested in Chinese history.

vocab.note: Before a verb of change: {不断|bú duàn}{提高|tí gāo}, {不断|bú duàn}{增加|zēng jiā}, {不断|bú duàn}{学习|xué xí}.
vocab.example: {科技|kē jì}{在|zài}{不断|bú duàn}{地|de}{发展|fā zhǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Science and technology keep developing.

vocab.note: {在|zài}…{的|de}{过程|guò chéng}{中|zhōng}: in the course of, while.
vocab.example: {在|zài}{学习|xué xí}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{的|de}{过程|guò chéng}{中|zhōng}，{我|wǒ}{认识|rèn shi}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{中国|Zhōng guó}{朋友|péng you}。
vocab.exampleEn: In the course of learning Chinese, I've made lots of Chinese friends.

vocab.note: {为|wéi} is wéi here. In speech, {分成|fēn chéng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{次|cì}{考试|kǎo shì}{分为|fēn wéi}{听力|tīng lì}、{阅读|yuè dú}{和|hé}{写作|xiě zuò}{三|sān}{部分|bù fen}。
vocab.exampleEn: This exam is divided into three parts, listening, reading and writing.

meanings: thick (a trunk, a rope, a line)
vocab.note: For long round things; the opposite is {细|xì}. A thick book or coat is {厚|hòu}. {粗心|cū xīn} (careless, lesson 22) uses the "rough" sense.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{棵|kē}{树|shù}{很|hěn}{粗|cū}，{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{人|rén}{才|cái}{能|néng}{抱|bào}{住|zhù}。
vocab.exampleEn: This tree is so thick that it takes two people to get their arms round it.

vocab.note: Mostly before a noun ({大量|dà liàng}{的|de}{水|shuǐ}, {大量|dà liàng}{研究|yán jiū}) or a verb ({大量|dà liàng}{砍树|kǎn shù}).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{植物|zhí wù}{要|yào}{大量|dà liàng}{的|de}{阳光|yáng guāng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This plant needs a great deal of sunshine.

vocab.note: Set phrase: {多种多样|duō zhǒng duō yàng} (of every kind).
vocab.example: {这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{植物|zhí wù}{非常|fēi cháng}{多样|duō yàng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The plants here are extremely varied.

vocab.note: Before a verb or a verb of change: {大大|dà dà}{提高|tí gāo}, {大大|dà dà}{改变|gǎi biàn}.
vocab.example: {手机|shǒu jī}{大大|dà dà}{改变|gǎi biàn}{了|le}{我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{生活|shēng huó}。
vocab.exampleEn: Mobile phones have greatly changed our lives.

vocab.note: {一|yì}{幅|fú}{画|huà}, {一|yì}{幅|fú}{地图|dì tú}. In speech {一|yì}{张|zhāng}{画|huà} is also heard; {幅|fú} is the standard word for a painting.
vocab.example: {客厅|kè tīng}{里|lǐ}{挂|guà}{着|zhe}{一|yì}{幅|fú}{很|hěn}{大|dà}{的|de}{画|huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: A very large painting hangs in the living room.

vocab.note: Both the technology of a field and a person's skill: {他|tā}{开车|kāi chē}{的|de}{技术|jì shù}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{家|jiā}{公司|gōng sī}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{技术|jì shù}。
vocab.exampleEn: This company has very good technology.

vocab.note: Science and technology together, the word of the news: {科技|kē jì}{发展|fā zhǎn}, {高科技|gāo kē jì} (high tech).
vocab.example: {现在|xiàn zài}{的|de}{科技|kē jì}{发展|fā zhǎn}{得|de}{真|zhēn}{快|kuài}。
vocab.exampleEn: Science and technology are developing really fast these days.

vocab.note: {科学家|kē xué jiā}: scientist. Also an adjective: {这个|zhè ge}{办法|bàn fǎ}{很|hěn}{科学|kē xué} (this is a very scientific method).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{从小|cóng xiǎo}{就|jiù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{科学|kē xué}。
vocab.exampleEn: I've loved science since I was little.

vocab.note: {老|lǎo} here isn't "old": it's part of the animal's name, as in {老鼠|lǎo shǔ} (mouse, HSK 6).
vocab.example: {动物园|dòng wù yuán}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{只|zhī}{老虎|lǎo hǔ}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are two tigers at the zoo.

vocab.note: {活|huó}{着|zhe} (alive); {活|huó}{了|le}{三百|sān bǎi}{年|nián} (lived three hundred years); {活|huó}{的|de}{鱼|yú} (a live fish). The {活|huó} of {生活|shēng huó} and {活动|huó dòng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{只|zhī}{猫|māo}{活|huó}{了|le}{二十|èr shí}{年|nián}。
vocab.exampleEn: This cat lived to be twenty.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{门口|mén kǒu}{有|yǒu}{一|yì}{棵|kē}{苹果|píng guǒ}{树|shù}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's an apple tree outside our door.

vocab.note: Thin flat pieces ({一|yí}{片|piàn}{叶子|yè zi}, {一|yí}{片|piàn}{面包|miàn bāo}) and wide stretches ({一|yí}{片|piàn}{草地|cǎo dì}, {一|yí}{片|piàn}{蓝天|lán tiān}). Also in {照片|zhào piàn} and {图片|tú piàn}.
vocab.example: {早上|zǎo shang}{我|wǒ}{吃|chī}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{片|piàn}{面包|miàn bāo}。
vocab.exampleEn: I had two slices of bread this morning.

vocab.note: Written and in the news: {全球|quán qiú}{气候|qì hòu}, {全球|quán qiú}{有|yǒu}…
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{问题|wèn tí}{全球|quán qiú}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{关心|guān xīn}。
vocab.exampleEn: The whole world cares about this problem.

vocab.note: Life as what living things have. Daily life, the way you live, is {生活|shēng huó}.
vocab.example: {每|měi}{个|gè}{生命|shēng mìng}{都|dōu}{很|hěn}{重要|zhòng yào}。
vocab.exampleEn: Every life matters.

vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{鸟|niǎo}{在|zài}{城市|chéng shì}{里|lǐ}{很|hěn}{少见|shǎo jiàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This kind of bird is rarely seen in the city.

vocab.note: Not to be confused with {士|shì} ({护士|hù shi}, {博士|bó shì}), whose long horizontal is on top.
vocab.example: {这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{土|tǔ}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{种|zhòng}{什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{长|zhǎng}{得|de}{好|hǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: The soil here is good: whatever you plant grows well.

vocab.note: The {熊|xióng} of {熊|xióng}{猫|māo} (panda).
vocab.example: {冬天|dōng tiān}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{有的|yǒu de}{熊|xióng}{会|huì}{睡|shuì}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}{时间|shí jiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: In winter, some bears sleep for a very long time.

vocab.note: After an adjective it's a degree complement, "to death": {累|lèi}{死|sǐ}{了|le}, {疼|téng}{死|sǐ}{了|le} (lesson 06).
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{浇水|jiāo shuǐ}，{花|huā}{都|dōu}{死|sǐ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: I forgot to water them, and the flowers have all died.

vocab.note: A verb and a noun: {研究|yán jiū}{老虎|lǎo hǔ}, {他|tā}{的|de}{研究|yán jiū}. {研究生|yán jiū shēng} (lesson 05) is a research student.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{在|zài}{大学|dà xué}{里|lǐ}{研究|yán jiū}{植物|zhí wù}。
vocab.exampleEn: She researches plants at the university.

vocab.note: The opposite of {粗|cū}. Also "careful, detailed": {仔细|zǐ xì} (lesson 02), {细心|xì xīn} (lesson 22).
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{根|gēn}{线|xiàn}{太|tài}{细|xì}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{不|bu}{清楚|qīng chu}。
vocab.exampleEn: This thread is too fine; I can't see it clearly.

vocab.note: {树叶|shù yè}: the leaves of a tree. Measure word {片|piàn}.
vocab.example: {秋天|qiū tiān}，{树|shù}{上|shàng}{的|de}{叶子|yè zi}{变|biàn}{黄|huáng}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: In autumn the leaves on the trees turn yellow.

vocab.note: Plants as living things ({动物|dòng wù} and {植物|zhí wù}). A plant you grow at home is often {花|huā}.
vocab.example: {植物|zhí wù}{要|yào}{有|yǒu}{阳光|yáng guāng}{和|hé}{水|shuǐ}{才|cái}{能|néng}{活|huó}。
vocab.exampleEn: Plants need sunshine and water to live.

vocab.note: As an adjective, "natural, unforced": {你|nǐ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{自然|zì rán}。 The natural world as a place to be is {大自然|dà zì rán} (lesson 26).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{自然|zì rán}。
vocab.exampleEn: Her Chinese sounds very natural.

vocab.note: {起|qǐ}{作用|zuò yòng} / {有|yǒu}{作用|zuò yòng} (to have an effect); {对|duì}…{有|yǒu}{作用|zuò yòng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{药|yào}{对|duì}{感冒|gǎn mào}{很|hěn}{有|yǒu}{作用|zuò yòng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This medicine works well for colds.

meanings: to cause, set off (a reaction, a problem)
vocab.note: {引起|yǐn qǐ}{注意|zhù yì} (attract attention), {引起|yǐn qǐ}{问题|wèn tí} (cause problems). Compare {产生|chǎn shēng} (interest, an effect, something new).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{的|de}{话|huà}{引起|yǐn qǐ}{了|le}{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{注意|zhù yì}。
vocab.exampleEn: What he said caught everyone's attention.

vocab.note: {是|shì}{用来|yòng lái}…{的|de}: what something is for: {这|zhè}{把|bǎ}{刀|dāo}{是|shì}{用来|yòng lái}{切|qiē}{菜|cài}{的|de}。 {用|yòng} X {来|lái} + verb: use X to….
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{房间|fáng jiān}{是|shì}{用来|yòng lái}{开会|kāi huì}{的|de}。
vocab.exampleEn: This room is for meetings.

vocab.note: Written, before a noun or verb phrase: {用于|yòng yú}{研究|yán jiū}, {用于|yòng yú}{保护|bǎo hù}{动物|dòng wù}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{技术|jì shù}{已经|yǐ jīng}{用于|yòng yú}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{方面|fāng miàn}。
vocab.exampleEn: This technology is already used in many areas.

meanings: to have (written; a quality, a history)
vocab.note: Written, before an abstract object: {有着|yǒu zhe}{很|hěn}{长|cháng}{的|de}{历史|lì shǐ}. No {了|le} or {过|guo}, no negative (say {没有|méi yǒu}), not for ordinary things you own.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{座|zuò}{城市|chéng shì}{有着|yǒu zhe}{两千|liǎng qiān}{多|duō}{年|nián}{的|de}{历史|lì shǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: This city has a history of over two thousand years.

vocab.note: Fourth tone, zhòng: {种|zhòng}{树|shù}, {种|zhòng}{菜|cài}. HSK 3's {种|zhǒng} zhǒng is "kind, sort" ({这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{树|shù}): same character.
vocab.example: {爷爷|yé ye}{在|zài}{院子|yuàn zi}{里|lǐ}{种|zhòng}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{菜|cài}。
vocab.exampleEn: Grandpa has planted lots of vegetables in the yard.

vocab.example: {我们|wǒ men}{应该|yīng gāi}{保护|bǎo hù}{动物|dòng wù}{和|hé}{它们|tā men}{生活|shēng huó}{的|de}{环境|huán jìng}。
vocab.exampleEn: We should protect animals and the places they live.

vocab.note: {塑料袋|sù liào dài} (a plastic bag), {环保袋|huán bǎo dài} (a reusable bag). Measure word {个|gè} or {只|zhī}.
vocab.example: {买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}，{我|wǒ}{总是|zǒng shì}{自己|zì jǐ}{带|dài}{袋子|dài zi}。
vocab.exampleEn: I always bring my own bag when I go shopping.

vocab.note: {饭盒|fàn hé} (a lunch box); a large box for moving or posting is often {箱子|xiāng zi} (HSK 3).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{盒子|hé zi}{里|lǐ}{是|shì}{什么|shén me}？
vocab.exampleEn: What's in this box?

vocab.note: Short for {环境保护|huán jìng bǎo hù}. Also an adjective: {这|zhè}{种|zhǒng}{方法|fāng fǎ}{很|hěn}{环保|huán bǎo} (this is a green way of doing it).
vocab.example: {骑|qí}{自行车|zì xíng chē}{上班|shàng bān}{又|yòu}{健康|jiàn kāng}{又|yòu}{环保|huán bǎo}。
vocab.exampleEn: Cycling to work is both healthy and green.

vocab.note: The air you breathe: {空气|kōng qì}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}, {空气|kōng qì}{污染|wū rǎn} (air pollution).
vocab.example: {下|xià}{过|guo}{雨|yǔ}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{空气|kōng qì}{特别|tè bié}{新鲜|xīn xiān}。
vocab.exampleEn: After the rain, the air is especially fresh.

vocab.note: {扔|rēng}{垃圾|lā jī} (to throw rubbish away), {垃圾桶|lā jī tǒng} (a bin), {垃圾|lā jī}{分类|fēn lèi} (sorting rubbish). In Taiwan it's read lè sè.
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{把|bǎ}{垃圾|lā jī}{扔|rēng}{进|jìn}{垃圾桶|lā jī tǒng}{里|lǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please put your rubbish in the bin.

vocab.note: Both "to reduce something" ({减少|jiǎn shǎo}{垃圾|lā jī}) and "to decrease" ({人数|rén shù}{减少|jiǎn shǎo}{了|le}). The opposite is {增加|zēng jiā}.
vocab.example: {为了|wèi le}{减少|jiǎn shǎo}{垃圾|lā jī}，{我们|wǒ men}{少|shǎo}{用|yòng}{塑料袋|sù liào dài}。
vocab.exampleEn: To cut down on rubbish, we use fewer plastic bags.

meanings: to save, use sparingly (water, time, money)
vocab.note: {节约|jié yuē}{用|yòng}{水|shuǐ} (save water), {节约|jié yuē}{时间|shí jiān}. The opposite is {浪费|làng fèi}.
vocab.example: {为了|wèi le}{节约|jié yuē}{用电|yòng diàn}，{离开|lí kāi}{房间|fáng jiān}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{请|qǐng}{关灯|guān dēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: To save electricity, please turn off the light when you leave the room.

vocab.note: The word of signs and rules: {禁止|jìn zhǐ}{吸烟|xī yān} (No smoking), {禁止|jìn zhǐ}{停车|tíng chē} (No parking).
vocab.example: {这儿|zhèr}{禁止|jìn zhǐ}{停车|tíng chē}。
vocab.exampleEn: Parking is prohibited here.

vocab.note: The object follows directly: {浪费|làng fèi}{时间|shí jiān}, {浪费|làng fèi}{钱|qián}, {浪费|làng fèi}{水|shuǐ}. Also an adjective: {太|tài}{浪费|làng fèi}{了|le}！
vocab.example: {菜|cài}{点|diǎn}{得|de}{太|tài}{多|duō}{了|le}，{吃|chī}{不|bu}{完|wán}{就|jiù}{浪费|làng fèi}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: We've ordered too much; if we can't finish it, it'll go to waste.

vocab.note: A large forest; a smaller wood near people is {树林|shù lín}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{片|piàn}{森林|sēn lín}{里|lǐ}{生活|shēng huó}{着|zhe}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{动物|dòng wù}。
vocab.exampleEn: Many animals live in this forest.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{后面|hòu miàn}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{片|piàn}{小|xiǎo}{树林|shù lín}。
vocab.exampleEn: There's a little wood behind our house.

vocab.note: {起到|qǐ dào}…{作用|zuò yòng}: to play a… role, have a… effect: {起到|qǐ dào}{很|hěn}{大|dà}{的|de}{作用|zuò yòng}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{办法|bàn fǎ}{起到|qǐ dào}{了|le}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}{的|de}{作用|zuò yòng}。
vocab.exampleEn: This method has worked very well.

vocab.note: {扔|rēng}{垃圾|lā jī} (to throw rubbish away), {别|bié}{乱扔|luàn rēng} (don't litter). First tone; {仍|réng} réng (still, lesson 20) is second.
vocab.example: {这些|zhè xiē}{旧|jiù}{报纸|bào zhǐ}{可以|kě yǐ}{扔|rēng}{了|le}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Can these old newspapers be thrown away?

vocab.note: {塑料袋|sù liào dài} (a plastic bag), {塑料瓶|sù liào píng} (a plastic bottle).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{杯子|bēi zi}{是|shì}{塑料|sù liào}{的|de}，{不|bú}{怕|pà}{掉|diào}{在|zài}{地上|dì shang}。
vocab.exampleEn: This cup is plastic, so it doesn't matter if it falls on the floor.

vocab.note: {垃圾桶|lā jī tǒng} (a rubbish bin), {水桶|shuǐ tǒng} (a bucket). Also a measure word: {一|yì}{桶|tǒng}{水|shuǐ} (a bucket of water).
vocab.example: {门口|mén kǒu}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{垃圾桶|lā jī tǒng}。
vocab.exampleEn: There are two bins at the door.

vocab.note: Smoke ({厨房|chú fáng}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{烟|yān}) and a cigarette: {吸烟|xī yān} (written) / {抽烟|chōu yān} (spoken), to smoke.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{爸爸|bà ba}{以前|yǐ qián}{抽烟|chōu yān}，{现在|xiàn zài}{不|bù}{抽|chōu}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: My dad used to smoke, but he's stopped now.

vocab.note: Written and formal: {停止|tíng zhǐ}{使用|shǐ yòng}, {雨|yǔ}{停止|tíng zhǐ}{了|le}. In speech, {停|tíng} (lesson 16).
vocab.example: {因为|yīn wèi}{下|xià}{大|dà}{雨|yǔ}，{比赛|bǐ sài}{停止|tíng zhǐ}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: The match was stopped because of heavy rain.

vocab.note: A noun ({空气|kōng qì}{污染|wū rǎn}, air pollution) and a verb ({污染|wū rǎn}{环境|huán jìng}; {水|shuǐ}{被|bèi}{污染|wū rǎn}{了|le}). Traditional {污染|wū rǎn} (Taiwan also writes {={汙染|wū rǎn}=}).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{空气|kōng qì}{污染|wū rǎn}{比|bǐ}{以前|yǐ qián}{少|shǎo}{多|duō}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: Air pollution in this city is much lower than it used to be.

vocab.note: {吸|xī}{一|yì}{口|kǒu}{气|qì} (take a breath), {吸烟|xī yān} (to smoke). The {吸|xī} of {吸引|xī yǐn} (lesson 18).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{吸|xī}{了|le}{一|yì}{口|kǒu}{气|qì}，{开始|kāi shǐ}{说话|shuō huà}。
vocab.exampleEn: He took a breath and began to speak.

vocab.note: An adjective ({这儿|zhèr}{很|hěn}{危险|wēi xiǎn}) and a noun ({有|yǒu}{危险|wēi xiǎn}, {远离|yuǎn lí}{危险|wēi xiǎn}).
vocab.example: {下雪|xià xuě}{以后|yǐ hòu}{开车|kāi chē}{很|hěn}{危险|wēi xiǎn}。
vocab.exampleEn: Driving after it has snowed is dangerous.

vocab.note: On signs and in advice: {远离|yuǎn lí}{火|huǒ} (keep away from fire), {远离|yuǎn lí}{危险|wēi xiǎn}.
vocab.example: {小孩儿|xiǎo háir}{要|yào}{远离|yuǎn lí}{火|huǒ}{和|hé}{热|rè}{水|shuǐ}。
vocab.exampleEn: Small children should keep away from fire and hot water.

vocab.note: {增加|zēng jiā}{人数|rén shù}, {增加|zēng jiā}{收入|shōu rù}; {增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{一|yí}{倍|bèi} (doubled). The opposite is {减少|jiǎn shǎo}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{几|jǐ}{年|nián}{来|lái}{中国|Zhōng guó}{留学|liú xué}{的|de}{人|rén}{增加|zēng jiā}{了|le}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。
vocab.exampleEn: The number of people coming to China to study has grown a lot in recent years.

meanings: to grow (a total, over time; written)
vocab.note: {长|zhǎng} is zhǎng here. For totals that grow over time: {经济|jīng jì}{增长|zēng zhǎng}, {人口|rén kǒu}{增长|zēng zhǎng} (population growth).
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{城市|chéng shì}{的|de}{人口|rén kǒu}{每|měi}{年|nián}{都|dōu}{在|zài}{增长|zēng zhǎng}。
vocab.exampleEn: The city's population grows every year.

vocab.note: What happened next, because of the first event: {下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}，{于是|yú shì}{我们|wǒ men}{回|huí}{家|jiā}{了|le}。 Not for advice or plans (use {所以|suǒ yǐ}).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{觉得|jué de}{这个|zhè ge}{工作|gōng zuò}{没意思|méi yì si}，{于是|yú shì}{换|huàn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}。
vocab.exampleEn: He found the job dull, so he changed it.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{门|mén}{外|wài}{就|jiù}{听|tīng}{到|dào}{了|le}{她|tā}{的|de}{歌声|gē shēng}。
vocab.exampleEn: I could hear her singing from outside the door.

vocab.note: Someone who sings as a profession or on stage; {手|shǒu} is "a person skilled at", as in {选手|xuǎn shǒu} (a contestant, HSK 5).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{是|shì}{一|yí}{个|gè}{很|hěn}{有名|yǒu míng}{的|de}{歌手|gē shǒu}。
vocab.exampleEn: She's a very famous singer.

vocab.note: People who watch a show, a match or TV. Listeners are {听众|tīng zhòng} (lesson 24).
vocab.example: {演出|yǎn chū}{结束|jié shù}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{观众|guān zhòng}{都|dōu}{站|zhàn}{起来|qǐ lái}{了|le}。
vocab.exampleEn: When the show ended, the whole audience stood up.

vocab.note: Played with {弹|tán}: {弹|tán}{钢琴|gāng qín}. {钢琴家|gāng qín jiā}: a pianist.
vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{妹妹|mèi mei}{从|cóng}{五|wǔ}{岁|suì}{开始|kāi shǐ}{学|xué}{钢琴|gāng qín}。
vocab.exampleEn: My younger sister started learning the piano at five.

vocab.note: A play with spoken dialogue, as against opera: {演|yǎn}{话剧|huà jù}, {看|kàn}{话剧|huà jù}.
vocab.example: {这个|zhè ge}{话剧|huà jù}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{演|yǎn}{了|le}{三|sān}{个|gè}{月|yuè}。
vocab.exampleEn: This play ran for three months in Beijing.

vocab.example: {我|wǒ}{爷爷|yé ye}{特别|tè bié}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{听|tīng}{京剧|jīng jù}。
vocab.exampleEn: My grandpa loves listening to Peking opera.

vocab.example: {剧院|jù yuàn}{离|lí}{这儿|zhèr}{不|bù}{远|yuǎn}，{走路|zǒu lù}{十|shí}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{就|jiù}{到|dào}。
vocab.exampleEn: The theatre isn't far from here: it's a ten-minute walk.

vocab.note: Of shows, matches, talks and books, not of people or food: {演出|yǎn chū}{很|hěn}{精彩|jīng cǎi}, {精彩|jīng cǎi}{的|de}{比赛|bǐ sài}.
vocab.example: {昨天|zuó tiān}{的|de}{比赛|bǐ sài}{太|tài}{精彩|jīng cǎi}{了|le}！
vocab.exampleEn: Yesterday's match was fantastic!

vocab.note: The general word for many stringed and keyboard instruments: {弹|tán}{琴|qín} (to play the piano, to play a stringed instrument), {钢琴|gāng qín}, {小提琴|xiǎo tí qín} (violin).
vocab.example: {她|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{都|dōu}{弹|tán}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{琴|qín}。
vocab.exampleEn: She plays for an hour every evening.

vocab.note: Opens a list of points ({首先|shǒu xiān}…{其次|qí cì}…{最后|zuì hòu}) or steps ({首先|shǒu xiān}…{然后|rán hòu}…).
vocab.example: {首先|shǒu xiān}，{我|wǒ}{要|yào}{感谢|gǎn xiè}{大家|dà jiā}{的|de}{支持|zhī chí}。
vocab.exampleEn: First of all, I'd like to thank you all for your support.

vocab.note: The second point after {首先|shǒu xiān}, often a less important one. For steps in time, use {然后|rán hòu}.
vocab.example: {租|zū}{房子|fáng zi}，{首先|shǒu xiān}{要|yào}{看|kàn}{离|lí}{地铁站|dì tiě zhàn}{远|yuǎn}{不|bu}{远|yuǎn}，{其次|qí cì}{要|yào}{看|kàn}{价格|jià gé}。
vocab.exampleEn: When you rent a flat, the first thing to look at is how far it is from the metro, and the second is the price.

meanings: to play (piano, guitar: with the fingers)
vocab.note: For instruments played with the fingers: {弹|tán}{钢琴|gāng qín}, {弹|tán}{琴|qín}, {弹|tán}{吉他|jí tā} (guitar). Bowed ones take {拉|lā}, wind ones {吹|chuī}, drums {打|dǎ}. In {子弹|zǐ dàn} (bullet) it's dàn.
vocab.example: {你|nǐ}{会|huì}{弹|tán}{钢琴|gāng qín}{吗|ma}？
vocab.exampleEn: Can you play the piano?

meanings: to act, play (a part); to put on (a play)
vocab.note: {演|yǎn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{医生|yī shēng} (to play a doctor); {这个|zhè ge}{电影|diàn yǐng}{演|yǎn}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{月|yuè} (the film ran for two months).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{在|zài}{这个|zhè ge}{话剧|huà jù}{里|lǐ}{演|yǎn}{一|yí}{个|gè}{老师|lǎo shī}。
vocab.exampleEn: He plays a teacher in this play.

vocab.note: Singing on stage: {演唱会|yǎn chàng huì} (a concert by a singer or band).
vocab.example: {下面|xià miàn}{请|qǐng}{她|tā}{为|wèi}{大家|dà jiā}{演唱|yǎn chàng}{一|yì}{首|shǒu}{歌|gē}。
vocab.exampleEn: Next, she'll sing a song for you all.

vocab.note: Any performer on stage or screen: {电影|diàn yǐng}{演员|yǎn yuán}, {京剧|jīng jù}{演员|yǎn yuán}.
vocab.example: {她|tā}{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{的|de}{理想|lǐ xiǎng}{是|shì}{当|dāng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{演员|yǎn yuán}。
vocab.exampleEn: When she was little, her dream was to be an actor.

vocab.note: {艺术家|yì shù jiā}: an artist. Art history is {美术史|měi shù shǐ} ({美术|měi shù}: the fine arts, HSK 5).
vocab.example: {他|tā}{对|duì}{中国|Zhōng guó}{艺术|yì shù}{很|hěn}{感兴趣|gǎn xìng qù}。
vocab.exampleEn: He's very interested in Chinese art.

vocab.note: The general word for a show, and "to perform": {今晚|jīn wǎn}{有|yǒu}{演出|yǎn chū}; {他们|tā men}{在|zài}{剧院|jù yuàn}{演出|yǎn chū}. Measure word {场|chǎng}.
vocab.example: {这|zhè}{场|chǎng}{演出|yǎn chū}{一共|yí gòng}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
vocab.exampleEn: The show lasts two hours in all.

vocab.note: A verb ({总结|zǒng jié}{一下|yí xià}) and a noun ({写|xiě}{一|yí}{个|gè}{总结|zǒng jié}). To begin a conclusion, say {总之|zǒng zhī} (in short).
vocab.example: {请|qǐng}{你|nǐ}{总结|zǒng jié}{一下|yí xià}{今天|jīn tiān}{学|xué}{的|de}{内容|nèi róng}。
vocab.exampleEn: Please sum up what we learned today.

vocab.note: A school composition, and the exam's writing task: {写|xiě}{作文|zuò wén}, {一|yì}{篇|piān}{作文|zuò wén}. (Also a verb in some dictionaries: to write a composition.)
vocab.example: {老师|lǎo shī}{让|ràng}{我们|wǒ men}{写|xiě}{一|yì}{篇|piān}{关于|guān yú}{家乡|jiā xiāng}{的|de}{作文|zuò wén}。
vocab.exampleEn: The teacher asked us to write a composition about our hometowns.

readingList.title: Chinese Breeze (汉语风) graded readers, levels 4 and 5
readingList.level: Level 4 (1,100 base words), level 5 (1,500 base words)
readingList.note: Original stories written for learners, each level built on a fixed number of base words. Level 4 sits well inside the 2,000 words of HSK 4, so it's reading for speed and pleasure; level 5 is the step beyond. Paid; sold by many booksellers (the link is one).

readingList.title: Mandarin Companion graded readers
readingList.level: Breakthrough, Level I and Level II
readingList.note: Short novels for learners, many of them classic novels retold and moved to a Chinese setting. After HSK 4 even Level II is comfortable, which makes these good for reading a whole book quickly without a dictionary, the habit that builds reading speed for the exam. Paid.

readingList.title: The Chairman's Bao
readingList.level: News articles graded by HSK level (1–6)
readingList.note: Short news stories rewritten for learners, in six HSK-graded levels, with recorded audio, a one-tap dictionary and exercises. Read the HSK 4 articles for the written register of this course (将, 由于, 此外) and try HSK 5 ones for a challenge. A subscription service; sample lessons are free once you register.

readingList.title: Mandarin Bean
readingList.level: Beginner to advanced, lessons labelled HSK 1 to 6+
readingList.note: Graded texts marked with HSK levels, with recordings by teachers, pinyin, tap-to-translate words and a simplified or traditional view. Read the HSK 4 lessons with pinyin off, then listen to the recording without the text. The graded lessons are free; some extras may need an account.

readingList.title: Du Chinese
readingList.note: An app and website of graded stories and articles with audio and a pop-up dictionary. After this course the Intermediate and Upper Intermediate lessons fit; listen first, then read. A limited selection is free (many stories have a free first chapter); the rest needs a subscription.

readingList.title: Chinese Grammar Wiki
readingList.note: A free reference of Chinese grammar points sorted by level, each with many example sentences in characters, pinyin and English. Its B1 and B2 pages cover this course's grammar (连…都, 即使…也, 不管…都, 既然…就, 不如, double negatives, 难道); use it when you want more examples of a pattern.

readingList.title: HSK sample papers and syllabus
readingList.note: The official HSK site, with the HSK 3.0 syllabus, sample questions and online demos of the new exam, test dates and test centres. Do a sample paper in the last weeks before the test (lesson 30), and check the format, the speaking test and the pass mark there before you register.
